title: NIR-II photothermal-driven pulsatile PTH release for osteoporotic bone repair
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Integrating light-controlled intelligent materials into 3D printing technology holds great promise for bone tissue engineering, enabling spatiotemporal control over in situ drug dosing. However, this integration faces a critical molecular design challenge, as incorporated photoresponsive molecules must simultaneously fulfill the dual demands of high UV-stability during UV-mediated photopolymerization, and strong long-wavelength absorption for deep-tissue activation. Here, we report a wavelength-selective quinolinium dye (QC7CN) as photoresponsive ‘dye ink’ for addressing this dilemma. This dye features high UV-transparency that ensures stability during printing process, while possessing robust second near infrared (NIR-II) absorbance for deep-seated photothermal responsiveness. Leveraging these properties, we engineer a NIR-II light-controlled 3D-printed scaffold, composed of methacryloylated gelatin and calcium phosphate oligomers as printing matrix, thermosensitive phase-transformable microspheres as parathyroid hormone (PTH) drug carrier, and QC7CN as photothermal trigger. Upon NIR-II laser irradiation, QC7CN induces localized mild hyperthermia to drive gel-sol phase transition of microspheres, thereby manipulating pulsatile PTH release for deep-tissue osteoporotic bone repair. As such, our study provides a full demonstration in molecular design and additive manufacturing to push the limits of intelligent materials in precision medicine.
title_zh: NIR-II 光热驱动脉冲 PTH 释放用于骨质疏松骨修复
abstract_zh: 将光控智能材料集成到 3D 打印技术中，为骨组织工程带来了巨大的希望，可以实现原位药物剂量的时空控制。然而，这种集成面临着关键的分子设计挑战，因为合并的光响应分子必须同时满足紫外线介导的光聚合期间的高紫外线稳定性和深层组织激活的强长波长吸收的双重要求。在这里，我们报告了一种波长选择性喹啉鎓染料（QC7CN）作为光响应“染料墨水”来解决这一困境。该染料具有高紫外线透明度，可确保打印过程中的稳定性，同时具有强大的第二近红外 (NIR-II) 吸光度，可实现深层光热响应。利用这些特性，我们设计了一种 NIR-II 光控 3D 打印支架，由甲基丙烯酰化明胶和磷酸钙低聚物作为打印基质，热敏相变微球作为甲状旁腺激素 (PTH) 药物载体，QC7CN 作为光热触发器组成。在 NIR-II 激光照射下，QC7CN 诱导局部温和热疗，驱动微球的凝胶-溶胶相变，从而操纵脉动 PTH 释放，实现深部组织骨质疏松骨修复。因此，我们的研究为分子设计和增材制造提供了充分的论证，以突破智能材料在精准医学中的极限。

title: Catecholamine modulation of frontal cortical ignition during wakefulness, sleep, and anesthesia
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Conscious awareness—diminished during non-rapid-eye-movement (NREM) sleep and general anesthesia—is prevalent during wakefulness, but the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Here we show that activity of catecholamine neurons, known to be higher during wakefulness than NREM sleep, enhances cortical ignition, a process closely associated with conscious awareness. Chemogenetic activation and inactivation of catecholamine neurons, particularly dopaminergic neurons in the ventral tegmental area (VTA), respectively increased and decreased the amplitude of anterior cingulate area (ACA) excitation evoked by visual cortex (V1) stimulation. Ketamine and isoflurane, two commonly used general anesthetics, greatly reduced V1-to-ACA activity propagation. In addition to suppressing ongoing cortical activity, these general anesthetics significantly reduced the activity of VTA dopaminergic and basal forebrain (BF) cholinergic neurons, with dopaminergic activity dropping well below its level during NREM sleep. The strong inhibition of frontal cortical activity evoked by V1 stimulation, prominent during NREM sleep, was also absent under ketamine and isoflurane anesthesia. These results indicate that general anesthesia and NREM sleep suppress global ignition through overlapping but non-identical mechanisms.
title_zh: 儿茶酚胺对清醒、睡眠和麻醉期间额叶皮质点火的调节
abstract_zh: 在非快速眼动 (NREM) 睡眠和全身麻醉期间，清醒意识普遍存在，但其潜在机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们发现儿茶酚胺神经元的活动（已知在清醒状态下比非快速眼动睡眠时更高）增强了皮质点火，这是一个与意识意识密切相关的过程。儿茶酚胺神经元，特别是腹侧被盖区（VTA）中的多巴胺能神经元的化学遗传学激活和失活分别增加和减少了视觉皮层（V1）刺激引起的前扣带区（ACA）兴奋的幅度。氯胺酮和异氟烷是两种常用的全身麻醉剂，可大大降低 V1 至 ACA 活性的传播。除了抑制正在进行的皮质活动外，这些全身麻醉药还显着降低了 VTA 多巴胺能和基底前脑 (BF) 胆碱能神经元的活性，其中多巴胺能活性降至远低于 NREM 睡眠期间的水平。 V1 刺激引起的额叶皮层活动的强烈抑制在 NREM 睡眠期间很明显，但在氯胺酮和异氟烷麻醉下也不存在。这些结果表明全身麻醉和 NREM 睡眠通过重叠但不相同的机制抑制全局点火。

title: Breaking steric hindrance restriction: compressed metal bonds realizing deep-level orbital delocalization
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: The introduction of large functional groups is a well-established strategy to enhance the stability and value of chemicals. However, the accompanying steric hindrance effects can significantly impede reaction progress, presenting a critical dilemma in synthetic design. Herein, a vacancy-constrained strategy was proposed to breaking steric hindrance restriction by realizing the deep-level delocalization of catalyst with compressed metal bonds. In detail, the delocalized deep-level orbit exhibits strong penetrating capability to overcome the steric hindrance effect of large functional groups by enhancing the charge-transfer process between the active sites and substrates. By taking bismuth atoms supported on defective CeO2 as an example, an ‘O4-Bi-Bi-O4’ ensemble was constructed by confining two adjacent Bi atoms in the vacancy of CeO2 nanosheets, where the Bi–Bi bond was strongly constrained from 3.10 Å to 3.05 Å. Such a functional Bi2/CeO2 catalyst exhibits enhanced photocatalytic efficiency in overcoming the steric hindrance from large functional groups, which is three times and two times higher than that of Bi single-atom catalyst and Bi clusters catalyst. This work proposed an applicable way in overcoming steric hindrance effects during high value-added chemical synthesis.
title_zh: 突破空间位阻限制：压缩金属键实现深能级轨道离域
abstract_zh: 引入大官能团是提高化学品稳定性和价值的行之有效的策略。然而，伴随的空间位阻效应会严重阻碍反应进程，给合成设计带来严重的困境。在此，提出了一种空位约束策略，通过压缩金属键实现催化剂的深层次离域化来打破空间位阻限制。具体而言，离域深能级轨道表现出强大的穿透能力，通过增强活性位点和底物之间的电荷转移过程来克服大官能团的空间位阻效应。以缺陷CeO2上负载的铋原子为例，通过将两个相邻的Bi原子限制在CeO2纳米片的空位中，构建了“O4-Bi-Bi-O4”系综，其中Bi-Bi键被强烈限制在3.10 Å至3.05 Å之间。这种功能性Bi2/CeO2催化剂在克服大官能团的空间位阻方面表现出增强的光催化效率，比Bi单原子催化剂和Bi簇催化剂高3倍和2倍。这项工作提出了一种在高附加值化学合成过程中克服空间位阻效应的适用方法。

title: Multimodal scanning-probe quantum sensing of quantum materials
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Spin-defect-based quantum microscopy has recently made transformative advances in cutting-edge scientific research and technological innovation. The high sensitivity, high spatial resolution and excellent measurement modalities of quantum spin defects open up a range of opportunities at the forefront of condensed-matter physics research. Many of the advantages of this approach result from the quantum mechanical nature of the sensors, which offer functionalities that are not available with their classical counterparts. In this Review, we provide an overview of progress on scanning-probe nitrogen-vacancy quantum sensing research and its application to investigating the physics of emergent quantum materials with nanoscale spatial resolution. We also discuss quantum sensing platforms built on more recently discovered spin defects in one-dimensional and two-dimensional materials beyond nitrogen-vacancy centres. We conclude with an outlook on future directions and opportunities for these rapidly advancing quantum sensing technologies.
title_zh: 量子材料的多模态扫描探针量子传感
abstract_zh: 基于自旋缺陷的量子显微镜最近在尖端科学研究和技术创新方面取得了革命性的进展。量子自旋缺陷的高灵敏度、高空间分辨率和出色的测量方式为凝聚态物理研究的前沿开辟了一系列机会。这种方法的许多优点源于传感器的量子力学性质，它提供了传统传感器所不具备的功能。在这篇综述中，我们概述了扫描探针氮空位量子传感研究的进展及其在研究具有纳米级空间分辨率的新兴量子材料物理方面的应用。我们还讨论了基于最近发现的氮空位中心之外的一维和二维材料中的自旋缺陷构建的量子传感平台。最后，我们对这些快速发展的量子传感技术的未来方向和机遇进行了展望。

title: Gas–Responsive Metal–Organic Frameworks for Adaptive Thermal Energy Storage with Tunable Charge–Discharge Temperatures
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: One of the major challenges for thermal energy storage (TES) systems based on phase change materials (PCMs)─a key technology for energy decarbonization─is achieving dynamical tunability of their charge and discharge temperatures (Tcharge, Tdischarge). This capability would enable a single material to operate effectively across varying ambient conditions (e.g., different times of day, seasons, or climates) without requiring the use of multiple TES materials. In this work, we present a gas-responsive TES solution based on breathing caloric MOFs, particularly MOF-508b, in which transition temperatures can be widely tuned from -30 to 120 °C (243 to 393 K) by adjusting the surrounding CO2 pressure from 5 to 25 bar under isobaric conditions. More importantly, we demonstrate that this method allows precise control over the thermal hysteresis (|Tcharge - Tdischarge|) and can even reverse the transition temperatures (Tcharge < Tdischarge), which could be highly advantageous for temperature-driven TES applications. These findings pave the way for adaptive thermal technologies in which a single material can respond to different ambient temperatures and diverse storage needs, from cold storage to medium-high-temperature applications. We anticipate that this gas-responsive behavior is not exclusive to MOF-508b and encourage the exploration of other materials exhibiting similar tunable characteristics for adaptive TES applications.
title_zh: 用于具有可调充放电温度的自适应热能存储的气体响应金属有机框架
abstract_zh: 基于相变材料 (PCM) 的热能存储 (TES) 系统（能源脱碳的关键技术）的主要挑战之一是实现充电和放电温度（Tcharge、Tdischarge）的动态可调性。这种能力将使单一材料能够在不同的环境条件（例如，一天中的不同时间、季节或气候）下有效运行，而无需使用多种 TES 材料。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于呼吸热量MOF（特别是MOF-508b）的气体响应TES解决方案，其中通过在等压条件下将周围的CO2压力从5巴调整到25巴，可以在-30到120°C（243到393 K）范围内广泛调整转变温度。更重要的是，我们证明这种方法可以精确控制热滞（|Tcharge - Tdischarge|），甚至可以逆转转变温度（Tcharge < Tdischarge），这对于温度驱动的 TES 应用非常有利。这些发现为自适应热技术铺平了道路，在这种技术中，单一材料可以响应不同的环境温度和不同的存储需求，从冷藏到中高温应用。我们预计这种气体响应行为并非 MOF-508b 所独有，并鼓励探索具有类似可调特性的其他材料，用于自适应 TES 应用。

title: In Situ and Operando Studies as Mechanistic Toolbox for Redox Flow Batteries, Redox Targeting, and CO 2 Capture Systems: Progress and Perspective
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: As renewable energy deployment accelerates, safe and scalable long-duration energy storage (LDES) becomes increasingly critical. Redox flow batteries (RFBs) offer intrinsic nonflammability and decoupled energy-power architectures, yet multihour operation and multidecade lifetimes demand precise and state-resolved diagnostics. These challenges are intensified for organic redox-active species and emerging architectures such as redox-targeting flow batteries and electrochemical CO2 capture systems. This perspective highlights recent advances in in situ and operando spectroscopic and electrochemical tools, including UV-vis-NIR, NMR/EPR, vibrational spectroscopy, X-ray technique, fluorescence microscopy, neutron imaging, ultramicroelectrodes, and SECM, that resolve electrolyte speciation, transient intermediates, aggregation, and interfacial kinetics. These methodologies establish a mechanistic framework for rational electrolyte design and next-generation RFB development.
title_zh: 原位和操作研究作为氧化还原液流电池、氧化还原靶向和CO 2 捕获系统的机械工具箱：进展和前景
abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源部署的加速，安全且可扩展的长期储能（LDES）变得越来越重要。氧化还原液流电池 (RFB) 具有固有的不可燃性和解耦的能量-功率架构，但数小时的运行和数十年的使用寿命需要精确的状态解析诊断。对于有机氧化还原活性物质和新兴架构（例如氧化还原靶向液流电池和电化学二氧化碳捕获系统）来说，这些挑战更加严峻。这一观点强调了原位和操作光谱和电化学工具的最新进展，包括紫外可见近红外、核磁共振/电子顺磁共振、振动光谱、X射线技术、荧光显微镜、中子成像、超微电极和SECM，可解决电解质形态、瞬态中间体、聚集和界面动力学。这些方法为合理的电解质设计和下一代 RFB 开发建立了机械框架。

title: Utilizing Vibrational Probes to Monitor Polaron–Anion Interactions during Polymer Electrochemical Doping
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Understanding the electrostatic interactions between an electrical charge carrier (polaron) and the compensating counterion, and how they evolve during the electrochemical doping of mixed ionic-electronic conducting polymers, is critical for designing new materials to enable applications from bioelectronics to neuromorphic computing. However, direct experimental probes of these interactions remain limited, hindering their development. Here, we introduce an in situ spectroelectrochemistry (SEC) approach that combines visible (vis), near-infrared (NIR), and infrared (IR) spectroscopy with the vibrational Stark effect to directly monitor polaron-ion pairs during the electrochemical doping of mixed conducting polymers. Using poly[3-(ethyl-4-butanoate)thiophene-2,5-diyl] (P3EBT) as a model, we exploit the ester carbonyl in its side chain as an internal vibrational probe of the local electrostatic field created by the polaron and its counterion. Using stepwise vis/NIR/IR SEC, we assign multiple stages of electrochemical doping. Stage 1 occurs at low voltages and features highly delocalized, two-dimensional polarons in aggregates and crystalline domains of the polymer. During stage 2, ions intercalate these domains, causing polarons to localize to single chains due to electrostatic trapping. After this, polarons form in the amorphous regions during stage 3. Calibrating the vibrational probe using a combination of vibrational solvatochromism measurements and molecular dynamic simulations, we quantify doping level-dependent changes in the electrostatic interactions between electronic and ionic charges, with changes in the detected local electric field strength as high as 5 MV/cm. These measurements suggest that polaron-ion distance governs trapping at low voltages, while polymer chain coherence length and bipolaron formation play a larger role at higher voltages. This work establishes the vibrational Stark effect probe as a powerful spectroelectrochemical tool for investigating mixed conducting materials.
title_zh: 利用振动探针监测聚合物电化学掺杂过程中极化子-阴离子相互作用
abstract_zh: 了解电荷载体（极化子）和补偿反离子之间的静电相互作用，以及它们在混合离子电子导电聚合物的电化学掺杂过程中如何演变，对于设计新材料以实现从生物电子学到神经形态计算的应用至关重要。然而，对这些相互作用的直接实验探索仍然有限，阻碍了它们的发展。在这里，我们介绍了一种原位光谱电化学（SEC）方法，该方法将可见光（vis）、近红外（NIR）和红外（IR）光谱与振动斯塔克效应相结合，以直接监测混合导电聚合物电化学掺杂过程中的极化子-离子对。使用聚[3-(4-丁酸乙酯)噻吩-2,5-二基] (P3EBT) 作为模型，我们利用其侧链中的酯羰基作为极化子及其反离子产生的局部静电场的内部振动探针。使用逐步可见光/近红外/红外 SEC，我们分配了电化学掺杂的多个阶段。第一阶段发生在低电压下，其特征是聚合物的聚集体和晶域中具有高度离域的二维极化子。在第二阶段，离子插入这些域，导致极化子由于静电捕获而定位于单链。此后，在第 3 阶段，非晶区域中形成极化子。结合振动溶剂化变色测量和分子动力学模拟来校准振动探针，我们量化了电子之间静电相互作用的掺杂水平相关变化。

title: Out-of-plane Ruddlesden–Popper ferroelectrics catch a break
source: Nature Electronics
abstract: By breaking the symmetry of a Ruddlesden–Popper ferroelectric material, an out-of-plane dielectric material with high tunability and low loss can be fabricated.
title_zh: 平面外鲁德尔斯登-波普尔铁电体迎来突破
abstract_zh: 通过打破 Ruddlesden-Popper 铁电材料的对称性，可以制造出具有高可调性和低损耗的面外介电材料。

title: A High-Performance Si-Based Photocathode Enhanced by Spatial Confinement Strategy for Photoelectrochemical Hydrogen Production
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Metallic materials (such as Ti, Pt, and Ag) modified on silicon-based photocathodes exhibit strong light reflection, which significantly hinders light absorption by the underlying silicon (Si), thereby limiting the efficiency of Si-based photocathodes. Herein, a high-performance Si-based photocathode is designed by spatial confinement strategy. The Pt cocatalysts are confined to the Ti protective layer at the top of the pyramid, which serve as catalytic active sites for the photoelectrochemical hydrogen evolution reaction. The other regions are covered by the SiO2 layer, which allow incident light to penetrate and be absorbed by the underlying Si. This design effectively suppresses parasitic light absorption, thereby enhancing the photoelectrochemical performance of the Si-based photocathodes. In addition, the SiO2 layer and the Ti layer can protect Si from being corroded by the electrolyte. Under 1 sun (AM 1.5G) illumination, the OP-Si/SiO2/Ti/Pt photocathode exhibits an onset potential of 0.415 V vs reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE) and a photocurrent density of -13.93 mA cm-2 at 0 V vs RHE, which is significantly superior to the control photocathode (OP-Si/Ti/Pt). This work provides a promising avenue to develop highly efficient Si-based photocathodes.
title_zh: 空间限制策略增强的高性能硅基光电阴极用于光电化学制氢
abstract_zh: 在硅基光电阴极上修饰的金属材料（如Ti、Pt和Ag）表现出强烈的光反射，这显着阻碍了底层硅（Si）的光吸收，从而限制了硅基光电阴极的效率。在此，通过空间限制策略设计了高性能硅基光电阴极。 Pt助催化剂被限制在金字塔顶部的Ti保护层中，作为光电化学析氢反应的催化活性位点。其他区域被 SiO2 层覆盖，允许入射光穿透并被下面的 Si 吸收。这种设计有效地抑制了寄生光吸收，从而提高了硅基光电阴极的光电化学性能。另外，SiO2层和Ti层可以保护Si不被电解液腐蚀。在1太阳（AM 1.5G）光照下，OP-Si/SiO2/Ti/Pt光电阴极的起始电位相对于可逆氢电极（RHE）为0.415 V，0 V相对于RHE的光电流密度为-13.93 mA cm-2，明显优于对照光电阴极（OP-Si/Ti/Pt）。这项工作为开发高效硅基光电阴极提供了一条有前途的途径。

title: Ultrafast Plasmonic Nanocavity Thermocycler for Direct Real-Time Reverse Transcription PCR at a Point-of-Care Level
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Rapid molecular diagnostics remain constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: nucleic acid extraction and slow thermocycling, which together limit true point-of-care deployment. Here we report ultrafast plasmonic nanocavity thermocycler (PNT) for direct real-time reverse transcription PCR (DRT-qPCR) at a point-of-care level. The PNT features a plasmonic nanocavity of clustered Au, silicon dioxide (SiO2), and Au thin film, with Pt resistance temperature detector and a white light-emitting diode (WLED). Under WLED illumination, the PNT shows highly efficient photothermal conversion with rapid heating (20.4 °C/s) and cooling (7.5 °C/s) rates, completing 40 thermocycles in 269 s. The PNT is compactly integrated with a microlens array fluorescence camera and a disposable PCR cartridge into a palm-sized real-time PCR system. The DRT-qPCR completes sample preparation, reverse transcription, and PCR amplification in less than 15 min, achieving amplification efficiency comparable to a commercial benchtop PCR machine. Clinical validation with 60 SARS-CoV-2 samples demonstrates 87.1% sensitivity, 100% specificity, and 93.3% diagnostic accuracy, with all false negatives successfully detected upon retesting. The PNT-based DRT-qPCR can provide a precise and scalable solution for rapid molecular diagnostics in decentralized and time-sensitive settings across diverse infectious diseases.
title_zh: 用于护理点水平直接实时逆转录 PCR 的超快等离子体纳米腔热循环仪
abstract_zh: 快速分子诊断仍然受到两个基本瓶颈的限制：核酸提取和缓慢的热循环，这两者共同限制了真正的现场护理部署。在这里，我们报告了用于即时护理水平的直接实时逆转录 PCR (DRT-qPCR) 的超快等离子体纳米腔热循环仪 (PNT)。 PNT 具有由簇状 Au、二氧化硅 (SiO2) 和 Au 薄膜组成的等离子体纳米腔，并配有 Pt 电阻温度检测器和白色发光二极管 (WLED)。在 WLED 照明下，PNT 显示出高效的光热转换，具有快速加热 (20.4 °C/s) 和冷却 (7.5 °C/s) 速率，在 269 秒内完成 40 个热循环。 PNT 与微透镜阵列荧光相机和一次性 PCR 盒紧凑集成到手掌大小的实时 PCR 系统中。 DRT-qPCR在不到15分钟内完成样品制备、反转录和PCR扩增，达到与商用台式PCR机相当的扩增效率。对 60 个 SARS-CoV-2 样本进行的临床验证显示出 87.1% 的敏感性、100% 的特异性和 93.3% 的诊断准确性，并且在重新测试后成功检测到所有假阴性。基于 PNT 的 DRT-qPCR 可以为多种传染病的分散和时间敏感环境中的快速分子诊断提供精确且可扩展的解决方案。

title: The Selective Routing of Plasmonic Interface Charge Transfer in Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy or Chemical Reaction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Plasmon-induced interface charge transfer has garnered enduring and widespread interest over the half century, starting from the chemical enhancement mechanism (CM) in surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) and climaxing with plasmon-mediated chemical reactions (PMCR). However, its mechanisms on various applications are tangled, severely hindering the development of related fields. Thus, it is urgent to reveal what dominates the selective routing of transferred electrons in enhanced spectroscopy and/or reaction. Herein, we elucidated direct electron transfer as the core process governing CM, with the number and lifetime of transferred electrons as key descriptors. Furthermore, we discovered that the CM for SERS and the chemical interface damping for PMCR are competitive, determined by the lifetimes of transferred electrons. Also, we emphasized the enhancement effect of the local electromagnetic field on interfacial electron transfer, revealing the overlooked synergy between CM and electromagnetic field enhancement. This work provides insights into CM and pursues the frontiers of interfacial electron transfer and related applications.
title_zh: 增强拉曼光谱或化学反应中等离子体界面电荷转移的选择性路由
abstract_zh: 从表面增强拉曼光谱 (SERS) 中的化学增强机制 (CM) 开始，到等离激元介导的化学反应 (PMCR) 达到顶峰，半个世纪以来，等离激元诱导的界面电荷转移引起了持久和广泛的兴趣。然而其在各个应用上的机制却比较纠结，严重阻碍了相关领域的发展。因此，迫切需要揭示增强光谱和/或反应中转移电子选择性路径的主导因素。在此，我们阐明了直接电子转移作为控制 CM 的核心过程，其中转移电子的数量和寿命作为关键描述符。此外，我们发现 SERS 的 CM 和 PMCR 的化学界面阻尼具有竞争性，这取决于转移电子的寿命。此外，我们强调了局域电磁场对界面电子转移的增强作用，揭示了 CM 和电磁场增强之间被忽视的协同作用。这项工作提供了对 CM 的见解，并探索了界面电子转移和相关应用的前沿。

title: Multidentate Phosphine Oxide Ligands for Regulating Surface Coordination and Electronic Coupling in CsPbI 3 Quantum Dot Solar Cells
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: All-inorganic CsPbI 3 perovskite quantum dots (PQDs) suffer from a long-standing trade-off between effective surface passivation and efficient interdot charge transport. Here, we identify ligand denticity as a key parameter governing this balance using mono-, bi-, and tetradentate phosphine oxide ligands. Increasing denticity strengthens surface coordination and suppresses defect-assisted recombination but simultaneously introduces steric constraints that weaken interdot electronic coupling. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the bidentate ligand 2-TPPO preferentially adopts an energetically favorable bridging configuration between adjacent PQDs, enabling both strong surface binding and efficient carrier transport. Consistent with this mechanism, 2-TPPO-treated PQD solids exhibit reduced trap density and improved structural ordering. Consequently, CsPbI 3 PQD solar cells achieve an efficiency of 17.1% with enhanced operational stability. These findings establish ligand denticity as a molecular design principle for balancing defect passivation and electronic coupling in PQD solids.
title_zh: 用于调节 CsPbI 3 量子点太阳能电池中表面配位和电子耦合的多齿氧化膦配体
abstract_zh: 全无机 CsPbI 3 钙钛矿量子点 (PQD) 长期以来一直面临着有效表面钝化和有效点间电荷传输之间的权衡问题。在这里，我们使用单齿、双齿和四齿氧化膦配体将配体齿数确定为控制这种平衡的关键参数。密度的增加增强了表面配位并抑制了缺陷辅助复合，但同时引入了空间约束，削弱了点间电子耦合。密度泛函理论计算表明，双齿配体 2-TPPO 优先在相邻 PQD 之间采用能量上有利的桥接构型，从而实现强表面结合和有效的载流子传输。与该机制一致，2-TPPO 处理的 PQD 固体表现出降低的陷阱密度和改善的结构有序性。因此，CsPbI 3 PQD 太阳能电池的效率达到 17.1%，并且运行稳定性增强。这些发现将配体密度确立为平衡 PQD 固体中的缺陷钝化和电子耦合的分子设计原理。

title: Direct Evidence of Photoinduced Protonation-Site Switching in Flavins
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Flavins frequently operate as visible-light photoreceptor in both biological and artificial systems. Previous studies (mostly computational) suggest photoinduced protonation-site switching as the fundamental origin of the flavin photoreactivity. In particular, photoexcitation is predicted to change the preferred protonation site to the opposite side of the tricyclic aromatic flavin ring. However, direct experimental identification of such protonation-site switching by photoexcitation has remained an outstanding challenge. Herein, we directly prove the photoinduced protonation-site switching by combining cryogenic ion-trap infrared spectroscopy with controlled microsolvation by water molecules. Using protonated lumiflavin as prototypical model flavin, we show that S1 ← S0 photoexcitation triggers proton transfer catalyzed by a water bridge across the aromatic ring. These results provide a general design principle of flavin photochemistry, with implications for developing biological/artificial photoactive molecules.
title_zh: 黄素中光诱导质子化位点转换的直接证据
abstract_zh: 黄素经常在生物和人工系统中充当可见光感光体。先前的研究（主要是计算）表明光诱导质子化位点转换是黄素光反应性的基本起源。特别是，光激发预计会将优选的质子化位点改变到三环芳香黄素环的另一侧。然而，通过光激发直接实验鉴定这种质子化位点仍然是一个突出的挑战。在此，我们通过将低温离子阱红外光谱与水分子控制的微溶剂化相结合，直接证明了光诱导质子化位点转换。使用质子化的光黄素作为典型模型黄素，我们证明 S1 ← S0 光激发触发由跨芳环的水桥催化的质子转移。这些结果提供了黄素光化学的一般设计原理，对开发生物/人造光活性分子具有重要意义。

title: Engineering a Thiamine-Dependent Benzoylformate Decarboxylase for Stereodivergent Radical C(sp 3 )–C(sp 3 ) Bond Formation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The stereodivergent construction of C(sp3)-C(sp3) bonds between two prochiral radicals remains a formidable challenge. Here, we report the engineering of a thiamine-diphosphate-dependent radical enzyme to catalyze redox-neutral and stereodivergent cross-coupling of two electrophilic C(sp3) precursors. This new-to-nature enzyme reactivity was achieved via light-accelerated single-electron transfer from an unprecedented enzymatic vinyl Breslow intermediate, generating two distinct prochiral radicals whose stereoselective recombination forges the new C(sp3)-C(sp3) bond. Through systematic protein engineering, we developed four enzyme variants that collectively deliver all four stereoisomers with high efficiency (up to 82% yield, 99% enantiomeric excess (ee) and >20:1 diastereomeric ratio (d.r.)). This work establishes a platform for enzymatic, reductant-free radical cross-coupling with simultaneous control over two C(sp3) stereocenters.
title_zh: 设计用于立体发散​​自由基 C(sp 3 )–C(sp 3 ) 键形成的硫胺素依赖性苯甲酰甲酸脱羧酶
abstract_zh: 两个前手性基团之间的 C(sp3)-C(sp3) 键的立体发散结构仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们报告了硫胺素二磷酸依赖性自由基酶的工程设计，以催化两个亲电 C(sp3) 前体的氧化还原中性和立体发散交叉偶联。这种新颖的酶反应性是通过前所未有的酶促乙烯基 Breslow 中间体的光加速单电子转移实现的，产生两个不同的前手性自由基，其立体选择性重组形成新的 C(sp3)-C(sp3) 键。通过系统的蛋白质工程，我们开发了四种酶变体，它们共同高效地传递所有四种立体异构体（产率高达 82%、对映体过量 (ee) 和 >20:1 非对映体比例 (d.r.)）。这项工作建立了一个酶催化、还原剂-自由基交叉偶联的平台，同时控制两个 C(sp3) 立构中心。

title: Alternating Current-Driven Hydrogen Isotope Labeling of Aliphatic Amines Using 1,3-Propanedithiol as an Efficient Hydrogen Atom Transfer Reagent
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Hydrogen isotope exchange (HIE) plays a pivotal role in the synthesis of isotopically labeled compounds, which are widely used in the pharmaceutical industry for drug pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic studies. While electrochemical HIE has emerged as a powerful strategy for site-selective labeling of C-H bonds, extending its application to alkyl amine-containing drugs has been hindered by the instability of α-amino radicals and their susceptibility to overoxidation. Here, we report the first electrochemical HIE protocol that enables efficient deuterium (D) labeling of both cyclic and acyclic alkyl amine substrates. The key innovation lies in using 1,3-propanedithiol as the hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) catalyst, which could in situ generate a potent HAT agent─a mercaptothiyl radical─via alternating current electrolysis. This radical benefits from a significantly weakened effective S-H bond dissociation energy of 34 kcal/mol compared to conventional monothiol HAT catalysts (∼80 kcal/mol), driven by exothermic disulfide ring formation. Mechanistic studies and computational analyses reveal a strong structure-activity relationship among dithiols, identifying 1,3-propanedithiol as the optimal catalyst, which is uniquely suited to balance fast HAT kinetics with efficient regeneration of the dithiol. The application of this method to over 30 pharmaceutically relevant compounds achieved up to 3.7 D per molecule. This work addresses a long-standing challenge in electrochemical HIE and introduces a new HAT platform with broad potential in synthetic and biological chemistry.
title_zh: 使用 1,3-丙二硫醇作为高效氢原子转移试剂进行交流电驱动的脂肪胺氢同位素标记
abstract_zh: 氢同位素交换（HIE）在同位素标记化合物的合成中发挥着关键作用，这些化合物广泛应用于制药行业的药物药代动力学和药效学研究。虽然电化学 HIE 已成为 C-H 键位点选择性标记的强大策略，但由于 α-氨基自由基的不稳定性及其对过度氧化的敏感性，其在含烷基胺药物中的应用扩展受到阻碍。在这里，我们报告了第一个电化学 HIE 协议，该协议能够对环状和无环烷基胺底物进行高效的氘 (D) 标记。关键创新在于使用1,3-丙二硫醇作为氢原子转移（HAT）催化剂，通过交流电解原位产生有效的HAT试剂——巯基自由基。与传统的单硫醇 HAT 催化剂（〜80 kcal/mol）相比，由放热二硫环形成驱动，该自由基受益于 34 kcal/mol 的有效 S-H 键解离能显着减弱。机理研究和计算分析揭示了二硫醇之间存在很强的结构-活性关系，确定 1,3-丙二硫醇是最佳催化剂，它特别适合平衡快速 HAT 动力学与二硫醇的高效再生。将该方法应用于 30 多种药学相关化合物，每个分子的检测结果高达 3.7 D。这项工作解决了电化学 HIE 中长期存在的挑战，并引入了在合成和生物化学领域具有广泛潜力的新 HAT 平台。

title: Skipped Dienes via Radical Allylic Heck Reaction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A photoinduced palladium-catalyzed allylic Heck reaction has been developed, enabling direct coupling of allylic electrophiles with alkenes to furnish densely functionalized skipped and conjugated dienes. The transformation proceeds through a hybrid Pd allyl radical intermediate, which allows efficient and regioselective C-C bond formation while exhibiting broad substrate scope and high functional group tolerance. This work introduces a distinct radical-based pathway for the allylic Heck reaction, providing a general platform for the synthesis of complex 1,4- and 1,3-diene motifs and expanding the conceptual framework of photoinduced Pd catalysis.
title_zh: 通过自由基烯丙基 Heck 反应跳过二烯
abstract_zh: 开发了一种光诱导钯催化的烯丙基 Heck 反应，使烯丙基亲电子试剂与烯烃直接偶联，形成密集官能化的跳跃二烯和共轭二烯。该转化通过杂化 Pd 烯丙基自由基中间体进行，该中间体允许有效且区域选择性的 C-C 键形成，同时表现出广泛的底物范围和高官能团耐受性。这项工作为烯丙基 Heck 反应引入了一种独特的基于自由基的途径，为复杂的 1,4- 和 1,3-二烯基序的合成提供了通用平台，并扩展了光诱导 Pd 催化的概念框架。

title: Temporal potential-induced regulation for extending alkaline electrolyzer lifespan under power fluctuations
source: Joule
abstract: Xia et al. report the temporal potential-induced regulation for large-scale alkaline water electrolyzers. Without modifying the catalyst and electrolyzer structures, this approach extends AWE durability via power supply optimization, providing a scalable and effective pathway. This work bridges electrical engineering and electrochemistry, advancing the integration of renewable energy into hydrogen infrastructure.
title_zh: 时间电位诱导调节可延长功率波动下碱性电解槽的使用寿命
abstract_zh: 夏等人。报告大型碱性水电解槽的时间电势诱导调节。该方法无需修改催化剂和电解槽结构，即可通过电源优化来延长 AWE 的耐用性，从而提供可扩展且有效的途径。这项工作将电气工程和电化学联系起来，推动可再生能源与氢基础设施的整合。

title: How the Unconventional Oxidation State Au 2+ Is Stabilized in the Halide Perovskite Cs 4 Au 3 Cl 12 : A First-Principles Study of Its Polaron Crystal Nature
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Gold in crystalline compounds is typically only stable in oxidation states Au1+ and Au3+. Even compounds with nominal Au2+ usually disproportionate into Au1+ and Au3+. Recently, Cs4Au3Cl12 was synthesized, where gold took the 2+ state in the bulk. Here, we investigate this compound using first-principles calculations and show that stabilization of the Au2+ ion is through the formation of a polaron crystal. The electronic and phononic structures suggest that the bonding network can be interpreted as a collection of [Au2+Cl4]2- and [Au3+Cl4]1- square planar motifs, and the crystal lacks a smooth pathway for Au2+ to disproportionate into Au1+ and Au3+ without creating dangling bonds. The electronic states of Au are contained within each AuCl4 motif, which allows for the Au2+ state to be localized and isolated electronically. The Au2+ sites form an ordered structure, which is driven by a strong repulsive interaction between [Au2+Cl4]2- motifs due to their lattice distortion. By considering a redox reaction, we show that Cs4Au3Cl12 has the maximal density of Au2+, and further reduction will induce a delocalized state. Cs4Au3Cl12 has a distinctive electronic structure, with a narrow gap, isolated HOMO and LUMO bands strongly localized at the Au sites, and magnetization at the Au2+ sites, making Cs4Au3Cl12 unique among quantum materials. Cs4Au3Cl12 can be a testbed to explore novel gold chemistry, opening opportunities to control the oxidation state through engineering of lattice distortions.
title_zh: 非常规氧化态 Au 2+ 如何在卤化物钙钛矿 Cs 4 Au 3 Cl 12 中稳定：极化子晶体性质的第一性原理研究
abstract_zh: 晶体化合物中的金通常仅在氧化态 Au1+ 和 Au3+ 下稳定。即使标称具有 Au2+ 的化合物通常也会歧化为 Au1+ 和 Au3+。最近，合成了 Cs4Au3Cl12，其中金大部分呈 2+ 态。在这里，我们使用第一原理计算研究了这种化合物，并表明 Au2+ 离子的稳定是通过形成极化子晶体来实现的。电子和声子结构表明键合网络可以解释为[Au2+Cl4]2-和[Au3+Cl4]1-方形平面图案的集合，并且晶体缺乏Au2+歧化为Au1+和Au3+而不产生悬空键的平滑路径。 Au 的电子态包含在每个 AuCl4 基序内，这使得 Au2+ 态能够以电子方式定位和隔离。 Au2+ 位点形成有序结构，这是由 [Au2+Cl4]2- 基序之间由于晶格畸变而产生的强烈排斥相互作用驱动的。通过考虑氧化还原反应，我们表明 Cs4Au3Cl12 具有 Au2+ 的最大密度，进一步还原将诱导离域态。 Cs4Au3Cl12 具有独特的电子结构，具有窄带隙、孤立的 HOMO 和 LUMO 能带强烈局域于 Au 位点，以及 Au2+ 位点的磁化，使 Cs4Au3Cl12 在量子材料中独一无二。 Cs4Au3Cl12 可以作为探索新型金化学的试验台，为通过晶格畸变工程控制氧化态提供机会。

title: Controlled Amine-Borane Dehydropolymerization Enabled by Mechanistic Insight Using the Ir( t Bu-POCOP)H 2 Catalyst
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A detailed kinetic, mechanism, and operando speciation study on the controlled, catalytic, cascade-like dehydropolymerization of H3B·NMeH2 to form N-methyl polyaminoborane [H2BNMeH]n (Me-PAB) using Ir(tBu-POCOP)H2 as a precatalyst is reported. Catalyst speciation, as monitored using online FlowNMR, shows the formation of a borohydride complex Ir(tBu-POCOP)(H)(BH4) during an induction period, that rapidly speciates to Ir(tBu-POCOP)H4 during productive turnover. Kinetic studies in the roles of NMeH2, trace water, and [H3B·NMeH2] on the induction period, productive catalysis and speciation reveal a complex set of processes that provide a framework for numerical and computational (DFT) modeling. Collectively these combine to support a mechanism for the dehydrogenation of H3B·NMeH2 to form the actual monomer, H2B═NMeH, that involves concerted B-H/N-H activation. By understanding the factors that control the maximum rate of dehydrogenation [ν(max)] and catalyst speciation, and deploying temperature variation and amine additives, a wide-range of Me-PAB molecular weights (Mn = 35,000-191,200 g·mol-1) can be achieved; in addition to low catalyst loadings (21 ppm), multigram scales (16 g) and water/air tolerance. The development of such systems which operate to selectively produce Me-PAB, using as-supplied substrates and simple catalysts, that also work on a scale useful for materials testing, promotes the wider exploitation of Me-PAB as a general preceramic precursor to hex-boron nitride.
title_zh: 使用 Ir( t Bu-POCOP)H 2 催化剂通过机理洞察实现受控胺-硼烷脱氢聚合
abstract_zh: 报道了使用 Ir(tBu-POCOP)H2 作为预催化剂，对 H3B·NMeH2 进行受控、催化、级联式脱氢聚合形成 N-甲基聚氨基硼烷 [H2BNMeH]n (Me-PAB) 的详细动力学、机理和操作形态研究。使用在线 FlowNMR 监测的催化剂形态显示，在诱导期内形成了硼氢化物配合物 Ir(tBu-POCOP)(H)(BH4)，并在生产周转期间迅速形成 Ir(tBu-POCOP)H4。 NMeH2、痕量水和 [H3B·NMeH2] 在诱导期、生产催化和形态形成中的作用的动力学研究揭示了一组复杂的过程，为数值和计算 (DFT) 建模提供了框架。这些共同支持 H3B·NMeH2 脱氢形成实际单体 H2B=NMeH 的机制，该机制涉及协调的 B-H/N-H 活化。通过了解控制最大脱氢速率 [ν(max)] 和催化剂形态的因素，并采用温度变化和胺添加剂，可以获得宽范围的 Me-PAB 分子量 (Mn = 35,000-191,200 g·mol-1)；除了低催化剂负载量 (21 ppm)、多克级 (16 g) 和水/空气耐受性之外。此类系统的开发可使用所提供的基材和简单催化剂选择性地生产 Me-PAB，该系统也可用于材料测试，从而促进 Me-PAB 作为六氮化硼的通用陶瓷前体的更广泛应用。

title: Negatively Curved Chiral Bilayer Nanographene
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Discrete π-π stacked nanocarbons, which serve as atomically precise models for layered graphitic materials, exhibit distinct optical and electronic properties. However, most reported examples are limited to planar building blocks. In this work, two negatively curved chiral nanographenes (1 and 2) containing a hexa[7]circulene core were synthesized. Both 1 and 2 form bilayer structures in the crystalline state, adopting eclipsed and displaced conformations, respectively. The bilayer stacking is driven by interlayer π-π and C-H···π interactions. NMR studies confirmed the well-defined bilayer structure of (1)2 in solution. Cyclic voltammetry measurements demonstrated interlayer coupling in (1)2. The inversion behavior of the chiral isomers was investigated using circular dichroism spectroscopy and theoretical calculations, revealing that the bilayer stacking stabilizes the chiral structure of (1)2. Enhanced chiroptical dissymmetry factors were observed in (1)2. This work not only establishes (1)2 as a molecular model for negatively curved bilayer graphene but also highlights the modulation of chiral behavior through stacking, offering a strategy for constructing well-defined chiral assemblies based on negatively curved nanocarbons.
title_zh: 负曲手性双层纳米石墨烯
abstract_zh: 离散的 π-π 堆叠纳米碳作为层状石墨材料的原子精确模型，表现出独特的光学和电子特性。然而，大多数报道的例子仅限于平面构建块。在这项工作中，合成了两种含有六[7]环烯核的负弯曲手性纳米石墨烯（1和2）。 1和2在结晶状态下均形成双层结构，分别采用重叠构象和置换构象。双层堆叠是由层间 π-π 和 C-H…π 相互作用驱动的。 NMR 研究证实了溶液中 (1)2 的明确双层结构。循环伏安法测量证明了 (1)2 中的层间耦合。利用圆二色光谱和理论计算研究了手性异构体的反转行为，揭示了双层堆叠稳定了(1)2的手性结构。 (1)2 中观察到增强的手性光学不对称因子。这项工作不仅建立了 (1)2 作为负弯曲双层石墨烯的分子模型，而且还强调了通过堆叠调节手性行为，为构建基于负弯曲纳米碳的明确手性组装体提供了策略。

title: Optically Detected Magnetic Resonance of a Cerium-Doped Nanocrystal: Toward the Generality of a Direct Spin-Optical Interface
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The spin-optical interface, enabling active control of spin states in materials, has attracted widespread interest. Circularly polarized light can be used to directly inject angular momentum into spin carriers by optical excitation, providing a robust means of spin polarization and readout. This approach, although featuring direct mapping between the photonic and spin quantum states, is yet underexplored among chemical systems. In this work, CaS:Ce3+ nanocrystals were used to demonstrate the chemical degrees of freedom in the realization of such a strategy. CaS host possesses high symmetry, low magnetic noise, red-shifted photoluminescence spectra, and openness to further functionalization. An analytical derivation of the exact mechanism underlying the spin selectivity in this system is presented, which is numerically verified using effective Hamiltonian parameters extracted from low-temperature photoluminescence spectra. We built a cryogenic confocal optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) spectrometer to realize the optical spin polarization in CaS:Ce3+ nanocrystals and to conduct pulsed ODMR experiments, and the results of which are compared with X-band EPR for further insights. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first realization of ODMR on chemically synthesized nanocrystals. With the current setup at 2.9 K and 350 G, we achieved spin polarization exceeding 12% and a detection limit of 105 spins. Spin-lattice relaxation time T1 = 0.65(2) ms was measured by the recovery of spin polarization. Spin coherence time T2 = 2.5(7) μs and dephasing time T2*=45(7)ns were measured by pulsed ODMR. Based on the resonance spectrum, the CaS:Ce3+ nanocrystals can function as a magnetic field sensor with an estimated sensitivity normalized to 55 fT·mol1/2·Hz-1/2.
title_zh: 掺铈纳米晶体的光学检测磁共振：走向直接自旋光学界面的通用性
abstract_zh: 自旋光学界面能够主动控制材料中的自旋态，引起了广泛的兴趣。圆偏振光可用于通过光学激发将角动量直接注入自旋载流子中，从而提供可靠的自旋偏振和读出方法。这种方法虽然具有光子和自旋量子态之间的直接映射，但在化学系统中尚未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，CaS:Ce3+纳米晶体被用来证明实现这种策略的化学自由度。 CaS主体具有高对称性、低磁噪声、红移光致发光光谱以及进一步功能化的开放性。提出了该系统中自旋选择性的确切机制的分析推导，并使用从低温光致发光光谱中提取的有效哈密顿参数进行了数值验证。我们构建了低温共焦光学检测磁共振（ODMR）光谱仪来实现 CaS:Ce3+ 纳米晶体中的光学自旋偏振并进行脉冲 ODMR 实验，并将结果与​​ X 波段 EPR 进行比较以获得进一步的见解。据我们所知，这是首次在化学合成纳米晶体上实现 ODMR。在 2.9 K 和 350 G 的当前设置下，我们实现了超过 12% 的自旋极化和 105 个自旋的检测极限。通过自旋极化的恢复测量自旋晶格弛豫时间T1 = 0.65(2) ms。自旋相干时间 T2 = 2.5(7) μs 和移相时间 T2*=45(7)ns w

title: Accelerated Directional Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer Enabled by Intrinsic Dipole Field in Biomimetic α-Helical Structure
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) is a fundamental mechanism in energy conversion processes such as photosynthesis and cellular respiration, yet its precise regulation through molecular conformation remains challenging. Here, we report a biomimetic strategy to modulate intramolecular PCET using an α-helical peptide scaffold. By grafting rhodamine dyes onto a designed peptide backbone (Pep-Rh), a well-defined α-helical structure is obtained, providing an intrinsic dipole field that is aligned with the proton transfer pathway during PCET. Spectroscopic, electrochemical, and theoretical analyses reveal that the dipole field of the α-helix accelerates PCET, outperforming nonhelical small molecule and polymeric analogues. This work establishes a new mechanistic framework for regulating PCET through structural dipoles and provides a strategy for precise control of energy conversion. The findings establish a well-defined molecular model for understanding structure-field-function relationships in photoinduced PCET systems, highlighting the role of structural dipoles at the molecular level.
title_zh: 仿生 α 螺旋结构中的固有偶极场实现加速定向质子耦合电子转移
abstract_zh: 质子耦合电子转移（PCET）是光合作用和细胞呼吸等能量转换过程的基本机制，但其通过分子构象的精确调节仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种使用 α-螺旋肽支架调节分子内 PCET 的仿生策略。通过将罗丹明染料接枝到设计的肽主链 (Pep-Rh) 上，获得了明确的 α 螺旋结构，提供了与 PCET 期间的质子转移途径对齐的内在偶极场。光谱、电化学和理论分析表明，α-螺旋的偶极场加速了 PCET，优于非螺旋小分子和聚合物类似物。这项工作建立了一个通过结构偶极子调控PCET的新机制框架，并为精确控制能量转换提供了策略。这些发现建立了一个明确的分子模型，用于理解光诱导 PCET 系统中的结构-场-功能关系，强调了结构偶极子在分子水平上的作用。

title: Entropy-Driven Assembly of Low-Density Superlattices via Shape Camouflage
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Entropy-driven colloidal assembly exploits both shape entropy and depletion entropy to form ordered superlattices (SLs). In many colloidal systems, these entropic contributions tend to favor compact, high-coordination arrangements, making the fabrication of open, low-density SLs a notable challenge. We address this challenge using a shape-camouflage-guided (SCG) strategy. By epitaxially growing sacrificial shells on nanoparticles, we decouple lattice symmetry from core morphology, allowing the shell-defined effective geometry to direct assembly and translate it into target nondense architectures after shell removal. Crucially, selective etching of the shells leaves behind self-supporting 3D frameworks stabilized by direct interparticle contacts, avoiding the collapse common in traditional template-assisted methods. We demonstrate a programmable evolution from face-centered cubic to simple cubic lattices, applying this strategy to spherical and highly anisotropic particles across 2D and 3D dimensions. Furthermore, FDTD simulations reveal that these open frameworks generate intense electromagnetic hotspots. Consequently, this strategy provides a general route for fabricating programmable, high-porosity SLs, offering versatile platforms for advanced plasmonic sensing and near-field catalysis.
title_zh: 通过形状伪装进行低密度超晶格的熵驱动组装
abstract_zh: 熵驱动的胶体组装利用形状熵和耗尽熵来形成有序超晶格（SL）。在许多胶体系统中，这些熵的贡献往往有利于紧凑、高配位的排列，使得开放、低密度SL的制造成为一个显着的挑战。我们使用形状伪装引导（SCG）策略来应对这一挑战。通过在纳米粒子上外延生长牺牲壳，我们将晶格对称性与核心形态解耦，允许壳定义的有效几何形状直接组装，并在壳去除后将其转化为目标非致密结构。至关重要的是，壳的选择性蚀刻留下了通过直接颗粒间接触稳定的自支撑 3D 框架，避免了传统模板辅助方法中常见的塌陷。我们展示了从面心立方到简单立方晶格的可编程演化，并将这种策略应用于 2D 和 3D 维度的球形和高度各向异性粒子。此外，FDTD 模拟表明这些开放框架会产生强烈的电磁热点。因此，该策略提供了制造可编程、高孔隙率SL的通用途径，为先进的等离子体传感和近场催化提供了多功能平台。

title: Impact of Metal Heterogeneity on Multivariate and High-Entropy MOF SBUs
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: In chemically complex multimetal systems, how local coordination asymmetry emerges and propagates to define the bulk structural behavior remains fundamentally unresolved. In high-entropy metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), long-range crystallographic order coexists with intrinsic chemical disorder, yet a quantitative relationship among metal identity, local coordination geometry, and lattice-scale response has not been established. Here, we demonstrate that metal heterogeneity induces well-defined, composition-dependent distortions within trinuclear secondary building units (SBUs), which propagate coherently to produce measurable lattice-level structural changes. Using a porphyrinic TCPP framework with conserved topology, metal identity was varied across mono-, bi-, tri-, and five-metal compositions containing Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, and Zn. Nearly 20 compositions and ∼50 element-specific extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) measurements provide metal-dependent bond-distance references across the full series. Single- and bimetallic references resolve M-O, M-C, and M-M distances, showing that heterometal substitution generates asymmetric, occupancy-dependent node distortions. In tri- and five-metal compositions, EXAFS signatures remain distributed rather than collapsing to a single averaged geometry, indicating persistent local heterogeneity within the conserved framework. These local distortions correlate with reproducible, composition-dependent lattice-parameter shifts while retaining long-range order. Time-resolved X-ray diffraction (XRD) and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) further reveal dynamic, metal-dependent incorporation during framework formation, while molecular dynamics (MD) simulations identify metal-nitrate binding and precursor lability as descriptors that rationalize early incorporation and late substitution trends. Together, these results provide an experimentally anchored framework for connecting metal identity, local coordination asymmetry, lattice response, and time-dependent incorporation in multivariate and high-entropy MOFs.

title: Engineering Organelle-Gated Reporters for Imaging Subcellular Enzyme Activity in Living Cells
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Enzymes catalyze biochemical reactions in all living systems, and their subcellular localizations can profoundly influence distinct cellular functions. Yet, the physiological roles of subcellular enzyme activity remain largely unexplored, owing to the lack of tools that allow imaging of enzymatic activity with organelle-level precision in living cells. Here, we present a class of fluorogenic reporters for spatiotemporally resolved imaging of enzyme activity within specific subcellular compartments, including mitochondria (Mito), lysosomes (Lyso), endoplasmic reticulum (ER), and Golgi apparatus (Golgi). These fluorogenic reporters comprise a rhodol fluorophore whose fluorescence is quenched by an enzyme-specific substrate and a bioorthogonal cage group, with signal restoration occurring only upon sequential uncaging by an organelle-localized bioorthogonal activator and subsequent enzymatic activation. We applied this versatile strategy to visualize the activity of enzymes from different families in live cells, such as leucyl aminopeptidases (LAP), γ-glutamyl transferases (GGT), and monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A). Application to LAPs revealed distinct, compartment-dependent functions: Mito-LAP activity maintained redox homeostasis in stressed cells, favoring tumor cell survival, whereas ER-LAP activity promoted antigen presentation and immune-mediated tumor cell killing. Notably, drug profiling showed that cisplatin (CDDP) and camptothecin (CPT) concurrently amplified both Mito-LAP and ER-LAP activities, eliciting opposing influences on tumor progression. These findings also inspire the development of a mitochondria-targeted inhibitor to improve anticancer efficacy. This platform offers a genetically independent, broadly adaptable framework for dissecting compartmentalized enzymology in living cells.
title_zh: 工程细胞器门控报告基因用于活细胞中亚细胞酶活性的成像
abstract_zh: 酶催化所有生命系统中的生化反应，其亚细胞定位可以深刻影响不同的细胞功能。然而，由于缺乏能够在活细胞中以细胞器水平精度对酶活性进行成像的工具，亚细胞酶活性的生理作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们提出了一类荧光报告基因，用于对特定亚细胞区室内的酶活性进行时空分辨成像，包括线粒体（Mito）、溶酶体（Lyso）、内质网（ER）和高尔基体（Golgi）。这些荧光报告分子包含对甲氨基酚荧光团，其荧光被酶特异性底物和生物正交笼基团猝灭，信号恢复仅在细胞器定位的生物正交激活剂连续解笼和随后的酶促激活时发生。我们应用这种多功能策略来可视化活细胞中不同家族的酶的活性，例如亮氨酰氨肽酶 (LAP)、γ-谷氨酰转移酶 (GGT) 和单胺氧化酶 A (MAO-A)。 LAP 的应用揭示了独特的区室依赖性功能：Mito-LAP 活性维持应激细胞中的氧化还原稳态，有利于肿瘤细胞存活，而 ER-LAP 活性则促进抗原呈递和免疫介导的肿瘤细胞杀伤。值得注意的是，药物分析显示顺铂 (CDDP) 和喜树碱 (CPT) 同时增强 Mito-LAP 和 ER-LAP 活性，对肿瘤进展产生相反的影响。这些发现还表明

title: Two-Dimensional van der Waals Polar Metal MoOBr 2
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) polar metals, which integrate long-range polar order and metallic conductivity, have garnered enormous interest for their extraordinary properties, including non-reciprocal charge transport and nonlinear optical effects. However, intrinsic 2D vdW polar metals remain exceedingly rare, as the dense itinerant electrons strongly screen internal electric fields and destabilize the macroscopic polarization needed for polar order. Herein, we report the discovery of MoOBr2, the first 2D vdW polar metal stacked by polar atomic layers. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction and atomic-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy reveal that MoOBr2 crystallizes in the non-centrosymmetric space group C2, with polarity originating from asymmetric [MoO2Br4] octahedral distortions. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and electrical transport measurements confirm its metallic behavior with a room-temperature resistivity of 5.13 × 10-5 Ω m and a carrier concentration of 1.34 × 1020 cm-3. The broken spatial inversion symmetry of MoOBr2 was further demonstrated by both second-harmonic generation and second-order nonlinear electrical transport measurement, providing the complementary signatures of the polar metallic state. Remarkably, MoOBr2 exhibits a high thermal conductivity of 219 W m-1 K-1, enabling efficient heat dissipation in high-power-density nanoscale devices. This work not only benefits next-generation multifunctional spintronic and nonlinear optoelectronic applications but also offers a rational chemical design strategy for new polar metals.
title_zh: 二维范德华极性金属 MoOBr 2
abstract_zh: 二维（2D）范德华（vdW）极性金属集成了长程极性有序和金属导电性，因其非凡的性能（包括非互易电荷传输和非线性光学效应）而引起了人们的极大兴趣。然而，本征二维 vdW 极性金属仍然极其罕见，因为密集的流动电子强烈屏蔽内部电场并破坏极性有序所需的宏观极化的稳定性。在此，我们报告了 MoOBr2 的发现，这是第一个由极性原子层堆叠的二维 vdW 极性金属。单晶X射线衍射和原子分辨率扫描透射电子显微镜表明，MoOBr2在非中心对称空间群C2中结晶，其极性源于不对称的[MoO2Br4]八面体扭曲。角分辨光电子能谱和电传输测量证实了其金属行为，室温电阻率为 5.13 × 10-5 Ω m，载流子浓度为 1.34 × 1020 cm-3。二次谐波产生和二阶非线性电输运测量进一步证明了 MoOBr2 破缺的空间反演对称性，提供了极性金属态的互补特征。值得注意的是，MoOBr2 具有 219 W m-1 K-1 的高导热率，可在高功率密度纳米级器件中实现高效散热。这项工作不仅有利于下一代多功能自旋电子和非线性光电应用，而且为新型极化提供了合理的化学设计策略。

title: Catalytic Dehydrogenation Enhanced by Controlling Platinum Nanoparticle Density
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Enhancing the catalytic activity of supported nanoparticles has traditionally relied on optimizing the nanoparticle size and electronic state. We found that optimizing nanoparticle density, while maintaining similar particle sizes and electronic states, could enhance intrinsic catalytic activity. In the catalytic dehydrogenation of cyclohexane, tuning the Pt nanoparticle density leads to a 9.6-fold increase in Pt efficiency, achieving a benzene formation rate of 24,217 molC6H6 molPt-1 h-1, which outperforms previous catalysts. The nanoparticle density-optimized catalyst remained durable during a continuous test for 800 h.
title_zh: 通过控制铂纳米颗粒密度增强催化脱氢
abstract_zh: 增强负载纳米颗粒的催化活性传统上依赖于优化纳米颗粒尺寸和电子态。我们发现，优化纳米颗粒密度，同时保持相似的颗粒尺寸和电子状态，可以增强内在的催化活性。在环己烷催化脱氢中，调节 Pt 纳米颗粒密度可使 Pt 效率提高 9.6 倍，苯的形成率为 24,217 molC6H6 molPt-1 h-1，优于之前的催化剂。纳米颗粒密度优化的催化剂在 800 小时的连续测试中保持耐用。

title: Record Carrier Diffusion Lengths in Large, Dense Nonfullerene Electron Acceptor Crystals Grown from Polar Aromatic Solvents
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Semicrystalline films of nonfullerene acceptors (NFAs) attract considerable interest for optoelectronic applications. Organic single crystals promise superior optoelectronic properties to films; however, NFA crystals have been little used in applications because of their challenging growth and micrometer-nanometer sizes. Here, phenol and acetophenone are used as aromatic, halogen-free recrystallization solvents, resulting in the growth of millimeter-sized Y6 crystals of varying polymorphisms─a crystallization technique which generalizes to other NFA molecules. The crystals show a novel structure which is denser than any previously reported for Y6. We use power-dependent fluorescence and fluorescence microscopy to demonstrate enhanced exciton diffusion lengths (70 ± 15 nm) and novel photophysical responses in these crystals compared to thin films, and compare these properties to quantum chemical calculations. This work demonstrates how material processing can improve future optoelectronics and emphasizes the critical role of molecular packing in current high-performance NFA devices.
title_zh: 由极性芳族溶剂生长的大型致密非富勒烯电子受体晶体中载流子扩散长度记录
abstract_zh: 非富勒烯受体（NFA）的半晶薄膜引起了光电应用的极大兴趣。有机单晶有望提供优于薄膜的光电性能；然而，由于 NFA 晶体的生长具有挑战性且尺寸为微米-纳米尺寸，因此在应用中很少使用。在这里，苯酚和苯乙酮被用作芳香族、无卤素重结晶溶剂，导致不同多晶型的毫米级 Y6 晶体的生长——这种结晶技术可推广到其他 NFA 分子。这些晶体表现出一种新颖的结构，比之前报道的 Y6 晶体更致密。我们使用功率依赖性荧光和荧光显微镜来证明这些晶体与薄膜相比增强的激子扩散长度（70 ± 15 nm）和新颖的光物理响应，并将这些特性与量子化学计算进行比较。这项工作展示了材料加工如何改善未来的光电子学，并强调了分子堆积在当前高性能 NFA 器件中的关键作用。
