title: Programmable Construction of Supramolecular Polymers Achieved in Neutral Lipid Environments
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Supramolecular polymerization within living cells has emerged as a promising strategy for controlling cellular functions. Lipid droplets, intracellular organelles mainly composed of neutral lipids, provide low-polarity environments, yet their role in regulating supramolecular assembly pathways remains unclear. Here we show that triolein, a representative triacylglycerol featuring three ester groups and cis-9-octadecenyl chains, acts as an effective medium for kinetically controlled supramolecular polymerization. An alanine-based diamide-functionalized fluorophore forms supramolecular polymers in triolein through a nucleation-elongation mechanism, in which an initial nucleus triggers subsequent growth. Although the thermodynamic stability is comparable to that in di-n-butyl ether, a commonly used organic solvent, triolein suppresses spontaneous nucleation and inter-fiber bundling, creating a lag phase during which seeded polymerization guides monomers along a defined assembly pathway. Kinetic studies with ethyl oleate, a structural analogue of triolein, indicate that transient solute-solvent interactions contribute to the suppression of both nucleation and bundling events. This kinetic control enables stepwise seeded growth of multiblock nanostructures and establishes neutral lipids as functional media for the precision-controlled construction of supramolecular polymers.
title_zh: 在中性脂质环境中实现超分子聚合物的可编程构建
abstract_zh: 活细胞内的超分子聚合已成为控制细胞功能的一种有前景的策略。脂滴是主要由中性脂质组成的细胞内细胞器，提供低极性环境，但其在调节超分子组装途径中的作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，三油酸甘油酯是一种具有三个酯基和顺式-9-十八碳烯基链的代表性三酰基甘油，可作为动力学控制的超分子聚合的有效介质。基于丙氨酸的二酰胺功能化荧光团通过成核-延伸机制在三油酸甘油酯中形成超分子聚合物，其中初始核触发后续生长。尽管其热力学稳定性与常用有机溶剂二正丁基醚相当，但三油酸甘油酯可抑制自发成核和纤维间成束，从而产生一个滞后阶段，在此期间种子聚合引导单体沿着确定的组装路径前进。油酸乙酯（三油酸甘油酯的结构类似物）的动力学研究表明，瞬时溶质-溶剂相互作用有助于抑制成核和成束事件。这种动力学控制能够实现多嵌段纳米结构的逐步种子生长，并建立中性脂质作为超分子聚合物精确控制结构的功能介质。

title: A virulent bacterial signature is associated with the development of recurrence following colorectal cancer surgery
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The primary treatment for non-metastatic colorectal cancer is surgical resection. Despite the use of neoadjuvant and/or adjuvant chemoradiation, up to 30% of patients undergoing surgery for colorectal cancer will develop a postoperative recurrence. Why patients develop postoperative tumors despite all known cancer being resected at the time of surgery is largely unknown, and novel biomarkers that can predict the development of recurrence are lacking. Here, we report a unique bacterial signature present in the gut during the perioperative period that is strongly associated with the development of postoperative tumors. By studying patients undergoing resection for colorectal cancer, we demonstrate that the gut microbiome on the day of surgery is enriched with collagenase-producing bacteria in patients who later develop a recurrence. This bacterial community demonstrated enhanced antimicrobial resistance, was not eradicated by the standardized perioperative bowel preparation, and could promote cancer cell migration and invasion. Our study establishes that microbiota may contribute to postoperative colorectal cancer recurrence and serve as a prognostic biomarker for postoperative oncologic outcomes.
title_zh: 有毒细菌特征与结直肠癌手术后复发的发生有关
abstract_zh: 非转移性结直肠癌的主要治疗方法是手术切除。尽管使用新辅助和/或辅助放化疗，但高达 30% 接受结直肠癌手术的患者会出现术后复发。尽管所有已知的癌症在手术时都被切除，但为什么患者在术后仍会出现肿瘤，目前尚不清楚，并且缺乏可以预测复发发展的新型生物标志物。在这里，我们报告了围手术期肠道中存在的独特细菌特征，该特征与术后肿瘤的发展密切相关。通过研究接受结直肠癌切除术的患者，我们证明手术当天的肠道微生物组富含产生胶原酶的细菌，这些细菌后来出现复发。该细菌群落表现出增强的抗菌素耐药性，标准化围手术期肠道准备无法根除，并且可以促进癌细胞迁移和侵袭。我们的研究表明，微生物群可能会导致术后结直肠癌复发，并可作为术后肿瘤结果的预后生物标志物。

title: The H3K4 methyltransferase KMT2D is an essential cofactor for GATA1 at erythroid gene enhancers
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gene expression during cellular differentiation is coordinated by combinatorial interactions between transcription factors (TFs) and cofactors. Although the TF GATA1 coordinates gene transcription in hematopoiesis, the specific cofactors required for GATA1-driven gene expression are incompletely defined. We identify the H3K4 methyltransferase KMT2D, as a cofactor of GATA1 in erythropoiesis. Loss of KMT2D in human erythroid precursors causes developmental arrest with impaired expression of numerous erythroid genes. Mechanistically, KMT2D colocalizes with GATA1 on more than one thousand erythroid enhancers, and such co-occupancy is associated with stronger transcriptional activity than occupancy by GATA1 alone. Acute depletion of KMT2D in erythroid precursors causes rapid reductions of H3K4me1 and H3K27ac on a subset of GATA1-bound enhancers and impairs their target gene expression. Moreover, acute depletion of GATA1 or KMT2D individually causes downregulation of overlapping gene sets. Our findings demonstrate how a lineage-specific TF cooperates with a ubiquitous epigenetic regulator to drive lineage-specific gene expression.
title_zh: H3K4 甲基转移酶 KMT2D 是红系基因增强子 GATA1 的重要辅助因子
abstract_zh: 细胞分化过程中的基因表达是通过转录因子 (TF) 和辅因子之间的组合相互作用来协调的。尽管 TF GATA1 协调造血过程中的基因转录，但 GATA1 驱动的基因表达所需的特定辅因子尚未完全确定。我们确定 H3K4 甲基转移酶 KMT2D 是红细胞生成过程中 GATA1 的辅助因子。人类红系前体细胞中 KMT2D 的缺失会导致发育停滞，并导致许多红系基因的表达受损。从机制上讲，KMT2D 与 GATA1 共定位于 1000 多个红细胞增强子上，并且这种共占据与单独占据 GATA1 相比更强的转录活性相关。红系前体中 KMT2D 的急性耗竭会导致 GATA1 结合增强子子集上的 H3K4me1 和 H3K27ac 快速减少，并损害其靶基因表达。此外，GATA1 或 KMT2D 的急性缺失会导致重叠基因组的下调。我们的研究结果证明了谱系特异性 TF 如何与普遍存在的表观遗传调节因子合作来驱动谱系特异性基因表达。

title: Design, synthesis and structural mechanism of action of TRPV1 agonist MSP20 with long-lasting analgesic effect
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transient receptor potential vanilloid type-1 (TRPV1) channel is a polymodal receptor involved in pain perception and neuronal signalling that represents a promising target for the development of analgesics and neuroprotective agents. In this study we implement a combination of computational techniques and targeted design of chemical libraries to discover benzothiophene-substituted TRPV1 agonists with high affinity and efficacy toward TRPV1. In vitro functional experiments show that prolonged or repeated exposure to these compounds induce calcium-dependent desensitization of TRPV1, making it insensitive to noxious stimuli. We solve a cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structure of human TRPV1 (hTRPV1) in complex with the most promising benzothiophene-substituted agonist MSP20. The structure reveals molecular details of MSP20 binding to the vanilloid site and a desensitized conformation of hTRPV1, characterized by the closed ion channel pore, α-helical C-terminus and distinct behaviour of annular lipids. Our in vivo experiments demonstrate that MSP20 exhibits robust and long-lasting antinociceptive activity with ex-vivo neuroprotective effects, supporting the perspective of benzothiophene-substituted vanilloids as future analgesics.
title_zh: 长效镇痛TRPV1激动剂MSP20的设计、合成及结构作用机制
abstract_zh: 瞬时受体电位香草酸 1 型 (TRPV1) 通道是一种参与疼痛感知和神经元信号传导的多模式受体，是镇痛药和神经保护剂开发的一个有前景的靶点。在这项研究中，我们结合了计算技术和化学库的针对性设计，以发现对 TRPV1 具有高亲和力和功效的苯并噻吩取代的 TRPV1 激动剂。体外功能实验表明，长期或反复接触这些化合物会诱导 TRPV1 钙依赖性脱敏，使其对有害刺激不敏感。我们解析了人 TRPV1 (hTRPV1) 与最有前途的苯并噻吩取代激动剂 MSP20 复合物的冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构。该结构揭示了 MSP20 与香草酸位点结合的分子细节和 hTRPV1 的脱敏构象，其特征是封闭的离子通道孔、α-螺旋 C 末端和环状脂质的独特行为。我们的体内实验表明，MSP20 表现出强大而持久的镇痛活性，并具有离体神经保护作用，支持苯并噻吩取代的香草醛作为未来镇痛药的前景。

title: Dipeptidyl peptidase 3 sets the threshold for immune activation and survival during experimental bacterial infection
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Effective host defense requires coordinated regulation of immune activation, metabolism, and redox balance, yet how these processes are integrated remains unclear. Here, we identify dipeptidyl peptidase 3 (Dpp3) as a regulator of immune activation thresholds during bacterial infection. Dpp3−/− mice display enhanced resistance to Klebsiella pneumoniae, with early divergence in bacterial burden, improved survival, preserved tissue architecture, and reduced systemic inflammation. Adoptive transfer experiments demonstrate that Dpp3-deficient immune cells are sufficient to confer protection, indicating a cell-intrinsic effect. Mechanistically, Dpp3 deficiency impairs inducible Nrf2 stabilization, resulting in amplified ROS accumulation and enhanced NF-κB–associated responses. Integrated metabolomic, bioenergetic, and proteomic analyses reveal coordinated mitochondrial remodeling and activation of inflammatory signaling networks, consistent with a metabolically primed immune state. Collectively, these findings establish Dpp3 as a systems-level regulator integrating redox control and immunometabolism to calibrate antimicrobial responses during infection.
title_zh: 二肽基肽酶 3 设置实验细菌感染期间免疫激活和存活的阈值
abstract_zh: 有效的宿主防御需要免疫激活、代谢和氧化还原平衡的协调调节，但这些过程如何整合仍不清楚。在这里，我们将二肽基肽酶 3 (Dpp3) 确定为细菌感染期间免疫激活阈值的调节剂。 Dpp3−/− 小鼠对肺炎克雷伯菌表现出增强的抵抗力，细菌负荷早期出现分歧，提高了生存率，保留了组织结构，并减少了全身炎症。过继转移实验表明，Dpp3 缺陷的免疫细胞足以提供保护，表明细胞内在效应。从机制上讲，Dpp3 缺乏会损害诱导型 Nrf2 稳定性，导致 ROS 积累放大并增强 NF-κB 相关反应。综合代谢组学、生物能量学和蛋白质组学分析揭示了协调的线粒体重塑和炎症信号网络的激活，与代谢引发的免疫状态一致。总的来说，这些发现确立了 Dpp3 作为一种系统级调节因子，整合了氧化还原控制和免疫代谢，以校准感染期间的抗菌反应。

title: Dynamic S-acylation controls CMG2 maturation extracellular matrix regulation and anthrax toxin susceptibility in vivo
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: CMG2/ANTXR2 functions as a Collagen VI receptor required for extracellular matrix homeostasis and as the primary portal for anthrax toxin entry. Mutations in CMG2 cause Hyaline Fibromatosis Syndrome (HFS), a rare and often fatal genetic disorder characterized by excessive extracellular matrix accumulation, yet the molecular mechanisms regulating CMG2 function remain poorly understood. We show that CMG2 is controlled by ordered cycles of S-acylation and deacylation that regulate its folding, trafficking, and signalling competence. S-acylation by ZDHHC7 on two juxtamembrane cysteines protects CMG2 from ER-associated degradation by stabilizing folding intermediates, leading to a ~ 5-fold increase in folded receptors competent for ER exit. In the Golgi, ZDHHC3-dependent acylation of a third cysteine promotes Arf6-mediated CMG2 transport to the plasma membrane, where it exerts its functions. Ligand binding triggers recruitment of the thioesterase APT2, which enables release of CMG2 from the actin cytoskeleton and endocytosis, linking extracellular recognition to intracellular signalling and uptake. Inhibition of APT2 reduces Collagen VI turnover and strongly attenuates anthrax toxin toxicity in a zebrafish model, showing lipidation cycles as regulators of receptor function and potential therapeutic targets.
title_zh: 动态S-酰化控制CMG2成熟细胞外基质调节和体内炭疽毒素敏感性
abstract_zh: CMG2/ANTXR2 充当细胞外基质稳态所需的 VI 型胶原蛋白受体，并作为炭疽毒素进入的主要门户。 CMG2 突变会导致透明纤维瘤病综合征 (HFS)，这是一种罕见且往往致命的遗传性疾病，其特征是细胞外基质过度积累，但调节 CMG2 功能的分子机制仍知之甚少。我们发现 CMG2 受 S-酰化和脱酰化有序循环控制，调节其折叠、运输和信号传导能力。 ZDHHC7 对两个近膜半胱氨酸进行 S-酰化，通过稳定折叠中间体来保护 CMG2 免受 ER 相关降解，导致能够 ER 退出的折叠受体增加约 5 倍。在高尔基体中，第三个半胱氨酸的 ZDHHC3 依赖性酰化促进 Arf6 介导的 CMG2 转运至质膜，并在质膜中发挥其功能。配体结合触发硫酯酶 APT2 的募集，从而使 CMG2 从肌动蛋白细胞骨架和内吞作用中释放，将细胞外识别与细胞内信号传导和摄取联系起来。在斑马鱼模型中，APT2 的抑制可减少 VI 型胶原蛋白的更新，并强烈减弱炭疽毒素的毒性，表明脂化循环是受体功能的调节剂和潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Levitated macroscopic rotors with 10 hours of free spin at room temperature
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Low-dissipation rotors with large angular momentum are essential for precision sensing and probing macroscopic quantum phenomena. To date, low dissipation can only be achieved for micro-scale rotors. Here, we report a diamagnetically levitated millimeter-scale rotor exhibiting a measured dissipation rate as low as 3.85 μHz at room temperature, corresponding to a free spinning duration exceeding 10 hours. The rotor is levitated stably over an axisymmetric permanent magnet trap, and can be driven up to 930 RPM using contactless electrostatic actuation in high vacuum. Leveraging its low damping rate and large angular momentum, we realize a precision gyroscope with a measured sensitivity of 6.5 × 10−3 °/s and an estimated thermal-limited stability of 5.7×10−7∘/h" role="presentation">5.7×10−7∘/h5.7 \, \times \, 1{0}^{-7 \, {^{\circ}}} /\sqrt{{\rm{h}}}. These results establish diamagnetic levitation as a promising room-temperature platform for high-performance sensors.
title_zh: 悬浮宏观转子可在室温下自由旋转 10 小时
abstract_zh: 具有大角动量的低耗散转子对于精密传感和探测宏观量子现象至关重要。迄今为止，只有微型转子才能实现低耗散。在这里，我们报告了一种反磁悬浮毫米级转子，其在室温下测量的耗散率低至 3.85 μHz，相当于自由旋转持续时间超过 10 小时。转子稳定地悬浮在轴对称永磁体陷阱上方，并且可以在高真空中使用非接触式静电驱动将其驱动至高达 930 RPM。利用其低阻尼率和大角动量，我们实现了一种精密陀螺仪，其测量灵敏度为 6.5 × 10−3 °/s，估计热极限稳定性为 5.7×10−7∘/h" role="presentation">5.7×10−7∘/h5.7 \, \times \, 1{0}^{-7 \, {^{\circ}}} /\sqrt{{\rm{h}}}。这些结果确立了反磁悬浮作为高性能传感器的一个有前途的室温平台。

title: Structural insights into the MLH1–FAN1 interaction reveal an uncharacterized binding interface on MLH1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Huntington’s disease is driven by CAG repeat expansion in the mutant huntingtin gene. Nuclease FAN1 and mismatch repair protein MLH1 regulate repeat expansion through direct interaction, but the underlying structural basis remains unclear. Here, we show that the MLH1 C-terminal domain binds to FAN1-derived peptides containing either the MIP or MIM motif with comparable affinities. Crystal structures of this domain bound to each motif provide structural insights into human MLH1–FAN1 interaction, revealing a conserved mechanism for FAN1-MIP recognition and a previously unrecognized binding site on MLH1, termed the S3 site, for FAN1-MIM engagement. Co-immunoprecipitation assays confirmed that mutation of key MLH1 residues disrupts FAN1 binding in cells. These findings establish the molecular basis of MLH1–FAN1 recognition and provide a structural framework for understanding the regulation of CAG repeat expansion in Huntington’s disease.
title_zh: 对 MLH1-FAN1 相互作用的结构洞察揭示了 MLH1 上未表征的结合界面
abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病是由突变亨廷顿基因中的 CAG 重复扩增引起的。核酸酶 FAN1 和错配修复蛋白 MLH1 通过直接相互作用调节重复扩增，但潜在的结构基础仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明 MLH1 C 末端结构域以相当的亲和力与含有 MIP 或 MIM 基序的 FAN1 衍生肽结合。该结构域与每个基序结合的晶体结构为人类 MLH1-FAN1 相互作用提供了结构见解，揭示了 FAN1-MIP 识别的保守机制以及 MLH1 上先前未识别的用于 FAN1-MIM 接合的结合位点（称为 S3 位点）。免疫共沉淀分析证实，关键 MLH1 残基的突变会破坏 FAN1 在细胞中的结合。这些发现建立了 MLH1-FAN1 识别的分子基础，并为理解亨廷顿病中 CAG 重复扩增的调节提供了结构框架。

title: Endosteal integrin-α8⁺ mesenchymal stem cells maintain haematopoietic stem cell function via extracellular matrix-mediated interactions
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The stem cell niche is a specialised microenvironment essential for maintaining haematopoietic stem cells (HSCs). Here we identify a distinct subset of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) expressing integrin α8 (Itga8⁺ MSCs) within the bone marrow (BM) endosteum. These cells exhibit distinct MSC properties and higher haematopoietic supportive activity than other MSC subsets. Depletion of Itga8⁺ MSCs decreased HSC numbers, reduced quiescence of endosteal HSCs and diminished BM repopulating capacity. Itga8⁺ MSCs support haematopoiesis through cell adhesion-related mechanisms. Single-cell RNA sequencing further identified Itga8⁺ MSCs as a distinct subpopulation within bone-lining cells. Moreover, we identified Mfap4 as a candidate factor expressed in Itga8⁺ MSCs, and Mfap4 supported the BM reconstitution capacity of HSCs. These results suggest that Itga8⁺ MSCs represent a distinct niche cell population for HSC maintenance. This work provides new insights into HSC regulation and strategies to optimise in vitro HSC maintenance and enhance in vivo engraftment.
title_zh: 骨内整合素-α8⁺间充质干细胞通过细胞外基质介导的相互作用维持造血干细胞功能
abstract_zh: 干细胞生态位是维持造血干细胞（HSC）所必需的特殊微环境。在这里，我们鉴定了骨髓 (BM) 内膜内表达整合素 α8 (Itga8⁺ MSC) 的间充质干细胞 (MSC) 的独特子集。与其他 MSC 亚群相比，这些细胞表现出独特的 MSC 特性和更高的造血支持活性。 Itga8⁺ MSC 的消耗减少了 HSC 数量，减少了骨内 HSC 的静止状态并降低了 BM 重新增殖能力。 Itga8⁺ MSC 通过细胞粘附相关机制支持造血。单细胞 RNA 测序进一步鉴定 Itga8⁺ MSC 是骨衬细胞内的一个独特亚群。此外，我们将 Mfap4 确定为 Itga8⁺ MSC 中表达的候选因子，并且 Mfap4 支持 HSC 的 BM 重建能力。这些结果表明 Itga8⁺ MSC 代表了 HSC 维持的独特生态位细胞群。这项工作为 HSC 调节和优化体外 HSC 维持和增强体内植入的策略提供了新的见解。

title: Embryo quality control via lineage-specific aneuploid cell elimination in embryos and stem cell-derived embryo models
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Aneuploidy is frequent in human pre-implantation embryos and a leading cause of early pregnancy loss, yet is rarely observed at birth, implying robust embryonic surveillance. Here we define how this surveillance operates after implantation using an integrated, three-lineage stem cell–derived embryo model that recapitulates the epiblast (EPI), visceral endoderm (VE), and extraembryonic ectoderm (ExE). Seeding of aneuploid cells into each lineage independently reveals lineage-specific fates: aneuploid cells are selectively depleted from EPI and VE but persist within ExE. Live imaging captures their removal by apoptosis or physical extrusion. Single-cell RNA sequencing shows p53 activation and Myc repression in aneuploid cells, and pathway perturbations modulate their clearance, confirming causality. Together, these findings demonstrate a post-implantation, lineage-restricted quality-control program that eliminates aneuploid cells from the embryo proper while permitting extraembryonic tolerance. They also establish integrated embryo models as a tractable platform to dissect the molecular logic of developmental quality control.
title_zh: 通过消除胚胎和干细胞衍生胚胎模型中谱系特异性非整倍体细胞来控制胚胎质量
abstract_zh: 非整倍体在人类植入前胚胎中很常见，也是早期妊娠失败的主要原因，但在出生时很少观察到，这意味着强有力的胚胎监测。在这里，我们使用集成的三系干细胞衍生胚胎模型定义了植入后如何进行这种监视，该模型概括了外胚层（EPI）、内脏内胚层（VE）和胚胎外外胚层（ExE）。将非整倍体细胞接种到每个谱系中独立地揭示了谱系特异性命运：非整倍体细胞选择性地耗尽 EPI 和 VE，但在 ExE 中持续存在。实时成像捕捉到它们通过细胞凋亡或物理挤压而被去除。单细胞 RNA 测序显示非整倍体细胞中 p53 激活和 Myc 抑制，通路扰动调节其清除，证实了因果关系。总之，这些发现证明了一种植入后、谱系限制的质量控制程序，该程序从胚胎本身消除非整倍体细胞，同时允许胚胎外耐受。他们还建立了集成胚胎模型作为易于处理的平台来剖析发育质量控制的分子逻辑。

title: AI-guided CRISPR screening reveals therapeutic targets in psoriasis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Psoriasis affects over 125 million people globally. Biologics targeting the IL-17/IL-17RA axis are effective but require systemic administration, are costly, and are unsuitable for some patients. Developing topical small-molecule alternatives requires a better understanding of how IL-17 receptor A (IL17RA) is regulated in keratinocytes, the principal effector cells of psoriatic lesions. Here, we report a genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen for regulators of surface IL17RA in primary human epidermal keratinocytes. We prioritize hits using experimental enrichment together with VirtualCRISPR, a language-model framework trained on functional-genomics data, and validate two regulators with minimal prior connection to IL17RA: 5-lipoxygenase (ALOX5) and the oxytocin receptor (OXTR), which act through distinct cell-intrinsic mechanisms. Topical zileuton, an ALOX5 inhibitor, and cligosiban, an OXTR antagonist, suppress imiquimod-induced psoriasiform dermatitis in mice, mirroring systemic anti-IL17RA antibody efficacy. By linking AI- guided selection to genetic perturbation screening, this study provides an efficient route from candidate gene nomination to biological validation and therapeutic discovery.
title_zh: AI 引导的 CRISPR 筛选揭示了银屑病的治疗靶点
abstract_zh: 银屑病影响全球超过 1.25 亿人。针对 IL-17/IL-17RA 轴的生物制剂有效，但需要全身给药，价格昂贵，并且不适合某些患者。开发局部小分子替代品需要更好地了解 IL-17 受体 A (IL17RA) 在角质形成细胞（银屑病病变的主要效应细胞）中的调节机制。在这里，我们报告了原代人表皮角质形成细胞中表面 IL17RA 调节因子的全基因组 CRISPR 敲除筛选。我们使用实验富集与VirtualCRISPR（一种基于功能基因组数据训练的语言模型框架）一起对命中进行优先级排序，并验证与IL17RA具有最小先前连接的两个调节因子：5-脂氧合酶（ALOX5）和催产素受体（OXTR），它们通过不同的细胞固有机制发挥作用。局部用齐留通（一种 ALOX5 抑制剂）和克利戈西班（一种 OXTR 拮抗剂）可抑制小鼠中咪喹莫特诱导的银屑病样皮炎，反映了全身抗 IL17RA 抗体的功效。通过将人工智能引导的选择与遗传扰动筛选联系起来，这项研究提供了一条从候选基因提名到生物验证和治疗发现的有效途径。

title: Conserved and lineage-specific mechanisms drive chromatophore differentiation in reptiles
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The mechanisms by which novel differentiation pathways evolve to produce new cell types are still not fully understood. Chromatophores, the pigmented cells in the skin, offer an ideal paradigm because each type independently develops from neural crest cells to produce a distinct colour using well-characterised biosynthetic pathways. Here we show, using single-cell gene expression analyses, that canonical chromatophores develop in the embryonic skin of corn snakes and bearded dragon lizards. Yet, we identify previously undescribed chromatophore subtypes in the bearded dragon. These populations co-express progenitor and mature markers and possibly contribute to embryonic skin patterning, as revealed by whole-mount in situ hybridisation. Comparative analyses uncover that while mature chromatophores show cross-species similarity reflecting shared pigmentary function, progenitor states differ in transcription factor usage, including species-specific deployment of MITF, PAX7, and TFEC. Integration with teleost and amphibian datasets confirms that diversification of pigmentation arises through distinct progenitor trajectories converging on similar mature states.
title_zh: 保守和谱系特异性机制驱动爬行动物中的色素细胞分化
abstract_zh: 新的分化途径进化产生新细胞类型的机制尚未完全了解。色素细胞（皮肤中的色素细胞）提供了一个理想的范例，因为每种类型都是从神经嵴细胞独立发育而来，利用特征明确的生物合成途径产生独特的颜色。在这里，我们利用单细胞基因表达分析表明，典型的色素细胞是在玉米蛇和胡须龙蜥蜴的胚胎皮肤中发育的。然而，我们在胡须龙中发现了以前未描述过的色素亚型。正如整体原位杂交所揭示的，这些群体共同表达祖细胞和成熟标记，并可能有助于胚胎皮肤图案的形成。比较分析发现，虽然成熟的色素细胞表现出跨物种相似性，反映了共享的色素功能，但祖细胞状态在转录因子的使用方面有所不同，包括 MITF、PAX7 和 TFEC 的物种特异性部署。与硬骨鱼和两栖动物数据集的整合证实，色素沉着的多样化是通过不同的祖细胞轨迹汇聚到相似的成熟状态而产生的。

title: Resolving Thermal Accumulation and Rigid–Soft Interface Mismatch in Stretchable Electronics with Cubic Boron Nitride Composite Islands
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Integrated stretchable electronic systems for soft robotics and wearable devices require effective thermal management to mitigate heat accumulation around functional components. Here, we propose an island-bridge architecture with localized thermally conductive composite islands for enhanced heat dissipation. By incorporating cubic boron nitride (c-BN) into selected regions of the soft substrate, we construct thermally conductive composite islands with in-plane and through-plane thermal conductivities of 2.327 and 2.596 Wm1-K-1, respectively. Compared with the substrate without composite islands, the peak temperature is reduced by 12.8 °C. Furthermore, a stretchable computing platform based on this design maintains an operating temperature below 40 °C during practical operation, demonstrating an important thermal safety advantage for human-contact applications. In addition, the local modulus gradient created by the composite islands near the chip mitigates rigid-soft interfacial mismatch, thereby alleviating stress concentration and increasing stretchability from 70.41% to 122.67%. The proposed design further demonstrates long-term stability in soft robotic end-effectors and wearable systems, providing an effective strategy for achieving both thermal safety and mechanical reliability in highly integrated stretchable electronics.
title_zh: 使用立方氮化硼复合岛解决可拉伸电子器件中的热积累和刚软界面不匹配问题
abstract_zh: 用于软机器人和可穿戴设备的集成可拉伸电子系统需要有效的热管理，以减轻功能组件周围的热量积聚。在这里，我们提出了一种岛桥架构，具有局部导热复合岛以增强散热。通过将立方氮化硼 (c-BN) 纳入软基板的选定区域，我们构建了导热复合岛，其面内和面内导热系数分别为 2.327 和 2.596 Wm1-K-1。与没有复合岛的衬底相比，峰值温度降低了12.8℃。此外，基于该设计的可伸缩计算平台在实际操作过程中可将工作温度保持在40°C以下，这为人体接触应用展示了重要的热安全优势。此外，芯片附近的复合材料岛产生的局部模量梯度减轻了刚软界面失配，从而减轻了应力集中，并将拉伸率从 70.41% 提高到 122.67%。所提出的设计进一步证明了软机器人末端执行器和可穿戴系统的长期稳定性，为在高度集成的可拉伸电子设备中实现热安全性和机械可靠性提供了有效的策略。

title: Design Strategies and Emerging Applications of Electrospun Silk Fibroin Nanofibers for Tissue Engineering
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Electrospun silk fibroin nanofibers (SFNFs) combine exceptional biocompatibility, tunable mechanical properties, and a native extracellular matrix (ECM)-mimetic architecture, making them compelling scaffolds for tissue engineering. Despite rapid progress, current research often pursues isolated material enhancements, lacking a cohesive strategy that aligns scaffold design with the complex biophysical and biochemical microenvironments of targeted tissues. To bridge this gap, this review presents a "design-application coupling" framework that systematically integrates SFNF composition, processing, and surface modifications with tissue-specific regenerative demands. Rather than exhaustively detailing basic manufacturing, we concisely distill advanced electrospinning modalities and targeted functionalization strategies─such as inorganic reinforcement and immunomodulation─that dictate mechanical robustness and bioactivity. Crucially, we map these engineered properties directly to their emerging clinical applications, comprehensively analyzing SFNF performance in the regeneration of bone, skeletal muscle, cardiovascular, neural, and skin tissues. Finally, we discuss critical challenges to clinical translation, including scalability and regulatory standardization, and propose future directions toward smart, bioresponsive materials. This framework provides a systematic pathway from bench-side innovation to bedside application, guiding the next generation of SFNF-based regenerative scaffolds.
title_zh: 静电纺丝素纳米纤维在组织工程中的设计策略和新兴应用
abstract_zh: 电纺丝素蛋白纳米纤维 (SFNF) 结合了卓越的生物相容性、可调节的机械性能和天然细胞外基质 (ECM) 模拟结构，使其成为组织工程中引人注目的支架。尽管取得了快速进展，但当前的研究往往追求孤立的材料增强，缺乏将支架设计与目标组织复杂的生物物理和生化微环境相结合的一致策略。为了弥补这一差距，本综述提出了一个“设计-应用耦合”框架，该框架系统地将 SFNF 成分、加工和表面修饰与组织特异性再生需求相结合。我们没有详尽地详细介绍基本制造，而是简洁地提炼出先进的静电纺丝模式和有针对性的功能化策略（例如无机强化和免疫调节），这些策略决定了机械鲁棒性和生物活性。至关重要的是，我们将这些工程特性直接映射到其新兴的临床应用，全面分析 SFNF 在骨骼、骨骼肌、心血管、神经和皮肤组织再生中的性能。最后，我们讨论了临床转化的关键挑战，包括可扩展性和监管标准化，并提出了智能生物响应材料的未来方向。该框架提供了从实验室创新到临床应用的系统途径，指导下一代基于 SFNF 的再生支架。

title: Tiered Evaluation of Carbosilane Dendrimer–siRNA Nanoplatform from Single-Cell Biocompatibility to Blood-Brain Barrier Model Dynamics and Murine Alzheimer Model Behavior Assessment
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Blood-brain barrier (BBB) transport remains a primary constraint on achieving predictable central nervous system exposure for Alzheimer's disease (AD) therapeutics, motivating the evaluation of delivery platforms with barrier-resolved and functionally relevant end points. We assessed a carbosilane dendrimer (G3Si PEG6000) and its siRNA dendriplex using a tiered, upstream strategy spanning cell internalization, DNA damage screening, BBB model integrity and permeability, and in vivo AD-relevant murine model learning. At the cellular level, the dendrimer enhanced intracellular siRNA-associated signal with predominantly cytoplasmic localization, and siRNA complexation attenuated genotoxicity relative to the noncomplexed carrier. In a BBB triculture model, barrier function was preserved without sustained transendothelial electrical resistance (TEER) loss, and complementary tracer flux readouts showed time- and formulation-dependent, nonmonotonic changes, including TEER-permeability decoupling consistent with nonuniform perturbation and time-dependent changes in barrier-associated paracellular responses. In APOE4 knock-in mice, dendriplex treatment increased platform-zone crossings in the Morris Water Maze probe trial, whereas target-quadrant time showed only a modest, nonsignificant trend. Collectively, these integrated results indicate that siRNA complexation improves the BBB-relevant safety-performance balance of G3Si PEG6000 and supports further studies that directly link brain exposure and target engagement to cognitive outcomes.
title_zh: 碳硅烷树状聚合物-siRNA纳米平台从单细胞生物相容性到血脑屏障模型动力学和小鼠阿尔茨海默病模型行为评估的分层评估
abstract_zh: 血脑屏障（BBB）运输仍然是阿尔茨海默病（AD）治疗中实现可预测的中枢神经系统暴露的主要限制，这推动了对具有屏障解决和功能相关终点的递送平台的评估。我们使用分层的上游策略评估了碳硅烷树枝状聚合物 (G3Si PEG6000) 及其 siRNA 树枝状复合物，该策略涵盖细胞内化、DNA 损伤筛选、BBB 模型完整性和渗透性以及体内 AD 相关小鼠模型学习。在细胞水平上，树枝状聚合物增强了细胞内 siRNA 相关信号，主要定位于细胞质，并且相对于非复合载体，siRNA 复合减弱了基因毒性。在 BBB 三培养模型中，屏障功能得以保留，而没有持续的跨内皮电阻 (TEER) 损失，并且补充示踪剂通量读数显示出时间和配方依赖性的非单调变化，包括与屏障相关的旁细胞反应的非均匀扰动一致的 TEER 渗透性解耦和时间依赖性变化。在 APOE4 敲入小鼠中，在莫里斯水迷宫探针试验中，树状复合物处理增加了平台区交叉，而目标象限时间仅显示出适度的、不显着的趋势。总的来说，这些综合结果表明 siRNA 复合改善了 G3Si PEG6000 的 BBB 相关安全性能平衡，并支持将大脑暴露和目标参与与认知结果直接联系起来的进一步研究。

title: Evolutionary drivers of encephalization and facial reduction in the genus Homo
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The evolution of cranial morphology in the genus Homo is marked by increasing encephalization and reduced facial robusticity through time. These changes are often assumed to be the product of directional natural selection for larger brain size, presumed to be associated with greater cognitive abilities, and for decreasing facial size to lower energetic costs, as masticatory demands were reduced through food processing and tool use. Here, we test this hypothesis by exploring the goodness-of-fit of the predictions of six evolutionary processes to the observed cranial morphological variation in Homo. We analyzed comprehensive neurocranial and facial 3D landmark coordinate datasets, grouped into eight Operational Taxonomic Units starting with early Homo and representing two lineages, Homo sapiens and Homo neanderthalensis. Our neurocranial analysis found strongest support for models of neutral evolution (Unbiased Random Walk) and stasis across both lineages. Similarly, the face shows strongest support for models of stasis, strict stasis, and neutral evolution (Unbiased Random Walk). Our findings suggest a limited role for gradual directional selection and underscore the importance of stabilizing selection and constraints in our lineage’s evolution, highlighting the importance of environmental constraints and possibly cultural behaviors as core drivers of human evolution.
title_zh: 人属脑化和面部缩小的进化驱动因素
abstract_zh: 人属颅骨形态进化的特点是随着时间的推移，脑化程度不断增强，面部坚固性不断降低。这些变化通常被认为是定向自然选择的产物，因为大脑尺寸更大，与更强的认知能力有关，而面部尺寸的减小是为了降低能量成本，因为通过食物加工和工具使用减少了咀嚼需求。在这里，我们通过探索六个进化过程的预测与观察到的人属颅骨形态变异的拟合优度来检验这一假设。我们分析了全面的神经颅骨和面部 3D 地标坐标数据集，分为八个操作分类单元，从早期智人开始，代表两个谱系：智人和尼安德特人。我们的神经颅骨分析发现了对两个谱系的中性进化（无偏随机游走）和停滞模型的最有力支持。同样，这张脸显示出对停滞、严格停滞和中性进化（无偏随机游走）模型的最强支持。我们的研究结果表明，逐步定向选择的作用有限，并强调了稳定选择和限制在我们谱系进化中的重要性，强调了环境限制和可能的文化行为作为人类进化核心驱动力的重要性。

title: The conformational multiplicity effect: Dictating graded order in supramolecular zwitterionic polymers
source: Matter
abstract: Controlling aggregate morphology in supramolecular ionic polymers is challenging with traditional binary monomer systems. Inspired by biological conformational multiplicity, we use a single fluorescent zwitterionic monomer to achieve selective self-assembly into crystalline, gel, or amorphous states. This minimalist, designable approach enables real-time visualization of gelation and yields a high-performance anode protection material for aqueous zinc-ion batteries, offering broad potential for functional supramolecular materials.
title_zh: 构象多重效应：决定超分子两性离子聚合物的分级顺序
abstract_zh: 对于传统的二元单体系统来说，控制超分子离子聚合物中的聚集体形态具有挑战性。受生物构象多样性的启发，我们使用单一荧光两性离子单体来实现选择性自组装成结晶、凝胶或无定形状态。这种极简、可设计的方法可以实现凝胶化的实时可视化，并为水性锌离子电池提供高性能阳极保护材料，为功能性超分子材料提供了广阔的潜力。

title: Dual Additives toward High-Performance Wide-Bandgap Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Wide-bandgap (WBG) metal halide perovskites are key materials for constructing high-efficiency tandem solar cells by coupling with narrow-bandgap bottom subcells. However, their practical performance is severely limited by pronounced open-circuit voltage loss and instability, arising from accelerated crystallization, abundant defect states, and photo induced halide phase segregation induced in Br-rich compositions. These issues are closely associated with iodine-related redox imbalance and undercoordinated Pb2+ sites induced by high bromide incorporation, which intensify nonradiative recombination and ion migration. Herein, a dual-additive strategy based on cesium formate (CsFa) and formamidinium formate (FAFa) is proposed, in which the introduced formate ion (HCOO-) plays a dominant bifunctional role. Acting simultaneously as a mild reducing agent and a coordinating ligand, HCOO- also converts photothermally generated I2/I3- species into I-, thereby rebalancing the iodine redox chemistry, while coordinating with undercoordinated Pb2+ ions to modulate crystallization kinetics and promote grain growth, thereby suppressing defect formation, and improving energy-level alignment. As a result, high quality WBG perovskite films with enlarged grain size and reduced defect density are obtained, enabling P-I-N structured perovskite solar cells with a bandgap of ∼1.79 eV to achieve a power conversion efficiency of 17.83% along with enhanced operational stability, demonstrating an effective strategy for performance optimization of WBG top cells in tandem photovoltaic devices.
title_zh: 高性能宽带隙钙钛矿太阳能电池的双添加剂
abstract_zh: 宽带隙（WBG）金属卤化物钙钛矿是通过与窄带隙底部子电池耦合构建高效串联太阳能电池的关键材料。然而，它们的实际性能受到明显的开路电压损失和不稳定性的严重限制，这些开路电压损失和不稳定性是由加速结晶、丰富的缺陷态以及富Br组合物中引起的光致卤化物相偏析引起的。这些问题与碘相关的氧化还原失衡和高溴化物掺入引起的配位不足密切相关，从而加剧了非辐射复合和离子迁移。在此，提出了基于甲酸铯（CsFa）和甲酸甲脒（FAFa）的双添加剂策略，其中引入的甲酸根离子（HCOO-）起主导双功能作用。 HCOO- 同时作为温和还原剂和配位配体，还将光热产生的 I2/I3- 物质转化为 I-，从而重新平衡碘氧化还原化学，同时与配位不足的 Pb2+ 离子配位以调节结晶动力学并促进晶粒生长，从而抑制缺陷形成并改善能级排列。结果，获得了晶粒尺寸增大、缺陷密度降低的高质量WBG钙钛矿薄膜，使得带隙~1.79 eV的P-I-N结构钙钛矿太阳能电池实现了17.83%的功率转换效率，同时增强了运行稳定性，展示了串联光伏器件中WBG顶部电池性能优化的有效策略。

title: Ultrafast Reactive Laser Sintering of Highly Conductive Garnet-Type LLZTO Solid Electrolytes
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Rapid and scalable fabrication of garnet-type solid electrolytes remains a major challenge for the practical deployment of lithium metal batteries. Here, we report reactive laser sintering (RLS) as an ultrafast and potentially scalable strategy for fabricating garnet-type Li6.4La3Zr1.4Ta0.6O12 (LLZTO) solid electrolytes. RLS of LLZTO enables simultaneous reaction and densification, achieving ∼95% relative density while minimizing lithium loss and suppressing secondary phase formation. Compared to conventional furnace sintering, RLS promotes enhanced grain growth and improved densification, leading to improved ionic conductivity (0.36 ± 0.08 mS cm-1) while maintaining comparable activation energies for Li+ transport. Structural characterization by X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, and solid-state 6Li/7Li NMR confirms the formation of cubic garnet LLZTO with homogeneous microscale elemental distribution. In addition, nanoindentation measurements demonstrate that RLS preserves the mechanical properties of the garnet framework despite ultrafast localized thermal processing. By integrating simultaneous reaction and densification with tunable microstructural control, reactive laser sintering provides a promising manufacturing pathway for high-performance garnet solid electrolytes toward next-generation solid-state batteries.
title_zh: 高导电石榴石型 LLZTO 固体电解质的超快反应激光烧结
abstract_zh: 石榴石型固体电解质的快速且可扩展的制造仍然是锂金属电池实际部署的主要挑战。在这里，我们报告反应激光烧结（RLS）作为一种超快且具有潜在可扩展性的策略，用于制造石榴石型Li6.4La3Zr1.4Ta0.6O12（LLZTO）固体电解质。 LLZTO 的 RLS 能够同时进行反应和致密化，实现约 95% 的相对密度，同时最大限度地减少锂损失并抑制二次相形成。与传统的炉烧结相比，RLS 促进了晶粒生长的增强和致密化的提高，从而提高了离子电导率 (0.36 ± 0.08 mS cm-1)，同时保持了相当的 Li+ 传输活化能。 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、拉曼光谱和固态 6Li/7Li NMR 的结构表征证实了具有均匀微尺度元素分布的立方石榴石 LLZTO 的形成。此外，纳米压痕测量表明，尽管进行超快局部热处理，RLS 仍保留了石榴石骨架的机械性能。通过将同时反应和致密化与可调微观结构控制相结合，反应激光烧结为高性能石榴石固体电解质和下一代固态电池提供了一条有前途的制造途径。

title: Patterns of emergence and circulation of West Nile Virus in Algeria
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In recent years, many countries have experienced increased outbreaks of vector-borne diseases, such as West Nile virus (WNV). WNV is primarily transmitted to humans by the bite of infected Culex mosquitoes and has an enzoonotic transmission cycle involving birds. In Algeria, serological evidence of WNV in humans dates back to the 1970s, but circulation patterns are poorly characterized. To address this, we conduct a cross-sectional seroprevalence survey of WNV in humans and fit serocatalytic models to the data. We also analyze data on severe WNV cases. In this study, we report a seroprevalence of 16.7%. We identify age, region, and residence type as risk factors for infection. We also show that patterns of spread in two provinces in the south are consistent with low level endemic risk over decades, while those from three provinces in the north are all consistent with single outbreaks that occurred within the last 10-15 years. An outbreak may have occurred in Oran in 2010 and in Jijel and Tizi Ouzou near the time of data collection in 2017 and 2018, respectively. Investigation of potential drivers of viral establishment, along with continued surveillance of WNV cases, especially in the northern provinces, is warranted.
title_zh: 阿尔及利亚西尼罗河病毒的出现和传播模式
abstract_zh: 近年来，许多国家经历了病媒传播疾病的爆发增加，例如西尼罗河病毒（WNV）。西尼罗河病毒主要通过受感染的库蚊叮咬传播给人类，并具有涉及鸟类的地方性人畜共患传播周期。在阿尔及利亚，人类中西尼罗河病毒的血清学证据可以追溯到 20 世纪 70 年代，但传播模式的特征却很少。为了解决这个问题，我们对人类中的西尼罗河病毒进行了横断面血清流行率调查，并根据数据拟合了血清催化模型。我们还分析了西尼罗河病毒严重病例的数据。在这项研究中，我们报告血清阳性率为 16.7%。我们将年龄、地区和居住类型确定为感染的危险因素。我们还表明，南方两个省份的传播模式与几十年来的低水平流行风险一致，而北方三个省份的传播模式都与过去 10-15 年内发生的单次疫情一致。奥兰可能于 2010 年爆发，吉杰勒和提济乌祖分别于 2017 年和 2018 年数据收集前后爆发。有必要调查病毒传播的潜在驱动因素，并持续监测西尼罗河病毒病例，特别是在北部省份。

title: Triangulating evidence for genetic and environmental components of associations between parental behaviours and aggressive behaviour in children
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Parenting behaviours are often linked to childhood aggression, but many studies fail to account for shared genetics or test directionality. Using family-based designs, we control for genetic confounding and examined bidirectional effects across two samples. First, we apply a children-of-twins/siblings design in the Norwegian Mother Father and Child Cohort Study which uses genetic relatedness between family members to separate genetic and environmental components of parent-child associations. Second, we use longitudinal models in the USA-based Early Growth and Development Study, an adoption sample where parents and child are not genetically related, enabling estimation of parent-child associations without genetic confounding.Across both studies, we find evidence for genetic and environmental transmission between parenting and child aggression. We show significant child-to-parent effects on inconsistent discipline in both samples. In the children-of-twins analysis, the association between positive parenting and child aggression is shown to be due to shared genetics, where no statistically significant association is observed in the adoption sample. These findings build on the growing body of literature showing genetic influences on both aggression and parenting behaviours, whilst underscoring the value of triangulation.
title_zh: 父母行为与儿童攻击行为之间关联的遗传和环境因素的三角测量证据
abstract_zh: 养育行为通常与儿童时期的攻击行为有关，但许多研究未能解释共同的遗传或测试方向性。使用基于家族的设计，我们控制了遗传混杂，并检查了两个样本的双向效应。首先，我们在挪威母亲父亲和儿童队列研究中应用了双胞胎/兄弟姐妹的孩子设计，该研究利用家庭成员之间的遗传相关性来区分亲子关联的遗传和环境成分。其次，我们在美国的早期生长和发育研究中使用了纵向模型，这是一个收养样本，其中父母和孩子没有遗传相关性，从而能够在没有遗传混杂的情况下估计亲子关联。在这两项研究中，我们发现了养育和孩子攻击性之间遗传和环境传播的证据。我们在两个样本中都显示出对不一致纪律的显着影响。在双胞胎子女分析中，积极养育和儿童攻击性之间的关联被证明是由于共同的遗传因素，而在收养样本中没有观察到统计上显着的关联。这些发现建立在越来越多的文献基础上，这些文献显示遗传对攻击性和养育行为的影响，同时强调了三角测量的价值。

title: Complementary roles of cell-type-specific plasticity in shaping neocortical dynamics for learning action timing
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neocortical spiking dynamics underlie voluntary behavior and are thought to emerge through synaptic plasticity during learning. However, the causal role of plasticity across cortical cell types in shaping population dynamics remains unclear. To address this, we manipulated Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII), a key mediator of plasticity, in mice learning a motor timing task. Transient CaMKII inactivation in the premotor cortex impaired learning without affecting execution of learned actions. Cell-type-specific manipulations revealed that CaMKII-dependent plasticity in two pyramidal tract (PT) neuron subtypes—but not intratelencephalic (IT) neurons—was required for learning. Concurrent large-scale electrophysiology showed that CaMKII activity in the two PT subtypes was necessary to shape distinct aspects of premotor cortical dynamics that jointly anticipate motor timing, whereas IT neuron plasticity was required to reduce the dimensionality of cortical activity. Together, synaptic plasticity in major cortical cell types plays specialized and complementary roles in sculpting cortical dynamics during learning.
title_zh: 细胞类型特异性可塑性在塑造学习动作时机的新皮质动力学中的互补作用
abstract_zh: 新皮质尖峰动态是自愿行为的基础，被认为是通过学习过程中的突触可塑性而出现的。然而，不同皮质细胞类型的可塑性在塑造群体动态方面的因果作用仍不清楚。为了解决这个问题，我们在学习运动计时任务的小鼠中操纵了 Ca2+/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶 II (CaMKII)，这是可塑性的关键介质。前运动皮层中的短暂 CaMKII 失活会损害学习，但不会影响所学动作的执行。细胞类型特异性操作表明，两种锥体束 (PT) 神经元亚型（而非端脑内 (IT) 神经元）中的 CaMKII 依赖性可塑性是学习所必需的。同时进行的大规模电生理学研究表明，两种 PT 亚型中的 CaMKII 活性对于塑造共同预测运动时序的运动前皮质动力学的不同方面是必要的，而 IT 神经元可塑性则需要降低皮质活动的维度。总之，主要皮层细胞类型的突触可塑性在学习过程中塑造皮层动态方面发挥着专门和互补的作用。

title: Salmonella SopB suppresses post-transcriptionally regulated cytokine release to reduce early tissue inflammation and delay disease progression
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium (S. Typhimurium) manipulates cellular processes through the translocation of effector molecules into the host cell cytosol. Using a recently established neonatal S. Typhimurium infection model, we provide functional insights into how Salmonella outer protein B (SopB) suppresses early mucosal tissue inflammation and prolongs host survival. Mechanistically, SopB prevents a disintegrin and metalloprotease 17 (ADAM17) activation, plasma membrane translocation and the release of membrane-bound TNFα from enterocytes and reduces epithelial secretion of IL-18 via mTOR-controlled secretory autophagy. This abolishes the early epithelial transcriptional response and reduces immune cell recruitment and programmed cell death-mediated mucosal barrier disruption delaying disease progression. The immunosuppressive effect of SopB is independent of the C-terminally encoded phosphatidylinositol phosphatase and phosphotransferase activity but requires an intact N-terminal domain. Also, it is restricted to the neonatal mouse model characterised by Salmonella pathogenicity island (SPI)1 type 3 secretion system (T3SS)-dependent enterocyte invasion-driven mucosal translocation. Thus, here we demonstrate that SopB suppresses the early, post-transcriptional regulation of epithelial cytokine release in an inositol phosphatase-independent manner likely promoting pathogen transmission.
title_zh: 沙门氏菌 SopB 抑制转录后调节的细胞因子释放，以减少早期组织炎症并延缓疾病进展
abstract_zh: 肠沙门氏菌亚种鼠伤寒肠杆菌（S. Typhimurium）通过将效应分子易位到宿主细胞胞浆中来操纵细胞过程。利用最近建立的新生儿鼠伤寒沙门氏菌感染模型，我们提供了关于沙门氏菌外部蛋白 B (SopB) 如何抑制早期粘膜组织炎症并延长宿主生存的功能性见解。从机制上讲，SopB 可防止解整合素和金属蛋白酶 17 (ADAM17) 激活、质膜易位以及肠细胞释放膜结合 TNFα，并通过 mTOR 控制的分泌性自噬减少上皮细胞 IL-18 的分泌。这消除了早期上皮转录反应，减少了免疫细胞的募集和程序性细胞死亡介导的粘膜屏障破坏，从而延缓了疾病进展。 SopB 的免疫抑制作用独立于 C 端编码的磷脂酰肌醇磷酸酶和磷酸转移酶活性，但需要完整的 N 端结构域。此外，它仅限于以沙门氏菌致病岛 (SPI)1 3 型分泌系统 (T3SS) 依赖性肠上皮细胞入侵驱动的粘膜易位为特征的新生小鼠模型。因此，我们在这里证明 SopB 以不依赖肌醇磷酸酶的方式抑制上皮细胞因子释放的早期转录后调节，可能促进病原体传播。

title: Non-reciprocal coalescence-breakup dynamics in flowing concentrated emulsions
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dense stabilized emulsions are mixtures of immiscible fluids where the high-volume fraction droplet dispersed phase is stabilized against coalescence by steric interactions. The production of emulsions-a key process in food, cosmetics and chemical industries-involves high-shear flows, elastic and steric interactions, and proceeds thanks to coalescence and breakup of droplets and interfaces. The complex interplay between all these interactions is key in determining both small-scale droplet morphology as well as large-scale emulsion rheology. It is well known that at a critical volume fraction, ϕc, the emulsion loses stability, undergoing an extremely rapid process where the fluid components in the emulsion exchange roles. This process, called catastrophic phase inversion, which resembles in several respects a dynamical phase transition, has remained widely elusive from an experimental and theoretical point of view. In this work, we present state-of-the-art experimental and numerical data to support a dynamical-system framework capable of precisely highlighting the dynamics occurring in the system as it approaches the catastrophic phase inversion. Our study clearly highlights that at high volume fractions, the droplet population starts to fluctuate wildly, leading to dramatic changes in the emulsion’s rheology and stability. Additionally, we show that at approaching the critical volume fractions, the dynamics can be simplified as being controlled by the evolution of a correlation length represented, in our systems, by the size of the largest droplet. This dynamics shares a close connection with non-reciprocal phase transitions where two different physical mechanisms, coalescences and breakups, can get out of balance leading to large non-symmetric periodic excursions in phase space. We clarify the phenomenology observed and quantitatively explain the essential aspects of the highly complex dynamics of flowing stabilized emulsions undergoing catastrophic phase inversion. More generally, our approach sets the basis for the definition and modeling of a vast number of dynamical phase transitions in hydrodynamic systems out-of-equilibrium where the flow, or other advection mechanisms, can enhance both aggregation and breakup of aggregates.
title_zh: 流动浓缩乳液中的非互易聚结破碎动力学
abstract_zh: 致密稳定乳液是不混溶流体的混合物，其中高体积分数液滴分散相通过空间相互作用稳定防止聚结。乳液的生产是食品、化妆品和化学工业的关键过程，涉及高剪切流、弹性和空间相互作用，并且由于液滴和界面的聚结和破碎而进行。所有这些相互作用之间复杂的相互作用是确定小尺度液滴形态以及大规模乳液流变学的关键。众所周知，在临界体积分数 ψc 下，乳液会失去稳定性，并经历乳液中流体成分交换作用的极其快速的过程。这个过程被称为灾难性相转变，在几个方面类似于动态相变，从实验和理论的角度来看仍然广泛难以捉摸。在这项工作中，我们提供了最先进的实验和数值数据来支持动力学系统框架，该框架能够精确地突出系统在接近灾难性相转化时发生的动力学。我们的研究清楚地强调，在高体积分数下，液滴数量开始剧烈波动，导致乳液的流变性和稳定性发生巨大变化。此外，我们表明，在接近临界体积分数时，动力学可以简化为由相关长度的演化控制，在我们的系统中，相关长度由最大液滴的尺寸表示。这种动态共享一个cl

title: Embodied cognition-driven interpretable trajectory prediction of autonomous systems
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: For autonomous systems to operate safely and reliably in dense traffic, they must perform trajectory prediction with human-like, interpretable reasoning. Prevailing data-driven “black-box” models fundamentally lack this capability. This research proposes a paradigm shift toward embodied intelligence, unifying cognitive science principles into a hierarchical framework: a Scene Attention Mechanism for threat prioritization, Social Impact Theory-driven graphs for intent inference, and a physics-compliant Social Force Model. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework reduces average displacement error by 42% and Final Displacement Error by 40% compared to existing state-of-the-art models on ETH and UCY, while enabling near-real-time inference (0.003 s). Crucially, the model’s interpretable architecture, which is validated through risk-sensitive heatmaps and graph visualizations, reveals how agents dynamically balance safety, efficiency, and socio-cultural norms. Beyond performance gains, this work constructs an interpretable bridge between computational models and human cognitive science, laying a foundation for trustworthy autonomous systems.
title_zh: 自主系统的具体认知驱动的可解释轨迹预测
abstract_zh: 为了让自主系统在密集的交通中安全可靠地运行，它们必须通过类人的、可解释的推理来执行轨迹预测。流行的数据驱动的“黑匣子”模型从根本上缺乏这种能力。这项研究提出了向具身智能的范式转变，将认知科学原理统一到分层框架中：用于威胁优先级排序的场景注意机制、用于意图推断的社会影响理论驱动的图表以及符合物理的社会力模型。实验结果表明，与 ETH 和 UCY 上现有的最先进模型相比，我们的框架将平均位移误差降低了 42%，最终位移误差降低了 40%，同时实现了近实时推理（0.003 秒）。至关重要的是，该模型的可解释架构通过风险敏感热图和图形可视化进行验证，揭示了代理如何动态平衡安全、效率和社会文化规范。除了性能提升之外，这项工作还在计算模型和人类认知科学之间构建了一座可解释的桥梁，为值得信赖的自治系统奠定了基础。

title: A human-specific microRNA controls the timing of excitatory synaptogenesis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neural circuit development in the human cortex is considerably prolonged in comparison to non-human primates, a trait that contributes to the remarkable cognitive capacity of modern humans. Here, we explore the regulatory role of non-coding RNAs, which dramatically expanded during brain evolution, in synapse development of human induced pluripotent stem-cell derived neurons. We found that inhibition of a human-specific microRNA, miR-1229-3p, alters the trajectory of human neuronal maturation and enhances excitatory synaptic transmission. Transcriptome analysis following miR-1229 knockdown revealed a downregulation of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encoded genes. We further show that miR-1229 regulates mitochondrial morphology, mtDNA abundance as well as mitophagy, and that stimulation of mitochondrial metabolism rescues decreased calcium buffering in miR-1229-3p depleted neurons. Accordingly, miR-1229 directly targets an entire network of genes involved in mitochondrial function and ER-associated protein homeostasis. Our findings reveal an important function of human-specific miR-1229-3p in developmental timing of human synaptogenesis and generally implicate non-coding RNAs in the control of human connectivity and cognition.
title_zh: 人类特有的 microRNA 控制兴奋性突触发生的时间
abstract_zh: 与非人类灵长类动物相比，人类皮层的神经回路发育时间要长得多，这一特征有助于现代人类卓越的认知能力。在这里，我们探讨了非编码 RNA 在人类诱导多能干细胞衍生神经元突触发育中的调节作用，这些 RNA 在大脑进化过程中急剧扩展。我们发现抑制人类特异性 microRNA miR-1229-3p 会改变人类神经元成熟的轨迹并增强兴奋性突触传递。 miR-1229 敲除后的转录组分析揭示了线粒体 DNA (mtDNA) 编码基因的下调。我们进一步表明，miR-1229 调节线粒体形态、mtDNA 丰度以及线粒体自噬，并且刺激线粒体代谢可以挽救 miR-1229-3p 耗尽的神经元中钙缓冲的减少。因此，miR-1229 直接靶向参与线粒体功能和 ER 相关蛋白稳态的整个基因网络。我们的研究结果揭示了人类特异性 miR-1229-3p 在人类突触发生的发育时间中的重要功能，并且通常暗示非编码 RNA 在人类连接和认知的控制中。

title: Li–air chemistry inspired electrodialysis for direct lithium carbonate production from seawater
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The global shift to renewable energy has intensified demand for lithium-ion batteries. Conventional lithium sources and extraction methods—such as brine evaporation and ore roasting—are time- and resource-intensive, geographically constrained, and environmentally damaging, underscoring the need for more sustainable resources and extraction strategies. Here we report an electrodialysis-based approach for direct lithium carbonate extraction from seawater, using ambient carbon dioxide as the carbon source. The method integrates a solid-state lithium-conducting membrane with Li–air chemistry, enabling lithium enrichment and carbonate formation in a single step without added precipitants. The Li–air configuration imparts intrinsic ion selectivity via thermodynamically driven displacement reactions. Experimental results confirm the production of lithium carbonate (93.8% purity) with an applied voltage below 2 V, while reducing chemical input and energy consumption compared to conventional processes. This work has the potential to provide a low-impact route for accessing lithium resources and contributes to the sustainability of future battery supply chains.
title_zh: 锂-空气化学启发电渗析从海水中直接生产碳酸锂
abstract_zh: 全球向可再生能源的转变增加了对锂离子电池的需求。传统的锂来源和提取方法（例如盐水蒸发和矿石焙烧）是时间和资源密集型、地理受限且对环境造成破坏的，这凸显了对更可持续的资源和提取策略的需要。在这里，我们报告了一种基于电渗析的方法，使用环境二氧化碳作为碳源，从海水中直接提取碳酸锂。该方法将固态锂导电膜与锂-空气化学相结合，无需添加沉淀剂即可一步实现锂富集和碳酸盐形成。锂-空气构型通过热力学驱动的置换反应赋予固有的离子选择性。实验结果证实，与传统工艺相比，可以在施加电压低于 2 V 的情况下生产碳酸锂（纯度为 93.8%），同时减少化学品输入和能源消耗。这项工作有可能为获取锂资源提供一条低影响的途径，并有助于未来电池供应链的可持续性。

title: Time-resolved Coulomb explosion imaging of a photochemical ring opening reaction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photoinduced ring-opening of cyclic organic molecules is fundamental to many photochemical processes, from vitamin D biosynthesis to molecular optical switching. Despite advances in several ultrafast techniques, direct and unambiguous imaging of the ultrafast nuclear motion is still a major challenge. As a consequence, reaction mechanisms remain controversial even for extensively studied prototypical systems. Here, we show that time-resolved Coulomb explosion imaging, together with molecular dynamics simulation, can be used to identify and map the ring-opening reaction of gas-phase furan following ultraviolet photoexcitation, a reaction for which widely contradicting predictions and observations have been reported. By directly imaging the transient carbon-backbone structure, we reveal the presence of a strong ring-opening pathway that occurs on average at approximately 70 fs. With the development of higher-repetition-rate lasers, we anticipate that our approach will enable mapping of a broad range of ultrafast photochemical reactions.
title_zh: 光化学开环反应的时间分辨库仑爆炸成像
abstract_zh: 环状有机分子的光诱导开环是从维生素 D 生物合成到分子光学开关等许多光化学过程的基础。尽管几种超快技术取得了进步，但超快核运动的直接和明确的成像仍然是一个重大挑战。因此，即使对于广泛研究的原型系统，反应机制仍然存在争议。在这里，我们展示了时间分辨库仑爆炸成像与分子动力学模拟相结合，可用于识别和绘制紫外光激发后气相呋喃的开环反应，该反应已被报道为广泛相互矛盾的预测和观察。通过直接对瞬态碳骨架结构进行成像，我们揭示了平均大约 70 fs 发生的强开环途径的存在。随着更高重复率激光器的发展，我们预计我们的方法将能够绘制广泛的超快光化学反应。

title: Breaking the activity-selectivity dilemma in direct electrocatalytic hydrogenolysis of furfural into furanic biofuel
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electrocatalytic hydrogenolysis of biomass-derived furfural usually encounters the disordered flow of electrons, particularly for the formation of 2-methylfuran with a complex four-electron transfer process. To address this, we develops an intermediates coverage-induced strategy through the mixed valences in copper clusters wrapped by carbonaceous matrix, which boosts the transfer of electrons toward 2-methylfuran with dual advantages in kinetics and thermodynamics. Experimental results indicate that the carbonaceous matrix create a furural-favorable environment for less adsorption of H+; on it surface, the cleavage of C-O bonds in Fur-CH2OH* can be easily activated by Cu+ sites for 2-methylfuran, while partial participation of Cu0 accelerates the hydrogenation processes with an enhancement of local H* concentration, leading to the high selectivity and faradaic efficiency at 89.8% and 76.6%, respectively. In addition, the coexistence of Cu+ and Cu0 is also stable under cathodic conditions, but the deposition of polymers disturbs the intermediates coverage, which is subsequently mitigated through the continuous-flow reactor. This study provides insights into the interfacial modulation on electrode surface, advancing the development of efficient electrocatalysts for biomass valorization.
title_zh: 打破糠醛直接电催化氢解制呋喃生物燃料的活性与选择性困境
abstract_zh: 生物质糠醛的电催化氢解通常会遇到电子的无序流动，特别是通过复杂的四电子转移过程形成2-甲基呋喃。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种中间体覆盖诱导策略，通过碳质基质包裹的铜簇中的混合价态，促进电子向2-甲基呋喃的转移，具有动力学和热力学的双重优势。实验结果表明，碳质基质创造了一个有利于糠醛的环境，减少了H+的吸附；在其表面，Fur-CH2OH*中C-O键的断裂很容易被Cu+位点激活生成2-甲基呋喃，而Cu0的部分参与加速了氢化过程，提高了局部H*浓度，导致高选择性和法拉第效率分别为89.8%和76.6%。此外，Cu+和Cu0的共存在阴极条件下也是稳定的，但聚合物的沉积扰乱了中间体的覆盖，随后通过连续流反应器得到缓解。这项研究提供了对电极表面界面调节的见解，推动了用于生物质增值的高效电催化剂的开发。

title: Calix[6]arene-Based Interlocked Inverse Vulcanizate Enabling Network–Interface Cooperative Reinforcement in Natural Rubber/Carbon Black Composites
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Conventional sulfur vulcanization provides practical cross-linking for unsaturated rubbers but struggles to simultaneously improve tear resistance, impact durability, processing stability, and aging performance through a simple and scalable strategy. Herein, we report a calix[6]arene-mediated inverse vulcanization approach to engineer mechanically interlocked polysulfide cross-linkers for natural rubber/carbon black (NR/CB) composites. Two macrocyclic systems were designed to clarify the role of the interface integration. Tert-butylcalix[6]arene (TBC6), lacking polymerizable groups, forms polyrotaxane structures that operate primarily at the rubber-filler interface, enhancing bound rubber formation and enabling interfacial sliding. In contrast, allyl-functionalized calix[6]arene (ATBC6) covalently incorporates into the vulcanized network, constructing slidable cross-links within the bulk while simultaneously strengthening rubber-filler interfacial coupling. This coordinated network interface architecture promotes efficient stress transfer and suppresses crack propagation. The ATBC6-based composite exhibits a 140% increase in tear strength and a 340% enhancement in fracture toughness relative to those of conventional vulcanizates, accompanied by pronounced strain-rate hardening and improved energy absorption. Additionally, stable polysulfide linkages and phenolic units impart enhanced thermo-oxidative aging resistance. This scalable interface engineering strategy offers a practical pathway toward high-performance elastomer composites.
title_zh: 天然橡胶/炭黑复合材料中基于 Calix[6] 芳烃的联锁反硫化胶使网络-界面协同增强
abstract_zh: 传统的硫磺硫化为不饱和橡胶提供了实用的交联，但难以通过简单且可扩展的策略同时提高抗撕裂性、冲击耐久性、加工稳定性和老化性能。在此，我们报告了一种杯[6]芳烃介导的逆硫化方法，用于设计天然橡胶/炭黑（NR/CB）复合材料的机械互锁多硫化物交联剂。设计了两个大循环系统来阐明界面集成的作用。叔丁基杯[6]芳烃（TBC6）缺乏可聚合基团，形成聚轮烷结构，主要在橡胶-填料界面起作用，增强结合橡胶的形成并实现界面滑动。相比之下，烯丙基官能化的杯[6]芳烃（ATBC6）共价结合到硫化网络中，在本体内部构建可滑动的交联，同时增强橡胶-填料界面耦合。这种协调的网络接口架构可促进有效的应力传递并抑制裂纹扩展。与传统硫化橡胶相比，基于 ATBC6 的复合材料的撕裂强度提高了 140%，断裂韧性提高了 340%，同时具有显着的应变率硬化和改进的能量吸收。此外，稳定的多硫键和酚单元赋予增强的热氧化老化性能。这种可扩展的界面工程策略为高性能弹性体复合材料提供了一条实用途径。

title: Removal of Codispersible Residual Impurities from CuInS 2 /ZnS Quantum Dots for Window-Replaceable Luminescent Solar Concentrators
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Luminescent solar concentrators (LSCs) are promising for building-integrated photovoltaic windows. CuInS2/ZnS colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) are ideal LSC emitters owing to broad absorption, large Stokes shift, and high photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY). However, ZnS shell growth with zinc acetate, 1-dodecanethiol, and oleic acid produces codispersible residual impurities (CDRI) via in situ thioesterification. Identified here for the first time, these species mimic CQD dispersion/precipitation, coprecipitating during excess-antisolvent purification, reducing colloidal stability and limiting ink formulation. We introduce polarity-tuned precipitation that precipitates CQDs while retaining CDRI in the supernatant, preserving PLQY, improving colloidal stability, and expanding formulation compatibility. The resulting inks yield impurity-free, low-haze, uniform 10 × 10 cm2 LSC waveguides and LSC-PV windows with acceptable transmittance. Integrated with heterojunction Si cells and a power-management IC, the window reliably powers a Bluetooth low energy sensor under mixed sunlight and indoor light.
title_zh: 去除可更换窗口发光太阳能聚光器的 CuInS 2 /ZnS 量子点中的共分散残留杂质
abstract_zh: 发光太阳能聚光器（LSC）在建筑一体化光伏窗方面很有前景。 CuInS2/ZnS 胶体量子点 (CQD) 具有宽吸收、大斯托克斯位移和高光致发光量子产率 (PLQY) 的优点，是理想的 LSC 发射器。然而，用乙酸锌、1-十二烷硫醇和油酸生长的 ZnS 壳会通过原位硫酯化产生共分散残留杂质 (CDRI)。此处首次鉴定，这些物质模拟 CQD 分散/沉淀，在过量反溶剂纯化过程中共沉淀，降低胶体稳定性并限制油墨配方。我们引入了极性调节沉淀，可沉淀 CQD，同时保留上清液中的 CDRI，保留 PLQY，提高胶体稳定性并扩大配方相容性。由此产生的油墨可产生无杂质、低雾度、均匀的 10 × 10 cm2 LSC 波导和具有可接受透射率的 LSC-PV 窗口。该窗户与异质结硅电池和电源管理 IC 集成，可在阳光和室内光线混合的情况下可靠地为蓝牙低能耗传感器供电。

title: Durable Core–Shell Scatterer Coating with Heat Storage for Radiative Cooling
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: To address global warming and energy crises, passive radiative cooling (PRC) technology has shown great application value as a zero-energy solution. However, the excellent optical properties of radiative cooling materials are susceptible to environmental pollution and aging, leading to cooling inefficiencies. Meanwhile, the continuous cooling inevitably leads to overcooling at night, making the cooling time-sensitive. These factors pose obstacles to achieving stable and continuous cooling solutions. Herein, we designed and fabricated a novel inorganic core-shell scatterer (ICSS) with ultraviolet (UV) resistance and thermal storage capability. Through silanization modification and evaporation-driven assembly, a superhydrophobic coating has been developed, thereby integrating UV resistance, antisoiling, and heat storage. The ICSS coatings with high solar reflectance of up to 96.7% and infrared emittance of up to 98.8%, combined with phase change material heat absorption, exhibit an average cooling effect of 4.8 °C during the daytime. At night, with the release of stored heat, the coating is only 0.6 °C lower than the ambient temperature, effectively avoiding nighttime overcooling, showing excellent temperature stability. Furthermore, after 336 h of UV irradiation and 1 month of outdoor aging, the solar reflectivity decreased by only 0.6% and 1.0% compared to the initial coating. The ability of the ICSS coating to maintain performance and temperature stability is expected to achieve long-term application in the real world, providing new ways to address global warming and energy crises.
title_zh: 耐用的核壳散射涂层，具有辐射冷却储热功能
abstract_zh: 为了解决全球变暖和能源危机，被动辐射冷却（PRC）技术作为零能耗解决方案显示出了巨大的应用价值。然而，辐射冷却材料优异的光学性能容易受到环境污染和老化的影响，导致冷却效率低下。同时，连续制冷不可避免地会导致夜间过冷，制冷时间敏感。这些因素对实现稳定、连续的冷却解决方案构成了障碍。在此，我们设计并制造了一种具有抗紫外线（UV）和蓄热能力的新型无机核壳散射体（ICSS）。通过硅烷化改性和蒸发驱动组装，开发出了一种集抗紫外线、防污和蓄热于一体的超疏水涂层。 ICSS涂层具有高达96.7%的高太阳光反射率和高达98.8%的红外发射率，结合相变材料吸热，在白天表现出平均4.8℃的降温效果。夜间，随着储存热量的释放，涂层仅比环境温度低0.6℃，有效避免夜间过冷，表现出优异的温度稳定性。此外，经过336小时的紫外线照射和1个月的户外老化后，太阳光反射率与初始涂层相比仅下降了0.6%和1.0%。 ICSS涂层保持性能和温度稳定性的能力有望在现实世界中实现长期应用，为解决全球变暖和能源问题提供新途径

title: Programmed cryogenic fabrication of cuttlebone-inspired lightweight cellular materials with enhanced energy absorption
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lightweight engineering materials with high energy absorption are critical for various strategic fields. However, designing cellular materials that overcome the trade-off between density and energy dissipation remains challenging. Inspired by the wall-septum architecture of cuttlebone, we develop a lightweight cellular epoxy resin using a facile layer-by-layer freezing technique. The resulting material exhibits high compressive strength and specific energy absorption, reaching 34.5 J g−1 at a density of 0.55 g cm−3. The dense septa between porous wall layers in the wall-septum structure enhance structural stability against wall buckling and provide lateral confinement during compression. Such architecture also improves high-strain-rate impact strength, achieving 190% and 66% increase in dynamic specific energy absorption compared to conventional isotropic and unidirectional structures, respectively. Large-size energy-absorbing epoxy panels are readily fabricated and demonstrate impact protection performance under high-speed impact. This work provides a practical route to lightweight cellular materials with improved energy absorption efficiency.
title_zh: 受墨鱼骨启发的轻质蜂窝材料的程序化低温制造，具有增强的能量吸收能力
abstract_zh: 具有高能量吸收的轻质工程材料对于各个战略领域至关重要。然而，设计克服密度和能量耗散之间的权衡的多孔材料仍然具有挑战性。受墨鱼骨壁隔膜结构的启发，我们使用简便的逐层冷冻技术开发了一种轻质多孔环氧树脂。所得材料表现出高抗压强度和比能量吸收，在密度为 0.55 g cm−3 时达到 34.5 J g−1。壁-隔膜结构中的多孔壁层之间的致密隔膜增强了针对壁屈曲的结构稳定性，并在压缩期间提供横向限制。这种结构还提高了高应变率冲击强度，与传统的各向同性和单向结构相比，动态比能量吸收分别提高了 190% 和 66%。大尺寸吸能环氧树脂板易于制造，并在高速冲击下表现出冲击防护性能。这项工作为制备具有更高能量吸收效率的轻质蜂窝材料提供了一条实用途径。

title: Tunable Redox Dynamics of Organic Electrochemical Transistors for High-Performance Parallel Reservoir Computing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) performance is determined by the channel material's ability to transport both ions and electrons. However, many high-mobility organic semiconductors are hydrophobic and ion-impermeable, which limits their electrochemical activity. Consequently, achieving controllable redox modulation requires complex molecular design and multistep synthesis, thereby impeding their use in diverse applications. Herein, we establish a facile semiconductor blending strategy that enables hierarchical redox control in OECTs, advancing them toward high-performance parallel reservoir computing (RC). By integrating a hydrophilic organic mixed ionic-electronic conductor (OMIEC) into a hydrophobic semiconductor, the resulting phase-separated microstructure preserves ordered molecular packing for charge transport while governing composition-dependent ion accessibility. This allows on-demand electrochemical doping kinetics to optimize transfer characteristics, overcome the electrochemical inactivity issue of pristine PBTTT-C14, and achieve high current, large on/off ratio (∼2.3 × 104) along with improved cycling stability. More importantly, blended OECTs serve as multitime scale synaptic nodes, and by leveraging these distinct relaxation dynamics, we construct a parallel reservoir via multitime scale fusion, boosting Fashion-MNIST data set accuracy by over 10% compared to a single OECT. This work pioneers a materials-centric paradigm for engineering emergent ion-electron functionalities via programmable microstructures, thereby laying the material foundation for next-generation neuromorphic hardware capable of integrated sensing, memory, and parallel computation.
title_zh: 用于高性能并行储层计算的有机电化学晶体管的可调谐氧化还原动力学
abstract_zh: 有机电化学晶体管 (OECT) 的性能取决于通道材料传输离子和电子的能力。然而，许多高迁移率有机半导体具有疏水性和离子不可渗透性，这限制了它们的电化学活性。因此，实现可控的氧化还原调节需要复杂的分子设计和多步骤合成，从而阻碍了它们在不同应用中的使用。在此，我们建立了一种简便的半导体混合策略，可以在 OECT 中实现分层氧化还原控制，从而将其推向高性能并行储层计算（RC）。通过将亲水性有机混合离子电子导体 (OMIEC) 集成到疏水性半导体中，所得的相分离微结构保留了用于电荷传输的有序分子堆积，同时控制了取决于成分的离子可及性。这使得按需电化学掺杂动力学能够优化转移特性，克服原始 PBTTT-C14 的电化学不活性问题，并实现高电流、大开/关比 (∼2.3 × 104) 以及改善的循环稳定性。更重要的是，混合 OECT 作为多时间尺度突触节点，通过利用这些不同的松弛动力学，我们通过多时间尺度融合构建了一个并行存储库，与单个 OECT 相比，将 Fashion-MNIST 数据集的准确性提高了 10% 以上。这项工作开创了一种以材料为中心的范例，通过可编程微结构设计新兴的离子电子功能，从而奠定了材料基础

title: Programmable Cell Orientation Induced by Highly Ordered Gold Nanosphere Arrays
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Cellular orientation is critical for the formation and functionality of many native tissues, which plays a pivotal role in tissue engineering and regeneration. Here, an anisotropic surface nanostructure composed of highly ordered linear assemblies of gold nanospheres (AuNSs) on wrinkled polydimethylsiloxane substrates is fabricated to direct cell alignment. The AuNS linear assemblies provide nanotopographical cues that induce pronounced elongation and directional alignment of RSC96 Schwann cells along the AuNS chains, overriding the guidance effect of the underlying wrinkle topography. Immunofluorescence analysis further reveals that this guidance effect is associated with the directional organization of focal adhesions and tension-dependent mechanotransduction, involving myosin II-mediated cytoskeletal reorganization. This cell-guidance effect is also observed across multiple cell types, including L929 fibroblasts, HeLa cells, and bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, demonstrating broad applicability across multiple cell types. Furthermore, the patterned AuNS assemblies could enable programmable control over cell alignment and migration. This surface nanostructure achieved by AuNS linear assemblies provides a potential strategy for manipulating cellular architecture and advancing the tissue engineering and regenerative medicine.
title_zh: 高度有序的金纳米球阵列诱导可编程细胞方向
abstract_zh: 细胞定向对于许多天然组织的形成和功能至关重要，在组织工程和再生中发挥着关键作用。在这里，在褶皱的聚二甲基硅氧烷基底上制造了由高度有序的金纳米球（AuNS）线性组装组成的各向异性表面纳米结构，以指导细胞排列。 AuNS 线性组件提供纳米形貌线索，诱导 RSC96 雪旺细胞沿着 AuNS 链显着伸长和定向排列，从而超越潜在皱纹形貌的引导效应。免疫荧光分析进一步揭示，这种引导效应与粘着斑的定向组织和张力依赖性机械转导有关，涉及肌球蛋白 II 介导的细胞骨架重组。这种细胞引导效应也在多种细胞类型中观察到，包括 L929 成纤维细胞、HeLa 细胞和骨髓间充质干细胞，证明了其在多种细胞类型中的广泛适用性。此外，图案化的 AuNS 组件可以实现对细胞排列和迁移的可编程控制。这种由 AuNS 线性组件实现的表面纳米结构为操纵细胞结构和推进组织工程和再生医学提供了潜在的策略。

title: An HMA-like integrated domain in the wheat tandem kinase WTK4 recognises an RNase-like pathogen effector
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Proteins with a tandem kinase structure have recently emerged as players in race-specific resistance in cereal crops. However, the molecular understanding of these immune receptors’ resistance mechanisms is limited by the lack of knowledge about the pathogen effectors that they recognise. In this work, we identify AvrWTK4, the wheat powdery mildew RNase-like effector recognised by the wheat tandem kinase protein WTK4, through a combination of bi-parental genetic mapping and mutagenesis. We demonstrate that mutations in the AvrWTK4 gene or a reduction of its expression lead to virulence on WTK4. Transfection of AvrWTK4 specifically induced cell death in WTK4-expressing Aegilops tauschii protoplasts. The avirulent AvrWTK4 variant interacts more strongly than the virulent variant with the N-terminal heavy metal-associated (HMA)-like domain of WTK4. We found that the integrated HMA-like domain possibly serves as a direct effector-binding decoy for WTK4, providing a mechanistic paradigm for effector recognition by tandem kinase proteins.
title_zh: 小麦串联激酶 WTK4 中的 HMA 样整合域可识别 RNase 样病原体效应子
abstract_zh: 具有串联激酶结构的蛋白质最近已成为谷类作物种族特异性抗性的参与者。然而，由于缺乏对这些免疫受体识别的病原体效应子的了解，对这些免疫受体抵抗机制的分子理解受到限制。在这项工作中，我们通过双亲遗传图谱和诱变的结合，鉴定了 AvrWTK4，即由小麦串联激酶蛋白 WTK4 识别的小麦白粉病 RNase 样效应子。我们证明 AvrWTK4 基因的突变或其表达的减少会导致 WTK4 的毒力。 AvrWTK4 的转染特异性诱导表达 WTK4 的节节山羊草原生质体中的细胞死亡。无毒 AvrWTK4 变体与 WTK4 N 端重金属相关 (HMA) 样结构域的相互作用比强毒变体更强。我们发现集成的 HMA 样结构域可能作为 WTK4 的直接效应器结合诱饵，为串联激酶蛋白的效应器识别提供了机制范例。

title: Applying Artificial Intelligence and machine learning in precision nutrition
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A key feature of the Precision Nutrition and Health approach is the ability to tailor interventions to individual variability using multimodal data from large-scale biobanks and cohorts. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) models offer new potential to model complex data but remain constrained by challenges related to data quality, interpretability, validation, and causal inference. This Perspective synthesizes current AI/ML methodologies in PN, elucidates their interplay with the distinctive features of multi-omic and nutritional data, such as being compositional, episodic, context-dependent, and error-prone, and delineates nutrition-specific best practices for achieving robust, interpretable, and clinically actionable AI integration in research and practice.
title_zh: 人工智能和机器学习在精准营养中的应用
abstract_zh: 精准营养与健康方法的一个关键特征是能够利用大规模生物库和队列的多模式数据根据个体差异定制干预措施。人工智能 (AI) 和机器学习 (ML) 模型为复杂数据建模提供了新的潜力，但仍然受到与数据质量、可解释性、验证和因果推理相关的挑战的限制。本视角综合了 PN 中当前的 AI/ML 方法，阐明了它们与多组学和营养数据的独特特征之间的相互作用，例如成分、情景、上下文相关和容易出错，并描述了特定于营养的最佳实践，以在研究和实践中实现稳健、可解释和临床可操作的 AI 集成。

title: FLOWR.ROOT – A flow matching-based foundation model for joint multi-purpose structure-aware 3D ligand generation and affinity prediction
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: We present FLOWR.ROOT, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching foundation model that unifies pocket-aware 3D ligand generation with multi-endpoint binding affinity prediction (pIC50, pKi, pKd, pEC50) and pLDDT-based confidence estimation in a single backbone. One trained model supports de novo pocket-conditional generation, interaction- and pharmacophore-conditional sampling, scaffold hopping and elaboration, and fragment growing or replacement, enabled by a mixed isotropic–anisotropic prior placement strategy. Training proceeds in three stages: large-scale pre-training on billions of ligand conformations and millions of mixed-fidelity protein–ligand complexes, refinement on curated co-crystal data, and project-specific adaptation via parameter-efficient LoRA finetuning. Joint structure–affinity modelling enables inference-time importance-sampling guidance for single- and multi-objective design without external scoring functions. Case studies on kinase selectivity (CK2α/CLK3) and scaffold elaboration on TYK2, ERα, and BACE1 illustrate utility from hit identification through lead optimization.
title_zh: FLOWR.ROOT – 基于流匹配的基础模型，用于联合多用途结构感知 3D 配体生成和亲和力预测
abstract_zh: 我们提出了 FLOWR.ROOT，一种 SE(3) 等变流匹配基础模型，它将口袋感知 3D 配体生成与多端点结合亲和力预测（pIC50、pKi、pKd、pEC50）和基于 pLDDT 的置信度估计统一在单个主干中。一种训练有素的模型支持从头口袋条件生成、相互作用和药效基团条件采样、支架跳跃和精加工以及片段生长或替换，通过混合各向同性-各向异性预先放置策略实现。训练分三个阶段进行：对数十亿个配体构象和数百万个混合保真度蛋白质-配体复合物进行大规模预训练，对策划的共晶数据进行细化，以及通过参数高效的 LoRA 微调进行项目特定的适应。联合结构亲和力建模可以为单目标和多目标设计提供推理时间重要性采样指导，而无需外部评分函数。关于激酶选择性 (CK2α/CLK3) 的案例研究以及 TYK2、ERα 和 BACE1 的支架阐述说明了从命中识别到先导化合物优化的实用性。

title: Engineering in vitro models to replicate the complexity of chronic wounds
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chronic wounds represent a major clinical challenge driven by sustained inflammation, proteolytic imbalance, microbial colonisation, and impaired tissue regeneration. This review critically examines 2D and 3D in vitro models used in chronic wound research, evaluating their capacity to recapitulate chronicity across venous leg ulcers, diabetic foot ulcers, and pressure ulcers. Current systems lack the biochemical complexity required to reproduce key features of the non-healing phenotype. Building on quantitative clinical wound exudate data, we propose a feature-driven, aetiology-stratified framework that provides modular design considerations for in vitro models and chronic wound simulating media.
title_zh: 设计体外模型来复制慢性伤口的复杂性
abstract_zh: 慢性伤口是由持续炎症、蛋白水解失衡、微生物定植和组织再生受损引起的主要临床挑战。本综述严格审查了慢性伤口研究中使用的 2D 和 3D 体外模型，评估了它们重现腿部静脉溃疡、糖尿病足溃疡和压疮慢性病的能力。当前的系统缺乏重现非愈合表型的关键特征所需的生化复杂性。基于定量的临床伤口渗出液数据，我们提出了一个特征驱动的、病因学分层的框架，为体外模型和慢性伤口模拟介质提供模块化设计考虑。

title: Droplet Microfluidics-Enabled Mitochondrial Transfer from Young to Senescent MSCs to Ameliorate Cellular Senescence
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) are widely used for tissue repair and regeneration, but prolonged in vitro expansion induces senescence and limits their therapeutic efficacy. Given the key role of mitochondria in cellular senescence and metabolic regulation, mitochondrial transfer may offer a promising strategy for ameliorating senescence-associated phenotypes. However, conventional mitochondrial transfer methods, such as coculture and microinjection, are limited by poor quantitative control, low throughput, and potential cell damage. Here, an inertial-focusing-assisted droplet microfluidic platform was developed for high-throughput, high-efficiency, and quantitative control of mitochondrial transfer at the single-cell level. The platform achieved 29.2% single-cell droplets and 1.3% multicell droplets, with a transfer efficiency of up to 56% at a droplet generation rate exceeding 4000 Hz. Using this platform, the transfer of 19 mitochondria from young adipose-derived MSCs (ADSCs) to senescent ADSCs enhanced proliferation capacity and metabolic activities, reduced senescence-associated markers, and transformed the senescent phenotype into a young MSC-like phenotype. The developed technique provides a cell therapy strategy for mitochondrial-related diseases.
title_zh: 液滴微流体使线粒体从年轻的间充质干细胞转移到衰老的间充质干细胞以改善细胞衰老
abstract_zh: 间充质干细胞（MSC）广泛用于组织修复和再生，但长时间的体外扩增会诱导衰老并限制其治疗效果。鉴于线粒体在细胞衰老和代谢调节中的关键作用，线粒体转移可能为改善衰老相关表型提供一种有前景的策略。然而，传统的线粒体转移方法，如共培养和显微注射，受到定量控制差、通量低和潜在细胞损伤的限制。在此，开发了惯性聚焦辅助液滴微流控平台，用于在单细胞水平上高通量、高效、定量地控制线粒体转移。该平台实现了 29.2% 的单细胞液滴和 1.3% 的多细胞液滴，在超过 4000 Hz 的液滴生成速率下，传输效率高达 56%。利用该平台，将19个线粒体从年轻的脂肪源性间充质干细胞（ADSCs）转移到衰老的ADSCs，增强了增殖能力和代谢活性，减少了衰老相关标志物，并将衰老表型转化为年轻的MSC样表型。所开发的技术为线粒体相关疾病提供了细胞治疗策略。

title: Nitrogen-doped amorphous carbon as atomically thin monolithic membrane
source: Matter
abstract: Atomically thin amorphous materials combine the benefits of two-dimensional geometry and structural disorder. Here, we report a remote plasma-assisted method to synthesize nitrogen-doped amorphous carbon (NDAC) membranes with continuously tunable thickness from sub-1 nm to several nanometers and demonstrate its application prospects in electron transmission and copper diffusion barrier fields. This work enables NDAC as a candidate for next-generation electronics and barrier coatings requiring extreme thickness, continuity, and isotropy.
title_zh: 氮掺杂无定形碳作为原子级薄单片膜
abstract_zh: 原子薄非晶材料结合了二维几何和结构无序的优点。在这里，我们报告了一种远程等离子体辅助方法来合成厚度从亚1纳米到几纳米连续可调的氮掺杂非晶碳（NDAC）膜，并展示了其在电子传输和铜扩散势垒领域的应用前景。这项工作使 NDAC 成为需要极高厚度、连续性和各向同性的下一代电子和阻隔涂层的候选材料。

title: High-Speed Atomic Force Microscopy Reveals Aptamer-Mediated Conformational Trapping of METTL3–METTL14 for m 6 A Inhibition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The conformational dynamics of METTL3-METTL14 (M3/M14) heterodimer, the catalytic core for N6-methyladenosine (m6A) deposition, remain largely unexplored, limiting insight into dynamic regulation of catalysis and opportunities for therapeutic targeting in cancer. Here, we report the first single-molecule visualization of M3/M14 dynamics by high-speed atomic force microscopy (HS-AFM). Our measurements show that substrate RNA binding induces a conformational transition from a rigid apo heterodimer with an open interlobe groove to a compact, catalytically competent state. Guided by these dynamic insights, we identify two potent DNA aptamer inhibitors of M3/M14, M3B, and M3L, using a competitive in vitro selection strategy. HS-AFM integrated with molecular docking reveals that both aptamers insert into the M3/M14 interface, forming a sandwich-like complex that stabilizes a distorted, open conformation and prevents RNA-induced compaction. This conformational trapping inhibits methyltransferase activity, reduces global m6A levels, and suppresses A549 lung cancer cell growth. These findings define a dynamically regulated, interlobe targetable state of the m6A writer complex and demonstrate the utility of HS-AFM for uncovering dynamic regulatory mechanisms and guiding the development of conformationally targeted therapeutics in epitranscriptomic biology.

title: Multifunctional Luminescent Solar Concentrator Integrating Optical Thermometry Based on PMMA/Eu III -Complex Films for Smart Windows
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Multifunctional luminescent materials capable of simultaneously harvesting solar energy and monitoring environmental conditions are promising for next-generation smart windows. Here, we report transparent poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) films doped with the EuIII-based (Et4N)[Eu(nta)4] complex (nta-: 4,4,4-trifluoro-1-(naphthalen-2-yl)butane-1,3-dionate; Et4N+: tetraethylammonium), designed to function as both luminescent solar concentrators (LSCs) and luminescent temperature probes. The nta- ligand enables efficient sunlight absorption in the near-ultraviolet spectral range and sensitization of the EuIII luminescence, affording overall emission quantum(QEuL)yields of up to 50% and sensitization efficiencies above 90%. The resulting PMMA films remain highly transparent (90-100% transmittance) and display homogeneous dopant dispersion, yielding intense red EuIII emission upon exposure to sunlight and effective waveguiding. When coupled to a silicon photovoltaic cell and exposed to daylight, the PMMA:2%EuIII film enhances current generation relative to an uncoated glass substrate, confirming its LSC capability. Moreover, the EuIII 5D0 lifetime is gradually quenched from 280 to 420 K (maximum relative thermal sensitivity of 4.7% K-1 at 397 K), indicating that the film can operate as a temperature probe in locations exhibiting elevated temperatures (e.g., tropical countries, rooftops, parking lots). These results establish EuIII-doped PMMA films as promising dual-function platforms for transparent, energy-harvesting smart windows with integrated optical temperature monitoring.
