title: Multi-metallic additive manufacturing: Interfaces and microstructures
source: Matter
abstract: Multi-metallic additive manufacturing integrates dissimilar metals into monolithic components with site-specific properties, yet inadequate atomic-level interfacial adhesion and inhomogeneous microstructural transitions remain critical challenges. This review elucidates the thermodynamic miscibility rules governing heterointerface formation, clarifies defect origins including intermetallic compounds, pores, and elemental segregation, and reveals the interface-microstructure-property correlations. A systematic framework encompassing compatibility evaluation, process decision-making, and defect control is established, advancing the materials science foundation for industrializing multi-metallic printed structures.
title_zh: 多金属增材制造：界面和微观结构
abstract_zh: 多金属增材制造将不同金属集成到具有特定位置特性的整体部件中，但原子级界面粘附力不足和微观结构转变不均匀仍然是关键挑战。这篇综述阐明了控制异质界面形成的热力学混溶性规则，阐明了缺陷起源，包括金属间化合物、孔隙和元素偏析，并揭示了界面-微观结构-性能之间的相关性。建立了涵盖兼容性评估、工艺决策和缺陷控制的系统框架，为多金属印刷结构工业化奠定了材料科学基础。

title: From thermodynamically metastable to stable: Stimuli-independent transformable nanophotosensitizers for practical photodynamic therapy
source: Matter
abstract: A key technical bottleneck in further translation of cancer nanomedicine is balancing deep tissue penetration with long-term retention. This study reports a stimuli-independent transformable nanophotosensitizer (SITNPS) that penetrates tumors as nanospheres and gradually converts into nanorods, prolonging tumor residence. SITNPS can be activated by either two-photon laser or smartphone torch excitation and facilitates repeated light treatments after a single administration, paving an accessible route toward more practical cancer phototherapy.
title_zh: 从热力学亚稳态到稳定：用于实际光动力治疗的独立于刺激的可转化纳米光敏剂
abstract_zh: 癌症纳米医学进一步转化的一个关键技术瓶颈是平衡深层组织渗透与长期保留。这项研究报告了一种不依赖刺激的可转化纳米光敏剂（SITNPS），它以纳米球的形式穿透肿瘤，并逐渐转化为纳米棒，从而延长肿瘤的停留时间。 SITNPS 可以通过双光子激光或智能手机火炬激发来激活，并有助于在单次给药后重复进行光治疗，为更实用的癌症光疗铺平了一条可行的途径。

title: Tumor Acidity-Activatable Ionizable Lipid Nanoparticles for Selective Oncolytic Therapy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Ionizable lipids, widely employed as pharmaceutical excipients for gene delivery, exhibit acidity-responsive membrane-destabilizing activity. This property prompted us to hypothesize that such membrane-destabilizing activity could be harnessed and selectively confined to the acidic tumor microenvironment (aTME) to achieve tumor-selective oncolysis. Herein, we report the rational design of tumor acidity-activatable oncolytic lipid nanoparticles (aoLNPs) through programmed structural modulation of ionizable lipids. By designing and screening an ionizable lipid library with systematic variations in alkyl tail length and number, we found a clear correlation between the total tail carbon number and the pH-dependent cytotoxicity of the corresponding lipid nanoparticles. Subsequent library expansion led to the identification of aoLNPE14A6-2 as the optimal candidate, which exhibited selective cytotoxicity toward cancer cells at pH 6.8 and demonstrated potent antitumor efficacy in vivo. Mechanistic investigations revealed that aoLNPE14A6-2 selectively induces lysosomal vacuolation and endoplasmic reticulum stress under tumor acidic conditions, ultimately leading to plasma membrane rupture. Notably, aoLNPE14A6-2 did not cause obvious chronic toxicity or structural damage to normal tissues after intravenous injection. This study expands the application of ionizable lipids for selective oncolytic therapy.
title_zh: 用于选择性溶瘤治疗的肿瘤酸度激活可电离脂质纳米颗粒
abstract_zh: 可电离脂质广泛用作基因传递的药物赋形剂，表现出酸度响应性膜不稳定活性。这一特性促使我们假设这种膜不稳定活性可以被利用并选择性地限制在酸性肿瘤微环境（aTME）中，以实现肿瘤选择性溶瘤。在此，我们报告了通过可电离脂质的程序结构调节合理设计的肿瘤酸度激活溶瘤脂质纳米颗粒（aoLNP）。通过设计和筛选具有系统变化的烷基尾长度和数量的可电离脂质库，我们发现总尾碳数与相应脂质纳米颗粒的pH依赖性细胞毒性之间存在明显的相关性。随后的文库扩展导致 aoLNPE14A6-2 被鉴定为最佳候选者，它在 pH 6.8 下对癌细胞表现出选择性细胞毒性，并在体内表现出有效的抗肿瘤功效。机制研究表明，aoLNPE14A6-2在肿瘤酸性条件下选择性诱导溶酶体空泡形成和内质网应激，最终导致质膜破裂。值得注意的是，aoLNPE14A6-2静脉注射后并未对正常组织造成明显的慢性毒性或结构损伤。这项研究扩大了可电离脂质在选择性溶瘤治疗中的应用。

title: Electrostatic regulation of solvation chemistry enables ampere-hour-scale high-energy lithium metal batteries
source: Nature Nanotechnology
abstract: Achieving high specific energy in lithium metal batteries requires rational electrolyte design to promote effective interphase formation. State-of-the-art electrolyte design strategies fall short because they lack fundamental guidelines that connect solvent characteristics with electrolyte properties. Here we explain the influence of the medium environment on solvation states and anion reduction, and propose a mediator-enhanced electrolyte design strategy by quantitatively exploring various solvent classes using designed polarity indices. The solvent mediator approach generates, at the nanoscale, intermolecular electrostatic fields through separated solvent surface charges, enhancing interactions to better accommodate solvated lithium ions and decreasing the reduction energy barrier for anions. These tailored mediator-enhanced electrolyte solutions (MEEs) exhibit stable solvation states and adequate interphase formation, enabling robust interfacial chemistries and preventing side reactions. Using the MEE design in a 6-Ah Li ‖ LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 pouch cell results in an initial specific energy of 508 Wh kg−1 (based on the cell’s total mass) at 21 mA g−1 (based on the cell’s cathode mass), with 93% energy retention after 149 cycles at 42 mA g−1. In a 16-Ah zero-lithium-excess Cu ‖ LiNi0.90Mn0.05Co0.05O2 pouch cell, the MEE approach also enables an initial specific energy of about 550 Wh kg−1 (based on the cell’s total mass) at 23 mA g−1.
title_zh: 溶剂化化学的静电调节使安时级高能锂金属电池成为可能
abstract_zh: 要在锂金属电池中实现高比能量，需要合理的电解质设计以促进有效的界面形成。最先进的电解质设计策略存在缺陷，因为它们缺乏将溶剂特性与电解质特性联系起来的基本准则。在这里，我们解释了介质环境对溶剂化状态和阴离子还原的影响，并通过使用设计的极性指数定量探索各种溶剂类别，提出了介体增强电解质设计策略。溶剂介体方法通过分离的溶剂表面电荷产生纳米级分子间静电场，增强相互作用以更好地容纳溶剂化锂离子并降低阴离子的还原能垒。这些定制的介体增强电解质溶液 (MEE) 表现出稳定的溶剂化状态和充分的界面形成，从而实现稳健的界面化学并防止副反应。在 6-Ah Li ‖ LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 软包电池中使用 MEE 设计，在 21 mA g−1（基于电池的阴极质量）下的初始比能量为 508 Wh kg−1（基于电池的总质量），在 42 mA g−1 下经过 149 个循环后能量保留率为 93%。在 16-Ah 零锂过量 Cu ‖ LiNi0.90Mn0.05Co0.05O2 软包电池中，MEE 方法还可以在 23 mA g−1 电流下实现约 550 Wh kg−1 （基于电池总质量）的初始比能。

title: Harnessing local chemical order in high-entropy ceramics for broadband electromagnetic absorption
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electromagnetic pollution from the rapid expansion of wireless and electronic systems demands advanced absorber materials. High-entropy ceramics offer a promising platform for broadband electromagnetic wave attenuation, yet their rational design remains underdeveloped. Here, we introduce a mechanism-driven strategy to enhance absorption by tailoring local chemical order via simple thermal processing. Applied to high-entropy carbides, this local chemical order-engineering approach delivers a record effective absorption bandwidth of 11.2 GHz. Atomic-resolution chemical mapping paired with theoretical simulations reveals that local chemical order, rather than atomic vacancies, governs the dominant electromagnetic wave absorption mechanisms. We further demonstrate the universality of this principle across diverse high-entropy ceramic families (borides, oxides, sulfides, silicides, and selenides), each exhibiting substantial performance gains. This work establishes a clear, structure-guided framework for designing high-performance single-phase absorbers and offers a versatile route to mitigate electromagnetic pollution through targeted control of atomic-scale chemical order.
title_zh: 利用高熵陶瓷中的局部化学顺序实现宽带电磁吸收
abstract_zh: 无线和电子系统快速扩张带来的电磁污染需要先进的吸收材料。高熵陶瓷为宽带电磁波衰减提供了一个有前景的平台，但其合理设计仍然不发达。在这里，我们引入了一种机制驱动的策略，通过简单的热处理定制局部化学顺序来增强吸收。这种局部化学顺序工程方法应用于高熵碳化物，可提供创纪录的 11.2 GHz 有效吸收带宽。原子分辨率化学测绘与理论模拟相结合表明，局部化学顺序（而不是原子空位）控制着主要的电磁波吸收机制。我们进一步证明了这一原理在不同高熵陶瓷家族（硼化物、氧化物、硫化物、硅化物和硒化物）中的普遍性，每种陶瓷都表现出显着的性能提升。这项工作为设计高性能单相吸收器建立了一个清晰的、以结构为导向的框架，并提供了一种通过有针对性地控制原子级化学顺序来减轻电磁污染的通用途径。

title: Spike-based alignment learning solves the weight transport problem
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Learning algorithms are often subject to symmetry constraints that are difficult to reconcile with local computation in physical neuronal networks. For example, contrastive Hebbian learning typically assumes symmetric connectivity, while error backpropagation requires knowledge of the forward weights in the backward pass. To solve this weight transport problem, we introduce spike-based alignment learning (SAL), a synapse-local learning rule that harnesses noise for weight alignment. This rule can operate simultaneously with other functional learning rules to maintain the necessary symmetry throughout learning and thereby ensure the correct local representation of gradients. SAL implicitly alleviates any discrepancy arising from the neuron and synapse variability that is ubiquitous in analog substrates, whether biological or artificial. We demonstrate the efficacy of our mechanism using different network models for spiking Bayesian inference and bio-plausible error backpropagation, and benchmark it in a deep learning computer vision task.
title_zh: 基于尖峰的对齐学习解决了重量传输问题
abstract_zh: 学习算法通常受到对称约束，这些约束很难与物理神经网络中的局部计算相协调。例如，对比赫布学习通常假设对称连接，而误差反向传播需要了解后向传递中的前向权重。为了解决这个权重传输问题，我们引入了基于尖峰的对齐学习（SAL），这是一种利用噪声进行权重对齐的突触局部学习规则。该规则可以与其他函数学习规则同时运行，以在整个学习过程中保持必要的对称性，从而确保梯度的正确局部表示。 SAL 隐含地减轻了由神经元和突触变异性引起的任何差异，这种差异在模拟基质（无论是生物的还是人工的）中普遍存在。我们使用不同的网络模型来证明我们的机制的有效性，以进行尖峰贝叶斯推理和生物合理误差反向传播，并在深度学习计算机视觉任务中对其进行基准测试。

title: A Robust Carbon Overlayer as Hydrogen Spillover Highway and CO-Binding Barrier Enhances Reverse Water–Gas Shift
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Selective CO2 hydrogenation into CO via the reverse water-gas shift (RWGS) reaction is a pivotal route for large-scale carbon abatement, yet it remains hindered by the scarcity of efficient and scalable catalysts. Here, we report the construction of a high-performance Ni/TiO2 catalyst by encapsulating in an in situ-created, robust carbon layer for boosting CO2 conversion and CO selectivity. Mechanistic studies reveal that this catalyst follows an oxygen-vacancy-mediated redox pathway that spatiotemporally decouples CO2 and H2 activation, thereby offering a straightforward route to mitigate the activity-selectivity trade-off inherent in RWGS catalysis. The carbon overlayer, featuring a substantially lower hydrogen diffusion barrier than the bare TiO2 surface, serves as a hydrogen spillover highway that generates abundant and distal oxygen vacancies on TiO2, thereby driving efficient CO2 dissociation. While ensuring effective H2 activation through the formed surface Ni-C species, the carbon overlayer suppresses CO adsorption on Ni by blocking charge transfer, thus inhibiting the undesirable side reactions of methanation and CO disproportionation. This dual functionality enables the carbon-coated Ni/TiO2 catalyst to sustain equilibrium CO2 conversion with a near-100% CO selectivity for over 500 h under industrially relevant conditions, outperforming the majority of previously developed catalysts. Decorating an economical and effective carbon layer for geometric and electronic tuning provides a promising avenue for the design of novel hydrogenation catalysts.
title_zh: 坚固的碳覆盖层作为氢溢出高速公路和共结合屏障增强了反向水-气转移
abstract_zh: 通过逆水煤气变换（RWGS）反应将二氧化碳选择性加氢为二氧化碳是大规模碳减排的关键途径，但由于缺乏高效且可扩展的催化剂，该路线仍然受到阻碍。在这里，我们报告了通过封装在原位创建的坚固碳层中来构建高性能 Ni/TiO2 催化剂，以提高 CO2 转化率和 CO 选择性。机理研究表明，该催化剂遵循氧空位介导的氧化还原途径，可在时空上解耦 CO2 和 H2 的活化，从而提供了一种直接的途径来减轻 RWGS 催化中固有的活性-选择性权衡。碳覆盖层的氢扩散势垒比裸露的 TiO2 表面低得多，可作为氢溢出高速公路，在 TiO2 上产生丰富的远端氧空位，从而驱动有效的 CO2 解离。在通过形成的表面 Ni-C 物质确保有效的 H2 活化的同时，碳覆盖层通过阻止电荷转移来抑制 CO 在 Ni 上的吸附，从而抑制甲烷化和 CO 歧化等不良副反应。这种双重功能使碳包覆的 Ni/TiO2 催化剂能够在工业相关条件下维持平衡 CO2 转化，且 CO 选择性接近 100%，持续时间超过 500 小时，优于大多数先前开发的催化剂。装饰经济有效的碳层以进行几何和电子调谐，为新型加氢催化剂的设计提供了一条有前途的途径。

title: In situ optical techniques for perovskite crystallization
source: Joule
abstract: In situ optical characterization techniques have emerged as powerful tools for probing nucleation, phase evolution, and intermediate-state formation in real time. This review provides a systematic overview of the development and application of in situ optical techniques for studying perovskite crystallization. It aims to offer a comprehensive technical guide for researchers seeking to employ in situ optical methods to investigate perovskite crystallization.
title_zh: 钙钛矿结晶的原位光学技术
abstract_zh: 原位光学表征技术已成为实时探测成核、相演化和中间态形成的强大工具。本综述系统地概述了用于研究钙钛矿结晶的原位光学技术的发展和应用。它旨在为寻求采用原位光学方法研究钙钛矿结晶的研究人员提供全面的技术指南。

title: Bulk Ferromagnetic Icosahedral Quasicrystals without Rapid Quenching
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: While ferromagnetism is well understood in periodic and amorphous materials, its critical behavior in quasiperiodic systems has remained elusive. Although ferromagnetic icosahedral quasicrystals (iQCs) have recently been discovered, all known examples have been limited to rapidly quenched, metastable states, precluding annealing, structural refinement, and quantitative studies of magnetic criticality. Here we demonstrate, for the first time, the realization of bulk, annealable ferromagnetic iQCs in compositionally tuned Au-Cu-Al-In-R (R = Gd, Tb, Dy) alloys. Guided by chemical design in multicomponent alloy space, single-phase iQCs are obtained by conventional arc melting and subsequent controlled annealing, resulting in sharp quasiperiodic diffraction and exceptional thermal robustness. Strikingly, while all compounds exhibit clear ferromagnetic order, their magnetic critical behavior differs systematically depending on the rare-earth element. Tb- and Dy-based iQCs display critical exponents close to mean-field values, whereas the Gd-based system exhibits a significantly enhanced critical exponent δ, deviating from mean-field behavior and from both anisotropic counterparts and previously studied approximant crystals. This difference is attributed to stronger spin fluctuations in the isotropic Gd system, which effectively shorten the interaction range, while anisotropy in Tb/Dy suppresses fluctuations and leads to mean-field-like behavior. These results establish that magnetic criticality in quasicrystals is not uniquely determined by quasiperiodic order alone but is governed by the interplay between quasiperiodicity and local spin symmetry. More broadly, they demonstrate that quasiperiodic solids provide a tunable materials platform for accessing nonmean-field critical behavior beyond the constraints of periodic systems.
title_zh: 无需快速淬火的大块铁磁二十面体准晶

title: Formation of iron oxide-apatite deposits triggered by magmatic assimilation of evaporitic sulfate
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The geological origins of iron oxide-apatite (IOA) rocks, important resources for iron and rare-earth elements, are intensely debated. Using triple oxygen isotope data, we here show that magnetite from IOA deposits near Kiruna, northern Sweden, and related igneous rocks contain high concentrations of oxygen derived from evaporitic sulfate. To explain these observations, we propose that the Kiruna IOA assemblage formed in response to massive assimilation of evaporites by silicate magmas. sulfate from the evaporites would have oxidised ferrous iron in these magmas, facilitating the formation of immiscible ferric iron-rich melts and/or magnetite, which then separated from the magmas to form ore deposits. Ferric iron-bearing fluids with low Δ′17O values, exsolved from the silicate magmas or the ore-forming melts, would have crystallised additional magnetite. An inventory study reveals that Proterozoic and Cambrian IOA deposits have lower Δ′17O values than post-Cambrian IOA deposits. This shows that the Δ′17O values of global IOA deposits reflect the changing isotope composition of atmospheric O2 incorporated by evaporitic sulfate over time, and demonstrates that oxygen released from evaporitic sulfate is a common component in IOA deposits.
title_zh: 蒸发硫酸盐的岩浆同化引发氧化铁-磷灰石矿床的形成
abstract_zh: 氧化铁磷灰石（IOA）岩石是铁和稀土元素的重要资源，其地质起源存在激烈争论。利用三重氧同位素数据，我们发现来自瑞典北部基律纳附近 IOA 矿床的磁铁矿以及相关火成岩含有来自蒸发硫酸盐的高浓度氧。为了解释这些观察结果，我们提出基律纳 IOA 组合是由于硅酸盐岩浆对蒸发岩的大量同化而形成的。来自蒸发岩的硫酸盐会氧化这些岩浆中的亚铁，促进形成不混溶的富含三价铁的熔体和/或磁铁矿，然后从岩浆中分离出来形成矿床。从硅酸盐岩浆或成矿熔体中溶出的具有低 Δ'17O 值的含铁流体会结晶出额外的磁铁矿。一项库存研究表明，元古代和寒武纪 IOA 矿床的 Δ′17O 值低于寒武纪后 IOA 矿床。这表明全球IOA矿床的Δ′17O值反映了蒸发硫酸盐吸收的大气O2同位素组成随时间的变化，并表明蒸发硫酸盐释放的氧是IOA矿床的常见成分。

title: K/Sr Dual-Doping Enables Simultaneous Enhancement of Ionic Conductivity and Phase Stability for β-PbF 2 -Based Solid-State Fluoride-Ion Electrolyte
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: All-solid-state fluoride-ion batteries (ASSFIBs) integrate high theoretical energy density, high safety characteristics, and low manufacturing costs, making them a promising candidate for next-generation energy storage technologies. However, the intrinsic shortcomings of high-performance fluoride-ion solid electrolytes severely limit their practical application. Herein, a potassium/strontium dual-doping strategy is designed to synthesize the fluoride-ion conductor β-Pb0.88Sr0.08K0.04F1.96 with a fluorite structure via a straightforward solid-state reaction method. It has been found that KF doping can introduce abundant fluorine vacancy defects to effectively enhance vacancy concentration, while SrF2 and PbF2 can form a continuous solid solution that not only disperses fluorine vacancies generated by K+ doping and suppresses defect aggregation to significantly enhance phase stability, but also induces moderate lattice distortion through the incorporated Sr2+. Through reconfiguration of the local coordination environment of F-, the electrostatic interaction between F- and Pb2+ can be weakened, thereby reducing the ionic migration energy barrier. Owing to the higher vacancy concentration and lower migration barrier, the as-prepared material exhibits a high ionic conductivity of 4.77 × 10-4 S·cm-1 at room temperature, exceeding most reported fluoride ion conductors. ASSFIBs assembled with the fluoride ion conductor as the solid electrolyte present a discharge specific capacity of approximately 132.5 mAh·g-1 over 400 cycles and a capacity retention rate of 97.4%. Therefore, this work offers unique insights into the rational design of PbF2-based solid electrolytes featuring both high ionic conductivity and exceptional phase stability.

title: Causal effects of wildfire PM2.5 on hospital costs and length of stay in Brazil
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: To quantify the hospital burden of short-term wildfire-specific fine particulate matter (PM2.5), we linked 184.5 million patient-level hospitalizations across 449 Brazilian regions from 2000–2019 with daily wildfire-specific and non-wildfire PM2.5 estimates at 0.25° resolution. Using wind-driven variation in wildfire-specific PM2.5 within a space-time-stratified case-crossover framework, we estimated the effects of exposure on hospitalization costs and length of stay. Each 1 µg/m3 increase in wildfire-specific PM2.5 was associated with higher hospitalization costs for all-cause, respiratory, and cardiovascular diseases by 0.36%, 1.59%, and 0.25%, respectively, and longer stays by 0.63%, 1.72%, and 0.68%. Asthma and heart failure showed the largest cost increases, while asthma and pneumonia showed the largest increases in length of stay. Overall, wildfire-specific PM2.5 accounted for US$755.6 million in hospitalization costs and 30.8 million hospital days, with stronger relative effects among individuals aged 0–19 years and higher burdens in central-west Brazil.
title_zh: 野火 PM2.5 对巴西医院费用和住院时间的因果影响
abstract_zh: 为了量化短期野火特定细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 给医院造成的负担，我们将 2000 年至 2019 年巴西 449 个地区 1.845 亿患者住院治疗与每日野火特定和非野火 PM2.5 估计值（分辨率为 0.25°）联系起来。在时空分层病例交叉框架内，利用风驱动的野火特定 PM2.5 变化，我们估计了暴露对住院费用和住院时间的影响。野火特定 PM2.5 每增加 1 µg/m3，全因疾病、呼吸系统疾病和心血管疾病的住院费用分别增加 0.36%、1.59% 和 0.25%，住院时间延长 0.63%、1.72% 和 0.68%。哮喘和心力衰竭的费用增幅最大，而哮喘和肺炎的住院时间增幅最大。总体而言，野火特有的 PM2.5 造成了 7.556 亿美元的住院费用和 3,080 万住院天数，对 0-19 岁人群的相对影响更大，巴西中西部的负担更高。

title: Delicate inhibition of NFκB/RELA circuitry facilitates efficient transition towards ground-state pluripotency in human
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Rebuilding human naïve pluripotency from primed stem cells is essential for generating pre-implantation epiblast-like cells, a key source for regenerative medicine. Here we present a defined, feeder-free protocol that efficiently converts primed human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) to a naïve-like state within 12 days. Integrated ATAC-seq, RNA-seq and miRNA-seq analyses reveal a rapid chromatin rewiring marked by increased accessibility at OCT/KLF motifs, closure at ZIC/RFX/NFκB sites, upregulation of miR-372/373 and miR-182/183, and downregulation of miR-302 and miR-363/106 clusters. Functional assays demonstrate that the inflammatory transcription factor NFκB/RELA blocks naïve induction by activating peri-implantation barrier genes, including IKBKE and VEGFR1. Conversely, enforced miR-372/373 expression accelerates conversion by directly targeting RELA. These data delineate an NFκB/RELA axis that orchestrates the epigenetic switch to human naïve pluripotency, offering a tractable framework for studying early human development and advancing cell-based therapies.
title_zh: NFκB/RELA 电路的精细抑制有助于人类向基态多能性的有效转变
abstract_zh: 从引发的干细胞重建人类幼稚多能性对于产生植入前外胚层样细胞至关重要，这是再生医学的关键来源。在这里，我们提出了一种明确的、无饲养层的方案，可在 12 天内有效地将引发的人类多能干细胞 (hPSC) 转化为幼稚状态。综合 ATAC-seq、RNA-seq 和 miRNA-seq 分析揭示了染色质快速重连，其特征是 OCT/KLF 基序的可及性增加、ZIC/RFX/NFκB 位点闭合、miR-372/373 和 miR-182/183 上调以及 miR-302 和 miR-363/106 簇下调。功能分析表明，炎症转录因子 NFκB/RELA 通过激活植入周围屏障基因（包括 IKBKE 和 VEGFR1）来阻断初始诱导。相反，强制表达 miR-372/373 通过直接靶向 RELA 来加速转化。这些数据描绘了一个 NFκB/RELA 轴，它协调表观遗传向人类原始多能性的转变，为研究人类早期发育和推进基于细胞的疗法提供了一个易于处理的框架。

title: Modern arc-like water content in the source of 3.1-billion-year-old volcanic rocks
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Whether Archean arc-like volcanism reflects subduction remains debated. We present high-resolution geochemical data from a well-preserved 3.13-3.10 Ga arc-like volcanic succession in Australia’s Pilbara Craton, a rare Archean analog of modern arc volcanism retaining fluid-mobile element concentrations consistent with primary magmatic values. The sequence records three primitive lava series typical of modern arcs: tholeiitic, calc-alkaline, and the oldest stratigraphically extensive genuine boninites. Geochemical modelling shows this melt diversity requires at least two mantle sources with distinct depletion histories. The mantle H2O required for fluid-assisted melting to produce these lavas substantially exceeds primitive mantle, approaching the H2O-saturated solidus of modern mantle wedges. We infer hydrous melting was triggered by dripduction, the short-lived inclined foundering of hydrated lithosphere without laterally continuous plate boundaries, in an off-plateau setting. Dripduction locally recycled surface water and generated arc-like magmas without self-sustained plate tectonics, possibly promoting mantle-ocean-atmosphere volatile exchange during the Archean.
title_zh: 31亿年前火山岩源头的现代弧状含水量
abstract_zh: 太古代弧状火山活动是否反映了俯冲作用仍有争议。我们提供了澳大利亚皮尔巴拉克拉通保存完好的 3.13-3.10 Ga 弧状火山序列的高分辨率地球化学数据，这是现代弧火山活动的罕见太古代类似物，保留了与原生岩浆值一致的流体流动元素浓度。该序列记录了现代弧线典型的三个原始熔岩系列：拉斑岩、钙碱性熔岩和最古老的地层广泛的真正的博宁岩。地球化学模型表明，这种熔体多样性需要至少两个具有不同消耗历史的地幔源。流体辅助熔化产生这些熔岩所需的地幔 H2O 大大超过了原始地幔，接近现代地幔楔的 H2O 饱和固相线。我们推断含水熔融是由滴落引发的，滴落是在高原外环境中没有横向连续板块边界的水合岩石圈的短暂倾斜沉没。滴水作用局部循环地表水并产生弧状岩浆，但没有自我维持的板块构造，可能促进了太古宙期间地幔-海洋-大气的挥发性交换。

title: An Amphibious Bifunctional Probe for Protein Chemical Cross-Linking
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (CXMS) has emerged as a powerful and well-established method for probing protein structure, conformational dynamics, and protein-protein interactions, particularly in cases where classical high-resolution techniques face intrinsic limitations. The development of new cross-linking reagents with defined reactivity, activation, and compatibility with native conditions remains essential for expanding the scope and reliability of CXMS analyses. Here, we report the design and synthesis of two novel bis-hypervalent iodine reagents, called Togni cross-linking reagents TR1 and TR2, which function as efficient covalent protein cross-linkers. These reagents feature hypervalent iodine-fluoroalkyl motifs on both termini, enabling intra- and intermolecular cross-link formation. They selectively target aromatic amino acids and cysteine residues and can be activated either by ascorbate or through redox activation by thiol groups of cysteines. Moreover, these bifunctional probes can undergo transformation to form acyl fluoride, acting as a reactive acylator toward nucleophilic amino acid residues, in particular lysines. The performance of both reagents and activation modes is demonstrated on a set of structurally and functionally diverse proteins, including apomyoglobin/holomyoglobin and the small GTPase RHOA. Together, these results establish Togni cross-linking agents as versatile additions to the CXMS toolbox and highlight the potential of amphibious bis-hypervalent iodine-fluoroalkyl chemistry for studying protein structure and dynamics under mild aqueous conditions. Data is accessible via the ProteomeXchange server with the data set identifier PXD074784.
title_zh: 一种用于蛋白质化学交联的两栖双功能探针
abstract_zh: 化学交联质谱 (CXMS) 已成为一种强大且行之有效的方法，用于探测蛋白质结构、构象动力学和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，特别是在经典高分辨率技术面临内在局限性的情况下。开发具有明确反应性、活化性以及与天然条件相容性的新型交联试剂对于扩大 CXMS 分析的范围和可靠性仍然至关重要。在这里，我们报告了两种新型双高价碘试剂的设计和合成，称为Togni交联试剂TR1和TR2，它们作为有效的共价蛋白质交联剂。这些试剂的两个末端均具有超价碘-氟烷基基序，可形成分子内和分子间交联。它们选择性地靶向芳香氨基酸和半胱氨酸残基，并且可以通过抗坏血酸或通过半胱氨酸硫醇基团的氧化还原激活来激活。此外，这些双功能探针可以转化形成酰氟，充当亲核氨基酸残基（特别是赖氨酸）的反应性酰化剂。试剂和激活模式的性能在一组结构和功能多样的蛋白质上得到了证明，包括脱辅基肌红蛋白/全肌红蛋白和小 GTP 酶 RHOA。总之，这些结果确立了 Togni 交联剂作为 CXMS 工具箱的多功能补充，并突出了两栖双高价碘-氟烷基化学在军用条件下研究蛋白质结构和动力学的潜力。

title: On the Importance of Additive Flexibility for Efficient Organic Solar Cells
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Additive engineering offers a simple and efficient way to enhance the structural order of organic semiconductors, yet the interplays between their molecular structural and interactions remains unclear. Herein, two sets of additives, including conformationally rigid DTCO-2Br and DTC and conformationally flexible INF-TC and BT-TC, featuring opposite electrostatic potentials (ESPs), are designed. For PM6, both ESP complementarity and conformational flexibility are effective in tuning the molecular packing, while the conformational flexible INF-TC with opposite ESP not only enhances the structural order but also shortens the π–π stacking distance. For the relatively rigid L8-BO, conformational flexibility is essential to adjust the intermolecular interaction. As such, only conformational flexible INF-TC and BT-TC improve the lamellar stacking of L8-BO, and the ESP complementary BT-TC demonstrates the strongest effect. By applying INF-TC in the donor layer and BT-TC in the acceptor layer, improved efficiency and morphological stability were achieved, with a maximum efficiency of 20.4% achieved in the D18/L8-BO system.
title_zh: 添加剂灵活性对于高效有机太阳能电池的重要性
abstract_zh: 增材工程提供了一种简单有效的方法来增强有机半导体的结构秩序，但其分子结构和相互作用之间的相互作用仍不清楚。在此，设计了两套添加剂，包括构象刚性的DTCO-2Br和DTC以及构象柔性的INF-TC和BT-TC，具有相反的静电势（ESP）。对于PM6，ESP互补性和构象灵活性都可以有效地调节分子堆积，而具有相反ESP的构象柔性INF-TC不仅增强了结构有序性，而且缩短了π-π堆积距离。对于相对刚性的L8-BO，构象灵活性对于调节分子间相互作用至关重要。因此，只有构象灵活的INF-TC和BT-TC可以改善L8-BO的层状堆积，并且ESP互补的BT-TC表现出最强的效果。通过在供体层应用INF-TC和在受体层应用BT-TC，提高了效率和形态稳定性，在D18/L8-BO系统中实现了20.4%的最大效率。

title: Direct Electrification of Liquid–Liquid Extraction by Imparting Fixed Charges onto Selective Redox Active Compounds
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Electrochemically mediated liquid–liquid extraction (e-LLE) is a unique separation approach that relies on organic-soluble redox groups. The method combines continuous electrochemical operation with molecular selectivity for metal recovery. However, conventional e-LLE relies on multicolumn systems and indirect redox agents due to insufficient conductivity in apolar solvents. Here, we report a unique redox moiety integrating a ferrocene redox center with a permanently charged ammonium unit that imparts ionic conductivity even in organic solvents. This design enables the direct electrification of e-LLE using a single-column architecture. The redox extractant undergoes reversible electrochemical cycling without external electrolyte and selectively recovers anionic gold complexes from aqueous streams. Direct charging achieves up to 91% ferrocene oxidation, as quantified by Mössbauer spectroscopy, with close to 95% release of the bound ion upon reduction, thus outperforming chemical oxidation pathways. Implementation in a continuous flow cell simplifies the process and eliminates intermediate redox agents, enabling 89% gold uptake from electronic waste leachates with high selectivity. Fundamentally, this work establishes design principles for directly electrifying liquid–liquid separations while accelerating its industrial translation to mining and recycling.
title_zh: 通过将固定电荷赋予选择性氧化还原活性化合物来实现液-液萃取的直接带电
abstract_zh: 电化学介导的液-液萃取（e-LLE）是一种依赖于有机可溶性氧化还原基团的独特分离方法。该方法将连续电化学操作与金属回收的分子选择性相结合。然而，由于非极性溶剂中的电导率不足，传统的 e-LLE 依赖于多柱系统和间接氧化还原剂。在这里，我们报告了一种独特的氧化还原部分，将二茂铁氧化还原中心与永久带电的铵单元相结合，即使在有机溶剂中也能赋予离子导电性。该设计可使用单柱架构实现 e-LLE 的直接电气化。氧化还原萃取剂无需外部电解质即可进行可逆电化学循环，并选择性地从水流中回收阴离子金络合物。通过穆斯堡尔光谱定量，直接充电可实现高达 91% 的二茂铁氧化，还原时释放出近 95% 的结合离子，因此优于化学氧化途径。在连续流通池中实施可简化流程并消除中间氧化还原剂，从而能够以高选择性从电子废物浸出液中吸收 89% 的金。从根本上说，这项工作确立了直接使液-液分离通电的设计原则，同时加速其向采矿和回收的工业转化。

title: Switching from insertion to conversion for multielectron aqueous vanadium batteries
source: Nature Materials
abstract: Conventional vanadium chemistries have been hindered by limited capacity inherent to the ion-insertion mechanism and modest redox potentials in near-neutral media, constraining their suitability for high-energy aqueous batteries. Here we demonstrate a conversion-type vanadium redox that delivers concomitant superiority in capacity and potential for aqueous batteries. OH−-mediated chemical activation promotes V–O bond cleavage, thereby driving a transition from the single-electron insertion reaction to the four-electron conversion reaction. As confirmed by in situ synchrotron characterizations, a tailored mesoporous architecture enriches local OH−, facilitating the reversible conversion between V2O3 and Na3VO4. The conversion anode delivers a high specific capacity of 700 mAh g−1 with 98% vanadium utilization, a low redox potential of −0.95 V versus standard hydrogen electrode and reversible cycling over 3,000 cycles. An alkaline Ni–V battery is fabricated, with a projected whole-battery-level energy density of up to 110 Wh kg−1. This work paves the way to tuning the reaction pathway and offers insights into multielectron redox design for next-generation aqueous batteries.

title: Scaling biodiversity-stability relationships from populations to meta-communities across trophic levels
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ecological stability is essential for maintaining ecosystem functioning, but may be imperiled by biodiversity loss. Although the scaling of diversity-stability relationships from populations to communities and metacommunities has been studied within single trophic levels, it remains poorly understood when considering interactions between trophic levels. Here, we utilize data collected from a large-scale forest biodiversity experiment to investigate the scaling of temporal stability from populations, to communities, and meta-communities in a plant-herbivore system, allowing us to disentangle the relative role of top-down and bottom-up regulation. We observe that biodiversity has generally stabilizing effects within and between trophic levels. Specifically, species diversity of herbivores shows strong stabilizing top-down effects by enhancing species stability and asynchrony of plants that cascade to higher levels of organization. In contrast, bottom-up effects play a much smaller role. Our study therefore highlights the importance of top-down processes in safeguarding plant stability across levels of organization, while simultaneously providing a framework that allows the investigation of the multi-layered nature of stability mechanisms that needs to be considered for a successful and sustainable ecosystem management.
title_zh: 将生物多样性与稳定性关系从种群扩展到跨营养级别的元群落
abstract_zh: 生态稳定性对于维持生态系统功能至关重要，但可能因生物多样性丧失而受到威胁。尽管已经在单一营养级内研究了从种群到群落和元群落的多样性-稳定性关系的尺度，但在考虑营养级之间的相互作用时，人们仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们利用从大规模森林生物多样性实验中收集的数据来研究植物-草食动物系统中从种群到群落和元群落的时间稳定性的尺度，使我们能够理清自上而下和自下而上监管的相对作用。我们观察到，生物多样性在营养级内部和营养级之间通常具有稳定作用。具体而言，食草动物的物种多样性通过增强物种稳定性和级联到更高级别组织的植物的异步性，表现出强大的自上而下的稳定效应。相比之下，自下而上的效应发挥的作用要小得多。因此，我们的研究强调了自上而下的流程在跨组织层面维护植物稳定性方面的重要性，同时提供了一个框架，允许调查稳定机制的多层性质，需要考虑成功和可持续的生态系统管理。

title: Allelic variation of an LRR only protein confers dual pathogen resistance in Arabidopsis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Plants utilize versatile leucine-rich repeat (LRR) proteins to perceive diverse pathogen-derived signals, thereby activating or suppressing defense responses. However, the specific roles of LRR-only proteins in pathogen-specific resistance remain largely unclear. Here, we show that allelic variations in an Arabidopsis thaliana LRR-only gene, LEUCINE-RICH REPEAT IMMUNE PROTEIN 1 (LRIP1), underlies dual functions in combating distinct pathogens. An allele common in arid regions confers resistance to Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato (Pst) bacteria via salicylic acid (SA) signaling pathway, whereas an allele enriched in high-precipitation regions protects against Botrytis cinerea fungus via camalexin biosynthesis. Divergence in promoter and coding sequences between the two alleles modulates gene expression and elicitor-associated immune responses, thereby promoting pathogen-specific complex formation with BRASSINOSTEROID INSENSITIVE 1 (BRI1)-ASSOCIATED RECEPTOR KINASE 1 (BAK1). Globally distributed A. thaliana accessions carry two distinct LRIP1 allele groups that correlate with local precipitation conditions. These findings demonstrate that a single LRR-only gene can evolve environmentally adapted alleles that optimize immunity against different pathogens in contrasting habitats.
title_zh: 仅 LRR 蛋白的等位基因变异赋予拟南芥双重病原体抗性
abstract_zh: 植物利用多功能的富含亮氨酸重复序列（LRR）蛋白来感知多种病原体来源的信号，从而激活或抑制防御反应。然而，LRR-only 蛋白在病原体特异性抗性中的具体作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现拟南芥 LRR 基因富含亮氨酸重复免疫蛋白 1 (LRIP1) 的等位基因变异是对抗不同病原体的双重功能的基础。干旱地区常见的等位基因赋予对丁香假单胞菌 pv. 的抗性。番茄（Pst）细菌通过水杨酸（SA）信号通路发挥作用，而富含在高降水区域的等位基因则通过camalexin生物合成防止灰葡萄孢真菌。两个等位基因之间启动子和编码序列的差异可调节基因表达和激发子相关的免疫反应，从而促进与油菜素类固醇不敏感 1 (BRI1) 相关受体激酶 1 (BAK1) 形成病原体特异性复合物。全球分布的拟南芥种质携带两个与当地降水条件相关的不同 LRIP1 等位基因组。这些发现表明，单个仅含有 LRR 的基因可以进化出适应环境的等位基因，从而优化不同栖息地中针对不同病原体的免疫力。

title: IL-6-induced C/EBPα drives follicular regulatory T cell differentiation to regulate humoral immunity in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Follicular regulatory T (Tfr) cells maintain immune homeostasis by suppressing excessive germinal center (GC) responses. However, the molecular mechanisms governing Tfr differentiation remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify interleukin-6 (IL-6) as a key regulator of Tfr generation. IL-6/IL-6Rα signaling promotes the differentiation of regulatory T cells (Treg) into Tfr cells by inducing CCAAT/enhancer binding protein α (C/EBPα), which binds the Bcl6 and Cxcr5 promoters in Tfr cells. Treg-specific deletion of C/EBPα in mice impairs Tfr differentiation, resulting in hyperactive GC responses and exacerbated pathology in mouse models of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and HDM-induced allergy. In humans, in silico perturbation of CEBPA in Tregs disrupts the Tfr differentiation trajectory. Furthermore, CEBPA expression in Tregs, but not total CD4+ T cells, from patients with SLE negatively correlates with disease activity (SLEDAI). Thus, these findings establish the IL-6–C/EBPα axis as a critical mechanism driving Tfr differentiation to restrain pathogenic humoral immunity.
title_zh: IL-6诱导的C/EBPα驱动滤泡调节性T细胞分化以调节小鼠的体液免疫
abstract_zh: 滤泡调节性 T (Tfr) 细胞通过抑制过度的生发中心 (GC) 反应来维持免疫稳态。然而，控制 Tfr 分化的分子机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定白细胞介素 6 (IL-6) 是 Tfr 生成的关键调节因子。 IL-6/IL-6Rα 信号传导通过诱导 CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白 α (C/EBPα) 促进调节性 T 细胞 (Treg) 分化为 Tfr 细胞，CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白 α (C/EBPα) 与 Tfr 细胞中的 Bcl6 和 Cxcr5 启动子结合。小鼠中 Treg 特异性删除 C/EBPα 会损害 Tfr 分化，导致系统性红斑狼疮 (SLE) 和 HDM 诱导过敏的小鼠模型中 GC 反应过度活跃并加剧病理学。在人类中，Treg 中 CEBPA 的计算机扰动会扰乱 Tfr 分化轨迹。此外，SLE 患者的 Tregs（而非总 CD4+ T 细胞）中的 CEBPA 表达与疾病活动性 (SLEDAI) 呈负相关。因此，这些发现确立了 IL-6-C/EBPα 轴作为驱动 Tfr 分化以抑制致病性体液免疫的关键机制。

title: Astrocytic ankyrin-2 enables memory persistence in the mouse hippocampus
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Memory persistence, the ability to retain information over time, is a fundamental feature of long-term memory. Although astrocytes contribute to synaptic plasticity, the molecular mechanisms by which they support memory persistence remain unclear. Here we show that astrocytic ankyrin-2 (Ank2) is required for memory persistence in adult mice. Astrocyte-specific deletion of Ank2 impaired remote memory without affecting recent memory and disrupted the maintenance of long-term potentiation. Loss of Ank2 reduced astrocyte contacts with engram neurons and impaired astrocyte morphogenesis driven by brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) signaling through the truncated tropomyosin receptor kinase B receptor (TrkB.T1) and inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 2 (IP3R2). Consistent with this mechanism, astrocytic Ank2 was required for the enhancement of memory persistence by hippocampal BDNF infusion. Furthermore, selective optogenetic activation of astrocytic TrkB.T1 signaling enhanced remote memory, demonstrating that astrocytic BDNF signaling is sufficient to promote memory persistence. These findings identify astrocytic Ank2 as a key regulator of long-term memory persistence.
title_zh: 星形胶质细胞ankyrin-2使小鼠海马体能够保持记忆
abstract_zh: 记忆持久性，即随着时间的推移保留信息的能力，是长期记忆的基本特征。尽管星形胶质细胞有助于突触可塑性，但它们支持记忆持久的分子机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明星形胶质细胞锚蛋白-2 (Ank2) 对于成年小鼠的记忆持久性是必需的。星形胶质细胞特异性删除 Ank2 会损害远期记忆，但不会影响近期记忆，并破坏了长期增强的维持。 Ank2 的缺失减少了星形胶质细胞与印迹神经元的接触，并损害了星形胶质细胞的形态发生，而星形胶质细胞的形态发生是由脑源性神经营养因子 (BDNF) 通过截短的原肌球蛋白受体激酶 B 受体 (TrkB.T1) 和肌醇 1,4,5-三磷酸受体 2 型受体 (IP3R2) 信号传导驱动的。与这一机制一致，星形胶质细胞 Ank2 是海马 BDNF 输注增强记忆持久性所必需的。此外，星形胶质细胞 TrkB.T1 信号传导的选择性光遗传学激活增强了远程记忆，表明星形胶质细胞 BDNF 信号传导足以促进记忆持久性。这些发现表明星形胶质细胞 Ank2 是长期记忆持久性的关键调节因子。

title: TNF-α induces type I IFN signalling to suppress neurogenesis and recruit T cells
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Adult hippocampal neurogenesis is essential for learning, memory, and mood regulation, and its disruption is implicated in ageing, neurodegeneration, and mood disorders. However, the mechanisms linking inflammation to adult hippocampal neurogenesis impairment remain unclear. Here, we identify chronic tumour necrosis factor-alpha signalling as a key driver of neurogenic dysregulation via a previously unrecognised type I interferon autocrine/paracrine loop in human hippocampal progenitor cells. Using a female-derived human in vitro neurogenesis model, single-cell RNA sequencing, and functional T cell migration assays, we show that tumour necrosis factor-alpha induces a robust type I interferon response in hippocampal progenitor cells, promoting chemokine-mediated and CXC motif chemokine receptor 3-dependent T cell recruitment and suppressing neurogenesis. This inflammatory signalling cascade drives a fate switch in hippocampal progenitor cells from a neurogenic trajectory towards an immune-defensive phenotype, with critical implications for infectious and inflammatory disease pathogenesis. These findings uncover a key inflammatory checkpoint regulating human adult hippocampal neurogenesis and highlight potential therapeutic targets to restore neurogenesis in chronic inflammatory states.
title_zh: TNF-α 诱导 I 型 IFN 信号传导抑制神经发生并招募 T 细胞
abstract_zh: 成人海马神经发生对于学习、记忆和情绪调节至关重要，其破坏与衰老、神经退行性和情绪障碍有关。然而，炎症与成人海马神经发生损伤之间的联系机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过人类海马祖细胞中先前未被识别的 I 型干扰素自分泌/旁分泌环，确定慢性肿瘤坏死因子-α 信号传导是神经源性失调的关键驱动因素。使用女性体外神经发生模型、单细胞 RNA 测序和功能性 T 细胞迁移测定，我们发现肿瘤坏死因子-α 在海马祖细胞中诱导强烈的 I 型干扰素反应，促进趋化因子介导和 CXC 基序趋化因子受体 3 依赖性 T 细胞募集并抑制神经发生。这种炎症信号级联驱动海马祖细胞的命运从神经源性轨迹转变为免疫防御表型，对传染病和炎症性疾病的发病机制具有重要意义。这些发现揭示了调节成人海马神经发生的关键炎症检查点，并强调了在慢性炎症状态下恢复神经发生的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Quantifying the net effect of biodiversity on ecological stability
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding the relationship between biodiversity and both the functioning and stability of ecosystems has been a central focus of ecologists for decades. A step-change in our understanding of the biodiversity–ecosystem functioning relationship was enabled by explicit measurement of the additional functioning provided by biodiversity through comparing expected and observed yields in multi-species communities. However, we lack an equivalent measure for stability. Here, we quantify the net biodiversity effect on stability using model simulations and a microcosm experiment that exposes different phytoplankton species and their combinations to temperature increases and fluctuations. As an emergent property of communities, stability frequently exceeds the expected stability of the combined component species, leading to a net biodiversity effect on stability analogous to the effect on functioning. In our simulations, these effects depend on the strength of competitive interactions as well as species composition and their thermal optima. Experimentally, the stabilising effect of biodiversity is, however, non-linear, greatest for two-species combinations, and varies with both community composition and disturbance regime. Quantifying the net biodiversity effect on ecological stability advances our mechanistic understanding of the biodiversity–stability relationship, and provides crucial information to support ecosystem management and conservation.
title_zh: 量化生物多样性对生态稳定性的净影响
abstract_zh: 几十年来，了解生物多样性与生态系统的功能和稳定性之间的关系一直是生态学家关注的焦点。通过比较多物种群落的预期产量和观察到的产量，明确测量生物多样性提供的额外功能，从而使我们对生物多样性与生态系统功能关系的理解发生了重大变化。然而，我们缺乏同等的稳定性措施。在这里，我们使用模型模拟和微观实验来量化生物多样性对稳定性的净影响，该微观实验将不同的浮游植物物种及其组合暴露在温度升高和波动的环境中。作为群落的新兴财产，稳定性常常超过组合组成物种的预期稳定性，导致生物多样性对稳定性的净影响，类似于对功能的影响。在我们的模拟中，这些效应取决于竞争相互作用的强度以及物种组成及其热最佳值。然而，在实验上，生物多样性的稳定作用是非线性的，对于两个物种的组合来说是最大的，并且随着群落组成和干扰方式的不同而变化。量化生物多样性对生态稳定性的净影响可以增进我们对生物多样性与稳定性关系的机械理解，并为支持生态系统管理和保护提供重要信息。

title: Anti-PD-1 plus anti-CTLA-4 blockade overcomes immune exclusion in NSCLC brain metastases by enhancing CD8+ T cell responses and promoting tertiary lymphoid structure formation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Brain metastases (BrMs) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) respond poorly to anti-PD-1 monotherapy, but the underlying immune resistance remains incompletely defined. Here we integrate clinical outcome analyses, paired human tissue profiling and syngeneic mouse models to characterize the BrM immune microenvironment. Clinical analyses suggest improved intracranial disease control with nivolumab plus ipilimumab compared with nivolumab alone. Paired human specimens show that BrMs contain fewer cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTLs) and tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) than primary tumors, defining an immune-excluded phenotype. A syngeneic BrM model recapitulates this phenotype and resists anti-PD-1 monotherapy, whereas combined anti-PD-1 and anti-CTLA-4 blockade suppresses tumor growth and prolongs survival. Single-cell RNA sequencing, flow cytometry and immunofluorescence show increased CTL infiltration and effector function after combination therapy. CD8+ T cell depletion abrogates therapeutic benefit, and combination therapy expands T follicular helper-like cells and induces TLS-like structures. These findings manifest increased adaptive immune response of dual checkpoint blockade in NSCLC BrMs.
title_zh: 抗 PD-1 联合抗 CTLA-4 阻断通过增强 CD8+ T 细胞反应和促进三级淋巴结构形成来克服 NSCLC 脑转移瘤中的免疫排斥
abstract_zh: 非小细胞肺癌 (NSCLC) 的脑转移 (BrM) 对抗 PD-1 单一疗法反应不佳，但潜在的免疫抵抗仍不完全确定。在这里，我们整合临床结果分析、配对人体组织分析和同基因小鼠模型来表征 BrM 免疫微环境。临床分析表明，与单用纳武单抗相比，纳武单抗联合伊匹单抗可改善颅内疾病控制。配对的人类标本显示，与原发性肿瘤相比，BrM 含有更少的细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞 (CTL) 和三级淋巴结构 (TLS)，从而定义了免疫排斥表型。同基因 BrM 模型重现了这种表型并抵抗抗 PD-1 单一疗法，而抗 PD-1 和抗 CTLA-4 联合阻断可抑制肿瘤生长并延长生存期。单细胞 RNA 测序、流式细胞术和免疫荧光显示联合治疗后 CTL 浸润和效应功能增加。 CD8+ T 细胞耗竭会消除治疗效果，而联合疗法会扩大滤泡辅助性 T 细胞并诱导 TLS 样结构。这些发现表明 NSCLC BrM 中双检查点阻断的适应性免疫反应增强。

title: Environment geometry alters sequential route learning and its integration into cognitive maps
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Researchers hypothesize that geometric irregularities can impede spatial memory by distorting neural metrics of space provided by entorhinal grid cells. However, irregularly-shaped geometries could also contribute orientation information that benefits spatial memory. Moreover, serial order effects could counteract or amplify geometry effects during route navigation. Our study directly tests how effects of environment geometry (trapezoid and square) and series in route navigation interact to influence spatial memory in a virtual navigation task. We uncover effects of environment geometry predicted by grid cell models and serial order effects predicted by path integration models. Critically, our results demonstrate that these effects combine in an additive manner, such that location memory toward the end of a route in regions with the largest geometric irregularities (trapezoid) yield the worst spatial memory. Additionally, self-report measures of navigational ability are associated with increased sensitivity to geometric irregularities, emphasizing the essential role of individual differences in navigation.
title_zh: 环境几何改变了顺序路线学习及其与认知地图的整合
abstract_zh: 研究人员推测，几何不规则性会扭曲内嗅网格细胞提供的空间神经度量，从而阻碍空间记忆。然而，不规则形状的几何形状也可以提供有利于空间记忆的方向信息。此外，序列顺序效应可以抵消或放大路线导航期间的几何效应。我们的研究直接测试环境几何形状（梯形和正方形）和路线导航中的系列的影响如何相互作用以影响虚拟导航任务中的空间记忆。我们揭示了网格单元模型预测的环境几何效应和路径集成模型预测的串行顺序效应。重要的是，我们的结果表明，这些效应以累加的方式结合在一起，使得在具有最大几何不规则性（梯形）的区域中接近路线末端的位置记忆产生最差的空间记忆。此外，导航能力的自我报告测量与对几何不规则性的敏感性增加相关，强调了个体差异在导航中的重要作用。

title: Declines in organic matter persistence with increased soil carbon
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The persistence of soil organic matter (SOM) is critical for predicting carbon-climate feedbacks, yet how increasing soil organic carbon (SOC) relates to long-term SOM persistence across environmental gradients remains unclear. Soil radiocarbon, SOM physicochemical composition, and microbial carbon use efficiency (CUE) are analyzed along a precipitation-driven gradient integrated with global datasets. Here we show, as SOC content increases, its persistence as reflected by radiocarbon signatures declines at both the transect and global scales. This pattern indicates that higher SOC soils are increasingly dominated by younger, faster-cycling carbon rather than older, stabilized pools. Plant carbon inputs strongly predict SOM persistence and are associated with younger, less persistent SOC. While microbial CUE increases with SOC, higher CUE does not necessarily enhance long-term stabilization. Our findings suggest that SOC content alone provides limited insight into long-term soil carbon persistence and highlight the importance of explicitly representing plant carbon inputs and microbially mediated persistence in Earth system models.
title_zh: 随着土壤碳的增加，有机质持久性下降
abstract_zh: 土壤有机质 (SOM) 的持久性对于预测碳-气候反馈至关重要，但土壤有机碳 (SOC) 的增加与跨环境梯度的长期 SOM 持久性有何关系仍不清楚。土壤放射性碳、SOM 物理化学成分和微生物碳利用效率 (CUE) 沿着降水驱动梯度与全球数据集集成进行分析。在这里，我们表明，随着 SOC 含量的增加，放射性碳特征所反映的其持久性在横断面和全球尺度上都会下降。这种模式表明，较高 SOC 的土壤越来越多地由较年轻、循环较快的碳而不是较老、稳定的碳库所主导。植物碳输入强烈预测 SOM 持久性，并与较年轻、持久性较低的 SOC 相关。虽然微生物 CUE 随 SOC 的增加而增加，但较高的 CUE 并不一定能增强长期稳定性。我们的研究结果表明，仅 SOC 含量对长期土壤碳持久性的了解有限，并强调了在地球系统模型中明确表示植物碳输入和微生物介导的持久性的重要性。

title: Learning regularities in noise engages both neural predictive activity and representational changes
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The ability to extract structured sensory patterns from a noisy environment is fundamental to cognition, yet how the brain learns complex regularities remains unclear. Using magnetoencephalography during a visuomotor task, we tracked the neural dynamics as humans learned non-adjacent temporal dependencies embedded in noise. We reveal that learning is supported by two temporally dissociable mechanisms. Neural predictive activity emerged rapidly, with stimulus-specific patterns appearing before stimulus onset and preceding measurable behavioral improvements. This is followed by a slower build-up of representational change, characterized by an increased neural pattern similarity between statistically dependent, non-adjacent elements. Both processes are supported by a distributed consortium of networks, with the sensorimotor and dorsal attentional networks playing a central role. These findings suggest that both neural predictive activity and representational changes contribute to learning regularities, revealing a temporal hierarchy in which neural predictive activity precedes behavioral improvement and is followed by neural representational changes, possibly facilitating the gradual consolidation of knowledge into stable neural representations.
title_zh: 噪声中的学习规律涉及神经预测活动和表征变化
abstract_zh: 从嘈杂的环境中提取结构化感觉模式的能力是认知的基础，但大脑如何学习复杂的规律仍不清楚。在视觉运动任务中使用脑磁图，我们跟踪了人类学习嵌入在噪声中的非相邻时间依赖性时的神经动力学。我们揭示了学习是由两种暂时分离的机制支持的。神经预测活动迅速出现，刺激特异性模式出现在刺激开始之前和可测量的行为改善之前。接下来是表征变化的缓慢积累，其特征是统计相关的非相邻元素之间的神经模式相似性增加。这两个过程都由分布式网络联盟支持，其中感觉运动网络和背侧注意网络发挥着核心作用。这些发现表明，神经预测活动和表征变化都有助于学习规律，揭示了一个时间层次结构，其中神经预测活动先于行为改善，随后是神经表征变化，可能有助于将知识逐渐巩固为稳定的神经表征。

title: Unlocking Fast and Stable Lithium Insertion in TiNb 2 O 7 via Bi-Induced Lattice Compliance
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: TiNb2O7 (TNO) is a promising anode material for next-generation safe lithium-ion batteries owing to its high theoretical capacity and intrinsically safe operating potential. However, its practical application is limited by the difficulty in simultaneously achieving high-rate capability and structural stability, arising from the energetic cost associated with cooperative lattice distortion during lithium insertion. Herein, we demonstrate that Bi doping enables a more adaptable lattice response in TNO by modulating local metal-oxygen bonding at the electronic level. The readily deformable electron cloud of Bi3+ facilitates adaptive charge redistribution under electrochemical perturbation, thereby lowering the rigidity of Ti/Nb-O bonding environments while preserving structural integrity. This reduces the deformation energy cost associated with cooperative octahedral rearrangement during lithiation and enables a strain-accommodating insertion process, as supported by highly reversible lattice evolution observed by in situ X-ray diffraction and accelerated reaction kinetics. As a result, the Bi0.02-TNO delivers a high specific capacity of 270 mAh g-1 at 0.2C, retains 145 mAh g-1 at an ultrahigh rate of 30C, and maintains 130 mAh g-1 (80% retention, 0.016% per-cycle decay) after 1250 cycles at 10C. This work established electronic-structure-mediated lattice response modulation as a viable design principle for reconciling rate capability and structural stability in crystallographic shear oxide anodes.
title_zh: 通过双诱导晶格顺应性解锁 TiNb 2 O 7 中快速稳定的锂嵌入
abstract_zh: TiNb2O7（TNO）由于其高理论容量和本质安全的工作潜力，是一种有前途的下一代安全锂离子电池负极材料。然而，其实际应用受到锂嵌入过程中与协同晶格畸变相关的能量成本的影响，难以同时实现高倍率性能和结构稳定性。在此，我们证明 Bi 掺杂通过在电子水平上调节局部金属-氧键合，使 TNO 中的晶格响应更具适应性。 Bi3+ 易于变形的电子云有利于电化学扰动下的自适应电荷重新分布，从而降低 Ti/Nb-O 键合环境的刚性，同时保持结构完整性。这降低了锂化过程中与协同八面体重排相关的变形能量成本，并实现了应变调节插入过程，这一点得到了原位 X 射线衍射和加速反应动力学观察到的高度可逆晶格演化的支持。因此，Bi0.02-TNO在0.2C下提供了270 mAh g-1的高比容量，在30C的超高倍率下保留了145 mAh g-1，并在10C下1250次循环后保持130 mAh g-1（80％保留，每循环0.016％衰减）。这项工作建立了电子结构介导的晶格响应调制作为协调晶体剪切氧化物阳极的速率能力和结构稳定性的可行设计原则。

title: Bioinspired Rhombic VO 2 Metasurface with Low Solar Absorptance for Self-adaptive All-Weather Building Thermal Management
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Passive radiative cooling effectively reduces energy consumption but often suffers from winter overcooling. To address this challenge, we report a bioinspired rhombic-patterned vanadium dioxide (VO2) metasurface intelligent thermal radiative device (RITD) for self-adaptive all-weather building thermal regulation. Through tailoring of the synergistic coupling between the metal-insulator transition (MIT) of VO2 and the multiple resonances of a Fabry-Pérot (F-P) cavity and subwavelength periodic VO2 arrays, the RITD achieves a dynamic emittance modulation (Δε) of 0.65 (from 0.27 to 0.92) within the atmospheric transparency window (8-14 μm). Crucially, the bioinspired architecture maintains a stable, low solar absorptance (αsol = 0.23), effectively suppressing excessive solar heating and thus maximizing the net cooling power during intense sunlight exposure. With a tungsten-doped tunable phase-transition threshold (25-68 °C), the RITD demonstrates a daytime subambient cooling of ∼14 °C and a nighttime heat retention of ∼3 °C above the ambient temperature. Building energy simulations across multiple Chinese cities reveal that RITD-integrated roofs deliver substantial annual energy savings by simultaneously addressing cooling demands in summer and insulation needs in winter. This mechanism-driven design provides a scalable and robust strategy for advancing zero-energy buildings and sustainable thermal management technologies.
title_zh: 具有低太阳能吸收率的仿生菱形 VO 2 超表面，用于自适应全天候建筑热管理
abstract_zh: 被动辐射冷却可有效降低能耗，但常常会出现冬季过冷的情况。为了应对这一挑战，我们报告了一种仿生菱形图案二氧化钒（VO2）超表面智能热辐射装置（RITD），用于自适应全天候建筑热调节。通过调整 VO2 的金属-绝缘体转变 (MIT) 与法布里-珀罗 (F-P) 腔和亚波长周期性 VO2 阵列的多重谐振之间的协同耦合，RITD 在大气透明窗口 (8-14 μm) 内实现了 0.65（从 0.27 到 0.92）的动态发射度调制 (Δε)。至关重要的是，仿生架构保持了稳定的低太阳能吸收率（αsol = 0.23），有效抑制了过度的太阳能加热，从而在强烈的阳光照射下最大限度地提高了净冷却能力。凭借掺钨可调相变阈值（25-68°C），RITD 表现出白天低于环境温度约 14°C 的冷却能力和夜间保温能力比环境温度高约 3°C 的能力。中国多个城市的建筑能源模拟表明，RITD 集成屋顶通过同时满足夏季冷却需求和冬季隔热需求，每年可节省大量能源。这种机制驱动的设计为推进零能耗建筑和可持续热管理技术提供了可扩展且稳健的策略。

title: A Multifunctional Hydrogel Integrating Hemostatic, Antioxidant, and Antibacterial Properties for Infected and Diabetic Wound Regeneration
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Wound management, especially for infected and diabetic ulcers, poses a persistent clinical challenge, largely attributed to sustained inflammation, bacterial colonization, and compromised tissue regeneration. Herein, a multifunctional hydrogel (CBOS) with integrated therapeutic properties was developed through Schiff base reaction between betaine-modified chitosan (CSBT) and oxidized sodium alginate (OSA), with poly(vinyl alcohol) and sodium borate incorporated to enhance network stability. The resulting CBOS hydrogel exhibited a uniform porous microstructure, robust viscoelasticity, high swelling capacity, and appropriate water vapor transmission. Comprehensive biocompatibility assessments confirmed its negligible cytotoxicity and applicable hemocompatibility. The hydrogel demonstrated broad-spectrum tissue adhesion and potent hemostatic efficacy in murine tail incision and liver hemorrhage models. Moreover, CBOS displayed antioxidant activity by scavenging multiple free radicals and reducing intracellular reactive oxygen species in H2O2-stressed fibroblasts. Antibacterial evaluations revealed potent activity against S. aureus, with molecular docking studies suggesting multitarget interactions with key bacterial proteins, including AgrA, ClpP, and FtsZ. In vitro, CBOS significantly enhances fibroblast migration. In vivo, the hydrogel accelerated healing in both S. aureus-infected full-thickness wounds and diabetic chronic wounds, as evidenced by reduced bacterial burden, attenuated inflammatory responses, enhanced collagen deposition, and promoted neovascularization. With its integrated hemostatic, antioxidant, antibacterial, and pro-regenerative properties, the CBOS hydrogel offers a viable and attractive therapeutic approach for complex wound tissue repair.
title_zh: 一种集止血、抗氧化和抗菌特性于一身的多功能水凝胶，用于感染和糖尿病伤口的再生
abstract_zh: 伤口处理，特别是感染性溃疡和糖尿病性溃疡，带来了持续的临床挑战，很大程度上归因于持续的炎症、细菌定植和组织再生受损。在此，通过甜菜碱改性壳聚糖（CSBT）和氧化海藻酸钠（OSA）之间的席夫碱反应开发了一种具有综合治疗特性的多功能水凝胶（CBOS），并掺入聚乙烯醇和硼酸钠以增强网络稳定性。所得的 CBOS 水凝胶表现出均匀的多孔微观结构、强大的粘弹性、高溶胀能力和适当的水蒸气透过率。全面的生物相容性评估证实其可忽略不计的细胞毒性和适用的血液相容性。该水凝胶在小鼠尾部切口和肝脏出血模型中表现出广谱组织粘附和有效的止血功效。此外，CBOS 通过清除多种自由基并减少 H2O2 应激的成纤维细胞中的细胞内活性氧而表现出抗氧化活性。抗菌评估揭示了对金黄色葡萄球菌的有效活性，分子对接研究表明与关键细菌蛋白（包括 AgrA、ClpP 和 FtsZ）具有多靶点相互作用。在体外，CBOS 显着增强成纤维细胞迁移。在体内，水凝胶加速了金黄色葡萄球菌感染的全层伤口和糖尿病慢性伤口的愈合，这通过减少细菌负荷、减弱炎症反应、增强胶原蛋白沉积和促进新血管形成来证明。和

title: Mo Dopant-Mediated Oxygen Vacancy Engineering for Enhanced Cathodic Activity in Protonic Ceramic Fuel Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Protonic ceramic fuel cells (PCFCs) have attracted more interest than solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) due to their potential to be operated at lower temperatures, therefore, addressing the limitation of high-temperature oxygen ion conducting SOFC. Layered double perovskite with triple conducting (H+/O2-/e-) properties, such as PrBa0.5Sr0.5Co1.5Fe0.5O5+δ (PBSCF), have demonstrated outstanding performance as cathodes in PCFCs. Our investigation on molybdenum-doped (Mo-doped) PBSCF showed that high valence Mo doping is an effective strategy for substantially promoting the formation of oxygen vacancy and accelerating the overall cathodic reaction. The improved oxygen reduction reaction (ORR)-related kinetics are reflected by the reduced polarization resistance (Rp) of PBSCFM01 (0.052 Ω·cm2 at 650 °C) and the enhanced peak power density (PPD) of the PBSCFM01 cell (817 mW·cm-2 at 650 °C), corresponding to a 75% decrease in Rp and a 44% increase in PPD compared with pure PBSCF. Mo doping promotes the formation of oxygen vacancies, which optimizes the lattice structure and facilitates oxygen ion transport. In addition, Mo incorporation improves the charge transfer kinetics and overall electrical conductivity, with the PBSCFM01 sample exhibiting a maximum conductivity of 1051 S/cm at 250 °C─about 15% higher than that of pure PBSCF. Density functional theory calculations were further performed to elucidate the role of Mo incorporation in modulating oxygen vacancy formation. The theoretical results are in excellent agreement with the experimental observations, providing atomic-scale insight into the enhanced cathodic activity. This work demonstrates Mo as effective dopant for layered double perovskite materials to develop high oxygen reduction reaction activity cathode material PCFCs.
title_zh: 钼掺杂介导的氧空位工程增强质子陶瓷燃料电池的阴极活性
abstract_zh: 质子陶瓷燃料电池 (PCFC) 比固体氧化物燃料电池 (SOFC) 更受关注，因为它们具有在较低温度下运行的潜力，因此解决了高温氧离子传导 SOFC 的局限性。具有三重导电 (H+/O2-/e-) 特性的层状双钙钛矿，例如 PrBa0.5Sr0.5Co1.5Fe0.5O5+δ (PBSCF)，作为 PCFC 的阴极表现出了出色的性能。我们对钼掺杂（Mo-掺杂）PBSCF 的研究表明，高价 Mo 掺杂是显着促进氧空位形成并加速整体阴极反应的有效策略。氧还原反应 (ORR) 相关动力学的改进体现在 PBSCFM01 极化电阻 (Rp) 的降低（650 °C 时为 0.052 Ω·cm2）和 PBSCFM01 电池的峰值功率密度 (PPD) 的增强（650 °C 时为 817 mW·cm-2），相当于与纯 PBSCF 相比，Rp 降低了 75%，PPD 增加了 44%。 Mo掺杂促进氧空位的形成，从而优化晶格结构并促进氧离子传输。此外，Mo 的掺入改善了电荷转移动力学和整体电导率，PBSCFM01 样品在 250 °C 时表现出最大电导率 1051 S/cm，比纯 PBSCF 高出约 15%。进一步进行密度泛函理论计算，以阐明钼掺入在调节氧空位形成中的作用。理论结果与实验观察结果非常吻合，提供了原子尺度的

title: TiO 2 -modified Carbon Nanoparticles (CNPs@TiO 2 ) Enabled Interfacial Charge Regulation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Balancing polarization strength and electrical stability remains a fundamental challenge in carbon-based electrorheological (ER) fluids, where enhanced electronic mobility often leads to leakage current and voltage collapse at high electric fields. Here, we design TiO2-surface-modified carbon nanoparticles (CNPs@TiO2) to decouple polarization efficiency from conductive percolation. The graphene-like sp2-rich carbon nanoparticles provide strong intrinsic polarizability, while an amorphous TiO2 interface limits long-range charge transport and promotes interfacial polarization. Structural and chemical analyses suggest the formation of amorphous TiO2 on the surface of CNPs and Ti-O-C interfacial bonding. EIS and leakage-current measurements further support this interpretation, showing high impedance, low-frequency charge-relaxation behavior, and microampere-level leakage current up to 3000 V. Dispersed in low-viscosity (100 cSt) silicone oil at ultralow loadings of 1-3 wt % (≈0.6-1.9 vol %), the system exhibits stable operation up to 3000 V without voltage collapse. At 3 wt %, a viscosity enhancement of ∼1870% and a field-induced yield stress of 25.5 Pa are achieved, with subsecond dynamic switching and minimal hysteresis over multiple voltage cycles. A TiO2-only control prepared by the same route shows a lower viscosity enhancement of ≈298%, confirming the advantage of the CNP-TiO2 heterointerface over TiO2 alone. Power-law scaling of yield stress with electric field suggests a polarization-dominated mechanism, while density functional theory calculations reveal significant interfacial charge redistribution at the CNPs@TiO2 interface. These results support interfacial charge regulation as an effective strategy for achieving electrically stable, low-loading ER fluids with low baseline viscosity, providing a scalable pathway toward energy-efficient adaptive fluid systems.
title_zh: TiO 2 改性碳纳米颗粒（CNPs@TiO 2 ）实现界面电荷调节
abstract_zh: 平衡极化强度和电稳定性仍然是碳基电流变 (ER) 流体的基本挑战，其中增强的电子迁移率通常会导致高电场下的漏电流和电压崩溃。在这里，我们设计了 TiO2 表面改性碳纳米颗粒 (CNPs@TiO2)，以将极化效率与导电渗流解耦。类石墨烯富含sp2的碳纳米粒子提供了很强的固有极化性，而无定形TiO2界面限制了长程电荷传输并促进了界面极化。结构和化学分析表明，CNP 表面形成了无定形 TiO2，并形成了 Ti-O-C 界面键合。 EIS 和泄漏电流测量进一步支持了这一解释，显示出高阻抗、低频电荷弛豫行为以及高达 3000 V 的微安级泄漏电流。该系统以 1-3 wt%（≈0.6-1.9 vol%）的超低负载分散在低粘度 (100 cSt) 硅油中，在高达 3000 V 的电压下表现出稳定运行，而没有电压崩溃。浓度为 3 wt% 时，粘度提高约 1870%，场致屈服应力达到 25.5 Pa，在多个电压周期内具有亚秒级动态切换和最小滞后现象。通过相同途径制备的仅 TiO2 对照显示出约 298% 的较低粘度增强，证实了 CNP-TiO2 异质界面相对于单独 TiO2 的优势。屈服应力与电场的幂律缩放表明极化主导机制，而密度泛函理论计算揭示了重要的

title: Two-Dimensional VSe 2 @Polypyrrole Heterostructure Enables Stable High-Rate Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries are promising candidates for next-generation high-energy-density storage systems. However, their practical application is limited by the poor conductivity of sulfur and its discharge products (Li2S2/Li2S) and the polysulfide shuttle effect. This work presents a two-dimensional sheet-like nanocomposite of polypyrrole-coated VSe2 (VSe2@PPy) as an advanced sulfur host for high-performance Li-S battery cathodes. The design integrates the high conductivity and intrinsic catalytic activity of metallic VSe2 for polysulfide conversion with the excellent conductive network, adsorption capacity, and mechanical flexibility offered by the PPy coating. A functional interface was established through the interface electronic coupling effect between VSe2 and PPy, thereby constructing an "adsorption-enrichment-fast interfacial conversion" pathway. Their synergy comprehensively enhances the overall conductivity of the electrode, ensures strong polysulfide adsorption, accelerates redox kinetics, and alleviates volume changes during cycling. Consequently, the VSe2@PPy/S cathode delivers a high initial capacity of 1243 mAh g-1 at 0.5 C and remarkable cycling stability with a low decay rate of 0.06% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 3 C. It also maintains good performance under challenging conditions, including high sulfur loading and a wide temperature range from -25 to 55 °C.
title_zh: 二维 VSe 2 @聚吡咯异质结构可实现稳定的高倍率锂硫电池
abstract_zh: 锂硫（Li-S）电池是下一代高能量密度存储系统的有希望的候选者。然而，它们的实际应用受到硫及其放电产物(Li2S2/Li2S)较差的导电性和多硫化物穿梭效应的限制。这项工作提出了一种二维片状聚吡咯涂层 VSe2 (VSe2@PPy) 纳米复合材料，作为高性能锂硫电池阴极的先进硫主体。该设计将金属 VSe2 对多硫化物转化的高导电性和固有催化活性与 PPy 涂层提供的优异导电网络、吸附能力和机械灵活性相结合。通过VSe2和PPy之间的界面电子耦合效应建立功能界面，从而构建“吸附-富集-快速界面转换”途径。它们的协同作用全面增强了电极的整体电导率，确保强多硫化物吸附，加速氧化还原动力学，并减轻循环过程中的体积变化。因此，VSe2@PPy/S正极在0.5 C下具有1243 mAh g-1的高初始容量，并具有卓越的循环稳定性，在3 C下经过1000次循环后，每次循环的衰减率为0.06%。它还在具有挑战性的条件下保持良好的性能，包括高硫负载和-25至55 °C的宽温度范围。

title: Microstructured PVDF-HFP/TPU Ionogels for Wide-Range Iontronic Pressure Sensing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Iontronic pressure sensors (IPSs) are attractive for flexible interfaces because electric-double-layer (EDL) capacitance enables high signal output from interfacial deformation, yet it remains challenging to simultaneously achieve high sensitivity, a wide pressure range, and stable operation under temperature variation. Here, we report a microstructured PVDF-HFP/TPU/[EMIM][TFSI] ionogel dielectric for robust iontronic pressure sensing. The ionogel is fabricated by a scalable solution-casting process, in which solvent-evaporation-induced phase separation generates an interconnected porous microstructure without templating. This microstructure increases dielectric compressibility and promotes pressure-dependent ion redistribution at the electrode/ionogel interface, leading to a sensitivity of 13.9 nF kPa-1 below 40 kPa and a measurable response up to 5 MPa. To improve signal reliability, a precalibrated thermal-coefficient compensation method is introduced to suppress capacitance drift over 30-70 °C. Integrated into multichannel sensor arrays, the device further enables proof-of-concept classification of representative seated postures and simulated cabin interaction patterns under controlled laboratory conditions, combined with machine-learning analysis. This work demonstrates a scalable ionogel dielectric platform for robust pressure sensing and highlights its potential for contact-based cabin-state monitoring.
title_zh: 用于宽范围离子电子压力传感的微结构 PVDF-HFP/TPU 离子凝胶
abstract_zh: 离子电子压力传感器（IPS）对于柔性接口很有吸引力，因为双电层（EDL）电容可以通过界面变形实现高信号输出，但同时实现高灵敏度、宽压力范围和温度变化下的稳定运行仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种微结构 PVDF-HFP/TPU/[EMIM][TFSI] 离子凝胶电介质，用于稳定的离子电子压力传感。该离子凝胶是通过可扩展的溶液浇铸工艺制造的，其中溶剂蒸发诱导的相分离产生互连的多孔微结构，无需模板化。这种微观结构提高了介电压缩性，并促进电极/离子凝胶界面处的压力依赖性离子重新分布，从而在低于 40 kPa 时实现 13.9 nF kPa-1 的灵敏度，并可测量高达 5 MPa 的响应。为了提高信号可靠性，引入了预校准热系数补偿方法来抑制 30-70 °C 范围内的电容漂移。该设备集成到多通道传感器阵列中，结合机器学习分析，进一步实现了在受控实验室条件下对代表性坐姿和模拟机舱交互模式进行概念验证分类。这项工作展示了一种可扩展的离子凝胶介电平台，可实现强大的压力传感，并强调其在基于接触的舱室状态监测方面的潜力。

title: Hierarchically Engineered Interfaces in Flexible Piezoelectric Composite Films for Broad-Range Pressure Sensing
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Broad-range pressure sensing remains challenging for flexible piezoelectric sensors since deformation becomes restricted under high compressive loads, often causing premature response saturation. Here, a flexible piezoelectric composite film featuring a nacre-inspired hierarchically engineered interfacial architecture was fabricated by a facile solvent exchange-induced self-assembly process. Graphene oxide lamellae are preferentially aligned at the interfaces between a quasi-interconnected piezoceramic framework and thermoplastic polyurethane matrix, forming a mechanically robust architecture that can withstand high compressive loads (megapascal regime) and facilitate efficient stress transfer and interfacial polarization. Consequently, the optimized piezoelectric film exhibits the quasi-static piezoelectric charge coefficient d33 of 52.2 pC N-1 and the voltage constant g33 of 74.8 mV m N-1, and the device demonstrates stable signal output across a broad pressure range from 8.95 kPa to 3.06 MPa, along with a rapid response time of 18.1 ms and excellent durability over 10,000 cycles. A seven-channel integrated sensing system based on the film is developed for distributed lower-limb biomechanical monitoring, highlighting its potential for wearable health management. This work provides a practical route toward flexible piezoelectric sensors for broad-range pressure sensing and wearable biomechanical monitoring.
title_zh: 用于宽范围压力传感的柔性压电复合薄膜中的分层设计接口
abstract_zh: 对于柔性压电传感器来说，宽范围压力传感仍然具有挑战性，因为在高压缩负载下变形受到限制，通常会导致过早响应饱和。在这里，通过简单的溶剂交换诱导自组装工艺制造了一种柔性压电复合薄膜，其具有受珍珠母启发的分层工程界面结构。氧化石墨烯片层优先在准互连压电陶瓷框架和热塑性聚氨酯基体之间的界面处排列，形成机械坚固的结构，可以承受高压缩载荷（兆帕状态）并促进有效的应力传递和界面极化。因此，优化后的压电薄膜表现出52.2 pC N-1的准静态压电电荷系数d33和74.8 mV m N-1的电压常数g33，并且该器件在8.95 kPa至3.06 MPa的宽压力范围内表现出稳定的信号输出，以及18.1 ms的快速响应时间和超过10,000次循环的优异耐用性。基于该薄膜的七通道集成传感系统被开发用于分布式下肢生物力学监测，凸显了其在可穿戴健康管理方面的潜力。这项工作为用于大范围压力传感和可穿戴生物力学监测的柔性压电传感器提供了一条实用途径。

title: Precursor-Derived Porous Layered HfC Ceramic with High-Temperature Resistance and Excellent Electromagnetic Wave Absorption Performance
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The demanding requirements of stealth components in advanced aircraft for extreme environments necessitate novel materials that integrate high-temperature resistance and efficient electromagnetic wave absorption. Among them, HfC ceramic possesses a high melting point of nearly 3900 °C. However, the poor impedance matching severely restricts its application in electromagnetic wave absorption. Precursor-derived ceramics (PDCs) offer a versatile platform for designing high-temperature-resistant materials with porous microstructures for improving impedance matching. Inspired by structural engineering strategies, this work presents a novel PDC route to fabricate a porous layered HfC ceramic. Specifically, the precursor was obtained by crushing and freeze-drying a gel that formed via the simultaneous self-assembly of GO and its in situ reaction with Hf(acac)2(OH)2 during the solvothermal reaction. Leveraging its high specific surface area, layered GO offers abundant -COOH/-OH that enables reactions with Hf-OH to form a stable Hf-O-C bond. This stable chemical bonding could create an intimate interfacial contact, reducing diffusion distances and enhancing carbothermal reduction for efficient HfO2-to-HfC conversion. As a result, the porous HfC ceramic with a high hafnium content of 91.01 wt % was successfully obtained after pyrolysis at only 1400 °C. The resulting porous layered HfC ceramic retained its structural integrity up to 1800 °C. The pore structure was mainly constructed through the self-assembly of GO during the solvothermal reaction, ice crystal sublimation via freeze-drying, as well as subsequent high-temperature pyrolysis. Moreover, the porous layered HfC ceramic delivers outstanding electromagnetic wave absorption performance, attributed to the synergy effect between optimized impedance matching, conductive loss, and multiple polarization losses. Notably, it achieves a remarkable minimum reflection loss (RLmin) to a matching thickness ratio of -37.02 dB/mm, along with a radar cross section (RCS) attenuation value of 40.188 dB m2 in simulation, demonstrating both strong intrinsic absorption and practical stealth capability. This work paves the way for the development of high-performance, integrated structural-functional materials for extreme applications.
title_zh: 具有耐高温和优异电磁波吸收性能的前驱体多孔层状 HfC 陶瓷
abstract_zh: 先进飞机的隐形部件在极端环境下的苛刻要求需要集耐高温和高效电磁波吸收于一体的新型材料。其中HfC陶瓷具有近3900℃的高熔点。然而，较差的阻抗匹配严重限制了其在电磁波吸收方面的应用。前体衍生陶瓷 (PDC) 提供了一个通用平台，用于设计具有多孔微结构的耐高温材料，以改善阻抗匹配。受结构工程策略的启发，这项工作提出了一种新颖的 PDC 路线来制造多孔层状 HfC 陶瓷。具体来说，前体是通过粉碎和冷冻干燥凝胶而获得的，该凝胶是通过GO同时自组装及其在溶剂热反应过程中与Hf(acac)2(OH)2的原位反应形成的。利用其高比表面积，层状 GO 提供丰富的 -COOH/-OH，能够与 Hf-OH 反应形成稳定的 Hf-O-C 键。这种稳定的化学键可以形成紧密的界面接触，减少扩散距离并增强碳热还原，从而实现 HfO2 到 HfC 的高效转化。结果，仅在1400℃下热解就成功获得了铪含量高达91.01wt％的多孔HfC陶瓷。由此产生的多孔层状 HfC 陶瓷在高达 1800 °C 的温度下仍保持其结构完整性。孔隙结构主要是通过溶剂热反应过程中GO的自组装、冷冻干燥过程中的冰晶升华来构建的

title: Primary sclerosing cholangitis displays distinct colonic mucosa topography yet a shared mast cell state with ulcerative colitis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a chronic, progressing cholestatic disease that often co-occurs with inflammatory bowel disease (PSC-IBD). PSC-IBD affecting the colon (PSC-ulcerative colitis or PSC-UC) resembles clinical UC, but is characterised by less severe disease flares, right-colon predominance, and a greater lifetime risk of colorectal cancer than UC alone. To elucidate differences in the underlying biology between PSC-UC and UC, here we combine single-cell mRNA and antigen receptor sequencing, 16S ribosomal RNA gene analysis and spatial transcriptomics on biopsies from four colon regions of patients with PSC-UC and UC during endoscopic remission or at the time of relapse. We show that the PSC-UC colon, compared to healthy control (HC) or UC colon, harbours distinct and region-specific mucosal-adherent microbial communities and an enrichment of activated CD8 T and γδ T cells at the right colon, even in the absence of histological inflammation. By contrast, a TMEM176B+ mast cell population that may be pro-tumourigenic is enriched in the colon during disease relapse in both PSC-UC and UC colon. These results highlight that the PSC-UC and UC colonic mucosa are fundamentally different while sharing similar cell programmes during active disease. Our data thus provide insights to guide tailored clinical management and precision therapies.
title_zh: 原发性硬化性胆管炎表现出独特的结肠粘膜形态，但与溃疡性结肠炎具有共同的肥大细胞状态
abstract_zh: 原发性硬化性胆管炎（PSC）是一种慢性进行性胆汁淤积性疾病，通常与炎症性肠病（PSC-IBD）同时发生。影响结肠的 PSC-IBD（PSC-溃疡性结肠炎或 PSC-UC）与临床 UC 类似，但其特点是疾病发作不太严重、右半结肠占主导地位，并且与单独的 UC 相比，终生结直肠癌风险更高。为了阐明 PSC-UC 和 UC 之间潜在生物学的差异，在这里，我们结合了单细胞 mRNA 和抗原受体测序、16S 核糖体 RNA 基因分析和空间转录组学，对内镜缓解或复发时 PSC-UC 和 UC 患者四个结肠区域的活检进行了活检。我们发现，与健康对照 (HC) 或 UC 结肠相比，PSC-UC 结肠即使在没有组织学炎症的情况下，也具有独特的区域特异性粘膜粘附微生物群落，并且在右侧结肠处富集活化的 CD8 T 和 γδ T 细胞。相比之下，在 PSC-UC 和 UC 结肠疾病复发期间，可能具有促肿瘤发生作用的 TMEM176B+ 肥大细胞群在结肠中富集。这些结果强调，PSC-UC 和 UC 结肠粘膜有本质上的不同，但在活动性疾病期间具有相似的细胞程序。因此，我们的数据提供了指导定制临床管理和精准治疗的见解。

title: Tunable Interfacial to Filamentary Resistive Switching Mechanism in Room-Temperature-Grown Amorphous YBa 2 Cu 3 O x with Excess Cu Addition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Resistive switching technologies have the potential not only to create large efficiency gains in computer memory but also to revolutionize emerging fields such as neuromorphic computing. In this paper, we report on novel resistive switching behavior in devices made from room-temperature-grown Cu-rich amorphous YBa2Cu3Ox (YBCO) films, a material otherwise well-known as a high-temperature superconductor. In Nb:STO substrate/amorphous YBCO film (≈200 nm)/metallic Cu (15 nm)/metallic Pt (15 nm) devices, we demonstrate that the resistive switching can be tuned between mechanisms involving extended areas of the YBCO/electrode interface and a single-point filamentary mechanism simply by changing the Cu content of the deposition target and hence in the films. Changing the Cu content can also be used to optimize the properties of the devices further, with devices with an added 15 mol % of Cu in YBCO initially providing an on/off ratio >100, switching endurance potential >6500 cycles, and state retention >2 × 104 s, all at low switching fields of 0.3 MV/cm. The amalgam of promising resistive switching properties, fast growth (150 nm/min) at room temperature, and tuneability of the switching mechanism indicates the strong potential of this proof-of-concept amorphous system for future memory applications.
title_zh: 添加过量 Cu 的室温生长非晶 YBa 2 Cu 3 O x 中的可调谐界面至丝状电阻切换机制
abstract_zh: 电阻开关技术不仅有可能大幅提高计算机内存的效率，而且有可能彻底改变神经形态计算等新兴领域。在本文中，我们报告了由室温生长的富铜非晶 YBa2Cu3Ox (YBCO) 薄膜制成的器件中的新型电阻开关行为，这种材料通常被称为高温超导体。在 Nb:STO 衬底/非晶 YBCO 薄膜（约 200 nm）/金属 Cu（15 nm）/金属 Pt（15 nm）器件中，我们证明，只需改变沉积靶材以及薄膜中的 Cu 含量，即可在涉及 YBCO/电极界面扩展区域的机制和单点丝状机制之间调整电阻切换。改变铜含量也可用于进一步优化器件的性能，在 YBCO 中添加 15 mol% 铜的器件最初可提供 >100 的开/关比、>6500 次循环的开关耐久性潜力以及 >2 × 104 s 的状态保持能力，所有这些都在 0.3 MV/cm 的低开关场下进行。具有前景的电阻开关特性、室温下的快速生长（150 nm/min）以及开关机制的可调谐性的结合表明了这种概念验证非晶系统在未来存储器应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Cross-Linked Diselenide Nanovesicles against Acute Liver Injury by Seamless Integration of ROS Elimination and Source Inhibition
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The persistent rise in case incidence and the acute shortage of effective treatments have heightened the urgent need for robust strategies to combat acute liver injury (ALI). Targeting reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging remains the predominant therapeutic approach. However, current clinical interventions and emerging therapies primarily emphasize symptomatic-level ROS elimination while neglecting endogenous ROS production inhibition, which severely limits their therapeutic efficiency. Herein, we introduce a cross-linked diselenide nanovesicles with surface folic acid modification (FA@cSeLAV), which effectively targets hepatic macrophages, key mediators of ROS-driven damage in ALI, and seamlessly integrates symptomatic-level ROS elimination with the inhibition of endogenous ROS production. Briefly, diselenide-enriched FA@cSeLAV efficiently scavenges excessive ROS and undergoes depolymerization to predominantly form the oxidized monomer selenolipoic acid (DSeO2LA). Seamlessly, DSeO2LA impairs the mitochondrial tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle by inhibiting the acyl group transfer activity of key mitochondrial metabolic enzymes, thus interfering with mitochondrial energy metabolism and suppressing aberrant ROS production. Impressively, this internal-external synergistic strategy maintains sustained and robust ROS regulation at normal levels within the hepatic environment, significantly surpassing the anti-inflammatory efficiency of approved drug N-acetylcysteine (NAC), offering insights for the clinical treatment of inflammation-associated diseases.
title_zh: 交联二硒化物纳米囊泡通过 ROS 消除和源抑制的无缝整合来对抗急性肝损伤
abstract_zh: 病例发生率的持续上升和有效治疗方法的严重缺乏，加剧了对强有力的策略来对抗急性肝损伤（ALI）的迫切需要。以活性氧（ROS）清除为目标仍然是主要的治疗方法。然而，目前的临床干预和新兴疗法主要强调症状水平的ROS消除，而忽视了内源性ROS产生抑制，这严重限制了它们的治疗效率。在此，我们介绍了一种表面叶酸修饰的交联二硒化物纳米囊泡（FA@cSeLAV），它有效地靶向肝巨噬细胞（ALI中ROS驱动损伤的关键介质），并将症状水平的ROS消除与内源性ROS产生的抑制无缝结合起来。简而言之，富含二硒化物的 FA@cSeLAV 有效清除过量的 ROS，并进行解聚，主要形成氧化单体硒硫辛酸 (DSeO2LA)。 DSeO2LA 通过抑制关键线粒体代谢酶的酰基转移活性来损害线粒体三羧酸 (TCA) 循环，从而干扰线粒体能量代谢并抑制异常的 ROS 产生。令人印象深刻的是，这种内外协同策略使肝脏环境内的ROS调节维持在正常水平，显着超过已批准药物N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）的抗炎效率，为炎症相关疾病的临床治疗提供了见解。

title: DNA Nanobridge with Cascade Operation Logic on a Transistor for Comprehensive Evaluation of Respiratory Infection
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Acute respiratory infections may cause a cytokine storm that poses a great threat to life. Thus, on-site pathogen screening and infection severity assessment are highly desired for immediate medical intervention. Here, we report the comprehensive monitoring of respiratory infection by a graphene field-effect transistor (g-FET) modified with a DNA nanobridge that consists of two DNA tetrahedrons linked by a bridge strand. The recognition of target viral nucleic acid triggers bridge dissociation, releasing the probe to detect the inflammatory cytokine IL-6. Such a cascade logical operation enables simultaneous detection of respiratory pathogens and evaluation of the associated inflammatory response. The device detects viral nucleic acid as low as 3.9 × 10-16 M, while the presence of IL-6 at a clinically relevant level of 2.4 × 10-12 M enhances the response by 3.7-fold. Thus, testing of clinical COVID-19 oropharyngeal swabs achieves ∼97.2% overall agreement with PCR results, demonstrating immense potential in practical applications.
title_zh: DNA纳米桥在晶体管上具有级联操作逻辑，用于呼吸道感染的综合评估
abstract_zh: 急性呼吸道感染可能引发细胞因子风暴，对生命造成极大威胁。因此，非常需要现场病原体筛查和感染严重程度评估，以便立即进行医疗干预。在这里，我们报告了用 DNA 纳米桥修饰的石墨烯场效应晶体管（g-FET）对呼吸道感染的全面监测，该纳米桥由两个通过桥链连接的 DNA 四面体组成。目标病毒核酸的识别触发桥解离，释放探针以检测炎症细胞因子 IL-6。这种级联逻辑操作能够同时检测呼吸道病原体并评估相关的炎症反应。该装置可检测低至 3.9 × 10-16 M 的病毒核酸，而临床相关水平 2.4 × 10-12 M 的 IL-6 的存在可将反应增强 3.7 倍。因此，临床 COVID-19 口咽拭子检测与 PCR 结果的总体一致性约为 97.2%，显示出在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Simulation-Guided Atomic Layer Deposition Enables Deterministic Interfacial Mechanics for Predictive Nanoimprint Lithography
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
