abstract: Nanoimprint lithography (NIL) is a key enabler for next-generation nanomanufacturing, yet its industrial scalability remains constrained by persistent challenges at the mold-resist interface, including mold fracture, structural deformation, and inefficient demolding. These limitations arise from the lack of coordinated control over adhesion, friction, and stress evolution during imprinting. Guided by simulation-based insights that identify tunable interfacial layers as a critical lever, we employ conformal molecular/atomic layer deposition (MLD/ALD) as a rational strategy to actively regulate these coupled interactions. Here we systematically investigate MLD/ALD-grown graphene, Al2O3, and polyurea as model interfacial layers for NIL molds. By integrating molecular dynamics simulations, finite element modeling, atomic force microscopy (AFM), and experimental imprinting, we establish quantitative links between coating chemistry, interfacial energetics, stress evolution, and pattern fidelity. Among the materials studied, graphene exhibits the most favorable balance of properties, reducing peak imprint-induced mechanical stress to ∼20% of that of bare silicon while maintaining ultralow surface energy (≤0.13 J m-2) and friction coefficient (≤0.1), thereby minimizing structural deformation during imprinting. We further identify coating-dependent thresholds in adhesion, friction, and elastic modulus that define a practical design window for high-performance NIL molds. This work introduces a unified and predictive framework for active interfacial control via ALD coatings in NIL, providing actionable guidelines for coating selection and establishing a pathway toward durable molds, efficient demolding, and reproducible, high-precision nanoscale pattern transfer.
title_zh: 仿真引导原子层沉积为预测纳米压印光刻提供确定性界面力学
abstract_zh: 纳米压印光刻 (NIL) 是下一代纳米制造的关键推动者，但其工业可扩展性仍然受到模塑抗蚀剂界面持续挑战的限制，包括模具断裂、结构变形和低效脱模。这些限制源于压印过程中缺乏对粘附、摩擦和应力演变的协调控制。基于模拟的见解将可调界面层确定为关键杠杆，我们采用共形分子/原子层沉积（MLD/ALD）作为主动调节这些耦合相互作用的合理策略。在这里，我们系统地研究了 MLD/ALD 生长的石墨烯、Al2O3 和聚脲作为 NIL 模具的模型界面层。通过集成分子动力学模拟、有限元建模、原子力显微镜 (AFM) 和实验印记，我们在涂层化学、界面能量学、应力演化和图案保真度之间建立了定量联系。在所研究的材料中，石墨烯表现出最有利的性能平衡，将压印引起的峰值机械应力降低至裸硅的约20%，同时保持超低表面能（≤0.13 J m-2）和摩擦系数（≤0.1），从而最大限度地减少压印过程中的结构变形。我们进一步确定了粘附力、摩擦力和弹性模量方面与涂层相关的阈值，这些阈值定义了高性能 NIL 模具的实用设计窗口。这项工作引入了一个统一的预测框架，用于通过 NIL 中的 ALD 涂层进行主动界面控制，pr

title: Self-Polarization and Zero-Bias Piezoelectricity Driven by Giant Interfacial Strain Gradient in Lead-Free BiFeO 3 /BaTiO 3 Superlattices
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Artificially engineered oxide superlattices offer a powerful platform for manipulating strain, interfacial coupling, and ferroelectric/piezoelectric properties, thereby enabling functionalities that cannot be achieved in single-phase materials. In this work, we investigate the structural and functional properties of 250-nm-thick (BiFeO3)0.65Λ/(BaTiO3)0.35Λ (BFO0.65Λ/BTO0.35Λ) superlattices with a modulation period Λ ranging from 24 to 195 Å, grown by pulsed laser deposition on (001) SrTiO3 substrates buffered with a conductive SrRuO3 electrode. Comprehensive structural analyses combining high-resolution X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) reveal phase-pure films with good epitaxial quality and a defined nanoscale chemical modulation of the layers. The analysis of the average lattice parameters shows that the BTO layers are subjected to compressive strain, resulting in an enhanced tetragonality, whereas the BFO layers experience tensile strain accompanied by a slight reduction in tetragonality relative to the bulk. However, STEM-GPA mapping reveals large interfacial strain gradients of about 105 m-1 within the first ∼30 nm near the SRO interface for Λ ≥ 95 Å, which are associated with a strong tetragonal distortion in the BTO layers and a c/a ratio greater than unity in the BFO layers, together with the coexistence of rhombohedral-like and tetragonal-like BFO domains. Ferroelectric and dielectric measurements show enhanced polarization and permittivity for short-period superlattices, while larger-period structures (Λ ≥ 95 Å) exhibit a giant internal bias field (Es ≈ -200 kV/cm) that stabilizes a robust self-polarized state. PFM measurements confirm the ferroelectric nature of the films and reveal nonvolatile piezoelectric shape memory, as well as self-piezoelectric responses driven by the strong built-in field induced by the interfacial strain gradient. The stabilization of the self-piezoelectric state, combined with the low dielectric permittivity at zero field, provides a promising route to maximizing the figure of merit of lead-free nanostructures for next-generation piezoelectric devices.
title_zh: 无铅BiFeO 3 /BaTiO 3 超晶格中巨界面应变梯度驱动的自极化和零偏置压电
abstract_zh: 人工设计的氧化物超晶格为操纵应变、界面耦合和铁电/压电特性提供了强大的平台，从而实现了单相材料无法实现的功能。在这项工作中，我们研究了 250 nm 厚的 (BiFeO3)0.65Λ/(BaTiO3)0.35Λ (BFO0.65Λ/BTO0.35Λ) 超晶格的结构和功能特性，调制周期 Λ 范围为 24 至 195 Å，通过脉冲激光沉积在用导电 SrRuO3 缓冲的 (001) SrTiO3 基底上生长。电极。结合高分辨率 X 射线衍射、原子力显微镜和扫描透射电子显微镜 (STEM) 的综合结构分析揭示了具有良好外延质量和明确的纳米级化学调制的纯相薄膜。平均晶格参数的分析表明，BTO 层受到压缩应变，导致四方性增强，而 BFO 层受到拉伸应变，同时四方性相对于体积略有降低。然而，STEM-GPA 映射显示，当 Λ ≥ 95 Å 时，SRO 界面附近的前 30 nm 内存在约 105 m-1 的大界面应变梯度，这与 BTO 层中强烈的四方畸变和 BFO 层中大于 1 的 c/a 比以及类菱面体和类四方 BFO 域的共存有关。铁电和介电测量显示短周期超晶格的极化和介电常数增强，而较大周期的结构

title: Robust Hybrid Plasmon–Photon Modes in Colloidal Metasurfaces Probed by Angle-Resolved SERS
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Plasmonic-photonic metasurfaces enable large-area, spectrally selective field enhancement for surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS). However, identifying low-loss hybrid plasmon-photon modes under confocal, near-normal excitation remains elusive. Angle-resolved SERS provides direct access to their dispersion and degeneracies under stationary, ultrahigh numerical aperture excitation (NA ≈ 1.0 in air) by independently scanning polar and azimuthal incidence angles. SERS additionally demands modes that tolerate defects and periodicity fluctuations. We therefore fabricate colloidal metasurfaces across particle concentrations and lattice periods to quantify robustness. Using template-assisted self-assembly, we reveal a direct correlation between nanoparticle concentration, structural order, and the emergence of hybrid modes. At the optimized periodicity, SERS is maximized (up to 2.32× higher SERS intensity), which we can modulate through resonance detuning. Angle-resolved SERS at 633 and 785 nm under oblique incidence shows maximal enhancement when the hybrid guided-mode resonance is tuned to the laser line, yielding up to 36× higher intensity than off-resonant conditions for the same sample. An analytical model attributes these modes to phase-coupled waveguide coupling and collective plasmonic chain resonances. Thus, we yield practical design rules for robust, tunable colloidal plasmonic-photonic SERS metasurfaces via hybrid-mode dispersion engineering.
title_zh: 通过角度分辨 SERS 探测胶体超表面中鲁棒的混合等离子体激元-光子模式
abstract_zh: 等离激元光子超表面能够实现大面积、光谱选择性场增强，以实现表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）。然而，在共焦、近正常激发下识别低损耗混合等离子体光子模式仍然难以实现。角度分辨 SERS 通过独立扫描极向和方位角入射角，可以直接了解静态超高数值孔径激发（空气中 NA ≈ 1.0）下的色散和简并性。 SERS 还需要能够容忍缺陷和周期性波动的模式。因此，我们制造了跨越粒子浓度和晶格周期的胶体超表面，以量化鲁棒性。使用模板辅助自组装，我们揭示了纳米颗粒浓度、结构顺序和混合模式的出现之间的直接相关性。在优化的周期下，SERS 最大化（SERS 强度高达 2.32 倍），我们可以通过共振失谐进行调节。当混合导模共振调谐到激光线时，斜入射下 633 和 785 nm 的角度分辨 SERS 显示出最大的增强，对于同一样品，产生的强度比非共振条件高出 36 倍。分析模型将这些模式归因于相位耦合波导耦合和集体等离子体链共振。因此，我们通过混合模式色散工程产生了稳健、可调谐胶体等离子体光子 SERS 超表面的实用设计规则。

title: Empowering clinical trial design with agentic intelligence and real-world data
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Clinical trial design (CTD) is a time-consuming process that requires substantial domain expertise. Large-scale real-world data (RWD), such as electronic health records (EHR), encodes practice-based evidence that is of tremendous value to CTD. In recent years, many machine learning methods have been developed to extract such real-world evidence (RWE) from the RWD to inform CTD, but they still need to be communicated with the domain experts extensively in an iterative manner to be further refined and ultimately useful. In this paper, we introduce EmulatRx, an agentic framework that derives RWE for helping with CTD. Through the iterative conversation and analysis across agents with different roles, EmulatRx can autonomously refine trial protocols and finally generate a robust report containing insights that inform better CTD. We applied EmulatRx on the CTD process for both acute diseases (e.g., septic shock, acute heart failure, acute pulmonary edema, and acute kidney injury) using the MIMIC-IV data and chronic diseases (e.g., Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease) using the INSIGHT Network across five New York City health systems. The results demonstrate EmulatRx’s capabilities in facilitating and accelerating the CTD process.
title_zh: 利用代理智能和真实数据增强临床试验设计
abstract_zh: 临床试验设计 (CTD) 是一个耗时的过程，需要大量的领域专业知识。电子健康记录 (EHR) 等大规模现实世界数据 (RWD) 编码对 CTD 具有巨大价值的基于实践的证据。近年来，已经开发了许多机器学习方法来从RWD中提取此类真实世界证据（RWE）以告知CTD，但它们仍然需要与领域专家以迭代的方式进行广泛沟通，以进一步完善并最终有用。在本文中，我们介绍了 EmulatRx，这是一个派生 RWE 的代理框架，用于帮助 CTD。通过不同角色的代理之间的迭代对话和分析，EmulatRx 可以自主完善试验方案，并最终生成包含见解的可靠报告，为更好的 CTD 提供信息。我们使用 MIMIC-IV 数据将 EmulatRx 应用于急性疾病（例如败血性休克、急性心力衰竭、急性肺水肿和急性肾损伤）的 CTD 流程，并使用跨纽约市五个卫生系统的 INSIGHT Network 将 EmulatRx 应用于慢性疾病（例如阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病）的 CTD 流程。结果证明了 EmulatRx 促进和加速 CTD 流程的能力。

title: Assessing corporate sustainability with large language models: evidence from Europe
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Companies play a crucial role in achieving global sustainability goals, yet evidence on their progress across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) dimensions remains limited. We develop a machine learning framework to systematically extract ESG indicators from corporate reports. Applying this approach to annual and sustainability reports of 600 large European firms (2014–2023), we construct a dataset of 2.9 million ESG observations across environmental, social, and governance topics. We assess ESG transparency based on disclosures aligned with the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and evaluate ESG performance using extracted numerical indicators. Results reveal a pronounced transparency gap: firms in the top ESG rating decile disclose 22% more indicators than those in the bottom decile, although this gap narrows over time. Performance trends are uneven: while most social indicators remain largely stagnant, except for gains in gender equality, environmental indicators show some improvement. Reported scope 3 emissions increase sharply, largely reflecting improved disclosure. Our open-source framework enables systematic tracking of corporate ESG efforts.
title_zh: 使用大型语言模型评估企业可持续性：来自欧洲的证据
abstract_zh: 企业在实现全球可持续发展目标方面发挥着至关重要的作用，但有关其在环境、社会和治理 (ESG) 方面取得进展的证据仍然有限。我们开发了一个机器学习框架，从企业报告中系统地提取 ESG 指标。将这种方法应用于 600 家大型欧洲公司的年度报告和可持续发展报告（2014-2023 年），我们构建了一个包含 290 万个涉及环境、社会和治理主题的 ESG 观察数据的数据集。我们根据符合欧洲可持续发展报告标准 (ESRS) 的披露来评估 ESG 透明度，并使用提取的数字指标评估 ESG 绩效。结果揭示了明显的透明度差距：ESG 评级最高十分位的公司披露的指标比最低十分位的公司多 22%，尽管这一差距随着时间的推移而缩小。绩效趋势参差不齐：虽然大多数社会指标基本停滞不前，但除了性别平等方面取得进展外，环境指标却显示出一些改善。报告的范围 3 排放量急剧增加，很大程度上反映了披露的改进。我们的开源框架可以系统地跟踪企业 ESG 工作。

title: Robust estimates of biodiversity change require high-resolution time series
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Robust estimates of biodiversity change are essential to inform management and conservation, and to address global biodiversity loss. However, common temporal data limitations may compromise trend accuracy. Here, we test how temporal resolution influences biodiversity trends using 1,353 river invertebrate time series collected annually for ≥ 10 years across 18 European countries. We simulate reduced sampling frequencies and durations and compare these trends to the complete time series. Reducing frequency from annual to every 2–6 years resulted in 87–73% of sites matching in trend directions, but only 78–39% matching in magnitude. Reducing duration from 10 to 9–2 years resulted in 88–52% direction matches and 86–8% magnitude matches. Similar results were observed for longer time series ( ≥ 20 years). Additionally, a comparison of two real-world monitoring datasets with different temporal resolutions shows that 53% of sites matched in direction, but only 12% in magnitude. Our findings indicate that biodiversity change magnitude is more sensitive to temporal resolution than direction. Consequently, accurate estimates of both direction and magnitude require high-resolution time series, whereas lower-resolution data may only reliably capture direction. These results highlight the value and limitations of temporal biodiversity data, and help plan future monitoring.
title_zh: 生物多样性变化的稳健估计需要高分辨率时间序列
abstract_zh: 对生物多样性变化的稳健估计对于为管理和保护提供信息以及解决全球生物多样性丧失问题至关重要。然而，常见的时态数据限制可能会损害趋势准确性。在这里，我们使用 18 个欧洲国家每年 ≥ 10 年收集的 1,353 个河流无脊椎动物时间序列来测试时间分辨率如何影响生物多样性趋势。我们模拟降低的采样频率和持续时间，并将这些趋势与完整的时间序列进行比较。将频率从每年一次减少到每 2-6 年一次，导致 87-73% 的站点在趋势方向上匹配，但只有 78-39% 在幅度上匹配。将持续时间从 10 年缩短至 9-2 年，结果方向匹配率为 88-52%，震级匹配率为 86-8%。较长时间序列（≥ 20 年）观察到类似的结果。此外，对两个具有不同时间分辨率的现实世界监测数据集的比较表明，53% 的站点在方向上匹配，但只有 12% 在大小上匹配。我们的研究结果表明，生物多样性变化的幅度对时间分辨率比方向更敏感。因此，方向和幅度的准确估计需要高分辨率时间序列，而较低分辨率的数据可能只能可靠地捕获方向。这些结果凸显了生物多样性时间数据的价值和局限性，并有助于规划未来的监测。

title: Ti/Sr Gradient Doping with SrTiO 3 Coating for Mitigating Strain and Oxygen Loss in Ni-Rich Cathode
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Ni-rich layered oxides are a class of lithium-ion battery cathode materials with great application potential, but their structural instability during cycling can adversely affect the battery performance. Here, we report bulk-to-surface engineering of Ti/Sr gradient-doped and SrTiO3-coated LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 (NCM90-2TS) cathode materials to circumvent instability. The Ti/Sr gradient-doping reduces the Li+ diffusion barrier, alleviates stress-strain accumulation and interlayer slip, and suppresses Li/Ni mixing during long-term cycling. Furthermore, the SrTiO3 coating suppresses the outward migration of oxygen anions, protecting the highly active surface, stabilizing the electrode-electrolyte interface, and effectively mitigating severe surface side reactions. Impressively, the NCM90-2TS achieves superior cycling stability with capacity retention remaining 96.3% at 4.5 V after 200 cycles. In a pouch cell comprising graphite anodes at 1 C, the capacity retention is nearly 96.3% after 500 cycles at 30 °C within 3.0-4.2 V. To boost the cycling stability of Ni-rich cathodes, the proposed synergistic strategy integrating coating, doping, and microstructural control provides a practical route for optimizing high-energy-density lithium-ion battery systems.
title_zh: Ti/Sr 梯度掺杂 SrTiO 3 涂层可减轻富镍阴极中的应变和氧损失
abstract_zh: 富镍层状氧化物是一类具有巨大应用潜力的锂离子电池正极材料，但其在循环过程中的结构不稳定性会对电池性能产生不利影响。在这里，我们报告了 Ti/Sr 梯度掺杂和 SrTiO3 涂层的 LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 (NCM90-2TS) 阴极材料的体到表面工程，以避免不稳定。 Ti/Sr梯度掺杂降低了Li+扩散势垒，减轻了应力应变积累和层间滑移，并抑制了长期循环过程中Li/Ni的混合。此外，SrTiO3涂层抑制氧阴离子向外迁移，保护高活性表面，稳定电极-电解质界面，有效缓解严重的表面副反应。 Impressively, the NCM90-2TS achieves superior cycling stability with capacity retention remaining 96.3% at 4.5 V after 200 cycles.在1 C下包含石墨阳极的软包电池中，在30°C、3.0-4.2 V范围内循环500次后，容量保持率接近96.3%。为了提高富镍阴极的循环稳定性，所提出的集成涂层、掺杂和微观结构控制的协同策略为优化高能量密度锂离子电池系统提供了一条实用途径。

title: Membrane-anchored DNA nanodevice with allosteric aptamer arms enables parallel probing and on-site drug delivery
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: DNA-based molecular computation enables targeting of cells via multiple surface receptors. However, existing platforms are often limited to single-receptor detection per operation or rely on freely diffusing components, a common source of off-target interference. Here we show an intelligent DNA nanodevice (DND) that integrates multivalent recognition, logic‑gated computation, and spatially precise drug delivery in a single nanostructure. The DND comprises a doxorubicin-loaded tetrahedral DNA framework (tFNA@Dox) connected via three allosteric aptamer arms to a cholesterol-modified membrane anchor. Simultaneous binding of all three aptamers triggers an AND‑logic gate, releasing tFNA@Dox specifically at the target cell membrane. This localized sense‑and‑act mechanism maximizes therapeutic specificity and minimizes systemic exposure. In tumor-bearing mice, DND@Dox effectively accumulated in tumors, significantly inhibited tumor growth under local and systemic administration, and reduced systemic toxicity. This work establishes a versatile platform for logic‑controlled, multimarker‑guided cancer theranostics.
title_zh: 具有变构适体臂的膜锚定 DNA 纳米装置可实现并行探测和现场药物输送
abstract_zh: 基于 DNA 的分子计算能够通过多个表面受体靶向细胞。然而，现有平台通常仅限于每次操作的单个受体检测，或者依赖于自由扩散的成分，这是脱靶干扰的常见来源。在这里，我们展示了一种智能 DNA 纳米器件 (DND)，它将多价识别、逻辑门控计算和空间精确药物输送集成在单个纳米结构中。 DND 包含负载阿霉素的四面体 DNA 框架 (tFNA@Dox)，通过三个变构适体臂连接到胆固醇修饰的膜锚。所有三个适体的同时结合会触发 AND 逻辑门，从而在靶细胞膜上特异性释放 tFNA@Dox。这种局部的感知和行动机制最大限度地提高了治疗特异性并最大限度地减少了全身暴露。在荷瘤小鼠中，DND@Dox在肿瘤中有效积累，在局部和全身给药下显着抑制肿瘤生长，并降低全身毒性。这项工作为逻辑控制、多标志物引导的癌症治疗诊断建立了一个多功能平台。

title: Shedding light on bacterial fitness in a tug-of-war with liquid crystal emulsions
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Rapid and reliable quantification of bacterial dynamics at the cellular level is critical for pathogen sensing, live-dead bacterial assays, and monitoring of bacteria fitness and viability. Here, we demonstrate bacterial fitness quantification by capturing individual cells on topological defects of micro-scale liquid crystal emulsion droplets. The emulsion droplets are composed of phase-separated nematic liquid crystal and fluorocarbon components and exhibit an asymmetric mass distribution. A topological singularity in the director field of the liquid crystal phase localizes tailormade surfactants that tether a single bacterium per droplet. Active motion of the bacterium induces a tilt and azimuthal rotation of the droplet trap, which is counteracted by gravity acting on the droplet center of mass. By comparing the observed dynamics of a tethered bacterium’s stochastic movement to a computational model of bacterial motion on spherical surfaces that is based on the classical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we quantify the fitness of bacteria subjected to starvation over several days. This pathogen fitness sensing concept, which relies on the scalable chemical design of single bacterial cell traps, a robust optical readout, and a theoretical understanding of bacterial dynamics on spherical surfaces, offers opportunities for rapid pathogen activity assessment, micro-biological sensing, and biologically powered micro-actuator systems.
title_zh: 揭示液晶乳液拉锯战中细菌的适应性
abstract_zh: 在细胞水平上快速、可靠地定量细菌动态对于病原体传感、活死细菌测定以及细菌适应性和活力监测至关重要。在这里，我们通过捕获微米级液晶乳液液滴的拓扑缺陷上的单个细胞来演示细菌适应性定量。乳液液滴由相分离的向列液晶和碳氟化合物成分组成，并表现出不对称的质量分布。液晶相导向场中的拓扑奇点定位了定制的表面活性剂，每个液滴束缚单个细菌。细菌的主动运动引起液滴捕集器的倾斜和方位角旋转，这被作用在液滴质心上的重力所抵消。通过将观察到的系留细菌随机运动的动力学与基于经典 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程的球面上细菌运动的计算模型进行比较，我们量化了几天内遭受饥饿的细菌的适应性。这种病原体适应性传感概念依赖于单细菌细胞陷阱的可扩展化学设计、强大的光学读数以及对球形表面细菌动力学的理论理解，为快速病原体活性评估、微生物传感和生物动力微执行器系统提供了机会。

title: Substrate recognition and transport mechanism of the human proton-coupled amino-acid transporter 1 (SLC36A1)
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The proton-coupled amino-acid transporter SLC36A1 (hPAT1) is an atypical H⁺-driven carrier and mediates the intestinal absorption of a wide array of zwitterionic amino-acid analogs, including many compounds with central nervous-system (CNS) activity, as well as the activation of the mTORC1 pathway and the export of amino acids from lysosomes, thereby maintaining cellular amino-acid homeostasis. Here, we present the cryo-EM structures of a member of the SLC36 family, hPAT1, in its apo state and in complex with three chemically distinct substrates, including the α-amino acid D-serine, the β-amino acid nipecotic acid, and the heterocyclic drug D-cycloserine, at resolutions of 3.4–3.5 Å. Despite their chemical diversity, all ligands adopt a spatially convergent binding mode, elucidating the structural basis for PAT1’s broad substrate promiscuity. In addition, we identify E270 as a potential proton-binding site. Together, these findings provide structural insights into the molecular mechanism of proton-coupled amino acid transport. Notably, the cryo-EM structure of PAT1 bound to D-cycloserine illustrates a viable oral CNS drug delivery strategy: exploiting polar scaffolds to achieve transporter-mediated intestinal absorption and blood–brain barrier penetration without relying on high lipophilicity.
title_zh: 人质子偶联氨基酸转运蛋白1（SLC36A1）的底物识别和转运机制
abstract_zh: 质子耦合氨基酸转运蛋白 SLC36A1 (hPAT1) 是一种非典型 H⁺ 驱动的载体，介导多种两性离子氨基酸类似物的肠道吸收，包括许多具有中枢神经系统 (CNS) 活性的化合物，以及 mTORC1 途径的激活和溶酶体中氨基酸的输出，从而维持细胞氨基酸稳态。在这里，我们展示了 SLC36 家族成员 hPAT1 的冷冻电镜结构，其处于 apo 状态，并与三种化学上不同的底物形成复合物，包括 α-氨基酸 D-丝氨酸、β-氨基酸尼哌酸和杂环药物 D-环丝氨酸，分辨率为 3.4-3.5 Å。尽管化学多样性不同，但所有配体均采用空间汇聚的结合模式，阐明了 PAT1 广泛底物混杂性的结构基础。此外，我们将 E270 确定为潜在的质子结合位点。总之，这些发现为质子耦合氨基酸运输的分子机制提供了结构见解。值得注意的是，PAT1 与 D-环丝氨酸结合的冷冻电镜结构说明了一种可行的口服 CNS 药物递送策略：利用极性支架实现转运蛋白介导的肠道吸收和血脑屏障渗透，而不依赖于高亲脂性。

title: The OsMYB4 transcription factor enables coordinated improvement of grain yield and quality in rice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The endosperm is the predominant storage organ for starch and storage proteins in cereal grains, which also determines both grain yield and quality. Although key enzymes involved in the biosynthesis of starch and storage proteins have been identified, the underlying regulatory mechanisms remain largely obscure. In this study, we identified OsMYB4, a MYB transcription factor, specifically expressed in rice (Oryza sativa L.) endosperm. Loss-of-function of OsMYB4 led to increased grain chalkiness, accompanied by reduced amylose and protein contents as well as decreased grain yield. OsMYB4 directly binds to the promoters of multiple genes involved in starch and storage protein synthesis to activate their transcription. It also forms protein complexes with multiple transcription factors to synergistically regulate grain yield and quality. In addition, OsMYB4 was directly activated by RISBZ1, a key regulator of storage reserve accumulation. Moreover, overexpression of OsMYB4 resulted in larger grains and enhanced yield. Notably, natural variation analysis revealed that the beneficial haplotype OsMYB4-Hap1 is positively associated with increased grain weight and superior quality. In conclusion, our results demonstrate the regulatory role of OsMYB4 for grain development, which provides valuable genetic resources for simultaneously improving grain yield and quality in rice.
title_zh: OsMYB4转录因子可协调提高水稻产量和品质
abstract_zh: 胚乳是谷物中淀粉和蛋白质的主要储存器官，也决定谷物的产量和品质。尽管淀粉和储存蛋白生物合成中涉及的关键酶已被确定，但潜在的调节机制仍然很大程度上不清楚。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了 OsMYB4，一种 MYB 转录因子，在水稻 (Oryza sativa L.) 胚乳中特异性表达。 OsMYB4 功能丧失导致谷物垩白度增加，同时直链淀粉和蛋白质含量减少以及谷物产量下降。 OsMYB4 直接与参与淀粉和储存蛋白合成的多个基因的启动子结合以激活它们的转录。它还与多种转录因子形成蛋白质复合物，协同调节谷物产量和质量。此外，OsMYB4 直接被 RISBZ1 激活，RISBZ1 是存储储备积累的关键调节因子。此外，OsMYB4 的过度表达导致籽粒变大并提高产量。值得注意的是，自然变异分析表明，有益的单倍型 OsMYB4-Hap1 与增加粒重和优良品质呈正相关。总之，我们的结果证明了OsMYB4对谷物发育的调节作用，为同时提高水稻产量和品质提供了宝贵的遗传资源。

title: Rapid GC content evolution in rice through GC-biased gene conversion and selection for translation efficiency
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: GC-biased gene conversion (gBGC), which favors GC over AT alleles during recombination, is responsible for the elevation of GC content in yeast and animals and is more effective in outcrossing species, yet its role in plants is less well understood. Here, we report empirical evidence for the presence of gBGC in rice (Oryza sativa). While the GC content of noncoding sequences is well correlated with the recombination frequency, the GC content of coding regions is shaped by both recombination and selection for GC-rich codons, which is linked to high translation efficiency. Surprisingly, GC content has declined in both rice and its partially outcrossing wild progenitor, and there is no evidence that full outcrossing results in a net increase of GC content. This suggests that the mutations are more robust than gBGC in altering GC content, implying that GC content will continue to decline in rice and its close relatives.
title_zh: 通过偏向 GC 的基因转换和翻译效率选择，水稻中 GC 含量快速进化
abstract_zh: GC偏向基因转换（gBGC）在重组过程中偏向GC而不是AT等位基因，它是酵母和动物中GC含量升高的原因，并且在异交物种中更有效，但其在植物中的作用尚不清楚。在此，我们报告了水稻 (Oryza sativa) 中存在 gBGC 的经验证据。虽然非编码序列的 GC 含量与重组频率密切相关，但编码区的 GC 含量是由重组和富含 GC 密码子的选择决定的，这与高翻译效率有关。令人惊讶的是，水稻及其部分异交野生祖先的 GC 含量均有所下降，并且没有证据表明完全异交会导致 GC 含量净增加。这表明突变在改变GC含量方面比gBGC更强大，这意味着水稻及其近亲中的GC含量将继续下降。

title: Full vibrational spectroscopy for simultaneous mechanical, structural and chemical analysis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The light scattered inelastically from molecular vibrations occurring at different temporal and spatial scales carries intrinsic physical information about the illuminated sample. Mechanical, structural and chemical properties can be simultaneously retrieved by analyzing the full vibrational spectrum in different frequency ranges, yet strong elastic scattering near the laser frequency typically overwhelms the low-frequency region. Here, we present a method for measuring the full vibrational spectrum from 0.1 to > 3,500 cm−1 using a Birefringence-Induced Phase Delay filter with high extinction ratio and ultranarrow bandwidth for efficient elastic suppression. Our multimodal, label-free approach enables the simultaneous acquisition of Brillouin, ultra-low-frequency Raman (ULFR), and Raman spectra from the same illumination voxel. We demonstrate the method acquiring Brillouin, ULFR, and Raman spectra from active pharmaceutical ingredients, revealing previously inaccessible distinctions in the amorphous forms of indomethacin and its mixtures with polyvinylpyrrolidone excipients. We further extended our approach to full vibrational imaging by acquiring maps of an ibuprofen tablet. Our findings demonstrate the high sensitivity and specificity of the multimodal platform to analyze chemical content while investigating mechanical and structural heterogeneities. Results open promising avenues in biomedical research and material science where key physical properties can be optically retrieved simultaneously at diffraction-limited spatial resolution.
title_zh: 用于同时进行机械、结构和化学分析的全振动光谱
abstract_zh: 在不同时间和空间尺度上发生的分子振动非弹性散射的光携带有关被照明样品的内在物理信息。通过分析不同频率范围内的完整振动谱，可以同时检索机械、结构和化学特性，但激光频率附近的强弹性散射通常会压倒低频区域。在这里，我们提出了一种使用双折射诱导相位延迟滤波器测量从 0.1 到 > 3,500 cm−1 的完整振动光谱的方法，该滤波器具有高消光比和超窄带宽，可实现有效的弹性抑制。我们的多模态、无标记方法能够从同一照明体素同时采集布里渊、超低频拉曼 (ULFR) 和拉曼光谱。我们演示了从活性药物成分中获取布里渊、ULFR 和拉曼光谱的方法，揭示了无定形吲哚美辛及其与聚乙烯吡咯烷酮赋形剂的混合物中以前难以获得的区别。我们通过获取布洛芬片剂的图谱进一步扩展了我们的全振动成像方法。我们的研究结果证明了多模式平台在研究机械和结构异质性的同时分析化学含量的高灵敏度和特异性。结果为生物医学研究和材料科学开辟了有希望的途径，可以在衍射极限的空间分辨率下同时光学检索关键物理特性。

title: Magnonic spontaneous oscillation induced by parametric pumping
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Spontaneous dynamic systems have attracted significant attention for their rich underlying physics such as phase-locking and synchronization. In this work, we report a new mechanism of generating magnetic spontaneous oscillation via parametric pumping. By applying a pump tone to excite propagating spin waves in a yttrium iron garnet delay line, four-wave mixing converts the pump mode into two phase-autonomous propagating magnon modes, i.e. a spontaneous mode with nearly twice the wavenumber of the pump mode and an idler mode with nearly zero wavenumber. This allows us to reliably generate ultrasharp spin wave dynamics with broad frequency tunability from the pump and magnetic field. We show that the spontaneous mode can be phase-locked to a probe tone, similar to an auto-oscillator. Furthermore, the spontaneous dynamics can be used to implement a high-gain magnonic parametric amplifier with a gain up to 40 dB. Our results open a new avenue for studying nonlinear magnonics and synchronization physics in propagating magnon geometry and for developing new magnonic devices.
title_zh: 参量泵浦引起的磁自发振荡
abstract_zh: 自发动力系统因其丰富的基础物理（例如锁相和同步）而引起了极大的关注。在这项工作中，我们报告了一种通过参数泵浦产生磁自发振荡的新机制。通过应用泵浦音来激发钇铁石榴石延迟线中传播的自旋波，四波混频将泵浦模式转换为两相自主传播磁振子模式，即波数接近泵浦模式两倍的自发模式和波数接近零的惰轮模式。这使我们能够通过泵和磁场可靠地生成具有宽频率可调性的超锐自旋波动力学。我们证明自发模式可以锁相到探测音，类似于自动振荡器。此外，自发动态可用于实现增益高达 40 dB 的高增益波角参量放大器。我们的研究结果为研究传播磁振子几何中的非线性磁振子学和同步物理以及开发新的磁振子器件开辟了一条新途径。

title: Thermodynamically programmed one-pot CRISPR platform for point-of-care SNP genotyping
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: One-pot CRISPR diagnostics face a fundamental incompatibility: isothermal nucleic acid amplification enables rapid target accumulation, whereas CRISPR activation irreversibly consumes those substrates, destabilizing reaction kinetics. Here we show that reaction order can be programmed into DNA primers through thermodynamic design. Differences in primer-binding strength create two sequential amplification stages, delaying CRISPR activation until enough amplicons have accumulated without physical separation or external control. The design also introduces the protospacer adjacent motif (PAM), a short sequence required for CRISPR recognition, through the primer rather than relying on its presence in the native target, expanding target accessibility while retaining single-nucleotide discrimination. An ordinary differential equation model captures the threshold behavior and establishes a predictable framework for primer design. Building on this principle, we develop Thermodynamically Encoded Molecular Programming for One-pot diagnostics (TEMPO), which achieves attomolar sensitivity within 30 min and enables sequencing-concordant SNP genotyping and pathogen detection in a single-step microfluidic format.
title_zh: 用于即时 SNP 基因分型的热力学编程一锅 CRISPR 平台
abstract_zh: 一锅 CRISPR 诊断面临着根本性的不兼容性：等温核酸扩增能够实现靶点的快速积累，而 CRISPR 激活会不可逆地消耗这些底物，从而破坏反应动力学的稳定性。在这里，我们展示了可以通过热力学设计将反应顺序编程到 DNA 引物中。引物结合强度的差异产生了两个连续的扩增阶段，延迟了 CRISPR 激活，直到在没有物理分离或外部控制的情况下积累了足够的扩增子。该设计还通过引物引入了原型间隔子相邻基序 (PAM)，这是 CRISPR 识别所需的短序列，而不是依赖其在天然靶标中的存在，从而扩大了靶标可及性，同时保留了单核苷酸区分度。常微分方程模型捕获阈值行为并建立引物设计的可预测框架。基于这一原理，我们开发了用于一锅诊断的热力学编码分子编程 (TEMPO)，可在 30 分钟内实现阿托摩尔级灵敏度，并以单步微流体格式实现测序一致的 SNP 基因分型和病原体检测。

title: Large-area two-dimensional MoO3 as a high-κ dielectric for van der Waals integration
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Large-area high-quality dielectrics are essential for the integration of two-dimensional (2D) transistors. However, this integration remains challenging, especially for conventional dielectrics that require deposition processes. Adopting van der Waals (vdW) dielectrics is attractive. Molybdenum trioxide (α-MoO3) has been demonstrated as a vdW dielectric in 2D field-effect transistors (FETs), but previous demonstrations showed limited performance and small size. Here, we grow large-area single-crystalline MoO3 with uniform thickness and explore its properties as a dielectric. Single-crystalline MoO3 reaches the millimeter scale and maintains a high dielectric constant of ~ 18.5, low gate leakage of approximately 10−2 A cm−2 at 3.0 MV cm−1, and a large breakdown field of ~ 26.75 MV cm−1. Top-gated molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) transistors exhibit an average subthreshold swing of ~ 71 mV dec−1, and an on/off current ratio exceeding 108. Furthermore, we demonstrate MoO3-based integrated circuits and low-power complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) inverters.
title_zh: 大面积二维 MoO3 作为范德华积分的高 κ 电介质
abstract_zh: 大面积高质量电介质对于二维 (2D) 晶体管的集成至关重要。然而，这种集成仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于需要沉积工艺的传统电介质。采用范德华 (vdW) 电介质很有吸引力。三氧化钼 (α-MoO3) 已被证明可作为二维场效应晶体管 (FET) 中的 vdW 电介质，但之前的演示显示性能有限且尺寸较小。在这里，我们生长了厚度均匀的大面积单晶 MoO3，并探索了其作为电介质的特性。单晶 MoO3 达到毫米级，并保持约 18.5 的高介电常数、在 3.0 MV cm−1 时约 10−2 A cm−2 的低栅极泄漏以及约 26.75 MV cm−1 的大击穿场。顶栅二硫化钼 (MoS2) 晶体管的平均亚阈值摆幅约为 71 mV dec−1，开/关电流比超过 108。此外，我们还演示了基于 MoO3 的集成电路和低功耗互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 逆变器。

title: Metallic Lead to Perfect Perovskite: A Bottom-Up Vapor-Assisted Colloidal Strategy for High-Performance Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Using elemental lead (Pb0) as a precursor offers an upstream and atom-economical alternative route for perovskite synthesis. However, producing perovskite solar cells (PSCs) from Pb0 remains fundamentally challenging because Pb0 is hard to convert to Pb2+ via ordinary approaches, while any remaining Pb0 acts as deep-level defects in perovskite. To address this challenge, Pb0 first reacts with I2 in N,N-dimethylformamide and dimethyl sulfoxide, yielding well-dispersed PbI2 colloidal precursors that facilitate subsequent full conversion to perovskites through vapor-solid reaction with formamidinium iodide vapors. Devices starting from Pb0 perform much better than those from as-purchased PbI2, in both efficiency and stability, achieving vapor-assisted solution-processed 22.65% efficiency under simulated AM1.5G illumination (over 20.65% from PbI2). These findings suggest that high-quality perovskites may also be prepared from PbI2 alternatives, even its upstream material Pb.
title_zh: 金属铅形成完美钙钛矿：高性能太阳能电池的自下而上蒸汽辅助胶体策略
abstract_zh: 使用元素铅（Pb0）作为前驱体为钙钛矿合成提供了一种上游且原子经济的替代路线。然而，用 Pb0 生产钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSC）仍然具有根本性的挑战，因为 Pb0 很难通过普通方法转化为 Pb2+，而任何剩余的 Pb0 都会充当钙钛矿中的深层缺陷。为了应对这一挑战，PbO 首先与 I2 在 N,N-二甲基甲酰胺和二甲亚砜中反应，产生分散良好的 PbI2 胶体前体，促进随后通过与甲脒碘化物蒸气的气固反应完全转化为钙钛矿。从 Pb0 开始的器件在效率和稳定性方面都比购买的 PbI2 器件表现得更好，在模拟 AM1.5G 照明下实现了蒸汽辅助溶液处理的 22.65% 效率（PbI2 的效率超过 20.65%）。这些发现表明，高质量的钙钛矿也可以由 PbI2 替代品，甚至是其上游材料 Pb 制备。

title: Cationic carbon nanotube modulates surface fields for general acidic CO2 reduction with aqueous organic cations
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The (bi)carbonate formation in neutral or alkaline media severely limits the carbon and energy efficiency of electrochemical CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR). Alkali metal cations and polymer coatings employed to inhibit hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) during acidic CO2RR often exacerbate salt precipitation or increase cell resistivity. Here we report cationic carbon nanotubes (CCNTs) as universal additives enabling efficient CO2RR in strong acids. Using bismuth, silver, and copper oxide catalysts, we attain Faradaic efficiency (FE) of 95%, 100%, and 67% for HCOOH, CO, and C2H4 in pH≤1 electrolyte. Notably, while organic cations typically suffer from poor proton shielding and inferior selectivity, CCNT additives enable their use as electrolytes for selective acidic CO2RR. Their higher solubility permits elevated concentrations, improving stability and energy efficiency. Quantum Mechanics reveals that CCNTs physically mixed with metal catalysts alter the distribution of electric field at the electrolyte/electrode interfaces, impeding HER by suppressing hydronium ions migration while promoting CO2RR. These findings highlight CCNTs as versatile and effective additives for advancing acidic CO2RR with improved selectivity, carbon efficiency, energy efficiency, and stability.
title_zh: 阳离子碳纳米管调节表面场，用于水性有机阳离子还原一般酸性二氧化碳
abstract_zh: 中性或碱性介质中碳酸（氢）盐的形成严重限制了电化学二氧化碳还原反应（CO2RR）的碳和能量效率。用于抑制酸性 CO2RR 过程中析氢反应 (HER) 的碱金属阳离子和聚合物涂层通常会加剧盐沉淀或增加电池电阻率。在此，我们报告了阳离子碳纳米管 (CCNT) 作为通用添加剂，可在强酸中实现高效的 CO2RR。使用铋、银和氧化铜催化剂，我们在 pH≤1 电解液中对 HCOOH、CO 和 C2H4 的法拉第效率 (FE) 分别达到 95%、100% 和 67%。值得注意的是，虽然有机阳离子通常存在较差的质子屏蔽和较差的选择性，但 CCNT 添加剂使其能够用作选择性酸性 CO2RR 的电解质。它们较高的溶解度可以提高浓度，从而提高稳定性和能源效率。量子力学揭示，CCNT 与金属催化剂物理混合会改变电解质/电极界面处的电场分布，通过抑制水合氢离子迁移同时促进 CO2RR 来阻碍 HER。这些发现凸显了 CCNT 作为通用且有效的添加剂，可促进酸性 CO2RR 的发展，并提高选择性、碳效率、能源效率和稳定性。

title: A triboelectric radical generation route to chlorine disinfectants from brine
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Contact electrification (CE), one of the earliest documented physical phenomena, has traditionally been associated with triboelectric charging but rarely considered as a driver of chemical transformations. Here we show that CE generates radicals at solid-liquid interfaces, establishing contact-electro-chemistry (CE-Chemistry) as a metal-catalyst-free route that uses ambient mechanical energy. Ultrasonically driven contact-separation of fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP) particulates in brine generates hydroxyl radicals (•OH) and chlorine radicals (•Cl), forming active chlorine [hypochlorous acid (HOCl) and hypochlorite ions (ClO−)], without detectable chlorine gas (Cl2) production. Using natural seawater, this strategy achieves active chlorine production of 208.8 μmol g−1 h−1 and operates for over 700 h without detectable FEP dissolution or toxic intermediates. Cation hydration engineering modulates interfacial electrical double layers, strengthening triboelectric fields and tuning reaction kinetics. This work enables Cl2-free disinfectant production from brine without external bias or illumination, opening avenues for heterogeneous catalysis and CE-driven reaction design.
title_zh: 从盐水中产生氯消毒剂的摩擦电自由基生成途径
abstract_zh: 接触起电 (CE) 是最早有记载的物理现象之一，传统上与​​摩擦起电有关，但很少被认为是化学转变的驱动因素。在这里，我们展示了 CE 在固液界面产生自由基，建立了接触电化学（CE-化学）作为一种使用环境机械能的无金属催化剂途径。超声波驱动接触分离盐水中的氟化乙烯丙烯 (FEP) 颗粒会产生羟基自由基 (·OH) 和氯自由基 (·Cl)，形成活性氯 [次氯酸 (HOCl) 和次氯酸根离子 (ClO−)]，且不会产生可检测到的氯气 (Cl2)。使用天然海水，该策略实现了 208.8 μmol g−1 h−1 的活性氯产量，并且运行超过 700 小时，没有检测到 FEP 溶解或有毒中间体。阳离子水合工程可调节界面双电层，增强摩擦电场并调节反应动力学。这项工作能够在没有外部偏压或照明的情况下从盐水中生产无 Cl2 消毒剂，为多相催化和 CE 驱动的反应设计开辟了途径。

title: Two-dimensional pixel-level addressable mid-infrared metasurface spatial light modulator
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Active metasurfaces enable dynamic control of light for applications in beam steering, pixelated holography, and adaptive optics, but demonstrations of two-dimensional electrically addressable arrays have so far been limited. Here we introduce a scalable two-dimensional architecture based on phase-change materials integrated metasurfaces and apply it to realize the first transmissive mid-infrared amplitude-only spatial light modulator. The device is fabricated through standard silicon photonic foundry processing combined with backend-of-line integration and employs multilayer backend metal interconnects to implement a crossbar addressing scheme. Each pixel is integrated with a silicon diode selector to suppress sneak-path currents, a feature essential for scaling to large arrays. The result establishes a foundry-compatible route to high-density, large-area active metasurfaces with independently tunable pixels.
title_zh: 二维像素级可寻址中红外超表面空间光调制器
abstract_zh: 有源超表面能够对光束控制、像素化全息术和自适应光学等应用中的光进行动态控制，但二维电可寻址阵列的演示迄今为止还很有限。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于相变材料集成超表面的可扩展二维架构，并将其应用于实现第一个透射式中红外纯振幅空间光调制器。该器件通过标准硅光子代工工艺与后端生产线集成相结合来制造，并采用多层后端金属互连来实现交叉寻址方案。每个像素都与硅二极管选择器集成，以抑制潜行电流，这是扩展到大型阵列的重要功能。结果建立了一条与铸造厂兼容的路线，以实现具有独立可调像素的高密度、大面积有源超表面。

title: Meso-electron-withdrawing pentamethine cyanines achieve large anti-Stokes blue-emitting triplet-triplet annihilation upconversion
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Developing metal-free triplet-triplet annihilation upconversion systems that operate under far-red excitation and produce efficient blue emission is challenging due to an inherent trade-off between a large anti-Stokes shift and a high upconversion quantum yield. Here we show that introducing electron-withdrawing groups at the meso-position of a pentamethine cyanine scaffold narrows the singlet-triplet energy gap, suppresses photoisomerization, and promotes the intersystem crossing. These meso-electron-withdrawing pentamethine cyanines possess higher triplet state energy levels than their meso-unsubstituted counterparts. In particular, the meso-hemicyanine-derived sensitizer exhibits characteristic low-temperature phosphorescence. When paired with perylene, it extends the excitation wavelength to 721 nm and yields blue emission at 470 nm, yielding an upconversion quantum yield of 9.6% (upper limit 50%). This study demonstrates that molecular engineering of pentamethine cyanines via meso-position electron-withdrawing substitution effectively reduces the singlet-triplet energy gap, enabling the design of organic triplet-triplet annihilation upconversion materials and advancing their utility in photonics and biophotonics.
title_zh: 介观吸电子五次甲基花青实现大反斯托克斯蓝光发射三重态-三重态湮灭上转换
abstract_zh: 由于大反斯托克斯位移和高上转换量子产率之间固有的权衡，开发在远红激发下运行并产生高效蓝色发射的无金属三重态-三重态湮没上转换系统具有挑战性。在这里，我们表明，在五次甲基花青支架的中间位置引入吸电子基团可以缩小单重态-三重态能隙，抑制光异构化并促进系间窜越。这些内消旋吸电子五次甲基花青比其未取代的内消旋对应物具有更高的三线态能级。特别地，内消旋半花青衍生的敏化剂表现出特征性的低温磷光。当与苝配合使用时，它将激发波长延伸至 721 nm，并在 470 nm 处产生蓝色发射，产生 9.6% 的上转换量子产率（上限 50%）。这项研究表明，通过中位吸电子取代对五次甲基花青进行分子工程，可以有效减小单重态-三重态能隙，从而能够设计有机三重态-三重态湮没上转换材料，并提高其在光子学和生物光子学中的应用。

title: Hydrogen bond network disruption enables efficient direct reactive capture of CO2 from flue gas
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Electrochemical CO2 conversion offers a direct route to decarbonized fuels, but its deployment on industrial flue gas remains hindered by the low CO2 content, high O2 levels, and the resulting parasitic oxygen reduction. Binary solvent electrolytes offer a lever to tune the local reaction environment under such dilute and impurity-rich conditions. Here we show a direct reactive capture (DRC) strategy that converts CO2 from dilute streams into CO with near-quantitative Faradaic efficiency in organic electrolytes under moderate pressure. We identify hydrogen-bond donation ability (HBD) as a decisive parameter governing competing hydrogen evolution and oxygen reduction reactions. Employing low-HBD electrolytes disrupts the hydrogen-bond network, suppresses competing reactions, and enables selective CO2 conversion even at 1% CO2 in the presence of O2. When fed with 15% CO2 and 8% O2 balanced with N2, the optimized system sustains >100 h operation with an energy consumption of 30.7 GJ ton−1 CO, and achieves a solar-to-fuel efficiency of ~5.5%. This impurity-tolerant strategy addresses a key barrier for industrial CO2 electrolysis and establishes a scalable route to solar-driven fuel production directly from flue gas.
title_zh: 氢键网络破坏可以有效地直接反应捕获烟气中的二氧化碳
abstract_zh: 电化学二氧化碳转化为脱碳燃料提供了直接途径，但其在工业烟气中的部署仍然受到二氧化碳含量低、氧气含量高以及由此产生的寄生氧还原的阻碍。二元溶剂电解质提供了在这种稀薄且富含杂质的条件下调节局部反应环境的杠杆。在这里，我们展示了一种直接反应捕获（DRC）策略，该策略可在中等压力下将稀流中的二氧化碳转化为有机电解质中的二氧化碳，其法拉第效率接近定量。我们将氢键供给能力（HBD）确定为控制竞争性析氢和氧还原反应的决定性参数。采用低 HBD 电解质会破坏氢键网络，抑制竞争反应，并在 O2 存在的情况下即使在 1% CO2 的情况下也能实现选择性 CO2 转化。当供给 15% CO2 和 8% O2 与 N2 平衡时，优化的系统可维持超过 100 小时的运行，能耗为 30.7 GJ ton−1 CO，并实现约 5.5% 的太阳能燃料效率。这种耐杂质策略解决了工业二氧化碳电解的一个关键障碍，并建立了一条直接从烟气生产太阳能驱动燃料的可扩展路线。

title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of scattering exceptional points
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) offer new routes to control wave-matter interactions in non-Hermitian systems. Whereas conventional EPs arise in Hamiltonians and mark eigenstate coalescence, scattering EPs recast them in input-output responses for free-space wave control. Yet the rich topology of EPs is largely concealed in steady-state observables, exhibiting similar asymmetric patterns governed by identical Jordan-block forms. Here we exploit scattering as an evolving process in space and time to resolve spatiotemporal dynamics. We establish a cross-domain mapping from momentum-frequency to space-time, connecting static EPs to dynamic scattering singularities. By projecting a unitary scattering matrix onto lower-dimensional subspaces, EP topology is imprinted into a wave packet as a spatiotemporal vortex (STV), whose phase singularity is anchored to the EP and carries its quantized topological charge. In a liquid-surface-wave platform, we observe a charge-1 STV and a disintegrated charge-2 STV, generated by distinct EPs in a single device. Our work links fixed exceptional topology to dynamic wave topology, establishing a framework for spatiotemporal wave control.
title_zh: 散射异常点的时空动力学
abstract_zh: 特异点（EP）提供了控制非厄米系统中波与物质相互作用的新途径。传统的 EP 出现在哈密顿量中并标记本征态合并，而散射 EP 在自由空间波控制的输入输出响应中重新塑造它们。然而，EP 丰富的拓扑结构很大程度上隐藏在稳态可观测值中，表现出由相同乔丹块形式控制的类似不对称模式。在这里，我们利用散射作为空间和时间的演化过程来解决时空动力学问题。我们建立了从动量频率到时空的跨域映射，将静态 EP 与动态散射奇点连接起来。通过将酉散射矩阵投影到低维子空间上，EP 拓扑被作为时空涡旋 (STV) 印记到波包中，其相位奇点被锚定到 EP 并携带其量化的拓扑电荷。在液体表面波平台中，我们观察到由单个设备中不同的 EP 生成的电荷 1 STV 和分解的电荷 2 STV。我们的工作将固定的特殊拓扑与动态波拓扑联系起来，建立了时空波控制的框架。

title: Optimizing Traps and Dihedral Angles to Modulate Charge Transport Behavior for High-Temperature Dielectric Energy Storage
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: High-temperature dielectric films hold broad prospects in next-generation microelectronics and power systems. However, commercially available dielectric materials for electrostatic energy storage, specifically biaxially oriented polypropylene, suffer from drawbacks such as low energy density, low efficiency, and poor reliability, which limit the application of film capacitors in harsh environments. Herein, a series of naphthalene tetracarboxylic acid dianhydrides were incorporated into polyetherimide (PEI) backbone, thereby modulating the charge transport behavior. Specifically, synergistic regulation of traps and dihedral angles has effectively enhanced the breakdown strength of PEI. At 200 °C, the optimized dielectric film delivers a discharged energy density of 6.00 J cm−3 at an efficiency of 90%, and maintains stable performance over 105 charge-discharge cycles at 300 MV m−1. Multilayer stacked film capacitors prepared from the optimized films exhibit remarkable thermal stability and capacitive performance. This work proposes a feasible strategy for developing dielectric films with remarkable energy storage performance, superior thermal stability, and scalable fabrication capability.
title_zh: 优化陷阱和二面角以调节高温电介质储能的电荷传输行为
abstract_zh: 高温介电薄膜在下一代微电子和电力系统中具有广阔的前景。然而，市售的静电储能介电材料，特别是双向拉伸聚丙烯，存在能量密度低、效率低、可靠性差等缺点，限制了薄膜电容器在恶劣环境下的应用。在此，一系列萘四甲酸二酐被纳入聚醚酰亚胺（PEI）主链中，从而调节电荷传输行为。具体而言，陷阱和二面角的协同调节有效增强了PEI的击穿强度。在200°C时，优化的介电薄膜以90%的效率提供6.00 J cm−3的放电能量密度，并在300 MV m−1的105次充放电循环中保持稳定的性能。由优化的薄膜制备的多层堆叠薄膜电容器表现出显着的热稳定性和电容性能。这项工作提出了一种开发具有卓越储能性能、卓越热稳定性和可扩展制造能力的介电薄膜的可行策略。

title: Engineering all-organic electrocatalysts with asymmetric dual-active sites for uncommon oxygen-evolving pathway
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The performance of electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction is governed by molecular evolution pathways, yet their regulation remains a significant experimental and theoretical hurdle. Herein, we propose the construction of asymmetric non-metallic dual-active sites through engineering hydroxyl groups in an all-organic electrocatalyst, thereby triggering an uncommon asymmetric oxide pathway mechanism. This reaction pathway reduces the requirement of strict equilibrium on adsorption energies at dual-active sites for traditional oxide pathway mechanism, and also avoids the limitation of the linear scaling relationship for adsorbate evolution mechanism. Therefore, the proposed metal-free electrocatalyst shows competitive oxygen evolution reaction performance with an overpotential of 364.3 ± 4.5 mV at 1.0 A·cm−2. Combining operando spectroscopic/mass spectrometry and theoretical calculations unveils that the asymmetric oxide pathway mechanism undergoes the critical step of *OH intramolecular nucleophilic attack to neighboring *O, forming *OOH with drastically reducing energy barriers. This work shows the diversity of oxygen evolution pathways in all-organic electrocatalysts and offers a viewpoint for optimizing the electrocatalytic performances of metal-free solids.
title_zh: 设计具有不对称双活性位点的全有机电催化剂，用于不常见的析氧途径
abstract_zh: 电催化析氧反应的性能受分子演化途径的控制，但它们的调节仍然是一个重大的实验和理论障碍。在此，我们提出通过在全有机电催化剂中改造羟基来构建不对称非金属双活性位点，从而触发不常见的不对称氧化物途径机制。该反应途径降低了传统氧化物途径机制对双活性位点吸附能严格平衡的要求，也避免了吸附质演化机制线性标度关系的限制。因此，所提出的无金属电催化剂表现出竞争性的析氧反应性能，在1.0 A·cm−2下的过电势为364.3 ± 4.5 mV。结合原位光谱/质谱和理论计算揭示了不对称氧化物途径机制经历了*OH分子内亲核攻击邻近*O的关键步骤，形成*OOH，并大大降低了能垒。这项工作展示了全有机电催化剂中析氧途径的多样性，并为优化无金属固体的电催化性能提供了观点。

title: Boundary-Bulk Interplay in Nonlinear Topological Transport
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nonlinear transport provides a powerful probe of the quantum geometry of electronic wavefunctions in topological materials. While nonlinear responses from bulk quantum geometry and band topology are well understood, the role of boundary modes remains largely unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate boundary-bulk interplay in nonlinear transport, including second-harmonic Hall and nonreciprocal longitudinal responses, in molecular beam epitaxy-grown magnetic topological insulator heterostructures. We find that the nonlinear transport is maximized when the sample is tuned slightly away from well-quantized quantum anomalous Hall and axion insulator states. The sign and amplitude of the nonlinear responses depend on electrode configuration, magnetic order, and carrier type. Supported by symmetry analysis and nonlinear Landauer-Büttiker formalism, our findings demonstrate that nonlinear transport is governed by the interplay between boundary and bulk states. Our work highlights the critical role of electrodes in nonlinear transport and establishes boundary modes as a key origin of the giant nonlinear response in nearly bulk-insulating topological materials.
title_zh: 非线性拓扑输运中的边界体相互作用
abstract_zh: 非线性输运为拓扑材料中电子波函数的量子几何提供了有力的探索。虽然体量子几何和能带拓扑的非线性响应已被很好地理解，但边界模式的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们展示了分子束外延生长的磁性拓扑绝缘体异质结构中非线性输运中的边界体相互作用，包括二次谐波霍尔和不可逆纵向响应。我们发现，当样本稍微远离量子化的量子反常霍尔和轴子绝缘体态时，非线性输运会最大化。非线性响应的符号和幅度取决于电极配置、磁序和载流子类型。在对称分析和非线性 Landauer-Büttiker 形式主义的支持下，我们的研究结果表明非线性输运受边界态和体态之间的相互作用控制。我们的工作强调了电极在非线性传输中的关键作用，并将边界模式确立为近体绝缘拓扑材料中巨大非线性响应的关键起源。

title: Thermally symbiotic integration of osmotic membrane distillation and electrolysis for direct seawater hydrogen production
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Integrating water purification membranes with electrolysis for in situ hydrogen (H2) production from seawater offers a rapid pathway to net-zero, but is limited by salt crossover and insufficient water production in existing approaches. Here we overcome these limitations by integrating osmotic membrane distillation (OMD) with alkaline water electrolysis (AWE). Driven by dual thermal and osmotic gradients to enhance salt-free water vapour transport, the OMD-AWE delivers a H2 production rate of 60 kg m–2 day–1 with excellent stability over 500 h of continuous operation. To eliminate the external heating energy penalty of OMD, we propose a thermally symbiotic architecture that converts the AWE’s waste heat to OMD’s thermal driving force while OMD simultaneously providing cooling to maintain AWE optimal temperatures, as validated by our thermal-water-hydrogen model. This thermal symbiosis not only makes OMD-AWE energy self-sufficient with energy efficiency of 51 kWh kg(H2)–1 but also establishes a self-regulating mechanism that phase-locks thermal driving force to fluctuating electrical inputs, synchronising water supply with demand to overcome renewable intermittency. Our approach enables flexible component matching and thermal self-sufficiency at any scale, providing a framework for membrane-integrated electrolysis, demonstrating both technical excellence and economic viability towards a sustainable hydrogen economy.
title_zh: 渗透膜蒸馏和电解的热共生集成直接海水制氢
abstract_zh: 将水净化膜与电解相结合，从海水中原位生产氢气（H2）提供了一条快速实现净零排放的途径，但现有方法受到盐交叉和产水不足的限制。在这里，我们通过将渗透膜蒸馏（OMD）与碱性水电解（AWE）相结合来克服这些限制。在双重热梯度和渗透梯度的驱动下，OMD-AWE 可提供 60 kg m–2 day–1 的氢气生产率，并在连续运行 500 小时内具有出色的稳定性。为了消除 OMD 的外部加热能量损失，我们提出了一种热共生架构，将 AWE 的废热转化为 OMD 的热驱动力，同时 OMD 提供冷却以维持 AWE 最佳温度，这一点已通过我们的热水-水-氢模型验证。这种热共生不仅使 OMD-AWE 能源自给自足，能源效率达到 51 kWh kg(H2)–1，而且还建立了一种自我调节机制，将热驱动力锁相到波动的电力输入，使供水与需求同步，以克服可再生能源的间歇性。我们的方法可以实现任何规模的灵活组件匹配和热自给自足，为膜集成电解提供框架，展示了可持续氢经济的技术卓越性和经济可行性。

title: Mechanically locking enzymes in covalent organic frameworks via light-responsive nanohands for stable biocatalysis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enzyme immobilization is pivotal to sustainable biocatalysis, yet the most widespread protocol of physical adsorption on static porous supports suffers from enzyme leakage and short catalytic lifespan. We introduce a dynamic-pore mechano-locking strategy employing tetrafluoroazobenzene-engineered covalent organic frameworks (COFs), where visible-light-mediated isomerization enables precise and reversible pore-size variation for adaptive enzyme confinement. This approach significantly enhances immobilization stability across diverse enzymes, improving the retention of horseradish peroxidase, cytochrome c, and laccase by 6.7-, 9.7-, and 1.8-fold, respectively. Mechanically locked formate dehydrogenase retained 99.2% activity after five cycles, surpassing most prior systems. In continuous-flow microreactors, productivity sustained over 22000 min, extending half-life 47-fold versus static-pore counterparts. Experimental and computational analyses reveal that synergistic pore compression and nanohands embedding during photoresponsive locking induce enzyme conformational restructuring and restricted residue mobility. This platform enables ultra-stable enzyme immobilization by orchestrating adaptive pore engineering with mechanically reinforced biocompatible interactions, unlocking broad potential for green biomanufacturing.
title_zh: 通过光响应纳米手将酶机械锁定在共价有机框架中，以实现稳定的生物催化
abstract_zh: 酶固定化对于可持续生物催化至关重要，但静态多孔载体上最广泛的物理吸附方案存在酶泄漏和催化寿命短的问题。我们引入了一种采用四氟偶氮苯工程共价有机框架（COF）的动态孔机械锁定策略，其中可见光介导的异构化能够实现精确且可逆的孔径变化，从而实现自适应酶限制。这种方法显着增强了多种酶的固定稳定性，将辣根过氧化物酶、细胞色素 c 和漆酶的保留分别提高了 6.7、9.7 和 1.8 倍。机械锁定的甲酸脱氢酶在五个循环后保留了 99.2% 的活性，超过了大多数现有系统。在连续流微反应器中，生产率持续超过 22000 分钟，半衰期比静态孔反应器延长了 47 倍。实验和计算分析表明，光响应锁定过程中协同孔压缩和纳米手嵌入会诱导酶构象重组并限制残基迁移率。该平台通过协调适应性孔工程与机械强化的生物相容性相互作用，实现超稳定的酶固定化，释放绿色生物制造的广泛潜力。

title: Red electroluminescent Cu4I4 bipyramids with external quantum efficiency beyond 40%
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The development of red cluster light-emitting devices (CLED) lags far behind blue and green congeners with respect to efficiencies, since multiple excited states of red cluster molecules are involved in non-radiation during electroluminescence. Herein, we accurately optimize excited states of a red bipyramidal [PXZDPPQ]2Cu4I4, whose ligand integrates conjugation-extended 2-diphenylphosphineylquinoline (DPPQ) and strong electron-donating phenoxazine (PXZ), giving rise to desired excited state locations of the outer intraligand charge transfer (nLCT)-featured first singlet (S1) and triplet (T1) excited states and the inner high-lying metal-ligand charge transfer (nMLCT) states. Its outer and highly radiative nLCT states are spatially and energetically advantageous in carrier capture and exciton confinement; meanwhile, its inner and high-lying nMLCT states are protected from collisional quenching, and support cross transitions between nLCT states to realize exactly balanced dual emissions with a ratio of 51/49. [PXZDPPQ]2Cu4I4 achieves eightfold increased photoluminescence quantum yield of 93.6%, tenfold increased external quantum efficiency reaching 43.7% as a new record for all kinds of planar red light-emitting devices, and 20% improved exciton utilization efficiency in comparison to the congener with the reverse excited state location. These results demonstrate the unique merit of cluster materials in exciton engineering and their potential for next-generation full-color displays.
title_zh: 红色电致发光 Cu4I4 双锥体，外量子效率超过 40%
abstract_zh: 红色簇发光器件（CLED）的发展在效率方面远远落后于蓝色和绿色同系物，因为红色簇分子的多个激发态参与电致发光过程中的非辐射。在这里，我们准确地优化了红色双锥体[PXZDPPQ]2Cu4I4的激发态，其配体集成了共轭延伸的2-二苯基膦基喹啉（DPPQ）和强给电子吩恶嗪（PXZ），产生了外部配体内电荷转移（nLCT）特征的第一单线态（S1）和三线态（T1）激发态和内部的所需激发态位置。高位金属配体电荷转移（nMLCT）态。其外部和高辐射nLCT态在载流子捕获和激子限制方面在空间和能量上具有优势；同时，其内部和高位nMLCT态免受碰撞猝灭，并支持nLCT态之间的交叉跃迁，以实现比例为51/49的精确平衡的双发射。 [PXZDPPQ]2Cu4I4的光致发光量子产率提高了8倍，达到93.6%，外量子效率提高了10倍，达到43.7%，创下了各类平面红光发光器件的新纪录，激子利用效率比反向激发态位置的同类产品提高了20%。这些结果证明了团簇材料在激子工程中的独特优点及其在下一代全彩显示器中的潜力。

title: Prognostic RNA-splicing archetypes in breast cancer identified by extended pre-training of histopathology foundation models
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recently, histopathology foundation models (hFM) have rapidly advanced in size and complexity, achieving excellent performance in cancer diagnosis and biomarker discovery. Here, we specialise pre-trained hFMs to invasive tumour tissue and present three key contributions. First, we systematically evaluate the biological concepts encoded in hFM representations across multiple biological scales. Second, we demonstrate that informed extended pre-training transforms generalist models into tumour-specialised ones encoding richer semantic information, enabling discovery of recurrent tumour archetypes with consistent morphological and molecular identities across patients. Third, we identify dominant tumour archetypes with aberrant gene-expression programs coexisting within tumours and recurring across heterogeneous epithelial cancers, including HER2-positive and triple-negative breast cancer. Crucially, these archetypes exhibit prognostic value, with RNA splicing-associated archetypes consistently predicting poorer outcomes. Our work shows that tumour-specialised hFMs unlock rich molecular and morphological information from routine H&E slides, providing computationally efficient and biologically informed solutions for biological discovery and patient stratification.
title_zh: 通过组织病理学基础模型的扩展预训练识别乳腺癌的预后 RNA 剪接原型
abstract_zh: 最近，组织病理学基础模型（hFM）在规模和复杂性方面迅速发展，在癌症诊断和生物标志物发现方面取得了优异的性能。在这里，我们专门针对侵袭性肿瘤组织进行预训练 hFM，并提出了三个关键贡献。首先，我们系统地评估跨多个生物尺度的 hFM 表示中编码的生物概念。其次，我们证明，知情的扩展预训练将通才模型转变为编码更丰富语义信息的肿瘤专用模型，从而能够发现患者之间具有一致形态和分子身份的复发肿瘤原型。第三，我们确定了在肿瘤内共存并在异质上皮癌（包括 HER2 阳性和三阴性乳腺癌）中反复出现的异常基因表达程序的显性肿瘤原型。至关重要的是，这些原型表现出预后价值，与 RNA 剪接相关的原型始终预测较差的结果。我们的工作表明，肿瘤专用 hFM 可从常规 H&E 切片中解锁丰富的分子和形态学信息，为生物发现和患者分层提供计算高效且生物学信息丰富的解决方案。

title: Disruption of microtubules with low intensity ultrasound rescues hair follicle damage by paclitaxel in mouse models
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Paclitaxel exemplifies one of the key taxanes, a group of versatile and effective drugs commonly used in chemotherapy for several major cancer types. These drugs work by stabilizing cellular microtubules, a unique mechanism to account for their impressive success in oncology. Hair loss (alopecia) is a well-known adverse side effect and poses a significant quality of life issue for many patients. We discovered that a brief exposure to low intensity and low frequency ultrasound at a defined timing was able to break cellular microtubules and mitotic spindles transiently, and thus annulled the consequent hair follicle damage and suppression of hair growth following paclitaxel administrations. These experimental findings herald a practical method that is within reach to prevent hair loss in cancer chemotherapy using taxanes.
title_zh: 用低强度超声破坏微管可挽救小鼠模型中紫杉醇造成的毛囊损伤
abstract_zh: 紫杉醇是关键紫杉烷类药物之一，是一组通用且有效的药物，常用于几种主要癌症类型的化疗。这些药物通过稳定细胞微管发挥作用，这是一种独特的机制，可以解释它们在肿瘤学方面取得的令人印象深刻的成功。脱发（脱发）是一种众所周知的不良副作用，给许多患者带来了严重的生活质量问题。我们发现，在规定的时间短暂暴露于低强度和低频超声波能够暂时破坏细胞微管和有丝分裂纺锤体，从而消除紫杉醇给药后随之而来的毛囊损伤和毛发生长抑制。这些实验结果预示着一种实用的方法可以在使用紫杉烷类药物的癌症化疗中预防脱发。

title: HIV-1 capsid interactions with Nuclear Pore Complex components support nuclear entry via affinity gradient
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Before entering the nucleus, the HIV capsid core [composed of capsid (CA) proteins] must translocate through the Nuclear Pore Complex (NPC). This process relies on direct interactions between CA and the phenylalanine-glycine (FG) repeats in nucleoporins (NUPs) within the NPC. FG repeats are generally classified into three canonical motifs: FG, GLFG, and FxFG, which are differentially distributed along the NPC axis: FG and FxFG motifs are predominantly at the cytoplasmic periphery and in the nuclear basket, whereas GLFG motifs are primarily in the central channel of the NPC. We demonstrate that the capsid engages the diverse FG repeats with markedly different affinities. Notably, GLFGs of NUP98 located in the central channel display significantly increased affinity to CA than conventional FGs/FxFGs. NUP153, which is located at the nuclear basket, contains an atypical FxFG that is adjacent to a PSGV sequence, thus forming additional favorable interactions. We designate this nonconventional FxFG motif as an “FG super-motif.” In addition, the C-terminus of NUP153 also contains a cluster of basic residues that serve as an enhancer of the NUP153 FG super-motif, dramatically increasing CA affinity by ~1,000-fold. Other binding enhancers for FG motifs were also identified in NUP58 and POM121 that are in the central channel and its nuclear boundary, respectively. Affinities of NUP58, POM121, and NUP153 enhancers to CA increase with proximity to the nuclear basket. Thus, we propose that the diverse FG repeats and their binding enhancers create an affinity gradient that potentiates HIV capsid translocation through the NPC.
title_zh: HIV-1衣壳与核孔复合体成分的相互作用支持通过亲和力梯度进入核

title: Structural insights into the nairovirus nucleoprotein endonuclease activity
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Nairoviruses are emerging tick-borne pathogens for which effective antiviral therapies are currently unavailable. Although nucleoproteins (NPs) are essential for viral genome encapsulation and have been extensively characterized at the structural level, whether they perform additional functions during viral replication remains unclear. Here, we investigated the NP of the representative nairovirus Tacheng tick virus 1 (TcTV1). We found that the TcTV1 NP binds to nucleic acids in a sequence-independent manner and assembles into tetramer-based ribonucleoprotein complexes upon nucleic acid binding. This assembly process is accompanied by a pronounced conformational rearrangement that facilitates NP polymerization. In addition to its role in RNA encapsulation, TcTV1 NP exhibits intrinsic endonuclease activity that does not require metal ions and preferentially cleaves unstructured single-stranded RNA, while structured RNA substrates are largely resistant to cleavage. Functional analysis indicates that the stalk domain of NP plays a central role in coordinating RNA binding, oligomerization, and access to the nuclease-active site, thereby influencing whether an RNA molecule is protected or degraded. Finally, we identified a small-molecule compound that interferes with both RNA binding and nuclease activity by targeting a conserved functional region of nairovirus NP. Together, these results reveal an expanded functional repertoire of nairovirus NPs and suggest that NP-mediated RNA discrimination may contribute to viral replication. Our findings also support the feasibility of targeting NP for the development of antiviral drugs against emerging nairoviruses.
title_zh: 内罗病毒核蛋白核酸内切酶活性的结构见解
abstract_zh: 内罗病毒是新出现的蜱传病原体，目前尚无有效的抗病毒疗法。尽管核蛋白（NP）对于病毒基因组封装至关重要，并且在结构水平上已被广泛表征，但它们在病毒复制过程中是否发挥额外功能仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究了代表性的内罗病毒塔城蜱病毒1（TcTV1）的NP。我们发现 TcTV1 NP 以序列无关的方式与核酸结合，并在核酸结合后组装成基于四聚体的核糖核蛋白复合物。该组装过程伴随着明显的构象重排，促进纳米粒子聚合。除了在 RNA 封装中的作用外，TcTV1 NP 还表现出不需要金属离子的内在核酸内切酶活性，并优先切割非结构化单链 RNA，而结构化 RNA 底物在很大程度上抵抗切割。功能分析表明，NP 的茎结构域在协调 RNA 结合、寡聚化和进入核酸酶活性位点方面发挥着核心作用，从而影响 RNA 分子是否受到保护或降解。最后，我们鉴定了一种小分子化合物，它通过靶向内罗病毒 NP 的保守功能区域来干扰 RNA 结合和核酸酶活性。总之，这些结果揭示了内罗病毒 NP 的扩展功能库，并表明 NP 介导的 RNA 区分可能有助于病毒复制。我们的研究结果也支持目标的可行性

title: Controlled generation of 3D vortices in driven atomic Josephson junctions
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: We propose an ac-driven atomic Josephson junction as a clean and tunable source of three-dimensional (3D) solitary waves in quantum fluids. Depending on the height of the junction barrier, the emitted excitations appear as vortex rings at low velocity or vorticity-free rarefaction pulses near the sound velocity, thus spanning the complete Jones-Roberts family of solitons. The Shapiro-step phenomenon renders the emission deterministic: on the first, second, third Shapiro steps, the junction ejects one, two, and three solitary excitations per drive cycle. This enables controlled generation of single- and multiexcitation configurations, allowing detailed studies of the full crossover between vortex rings and rarefaction pulses and their interaction dynamics. By Shapiro phase locking, multiexcitations are emitted in succession and interact, revealing leapfrogging motion of two and three coaxial rings and their decay via boundary-assisted, sound-mediated processes. This ac-driven protocol establishes a compact and reproducible platform for generating, classifying, and controlling 3D solitonic excitations, paving the way for precision studies of nonlinear vortex dynamics, dissipation, and quantum turbulence in trapped superfluids.
title_zh: 驱动原子约瑟夫森结中 3D 涡流的受控生成
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种交流驱动的原子约瑟夫森结作为量子流体中三维（3D）孤立波的清洁且可调谐的源。根据结势垒的高度，发射的激发表现为低速涡环或接近声速的无涡度稀疏脉冲，从而跨越完整的琼斯-罗伯茨孤子族。夏皮罗阶现象使发射具有确定性：在第一、第二、第三夏皮罗阶上，结在每个驱动周期喷射一个、两个和三个孤立激发。这使得能够控制生成单激发和多激发配置，从而可以详细研究涡环和稀疏脉冲之间的完全交叉及其相互作用动力学。通过夏皮罗锁相，多重激励连续发射并相互作用，揭示了两个和三个同轴环的跳跃运动及其通过边界辅助、声音介导的过程的衰减。这种交流驱动协议建立了一个紧凑且可重复的平台，用于生成、分类和控制 3D 孤子激发，为捕获超流体中的非线性涡动力学、耗散和量子湍流的精确研究铺平了道路。

title: Costunolide ameliorates autoimmune uveitis by targeting USP15 to suppress TNF-α-induced retinal endothelial inflammation
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Autoimmune uveitis is a sight-threatening inflammatory disease, with the majority of entities driven by leukocyte infiltration into the retina. A critical early step in this process is the activation of retinal vascular endothelial cells (ECs), which up-regulate adhesion molecules that mediate T cell adhesion and subsequent extravasation. Here, we identify the small terpenoid compound costunolide (COS) as a potent suppressor of retinal endothelial inflammation and disease progression in experimental autoimmune uveitis (EAU). Quantitative proteomics of primary human retinal endothelial cells stimulated with TNF-α defined a proinflammatory endothelial signature and revealed induction of adhesion molecules. Screening of a focused library of 337 terpenoids uncovered COS as a top hit that markedly attenuated TNF-α-induced endothelial activation. In vivo, COS treatment significantly reduced clinical and histopathologic EAU scores, accompanied with reduced endothelial adhesion molecule expression and decreased T cell infiltration. Mechanistically, COS directly targeted deubiquitinase USP15, inhibiting USP15-dependent deubiquitination of TRAF1 and TNF signaling in retinal ECs. These findings establish COS as a candidate therapeutic agent for autoimmune uveitis and reveal a TNF-α–USP15–TRAF1 axis in retinal endothelium that can be pharmacologically exploited to limit pathogenic leukocyte trafficking.
title_zh: Costunolide 通过靶向 USP15 抑制 TNF-α 诱导的视网膜内皮炎症来改善自身免疫性葡萄膜炎
abstract_zh: 自身免疫性葡萄膜炎是一种威胁视力的炎症性疾病，大多数实体是由白细胞浸润到视网膜驱动的。该过程中关键的早期步骤是视网膜血管内皮细胞 (EC) 的激活，其上调介导 T 细胞粘附和随后外渗的粘附分子。在这里，我们确定小萜化合物木香烯内酯（COS）是实验性自身免疫性葡萄膜炎（EAU）中视网膜内皮炎症和疾病进展的有效抑制剂。用 TNF-α 刺激的原代人视网膜内皮细胞的定量蛋白质组学定义了促炎内皮特征，并揭示了粘附分子的诱导。对 337 种萜类化合物的重点库的筛选发现 COS 是显着减弱 TNF-α 诱导的内皮激活的热门药物。在体内，COS治疗显着降低了临床和组织病理学EAU评分，同时减少了内皮粘附分子表达和减少了T细胞浸润。从机制上讲，COS 直接靶向去泛素酶 USP15，抑制视网膜 EC 中 TRAF1 和 TNF 信号转导的 USP15 依赖性去泛素化。这些发现确立了 COS 作为自身免疫性葡萄膜炎的候选治疗剂，并揭示了视网膜内皮细胞中的 TNF-α-USP15-TRAF1 轴，可在药理学上利用该轴来限制致病性白细胞运输。

title: A ligandable PNT domain establishes ERG as a directly targetable oncogenic driver in prostate cancer
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The
                    TMPRSS2:ERG
                    gene fusion, present in approximately 50% of prostate cancers in patients of European ancestry, drives oncogenesis through aberrant overexpression of the ERG transcription factor. Despite its role as a truncal oncogenic driver, ERG has been considered undruggable due to the absence of enzymatic activity and apparent lack of ligandable pockets. Here, we demonstrate continued dependency on ERG in metastatic prostate cancer and identify a druggable pocket within its N-terminal Pointed (PNT) domain. Using an inducible shRNA system in
                    TMPRSS2:ERG
                    -positive VCaP cells, we show that ERG depletion causes profound growth inhibition. To therapeutically exploit this vulnerability, we conducted a domain-focused differential scanning fluorimetry screen targeting the ERG PNT domain, followed by structure–activity relationship optimization. This approach yielded PBITE-1 (PNT-Binding Inhibitor of the Transcription factor ERG), a small molecule that selectively binds the ERG PNT domain. NMR chemical-shift perturbation mapping and molecular docking revealed that PBITE-1 engages a discrete, solvent-exposed surface comprising two α-helices and an adjacent flexible loop, defining a ligand-binding pocket within the PNT domain. In cellular models, PBITE-1 directly engaged ERG, selectively inhibited proliferation and invasion, and induced apoptosis in ERG-driven prostate and hematologic malignancies. PBITE-1 potently suppressed growth of ERG-positive mouse and human-derived prostate cancer organoids. Furthermore, PBITE-1 treatment significantly induced tumor cell apoptosis in VCaP xenograft models. These findings establish the ERG PNT domain as ligandable and provide preclinical evidence that ERG is directly targetable by small molecules, enabling future development of ERG-directed inhibitors and targeted protein degraders.
title_zh: 可配位的 PNT 结构域将 ERG 确立为前列腺癌的直接靶向致癌驱动因素
abstract_zh:

title: Sex- and experience-dependent regulation of synaptic protein turnover
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Synaptic transmission can be tuned through plasticity mechanisms that regulate synaptic strength, structure, and number. In vivo measurements demonstrate remarkable spine dynamics, with subsets of synapses persisting for months. This correlates with the longevity of certain memories, which can persist for an organism’s lifetime. The molecular basis supporting the long-term stability of specific synapses and the long-term durability of memories remains unknown. At the protein level, most proteins persist for a relatively short amount of time before they are degraded and replaced with new molecules. However, recent work has identified a population of proteins, including those present at the synapse, that are exceptionally long-lived. It has been speculated that long-lived proteins (LLPs) could contribute to long-term synapse stability, function, and memory. Here, we used stable isotope labeling in mammals to first identify LLPs in the post synaptic density (PSD) of the hippocampus and subsequently determine if protein turnover rates varied by sex or following learning. We identified synaptic LLPs and found that both sex and experience can regulate synaptic protein turnover rates. We identified sex-dependent changes in protein turnover rates in autism spectrum disorder risk genes, including increased stability of Gabrg2, a GABA-A receptor subunit, in male mice. Furthermore, we observed stabilization of a subset of PSD proteins, such as Shank3, following contextual fear conditioning. We propose that sex- and experience-dependent changes in protein turnover rates could help explain sex-differences in psychiatric risk and aid our understanding of the molecular mechanisms that support learning and memory.

title: Intracellular structural modifications of natural peptidoglycan fragments preceding NOD2 signaling in mammalian cells
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
Bacterial peptidoglycan fragments (PGNs) are pathogen-associated molecular patterns that activate the mammalian innate immune system, particularly through NOD2 signaling pathways. Since NOD2 is a cytosolic sensor in mammalian cells, cellular assays are commonly used to identify bioactive PGNs that elicit NOD2 response, with muramyl dipeptide (MDP) long recognized as the minimal NOD2 agonist. However, recent studies have highlighted the intracellular phosphorylation of MDP by mammalian
                    N
                    -acetylglucosamine kinase (NAGK) as a critical prerequisite for NOD2 activation, emphasizing the need for further investigation into other host-mediated processing of PGNs. In this study, we examined how various bacterial PGNs, differing in saccharide and stem peptide length, undergo intracellular structural modifications within mammalian cells. Our findings show that disaccharide PGNs are processed through intracellular glycosidic cleavage to generate monosaccharide MurNAc-containing PGNs intracellularly, followed by NAGK-dependent phosphorylation, uncovering an additional essential step that precedes NOD2 activation. To identify the glycosidase responsible for disaccharide PGN cleavage, we provide biochemical and cellular observations that human
                    O
                    -GlcNAcase functions as a promiscuous glycosidase capable of processing certain disaccharide PGNs and potentially modulate their NOD2 activation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that PGNs with a lysine-type tripeptide stem are specifically cleaved into dipeptides and that phosphorylated PGNs are subjected to dephosphorylation in mammalian cells. Together, these findings offer insights into the metabolism and intracellular processing of PGNs in mammalian cells, which are crucial in shaping the host innate immune responses.

title: Dendritic morphology and synaptic nonlinearities enhance functional complexity in human cortical neurons
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Humans exhibit unique cognitive abilities within the animal kingdom, but the neural mechanisms driving these advanced capabilities remain poorly understood. Human cortical neurons differ from those of other species, such as rodents, in both their morphological and physiological characteristics. Could the distinct properties of human cortical neurons help explain the superior cognitive capabilities of humans? Understanding this relationship requires a measure to quantify how neuronal properties contribute to the functional complexity of single neurons; yet, such a standardized measure is currently missing. Here, we propose the Functional Complexity Index (FCI), a general, deep-learning-based framework for assessing the input–output complexity of neurons. By comparing the FCI of cortical pyramidal neurons across layers in rats and humans, we identified key morpho-electrical factors that underlie neuronal functional complexity. Human cortical pyramidal neurons are significantly more functionally complex than their rat counterparts, primarily due to differences in dendritic membrane area and branching patterns, as well as in the density and nonlinearity of NMDA-mediated synaptic receptors. These findings reveal the structural and biophysical basis for the enhanced functional properties of human cortical neurons, providing a key step toward understanding the underpinnings of our enhanced cognitive capabilities.

abstract:

title: Arabidopsis BSL phosphatases regulate zygote polarity through a brassinosteroid-independent essential function in MAP kinase signaling
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract:
The main axis of the plant body is established in early embryogenesis. Polar growth and asymmetric division of the
                    Arabidopsis
                    zygote require the Mitogen-Activated Protein (MAP) kinase kinase kinase YODA and the MAP kinases MPK3/MPK6, but regulation of this signaling cascade is not well understood. Here, we show that three BSU1-LIKE phosphatases (BSL1-3) are essential positive regulators: A combined loss causes closely similar defects to loss of the
                    YODA
                    MAP kinase cascade, resulting in nonpolar embryos; transcriptional profiling and cell-fate markers confirm that BSL phosphatases and the MAP kinase cascade regulate the same process. Unexpectedly, the founding member of the family, BSU1, appears dispensable. These results cast doubt on the view of BSU1-family phosphatases as core components of brassinosteroid hormone signaling. MPK3 activity shows striking sensitivity to
                    BSL
                    dosage, and genetic interactions with activated MPK3 suggest that BSL phosphatases function downstream of YODA and either in conjunction with or downstream of MPK3/MPK6, implying a novel mechanism of MPK regulation.

title: Probing anharmonic and heterogeneous carrier dynamics across sublattice melting in a minimal model superionic conductor
source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
abstract: Despite decades of research, the microscopic origin of sublattice melting and fast ion transport in superionic conductors remains elusive. Here, we introduce a chemically neutral minimal binary model consisting of a rigid host lattice stabilized by short-range steric repulsion and a soft carrier sublattice interacting via long-range Wigner-type forces. This contrast naturally produces distinct melting temperatures and an intermediate sublattice-melting phase in which carriers become fluidlike while the host remains crystalline. Molecular dynamics simulations identify multiple dynamical regimes–crystalline, sublattice-melt, and fully molten–marked by sharp changes in diffusivity, structural correlations, and dynamical heterogeneity. Near sublattice melting, carrier motion is strongly anharmonic and spatially heterogeneous, beyond mean-field hopping descriptions. By tuning the density, we demonstrate that sublattice melting can be continuously controlled, establishing a direct link between lattice softness, anharmonicity, and collective ion transport. Comparison with conventional long-range Coulombic models confirms that our minimal model reproduces the key dynamical signatures of superionicity, providing a unified microscopic foundation for designing mechanically robust superionic conductors.

Procrastination has a maladaptive impact on health and survival, yet it remains moderately heritable, presenting a biological paradox.
