title: Molecular Mechanism of the Catalytic Radical Termination in Fatty Acid Photodecarboxylase
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Fatty acid photodecarboxylase (FAP) is a photoenzyme that converts fatty acids into hydrocarbons through light-driven radical chemistry. Although the early photochemical steps have been elucidated, the molecular mechanism governing the catalytic termination remains unresolved. Here, we address this issue through a multiscale computational investigation based on explicit dynamic simulations of the reactive processes through a combination of classical and polarizable QM/MM strategies. Our results indicate that, following rapid decarboxylation, the resulting alkyl radical is predominantly quenched via a proton-coupled electron transfer mechanism mediated by the protonated arginine R451 and nearby water molecules. In contrast, water-assisted bicarbonate formation is found to be a rare event at room temperature, consistent with recent experimental observations. Furthermore, calculated absorption spectra demonstrate that distinct active-site configurations, either involving a neutral R451/water network or the presence of bicarbonate, can both account for the transient red-shifted flavin species FADRS observed experimentally. Overall, these findings provide a coherent and unified molecular picture of the catalytic termination in FAP and emphasize the key roles played by active-site heterogeneity and water dynamics in controlling photoenzymatic reactivity.
title_zh: 脂肪酸光脱羧酶催化自由基终止的分子机制
abstract_zh: 脂肪酸光脱羧酶（FAP）是一种光酶，可通过光驱动的自由基化学将脂肪酸转化为碳氢化合物。尽管早期的光化学步骤已被阐明，但控制催化终止的分子机制仍未解决。在这里，我们通过结合经典和极化 QM/MM 策略，通过基于反应过程的显式动态模拟的多尺度计算研究来解决这个问题。我们的结果表明，快速脱羧后，产生的烷基主要通过质子化精氨酸 R451 和附近水分子介导的质子耦合电子转移机制被猝灭。相比之下，在室温下水辅助碳酸氢盐的形成是罕见的，这与最近的实验观察结果一致。此外，计算的吸收光谱表明，不同的活性位点配置，无论是涉及中性 R451/水网络还是碳酸氢盐的存在，都可以解释实验中观察到的瞬时红移黄素物质 FADRS。总体而言，这些发现提供了 FAP 催化终止的连贯且统一的分子图景，并强调了活性位点异质性和水动力学在控制光酶反应活性中发挥的关键作用。

source: Matter
abstract: Traditional radiative cooling faces low cooling limits and environmental restrictions. It summarizes related material designs and diverse applications, and discusses key challenges, offering guidelines for advanced passive cooling toward energy sustainability. This work provides a comprehensive roadmap to advance next-generation passive cooling research and real-world implementation.

abstract_zh: 传统的辐射冷却面临低冷却限制和环境限制。本综述介绍了蒸发辅助辐射冷却，揭示了其协同热力学打破辐射冷却的功率上限。它总结了相关材料设计和各种应用，并讨论了关键挑战，为先进的被动冷却实现能源可持续性提供了指导方针。这项工作为推进下一代被动冷却研究和实际实施提供了全面的路线图。

title: Selective Bidentate Coordination Reconstructs Residual PbI 2 to Homogenize Interfacial Energetics in Perovskite Solar Cells
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Spatially heterogeneous interfacial energetics, often originating from residual lead iodide (PbI2), represent a fundamental bottleneck to both the efficiency and operational stability of perovskite photovoltaics. Conventional PbI2 passivation strategies based on monodentate ligands or highly polar solvents either interact weakly with PbI2 or undesirably perturb the underlying three-dimensional perovskite lattice. Here, we report a diammonium bidentate strategy that selectively reconstructs residual PbI2 into corner-sharing PbI6 octahedra while preserving the bulk perovskite. Enabled by dual-site coordination, a newly designed thiophene-based bidentate ligand (MeXT) stabilizes PbI6 units during passivation and establishes spatially homogeneous interfacial energetics. Perovskite solar cells incorporating MeXT achieve 26.19% power conversion efficiency and retain over 80% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous 1-sun illumination at 75 °C. This dual-anchor coordination passivation strategy establishes a general design principle for selectively treating residual PbI2 and creating electronically coherent and operationally stable interfaces in perovskite photovoltaics.
title_zh: 选择性双齿配位重构残余 PbI 2 以均匀化钙钛矿太阳能电池中的界面能量
abstract_zh: 空间异质界面能量通常源自残留的碘化铅（PbI2），是钙钛矿光伏电池效率和运行稳定性的根本瓶颈。基于单齿配体或高极性溶剂的传统 PbI2 钝化策略要么与 PbI2 相互作用较弱，要么干扰底层的三维钙钛矿晶格。在这里，我们报告了一种二齿二铵策略，可以选择性地将残留的 PbI2 重建为共享角的 PbI6 八面体，同时保留大块钙钛矿。通过双位点配位，新设计的基于噻吩的二齿配体 (MeXT) 可在钝化过程中稳定 PbI6 单元，并建立空间均匀的界面能量学。采用 MeXT 的钙钛矿太阳能电池实现了 26.19% 的功率转换效率，并在 75 °C 下连续 1 太阳光照 1000 小时后仍保持其初始效率的 80% 以上。这种双锚配位钝化策略建立了选择性处理残留 PbI2 并在钙钛矿光伏电池中创建电子相干且运行稳定的界面的一般设计原则。

title: On-Demand Viscosity Gradients Turn Nanoliter Droplets into Programmable Sources of Enriched Picoliter Droplets
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Droplet microfluidics has revolutionized diagnostics, chemical synthesis, and biotechnology. While droplet merging and mixing are routine operations, the opposite processes─coupled enrichment and pinch-off of reagents, analytes, or products─is nontrivial. If accessed, these operations are highly valuable, enabling improved reaction kinetics, increased assay sensitivity, and purification. In this work, we present coupled enrichment and on-demand emission of picoliter-scale daughter droplets from nanoliter-scale parents. The reported approach leverages electrokinetically driven viscosity gradients within droplets to modulate droplet dynamics. Specifically, localized enrichment of a charged viscosity modifier (the polyelectrolyte, alginate) and a charged target species (here, an anionic fluorescent tracer) is accomplished by in-droplet ion concentration polarization (ICP). The results presented here demonstrate that emission is favored by a steep viscosity gradient and that the volume of daughter droplets is programmable. These findings potentiate unprecedented control over droplet-mediated chemistry and bioassays via a tunable process reminiscent of vesicle packaging and pinch-off in biological cells.
title_zh: 按需粘度梯度将纳升液滴转变为浓缩皮升液滴的可编程来源
abstract_zh: 液滴微流控彻底改变了诊断、化学合成和生物技术。虽然液滴合并和混合是常规操作，但相反的过程（试剂、分析物或产品的富集和夹断）却很重要。如果能够实现，这些操作非常有价值，可以改善反应动力学、提高测定灵敏度和纯化。在这项工作中，我们提出了来自纳升规模亲代的皮升规模子代液滴的耦合富集和按需发射。所报道的方法利用液滴内电动驱动的粘度梯度来调节液滴动力学。具体来说，带电粘度调节剂（聚电解质、藻酸盐）和带电目标物质（此处为阴离子荧光示踪剂）的局部富集是通过液滴内离子浓差极化（ICP）来实现的。这里给出的结果表明，陡峭的粘度梯度有利于发射，并且子液滴的体积是可编程的。这些发现通过可调节的过程（类似于生物细胞中的囊泡包装和夹断）增强了对液滴介导的化学和生物测定的前所未有的控制。

title: Cobalt-Catalyzed Cyclohydrocarbonylations: Syntheses of Saturated Heterocycles Promoted by Light
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A general strategy for the syntheses of valuable saturated heterocycles via regio- and stereoselective cyclohydrocarbonylation is reported. This annulation uses a simple cobalt catalyst and visible light under mild conditions and enables broad access to δ-lactams or piperidines from diverse alkylamine substrates. Cyclohydrocarbonylations accessing lactones are also demonstrated. Increasing catalyst loading enables cyclohydrocarbonylations under an argon atmosphere, using the cobalt carbonyl as both a precatalyst and in situ CO source. The cyclohydrocarbonylations display a surprising dependence on the identity of the cobalt precatalyst, with different reaction outcomes observed using either cobalt carbonyl or KCo(CO)4. Initial mechanistic and computational studies indicate multiple operative pathways dependent on the catalytic conditions.
title_zh: 钴催化的环烃羰基化：光促进的饱和杂环的合成
abstract_zh: 报道了通过区域和立体选择性环烃基化合成有价值的饱和杂环的一般策略。这种成环反应使用简单的钴催化剂和可见光，在温和的条件下，可以从不同的烷基胺底物中广泛获得δ-内酰胺或哌啶。还证明了获得内酯的环烃基化。增加催化剂负载量可以在氩气氛下实现环烃羰基化，使用羰基钴作为预催化剂和原位 CO 源。环烃基化显示出对钴预催化剂特性的惊人依赖性，使用羰基钴或 KCo(CO)4 观察到不同的反应结果。初步的机械和计算研究表明多种操作途径取决于催化条件。

title: Nitrogen-Tuned Cationic Au Sites on TiO 2 Enable Selective Methane Oxidation to Methanol
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Selective oxidation of methane to methanol under mild conditions remains a long-standing challenge because of the high inertness of the C-H bond in methane and the susceptibility of methanol to overoxidation. Here, we report a nitrogen-incorporation strategy for constructing TiO2-supported Au catalysts with cationic Au sites for selective methane oxidation using O2 as the oxidant in aqueous CH4/O2/CO media. The optimized Au/N-TiO2 catalyst delivers a methanol productivity of 3956 μmol gcat-1 h-1, corresponding to 177 mol molAu-1 h-1, with 98% selectivity at 180 °C, demonstrating superior catalytic performance to most reported systems under comparable conditions. Spectroscopic and structural analyses reveal that nitrogen incorporation modulates the electronic state of Au and, in combination with an appropriate Au particle size, establishes a favorable size-charge match for constructing highly efficient interfacial active sites. Isotope-labeling experiments, in situ DRIFTS, kinetic analysis, and density functional theory calculations show that the reaction proceeds through a CO-assisted, surface-mediated O2 activation pathway involving surface methoxy species as key intermediates.
title_zh: TiO 2 上的氮调节阳离子金位点能够选择性地将甲烷氧化为甲醇
abstract_zh: 由于甲烷中C-H键的高惰性以及甲醇对过度氧化的敏感性，在温和条件下将甲烷选择性氧化为甲醇仍然是一个长期存在的挑战。在此，我们报告了一种氮掺入策略，用于构建具有阳离子 Au 位点的 TiO2 负载的 Au 催化剂，用于在水性 CH4/O2/CO 介质中使用 O2 作为氧化剂进行选择性甲烷氧化。优化的 Au/N-TiO2 催化剂的甲醇生产率为 3956 μmol gcat-1 h-1，相当于 177 mol molAu-1 h-1，在 180 °C 下选择性为 98%，在可比条件下表现出比大多数报道的系统更优异的催化性能。光谱和结构分析表明，氮的掺入调节了 Au 的电子态，并与适当的 Au 粒径相结合，为构建高效的界面活性位点建立了有利的尺寸-电荷匹配。同位素标记实验、原位漂移、动力学分析和密度泛函理论计算表明，该反应通过 CO 辅助、表面介导的 O2 活化途径进行，涉及表面甲氧基物质作为关键中间体。

title: Cryo-EM structures of naturally occurring dimeric photosystem II complexes lacking the Mn4CaO5 cluster
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Robust oxygenic photosynthesis requires the efficient assembly and repair of the multi-subunit oxygen-evolving photosystem II (PSII) complex. Previous cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of PSII assembly/disassembly intermediates have relied on the analysis of deletion mutants or removal of PSII subunits in vitro. Here we report the cryo-EM structures of naturally occurring dimeric PSII intermediates from the cyanobacterium Thermosynechococcus vestitus at a resolution of about 2.2 Å. These intermediates contain inactive dimers lacking the oxygen-evolving complex (OEC) and semi-active dimers with the OEC present in one of the two monomers. Our structural data provide a mechanism for how assembly and disassembly of the Mn4CaO5 cluster is coordinated with the binding and release of the extrinsic proteins: restructuring of the C-terminal tail of D1 subunit during assembly or disassembly of the Mn cluster triggers conformational changes in D2, CP47 and CP43 to drive the binding/release of the extrinsic proteins. A combination of structural and mass spectrometry data also suggests that the inactive PSII complexes may include damaged complexes containing oxidized D1-His332, a monodentate ligand to one of the Mn ions of the OEC.
title_zh: 缺乏 Mn4CaO5 簇的天然二聚光系统 II 复合物的冷冻电镜结构
abstract_zh: 强大的产氧光合作用需要多亚基释氧光系统 II (PSII) 复合物的有效组装和修复。先前的 PSII 组装/拆卸中间体的低温电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构依赖于体外删除突变体或 PSII 亚基的分析。在这里，我们报告了来自蓝细菌Thermosynechoccas pestitus 的天然存在的二聚 PSII 中间体的冷冻电镜结构，分辨率约为 2.2 Å。这些中间体含有缺乏释氧复合物 (OEC) 的非活性二聚体和 OEC 存在于两个单体之一的半活性二聚体。我们的结构数据提供了一种机制，说明 Mn4CaO5 簇的组装和分解如何与外在蛋白的结合和释放相协调：在 Mn 簇的组装或分解过程中，D1 亚基 C 末端尾部的重组触发 D2、CP47 和 CP43 的构象变化，从而驱动外在蛋白的结合/释放。结构和质谱数据的结合还表明，失活的 PSII 复合物可能包括含有氧化 D1-His332 的受损复合物，D1-His332 是 OEC Mn 离子之一的单齿配体。

title: Dynamic interactions between epithelial skin cells and a sensory cavity sculpt the growing olfactory orifice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: During morphogenesis and in pathological conditions, gaps can form in the plane of epithelial barriers upon cellular forces that disrupt intercellular junctions. How the size of these epithelial holes further increases over time and what sets their shape remain poorly understood. Here we analyze the formation of the olfactory orifice (the nostril) in zebrafish, which opens and grows in the skin epithelium above a rosette of olfactory placode cells, allowing the sensory neurons to directly access odor cues. Using quantitative imaging and tissue-specific perturbations, we analyze the dynamic remodeling of skin cells allowing the expansion of the orifice edge. We identify the sensory cavity located in the center of the placodal rosette as a crucial player that sets the size of the growing epithelial hole in the skin. We further show that fine-tuning of actomyosin contractility within each tissue (skin and sensory cavity) exerts non-autonomous effects on the neighboring tissue, thereby shaping the nostril structure. This study uncovers dynamic cell behaviors and reciprocal tissue-tissue interplay that control the growth and shape of an epithelial hole in vivo.
title_zh: 上皮皮肤细胞和感觉腔之间的动态相互作用塑造了不断增长的嗅孔
abstract_zh: 在形态发生和病理条件下，在破坏细胞间连接的细胞力的作用下，上皮屏障平面上会形成间隙。这些上皮孔的尺寸如何随着时间的推移而进一步增加以及它们的形状是如何形成的，人们仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们分析了斑马鱼嗅孔（鼻孔）的形成，它在嗅基板细胞花环上方的皮肤上皮细胞中打开并生长，使感觉神经元能够直接获取气味线索。使用定量成像和组织特异性扰动，我们分析了允许孔口边缘扩张的皮肤细胞的动态重塑。我们认为位于基底莲座中心的感觉腔是决定皮肤上皮上皮孔洞大小的关键因素。我们进一步表明，每个组织（皮肤和感觉腔）内肌动球蛋白收缩力的微调会对邻近组织产生非自主效应，从而塑造鼻孔结构。这项研究揭示了控制体内上皮孔生长和形状的动态细胞行为和相互的组织-组织相互作用。

title: Pulmonary mRNA-LNP vaccines for rapid and durable protection against bacterial infection
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Pulmonary bacterial infections remain a major clinical challenge. Although vaccination reduces infection rates and mortality, the vulnerable post-vaccination immunity gap can still result in infection and vaccine failure. In addition, effective vaccines are unavailable for many clinically important bacterial pathogens. Here, we report a pulmonary mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccine incorporating an ionizable lipid engineered for localized high-level expression, which elicits both rapid and durable protection against bacterial lung infections in female mice, effectively bridging this critical window of vulnerability. Intratracheal delivery of mRNA-LNP rapidly primes lung neutrophils and macrophages into a transcriptionally pre-activated state, enhancing their phagocytic activity and enabling rapid, antigen-independent bacterial clearance during the early post-vaccination period (approximately 1-7 days). Subsequently, vaccination induces potent antigen-specific adaptive responses, conferring sustained protection against both laboratory and clinical drug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa strains. Single-cell transcriptomics and immune profiling reveal coordinated activation of innate and adaptive immune programs. This dual-phase immune response exemplifies a paradigm-shifting vaccine design that integrates innate and adaptive immunity to confer both immediate and long-term protection. Our findings establish a mechanistic basis for rapid antibacterial defense and highlight pulmonary mRNA-LNP vaccination as a promising strategy for combating respiratory infections.
title_zh: 肺部 mRNA-LNP 疫苗可快速、持久地预防细菌感染
abstract_zh: 肺部细菌感染仍然是一个主要的临床挑战。尽管疫苗接种可降低感染率和死亡率，但疫苗接种后脆弱的免疫缺口仍可能导致感染和疫苗失败。此外，对于许多临床上重要的细菌病原体还没有有效的疫苗。在这里，我们报告了一种肺部 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒 (mRNA-LNP) 疫苗，其中含有一种可电离脂质，可实现局部高水平表达，可对雌性小鼠产生快速而持久的细菌性肺部感染保护，有效地弥合了这一关键的脆弱窗口。气管内递送 mRNA-LNP 迅速使肺中性粒细胞和巨噬细胞进入转录预激活状态，增强其吞噬活性，并在疫苗接种后早期（大约 1-7 天）实现快速、不依赖于抗原的细菌清除。随后，疫苗接种可诱导有效的抗原特异性适应性反应，从而针对实验室和临床耐药铜绿假单胞菌菌株提供持续的保护。单细胞转录组学和免疫分析揭示了先天性和适应性免疫程序的协调激活。这种双阶段免疫反应体现了一种范式转变的疫苗设计，它整合了先天免疫和适应性免疫，以提供即时和长期保护。我们的研究结果为快速抗菌防御奠定了机制基础，并强调肺部 mRNA-LNP 疫苗接种是对抗呼吸道感染的一种有前途的策略。

title: A single-cell atlas of porcine hematopoietic development
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Domestic pigs are both a globally important agricultural species and an increasingly valuable biomedical model that bridges the gap between rodents and non-human primates. Thus, a thorough understanding of the developing porcine immune system is important to improve pig health and advance preclinical research. Here, we coupled single-cell transcriptomic analyses with T and B cell receptor profiling to create a comprehensive cell atlas of pig hematopoietic development across fetal liver, bone marrow, and thymus tissues from fetal to adult life. We highlight tissue-specific and age-related features; identify gene modules underlying B cell and T cell development; describe the maturation and diversification of B and T cell receptor repertoires in bone marrow B cells and thymic αβ and γδ T cells; and distinguish transcriptionally distinct subsets of γδ T cells according to their γ chain usage. Our data provide key insights into pig immune system development and contribute a valuable resource for advancing pigs as a model of human blood and immune diseases.
title_zh: 猪造血发育的单细胞图谱
abstract_zh: 家猪既是全球重要的农业物种，也是弥合啮齿动物和非人类灵长类动物之间差距的日益有价值的生物医学模型。因此，全面了解正在发育的猪免疫系统对于改善猪的健康和推进临床前研究非常重要。在这里，我们将单细胞转录组分析与 T 细胞和 B 细胞受体分析相结合，创建了从胎儿到成年的猪肝、骨髓和胸腺组织造血发育的综合细胞图谱。我们强调组织特异性和年龄相关的特征；识别 B 细胞和 T 细胞发育的基因模块；描述骨髓 B 细胞和胸腺 αβ 和 γδ T 细胞中 B 和 T 细胞受体库的成熟和多样化；并根据 γ 链的使用区分转录上不同的 γδ T 细胞亚群。我们的数据提供了有关猪免疫系统发育的重要见解，并为将猪作为人类血液和免疫疾病的模型发展提供了宝贵的资源。

title: Alternatively spliced killer–protector system confers S19-mediated hybrid male sterility in rice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hybrid sterility limits the use of strong interspecific heterosis and S19 is a major locus that confers hybrid sterility between Oryza sativa (Asian cultivated rice) and Oryza glaberrima (African cultivated rice). However, the S19 is not yet cloned and its underlying mechanism remains elusive. In this study, we identify two closely linked genes (S19A1 and S19A7) specific to African rice allele that encode a killer–protector module at the S19 locus. Two alternatively spliced transcripts expressed from the killer gene S19A1 (S19A1.1 and S19A1.2) encode mitochondria-targeted cytotoxic proteins that cause toxicity diversity for somatic and/or gametic cell death, respectively. However, S19A7 interacts with S19A1.1 and S19A1.2, blocking their cytotoxic effect. Because the Asian rice S19 allele lacks S19A1 and S19A7, male gametes that carry this allele are selectively aborted in Asian–African F1 hybrids. Knockout of S19A1 can overcome S19-mediated hybrid sterility. Haplotype analysis reveals that the functional S19 allele is absent in non-AA-genome Oryza species and likely emerged in the O. barthii–O. glaberrima lineage through a multi-step evolutionary process. Our findings provide insight into the genetic mechanisms responsible for hybrid sterility between Asian and African rice and suggest genetic and biotechnological strategies for the use of interspecific heterosis in rice.
title_zh: 选择性剪接的杀手-保护系统赋予水稻S19介导的杂交雄性不育性
abstract_zh: 杂交不育性限制了强种间杂种优势的使用，S19 是赋予 Oryza sativa（亚洲栽培稻）和 Oryza glaberrima（非洲栽培稻）之间杂交不育性的主要基因座。然而，S19 尚未被克隆，其基本机制仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了非洲水稻等位基因特有的两个紧密连锁的基因（S19A1 和 S19A7），它们在 S19 位点编码杀手-保护模块。杀伤基因 S19A1 表达的两个选择性剪​​接转录物（S19A1.1 和 S19A1.2）编码线粒体靶向的细胞毒性蛋白，分别导致体细胞和/或配子细胞死亡的毒性多样性。然而，S19A7 与 S19A1.1 和 S19A1.2 相互作用，阻断它们的细胞毒性作用。由于亚洲水稻 S19 等位基因缺乏 S19A1 和 S19A7，因此携带该等位基因的雄配子在亚洲-非洲 F1 杂种中选择性败育。 S19A1 的敲除可以克服 S19 介导的杂种不育。单倍型分析表明，功能性 S19 等位基因在非 AA 基因组稻物种中不存在，并且可能出现在 O. barthii-O 中。 glaberrima 谱系经历了多步进化过程。我们的研究结果深入了解了亚洲和非洲水稻杂交不育的遗传机制，并提出了利用水稻种间杂种优势的遗传和生物技术策略。

title: Tailoring Hydrogen Bonding in Organic Frameworks for Rapid Atmospheric Water Harvesting with Low-Temperature Regeneration
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Atmospheric water harvesting (AWH) offers a promising route to address water scarcity by decentralizing freshwater production. Developing materials capable of performing rapid sorption-desorption cycles with reduced energy consumption is crucial for achieving high water productivity. We report amino-functionalized hydrogen-bonded organic frameworks (HOFs), HOF-101-NH2, that enable efficient moisture capture through hydrogen-bond-engineered adsorption. Strategic -NH2 integration creates abundant water nucleation sites and promotes cooperative hydrogen-bond networks, achieving a water uptake of ∼0.46 g g-1 at 60% RH. Captured water can be released at ∼50 °C within 3 min, enabling low-energy regeneration. This fast sorption-desorption kinetics allows more than 30 cycles per day with a water yield of ∼15 L kg-1 day-1. Beyond demonstrating HOFs as effective AWH sorbents, this hydrogen-bond engineering strategy opens opportunities for rational design of next-generation water harvesting materials operating under diverse climatic conditions.
title_zh: 定制有机框架中的氢键，用于低温再生快速大气水收集
abstract_zh: 大气水收集（AWH）提供了一条通过分散淡水生产来解决水资源短缺问题的有前途的途径。开发能够执行快速吸附-解吸循环并降低能耗的材料对于实现高水生产率至关重要。我们报告了氨基功能化的氢键有机框架（HOF）HOF-101-NH2，它可以通过氢键设计的吸附来有效捕获水分。战略性的-NH2整合创造了丰富的水成核位点并促进了合作氢键网络，在60% RH下实现了~0.46 g g-1的吸水量。捕获的水可以在 50 °C 的温度下在 3 分钟内释放，从而实现低能量再生。这种快速的吸附-解吸动力学允许每天超过 30 个循环，产水量为 ∼15 L kg-1 day-1。除了证明 HOF 作为有效的 AWH 吸附剂外，这种氢键工程策略还为合理设计在不同气候条件下运行的下一代集水材料提供了机会。

title: Twist-tuned exchange and hysteresis in a bilayer van der Waals magnet
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Moiré superlattices in twisted bilayers enable strong reconstruction of electronic band structures, giving rise to correlated phases with high tunability. Extending this concept to van der Waals magnets, we show that twisting induces spatially varying interlayer exchange interactions that can stabilize complex magnetic responses. Here, we demonstrate robust magnetic hysteresis in bilayer CrSBr upon a twist of ~ 3°, observed as a hysteretic evolution of exciton energies that directly track the underlying magnetic configuration in field-dependent photoluminescence measurements. An analytic two-sublattice model captures this behaviour, attributing it to a twist-induced reduction of interlayer exchange that stabilizes both parallel and antiparallel spin states over a broad field range. Spatially resolved measurements reveal local variations in hysteresis loops, consistent with position-dependent modulation of magnetic parameters. In certain regions, coherent averaging over the moiré unit cell yields an effective monodomain-like response. Our results establish twist engineering as a route to programmable magnetism in two-dimensional antiferromagnets.
title_zh: 双层范德华磁体中的扭转调谐交换和磁滞
abstract_zh: 扭曲双层中的莫尔超晶格能够强烈重建电子能带结构，从而产生具有高可调性的相关相位。将这一概念扩展到范德华磁体，我们发现扭曲会引起空间变化的层间交换相互作用，从而稳定复杂的磁响应。在这里，我们证明了双层 CrSBr 在扭转约 3° 时存在强大的磁滞，观察到激子能量的磁滞演化，直接跟踪场相关光致发光测量中的底层磁配置。解析双子晶格模型捕获了这种行为，将其归因于扭转引起的层间交换减少，从而在广泛的场范围内稳定了平行和反平行自旋状态。空间分辨测量揭示了磁滞回线的局部变化，与磁参数的位置相关调制一致。在某些区域，莫尔晶胞上的相干平均产生有效的类单域响应。我们的结果确立了扭转工程作为二维反铁磁体中可编程磁性的途径。

title: Embodied behavioural complexity in a ciliated microorganism
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Most animals coordinate behaviour using neural computations. Yet, single-celled organisms also exhibit stimulus-responsive, even cognitive, actions. To understand how a single cell can coordinate and drive complex behaviours without any neural encoding, we study an algal protist – a motile cell with four extremely long cilia. The organism displays a surprisingly rich locomotor repertoire, emerging from the intricate dynamics of the cilia, which form a tight bundle when swimming. We use high-speed quantitative live imaging to extract the spectrum of possible ciliary beating patterns and derive a dispersion relation coupling the temporal frequency and spatial wavelength of cilia oscillations. We further reconstruct the manifold embedded in the behavioural space, showing that despite the range and complexity of ciliary beating modes, the underlying behavioural manifold is intrinsically low-dimensional with non-trivial topological structure. Dynamic transitions in motility patterns are encoded as trajectories in this space, thus reducing the macroscopic behavioural states to the underlying microscopic dynamics of the cilia.
title_zh: 纤毛微生物的具体行为复杂性
abstract_zh: 大多数动物使用神经计算来协调行为。然而，单细胞生物也表现出刺激反应，甚至认知行为。为了了解单个细胞如何在没有任何神经编码的情况下协调和驱动复杂的行为，我们研究了一种藻类原生生物——一种具有四个极长纤毛的运动细胞。这种生物体表现出令人惊讶的丰富运动能力，这些运动能力源于纤毛复杂的动力学，在游泳时纤毛会形成紧密的束。我们使用高速定量实时成像来提取可能的纤毛跳动模式的光谱，并导出耦合纤毛振荡的时间频率和空间波长的色散关系。我们进一步重建了行为空间中嵌入的流形，表明尽管纤毛跳动模式的范围和复杂性，潜在的行为流形本质上是低维的，具有不平凡的拓扑结构。运动模式的动态转变被编码为该空间中的轨迹，从而将宏观行为状态还原为纤毛的潜在微观动力学。

title: Structural dynamics of RNA polymerase II throughout the nucleotide addition cycle
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: RNA polymerase II (RNAPII) drives gene expression through iterative nucleotide addition cycles (NACs) comprising translocation, substrate binding, and catalysis. The lack of pre-catalysis and post-catalysis intermediates has precluded a complete mechanistic understanding of the NAC. Here we present 31 Cryo-electron Microscopy structures (with 43 maps) capturing distinct stages of Saccharomyces cerevisiae RNAPII elongation complex (EC) NAC, including previously intractable transition intermediates. We establish a continuous spectrum of RNAPII EC structural dynamics during the NAC, which can be divided into two coordinated phases: a substrate-induced EC tightening phase and a post-catalysis EC relaxation phase. For the substrate-induced EC tightening phase, the substrate binding initiates allosteric conformational changes across the entire RNAPII EC, including Trigger Loop folding, funnel closure, clamp closure, transcription bubble ordering, and precise alignment of the RNA 3′-end with substrate to form a catalysis-competent configuration. For the post-catalysis EC relaxation phase, we capture the long-sought, short-lived post-catalysis product state and identify a series of intermediates that reveal a reverse conformational transition that facilitates rapid translocation. Together, our findings define a comprehensive structural and dynamic framework for RNAPII NAC, yielding a “molecular movie” of RNAPII in action and revealing a fundamental principle by which the enzyme balances speed and fidelity through coordinated conformational dynamics.
title_zh: RNA 聚合酶 II 在整个核苷酸添加循环中的结构动力学
abstract_zh: RNA 聚合酶 II (RNAPII) 通过包括易位、底物结合和催化的迭代核苷酸添加循环 (NAC) 驱动基因表达。由于缺乏催化前和催化后中间体，无法对 NAC 进行完整的机理理解。在这里，我们展示了 31 个冷冻电子显微镜结构（带有 43 个图谱），捕获了酿酒酵母 RNAPII 延伸复合物 (EC) NAC 的不同阶段，包括以前难以处理的过渡中间体。我们建立了 NAC 期间 RNAPII EC 结构动力学的连续谱，它可以分为两个协调阶段：底物诱导的 EC 紧缩阶段和催化后 EC 松弛阶段。对于底物诱导的 EC 紧缩阶段，底物结合引发整个 RNAPII EC 的变构构象变化，包括触发环折叠、漏斗闭合、夹闭合、转录气泡排序以及 RNA 3' 端与底物的精确对齐，以形成具有催化能力的构型。对于催化后 EC 弛豫阶段，我们捕获了长期寻找的、短寿命的催化后产物状态，并确定了一系列中间体，这些中间体揭示了促进快速易位的反向构象转变。总之，我们的研究结果定义了 RNAPII NAC 的全面结构和动态框架，产生了 RNAPII 作用的“分子电影”，并揭示了酶通过协调构象动力学平衡速度和保真度的基本原理。

title: Immobilization of Single Ni Sites and Separated Pd Clusters in Covalent Organic Framework for Enhanced Electrochemical Reduction of Nitrite to Ammonia
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The electrochemical reduction of nitrite (NO2-) to ammonia (NH3) offers a promising strategy for simultaneously purifying wastewater and producing value-added chemicals. The metal active site struggles to simultaneously optimize the adsorption strengths of NO2- and H*, resulting in a mismatch between the kinetics of intermediate activation and hydrogenation. In this work, we construct a composite catalyst of NiSS-COF/Pd ICs, which enhances the catalytic performance by precisely incorporating nickel single sites (NiSS) and Pd metal-isolated clusters (Pd ICs) into covalent organic frameworks. Thus, NiSS-COF/Pd ICs exhibit an NH3 production rate of 20.9 mg h-1 mgcat-1 and a high NH3 Faradaic efficiency of 95.5% at -1.0 V (vs RHE). With -1.3 V applied, NiSS-COF/Pd ICs yielded 35.3 mg h-1 mgcat-1 NH3, the turnover number reached 58421, and the turnover frequency was 3436.8 h-1 per Ni. The NiSS tunes electronic structures to boost NO2- adsorption, while Pd ICs generate H* via these H* migrate to Ni sites, facilitating rapid hydrogenation and synergistic catalysis. As a result, the NiSS-COF/Pd ICs catalyst enables efficient electrochemical conversion of NO2- to NH3, delivering high Faradaic efficiency and enhanced NH3 production. Overall, this work presents a novel design strategy for developing synergistic catalytic systems that integrate single sites with metal-isolated clusters.
title_zh: 将单个 Ni 位点和分离的 Pd 簇固定在共价有机框架中，以增强亚硝酸盐电化学还原为氨的能力
abstract_zh: 亚硝酸盐 (NO2-) 电化学还原为氨 (NH3) 为同时净化废水和生产增值化学品提供了一种有前途的策略。金属活性位点难以同时优化 NO2- 和 H* 的吸附强度，导致中间活化和氢化动力学之间不匹配。在这项工作中，我们构建了一种NiSS-COF/Pd ICs复合催化剂，通过将镍单中心（NiSS）和Pd金属隔离簇（Pd ICs）精确地结合到共价有机框架中来增强催化性能。因此，NiSS-COF/Pd IC 在 -1.0 V（相对于 RHE）下表现出 20.9 mg h-1 mgcat-1 的 NH3 生产率和 95.5% 的高 NH3 法拉第效率。在施加-1.3 V电压时，NiSS-COF/Pd IC产生35.3 mg h-1 mgcat-1 NH3，周转数达到58421，周转频率为3436.8 h-1/Ni。 NiSS 调整电子结构以促进 NO2 吸附，而 Pd IC 通过这些 H* 迁移到 Ni 位点产生 H*，从而促进快速氢化和协同催化。因此，NiSS-COF/Pd IC 催化剂能够实现 NO2- 到 NH3 的高效电化学转化，提供高法拉第效率并提高 NH3 产量。总的来说，这项工作提出了一种新颖的设计策略，用于开发将单位点与金属隔离簇集成的协同催化系统。

title: Bilayer TeO 2 : The First Predicted Oxide Semiconductor with Symmetric Sub-5-nm NMOS and PMOS
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Wide-band-gap oxide semiconductors are very promising channel candidates for next-generation electronics due to their large-area manufacturing, high-quality dielectrics, low contact resistance, and low leakage current. However, the absence of ultrashort-gate-length (Lg) p-type transistors has restricted their application in future complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) integration. Inspired by the successfully grown high-hole-mobility bilayer (BL) β-tellurium dioxide (β-TeO2), we investigate the performance of sub-5-nm Lg BL β-TeO2 field-effect transistors (FETs) by utilizing first-principles quantum transport simulation. The distinctive anisotropy of BL β-TeO2 yields different transport properties. In the y direction, both the sub-5-nm Lg n-type and p-type BL β-TeO2 FETs can fulfill the International Technology Roadmap for Semiconductors (ITRS) criteria for high-performance (HP) devices, which are superior to the reported oxide FETs (only n-type). Remarkably, we for the first time demonstrate the existence of the NMOS and PMOS symmetry in sub-5-nm Lg oxide semiconductor FETs. As to the x direction, the n-type BL β-TeO2 FETs satisfy both the ITRS HP and low-power (LP) requirements with Lg down to 3 nm. Consequently, our work sheds light on the tremendous prospects of BL β-TeO2 for CMOS applications.
title_zh: 双层 TeO 2：首个预计具有对称亚 5 纳米 NMOS 和 PMOS 的氧化物半导体
abstract_zh: 宽带隙氧化物半导体因其大面积制造、高质量电介质、低接触电阻和低漏电流而成为下一代电子器件非常有前途的通道候选者。然而，超短栅长（Lg）p型晶体管的缺乏限制了它们在未来互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）集成中的应用。受成功生长的高空穴迁移率双层 (BL) β-二氧化碲 (β-TeO2) 的启发，我们利用第一原理量子输运模拟研究了亚 5 nm Lg BL β-TeO2 场效应晶体管 (FET) 的性能。 BL β-TeO2 独特的各向异性产生不同的传输特性。在 y 方向上，亚 5 nm Lg n 型和 p 型 BL β-TeO2 FET 都可以满足高性能（HP）器件的国际半导体技术路线图（ITRS）标准，优于已报道的氧化物 FET（仅限 n 型）。值得注意的是，我们首次证明了亚 5 nm Lg 氧化物半导体 FET 中 NMOS 和 PMOS 对称性的存在。对于 x 方向，n 型 BL β-TeO2 FET 满足 ITRS HP 和低功耗 (LP) 要求，Lg 低至 3 nm。因此，我们的工作揭示了 BL β-TeO2 在 CMOS 应用中的巨大前景。

title: Tunable, High-Relaxivity Gd(III)-Conjugated Lipoic Acid Hydrogels for Magnetic Resonance Imaging
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: A lipoic acid(LA)-base hydrogel polymerization, viscosity, and relaxivity were explored by varying several different bases, additives, Gd3+ chelates, and with or without a reducing agent (tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, TCEP). The polymerization of LA was greatly improved by using TCEP to convert the more inert disulfides into thiol initiators. The base deprotonation of LA was found to be essential to solubilize LA for polymer propagation. The various bases and TCEP additions had a substantial effect on viscosity, with values ranging from 1 × 108 to 1 × 103 mPa·s. This can enable targeting of many different applications that depend on viscosity, such as topical ointments or injectable hydrogels. The relaxivity effects of the LA-hydrogels were explored by varying the Gd3+ chelates' inner-sphere coordination or by adding one or two sulfur atoms, thereby allowing for a terminal or internal-linking Gd3+ chelate. It was found that the inner sphere and microenvironment dominate the relaxivity of Gd3+ chelates in the LA-hydrogel, with a high relaxivity of r1 = 49.2 ± 1.2 mM-1 s-1 at 1.4 T and 37 °C. Cellular uptake was confirmed by confocal fluorescence microscopy, and contrast was assessed in vivo at 9.4 T.
title_zh: 用于磁共振成像的可调谐高弛豫 Gd(III) 共轭硫辛酸水凝胶
abstract_zh: 通过改变几种不同的碱、添加剂、Gd3+螯合物以及有或没有还原剂（三（2-羧乙基）膦，TCEP），探索了硫辛酸（LA）基水凝胶的聚合、粘度和弛豫率。通过使用TCEP将惰性较大的二硫化物转化为硫醇引发剂，LA的聚合反应得到了极大的改善。人们发现 LA 的碱基去质子化对于溶解 LA 以进行聚合物增长至关重要。各种碱和 TCEP 添加对粘度有显着影响，值范围为 1 × 108 至 1 × 103 mPa·s。这可以实现许多取决于粘度的不同应用的目标，例如外用软膏或可注射水凝胶。通过改变 Gd3+ 螯合物的内球配位或添加一个或两个硫原子，从而允许末端或内部连接的 Gd3+ 螯合物，探索了 LA-水凝胶的弛豫效应。结果发现，LA-水凝胶中Gd3+螯合物的弛豫率由内球和微环境决定，在1.4 T和37 °C下具有r1 = 49.2 ± 1.2 mM-1 s-1的高弛豫率。通过共焦荧光显微镜证实细胞摄取，并在 9.4 T 下评估体内对比度。

title: Squeezing Gas Diffusion Electrodes in Zero-Gap CO 2 Electrolyzers─Enough Is Enough
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Recent scientific advancements indicate that the electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide to carbon monoxide (CO2RR) is approaching industrial viability. Beyond scientific achievements, technology scale-up requires a full understanding of how certain cell components are to be used for long-term optimal performance and of what other challenges are posed by the larger sizes. Here, we investigated in detail how varying the compression ratio of the cathode gas diffusion electrode affects the electrochemical performance, using three fundamentally different carbon-based cathode supports. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and microtomography measurements are presented to explain the observed changes in the electrolysis performance, while the cathodes were gradually compressed to below 40% of their original thickness. The optimal compression range depends on the properties of the gas diffusion layer. Notably, a more than 100 μm wide optimal compression range is found for the thick ELAT1400W gas diffusion layer (i.e., a compression to 60-85% of its original thickness), which is further confirmed in 100-h-long experiments.
title_zh: 零间隙CO 2 电解槽中的挤压气体扩散电极─够了
abstract_zh: 最近的科学进展表明，二氧化碳电化学还原为一氧化碳 (CO2RR) 正在接近工业可行性。除了科学成就之外，技术规模化还需要充分了解如何使用某些电池组件来实现长期最佳性能，以及更大尺寸带来的其他挑战。在这里，我们使用三种根本不同的碳基阴极支架，详细研究了改变阴极气体扩散电极的压缩比如何影响电化学性能。电化学阻抗谱和显微断层扫描测量用于解释观察到的电解性能变化，同时阴极逐渐压缩至原始厚度的 40% 以下。最佳压缩范围取决于气体扩散层的特性。值得注意的是，对于厚的 ELAT1400W 气体扩散层，发现了超过 100 μm 宽的最佳压缩范围（即压缩至其原始厚度的 60-85%），这在 100 小时长的实验中得到了进一步证实。

title: Activation-Controlled Structural Integrity in A520 MOF Membranes for Efficient CO 2 /N 2 and CO 2 /CH 4 Separation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Aluminum fumarate (A520) is a promising metal-organic framework (MOF) for gas adsorption and separation. However, the fabrication of dense, pristine polycrystalline A520 membranes has not yet been reported. Herein, we present a robust seeded-growth protocol to fabricate continuous A520 polycrystalline membranes with a thickness of approximately 3 μm on α-alumina substrates. Our results demonstrate that the post-synthetic activation process plays a critical role in determining membrane integrity. In particular, a methanol exchange (ME) pretreatment prior to thermal activation effectively suppresses lattice distortion induced by capillary stress during solvent evaporation, as evidenced by X-ray diffraction and gas permeation tests. The resulting A520 (ME) membranes exhibit excellent molecular sieving performance, with ideal CO2/N2 and CO2/CH4 selectivities of 71 and 112, respectively. Mixed-gas permeation measurements reveal pronounced composition-dependent separation behavior, where the CO2/N2 separation factor reaches 153 at a 20 mol % CO2 feed, exceeding the 2019 Robeson upper bound, but decreases at higher CO2 concentrations. This behavior is associated with composition-dependent competitive adsorption and diffusion within the confined A520 channels. Grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations reveal that increasing N2 partial pressure enhances N2 uptake but significantly reduces its diffusional mobility, suggesting that additional N2 molecules occupy less favorable transport environments and experience increased diffusion resistance. In contrast, CO2/CH4 separation remains primarily governed by the intrinsic molecular sieving capability of the A520 framework, where the larger kinetic diameter of CH4 results in stronger diffusion limitation. These results highlight the importance of controlled activation strategies and provide insights into the interplay between competitive adsorption and confined diffusion in A520 membranes for carbon capture applications.
title_zh: A520 MOF 膜中活化控制的结构完整性可实现高效 CO 2 /N 2 和 CO 2 /CH 4 分离
abstract_zh: 富马酸铝（A520）是一种很有前景的金属有机框架（MOF），用于气体吸附和分离。然而，致密、原始的多晶 A520 膜的制造尚未有报道。在此，我们提出了一种强大的种子生长方案，用于在 α-氧化铝基板上制造厚度约为 3 μm 的连续 A520 多晶膜。我们的结果表明，合成后活化过程在确定膜完整性方面起着关键作用。特别是，热活化前的甲醇交换（ME）预处理可有效抑制溶剂蒸发过程中毛细管应力引起的晶格畸变，X射线衍射和气体渗透测试证明了这一点。所得的 A520 (ME) 膜表现出优异的分子筛性能，理想的 CO2/N2 和 CO2/CH4 选择性分别为 71 和 112。混合气体渗透测量揭示了明显的成分依赖性分离行为，其中 CO2 进料量为 20 mol% 时，CO2/N2 分离因子达到 153，超过 2019 Robeson 上限，但在较高 CO2 浓度下会降低。这种行为与受限 A520 通道内成分依赖性竞争吸附和扩散有关。大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟表明，增加 N2 分压会增强 N2 吸收，但会显着降低其扩散迁移率，这表明额外的 N2 分子占据不太有利的传输环境并经历增加的扩散阻力。相比之下，CO2/CH4 分离重新

title: Effects of Metal Ions of Metal–Organic Framework Membranes on the Transport of NaCl Solutions toward Seawater Desalination
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: In this work, we study the effects of metal ions on the desalination performance of metal-organic framework (MOF) membranes through molecular dynamics simulations. The transport of NaCl solutions through three M-MOF-74 membranes (M: Cu, Ni, and Zn), which share similar topological structures but differ in metal ions, is investigated under various driving pressures. Simulations reveal that Ni-MOF-74 and Zn-MOF-74 membranes allow the passage of Na+ and Cl-, whose fluxes increase with increasing driving pressure. However, the Cu-MOF-74 membrane exhibits excellent desalination performance. It can completely block the transport of Na+ and Cl- when the driving pressure is lower than 50 MPa, leading to 100% ion rejection rate. Furthermore, water fluxes through the three MOF membranes are similar at low driving pressures. When the driving pressure is higher than 30 MPa, the water flux through the Cu-MOF-74 membrane becomes lower than those for Ni-MOF-74 and Zn-MOF-74 membranes. The underlying mechanisms are explained using effective pore diameters of the membranes, dehydration of salt ions, and the energy barriers associated with the transport of Na+ and Cl-.
title_zh: 金属有机骨架膜金属离子对海水淡化中 NaCl 溶液传输的影响
abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过分子动力学模拟研究了金属离子对金属有机骨架（MOF）膜脱盐性能的影响。在不同的驱动压力下研究了 NaCl 溶液通过三种 M-MOF-74 膜（M：Cu、Ni 和 Zn）的传输，这三种膜具有相似的拓扑结构，但金属离子不同。模拟表明 Ni-MOF-74 和 Zn-MOF-74 膜允许 Na+ 和 Cl- 通过，其通量随着驱动压力的增加而增加。然而，Cu-MOF-74膜表现出优异的海水淡化性能。当驱动压力低于50 MPa时，可以完全阻断Na+和Cl-的传输，离子截留率达到100%。此外，在低驱动压力下，通过三个 MOF 膜的水通量相似。当驱动压力高于30 MPa时，通过Cu-MOF-74膜的水通量变得低于Ni-MOF-74和Zn-MOF-74膜的水通量。使用膜的有效孔径、盐离子脱水以及与 Na+ 和 Cl- 传输相关的能量势垒来解释潜在的机制。

title: Evidence for Step-Edge-Assisted Large Hole Borophene on Ni(111)
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Due to its unique electronic properties, boron tends to form various multicenter bonds, enabling the construction of diverse two-dimensional borophene structures through modulation of the number and distribution of boron vacancies within a triangular lattice. In this study, we investigate a large-hole borophene model on heated Ni(111) substrates via molecular beam epitaxy under ultra-high-vacuum conditions. The complex atomic arrangement and electronic structures were investigated by scanning tunneling microscopy, low-energy electron diffraction, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, and density functional theory calculations. Our results suggest that boron atoms are initially incorporated into the Ni surface and preferentially nucleated at step edges. The favorable geometric matching between the proposed structure and the Ni step-edge configuration contributes to the stabilization of the structure and facilitates its formation under the present growth conditions. These findings broaden the structural diversity of 2D borophene sheets and offer insights into the controlled synthesis of complex borophene architectures on metallic substrates.
title_zh: Ni(111) 上阶梯边缘辅助大孔硼吩的证据
abstract_zh: 由于其独特的电子特性，硼倾向于形成各种多中心键，从而能够通过调节三角晶格内硼空位的数量和分布来构建多种二维硼烯结构。在这项研究中，我们在超高真空条件下通过分子束外延研究了加热 Ni(111) 基板上的大孔硼烯模型。通过扫描隧道显微镜、低能电子衍射、角分辨光电子能谱和密度泛函理论计算研究了复杂的原子排列和电子结构。我们的结果表明，硼原子最初并入镍表面，并优先在阶梯边缘成核。所提出的结构和镍阶梯边缘配置之间有利的几何匹配有助于结构的稳定并促进其在当前生长条件下的形成。这些发现扩大了二维硼烯片的结构多样性，并为金属基底上复杂硼烯结构的受控合成提供了见解。

title: Growth Mode-Dependent Bi Incorporation and Carrier Localization in GaAsBi Wires
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Dilute bismide III-V semiconductors are attractive for infrared optoelectronics because of their large band gap bowing and suppressed Auger recombination; however, achieving controlled Bi incorporation with uniform optical quality remains challenging. Here, we systematically investigate the relationship between growth mode, Bi incorporation, and carrier dynamics in GaAsBi wires grown by molecular beam epitaxy. By varying the substrate temperature and V/III beam-equivalent pressure ratio, growth transitions from planar deposition to vapor-liquid-solid (VLS) wire growth and subsequently to vapor-solid (VS) growth, defining a process window for homogeneous axial Bi incorporation of up to 2.4%. STEM-EDS analysis confirms uniform axial composition under stable VLS conditions, whereas VS growth results in radial overgrowth and compositional averaging. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence reveals growth-dependent alloy fluctuations and carrier localization, which are quantitatively analyzed using a two-activation Arrhenius model to distinguish carrier delocalization from nonradiative recombination pathways. Homogeneous GaAsBi wires exhibit an internal quantum efficiency of ∼0.2% at 260 K and a temperature-dependent band gap shift slightly larger than those of GaAs nanowires and GaAsBi bulk alloys. Furthermore, droplet-mediated growth enables axial GaAsBi/GaAs heterostructures, demonstrating controlled band-structure engineering in dilute bismide wires. This work establishes a quantitative growth-mode stability window for homogeneous axial Bi incorporation in GaAsBi wires and reveals how VLS-to-VS transitions fundamentally alter carrier localization and thermal quenching behavior.
