title: Targeting and antioxidant surface-engineered mesenchymal stromal cells for enhanced erectile dysfunction therapy
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Erectile dysfunction compromises men’s quality of life and fertility. Mesenchymal stromal cell injection therapy holds clinical promise, yet its efficacy is limited by poor cell retention and survival in the corpus cavernosum due to rapid blood flow, elevated reactive oxygen species and inflammation. Here, we show that mesenchymal stromal cells surface-engineered with polydopamine nanoparticles conjugated to antibodies against vascular cell adhesion molecule 1 exhibit enhanced retention, survival, and therapeutic efficacy in erectile dysfunction. We demonstrate that the multivalent antibodies guide the cells to inflamed cavernosal endothelium, while polydopamine mitigates reactive oxygen species‑induced damage and improves the inflammatory microenvironment. We show that the underlying engineering process is rapidly achievable under mild conditions, minimizing the impact on cell viability. We find that surface-engineered mesenchymal stromal cells display improved survival under high reactive oxygen species stress and enhanced targeting capabilities in vitro. In rat models of erectile dysfunction, we demonstrate that the engineered cells achieve robust cavernosal retention, reduce local reactive oxygen species and inflammation, reverse tissue pathology, and restore erectile function. We further validate their efficacy in beagle models, confirming cross-species translational potential. Thus, this study provides a facile and translatable surface engineering strategy to overcome key bottlenecks in mesenchymal stromal cell-based erectile dysfunction therapy.
title_zh: 靶向和抗氧化表面工程间充质基质细胞用于增强勃起功能障碍治疗
abstract_zh: 勃起功能障碍会损害男性的生活质量和生育能力。间充质基质细胞注射疗法具有临床前景，但由于血流过快、活性氧含量升高和炎症导致海绵体内细胞保留和存活率较差，其疗效受到限制。在这里，我们表明，用与抗血管细胞粘附分子1的抗体缀合的聚多巴胺纳米颗粒进行表面工程改造的间充质基质细胞在勃起功能障碍中表现出增强的保留、存活和治疗功效。我们证明多价抗体引导细胞到达发炎的海绵体内皮，而聚多巴胺减轻活性氧诱导的损伤并改善炎症微环境。我们表明，基础工程过程在温和条件下可以快速实现，最大限度地减少对细胞活力的影响。我们发现表面工程间充质基质细胞在高活性氧应激下表现出更高的存活率，并增强了体外靶向能力。在勃起功能障碍的大鼠模型中，我们证明工程细胞实现了强大的海绵体保留，减少了局部活性氧和炎症，逆转了组织病理学并恢复了勃起功能。我们进一步验证了它们在比格犬模型中的功效，证实了跨物种转化潜力。因此，这项研究提供了一种简便且可转化的表面工程策略，以克服基于间充质基质细胞的勃起功能障碍治疗的关键瓶颈。

title: Molecular profiling of the single-cell proteome via gel electrophoresis and 3D single-molecule imaging
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recent advances in shotgun proteomics and immunoassays have yielded powerful single-cell proteomics technologies. However, current methods lack the sensitivity required to comprehensively quantify protein abundances in individual cells. Here, we present single-cell PAGE-PISA, an ultra-sensitive proteome profiling strategy that combines gel electrophoresis with 3D single-molecule fluorescence imaging. Our approach labels all proteins in single cells with fluorescent dyes, separates them by electrophoresis, and counts with single-molecule resolution. This technique quantified over 107 protein copies from a single mammalian cell with the sensitivity to detect low-abundance proteins down to 105 copies per species. Single-cell PAGE-PISA successfully classified cells into distinct cell types based on their proteomic profiles. Furthermore, our single-cell proteome data strongly correlated with predicted developmental states during cardiomyocyte differentiation, providing complementary information to single-cell transcriptome data. Together, single-cell PAGE-PISA enables highly sensitive and quantitative proteome profiling at the single-cell level, capturing subtle proteomic differences that distinguish diverse cellular states.
title_zh: 通过凝胶电泳和 3D 单分子成像对单细胞蛋白质组进行分子分析
abstract_zh: 鸟枪法蛋白质组学和免疫分析的最新进展产生了强大的单细胞蛋白质组学技术。然而，当前的方法缺乏全面量化单个细胞中蛋白质丰度所需的灵敏度。在这里，我们提出了单细胞 PAGE-PISA，这是一种将凝胶电泳与 3D 单分子荧光成像相结合的超灵敏蛋白质组分析策略。我们的方法用荧光染料标记单细胞中的所有蛋白质，通过电泳将它们分离，并以单分子分辨率进行计数。该技术可定量单个哺乳动物细胞中超过 107 个蛋白质拷贝，其灵敏度可检测每个物种低至 105 个拷贝的低丰度蛋白质。单细胞 PAGE-PISA 根据细胞的蛋白质组谱成功地将细胞分为不同的细胞类型。此外，我们的单细胞蛋白质组数据与心肌细胞分化过程中的预测发育状态密切相关，为单细胞转录组数据提供了补充信息。总之，单细胞 PAGE-PISA 能够在单细胞水平上进行高度灵敏的定量蛋白质组分析，捕获区分不同细胞状态的细微蛋白质组差异。

title: TREM1 signaling amplifies neutrophil-mediated inflammation in inflammatory bowel disease
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), complex immune dysregulation induces chronic inflammation. TREM1 is a receptor expressed on myeloid cells and is activated by ligands such as PGLYRP1 to amplify inflammatory responses. Here, we analyze the function of TREM1 signaling in neutrophil-driven inflammation, identifying two positive feedback loops. First, neutrophils activated by phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA) or by bacteria release PGLYRP1, which forms a ligand complex with bacterial peptidoglycan and activates TREM1, thereby enhancing neutrophil degranulation, reactive oxygen species production, and NETosis. Second, TREM1 activation on monocytes promotes the secretion of chemokines and cytokines that recruit and activate additional neutrophils, further perpetuating inflammation. In vivo, TREM1 activation exacerbates colitis in mice, with the gut commensal bacterium Blautia faecis potentially contributing to human TREM1 activation in IBD. In biopsy samples from patients with IBD, an elevated TREM1 pathway signature is associated with inflamed tissue and treatment resistance in ulcerative colitis. Our findings thus highlight TREM1 as a regulator of mucosal inflammation, and a potential therapeutic target for IBD.
title_zh: TREM1 信号放大炎症性肠病中中性粒细胞介导的炎症
abstract_zh: 在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，复杂的免疫失调会诱发慢性炎症。 TREM1 是骨髓细胞上表达的受体，被 PGLYRP1 等配体激活以放大炎症反应。在这里，我们分析了 TREM1 信号在中性粒细胞驱动的炎症中的功能，确定了两个正反馈回路。首先，佛波醇 12-肉豆蔻酸酯 13-乙酸酯 (PMA) 或细菌激活的中性粒细胞释放 PGLYRP1，后者与细菌肽聚糖形成配体复合物并激活 TREM1，从而增强中性粒细胞脱粒、活性氧产生和 NETosis。其次，单核细胞上的 TREM1 激活会促进趋化因子和细胞因子的分泌，从而招募和激活额外的中性粒细胞，从而进一步使炎症持续存在。在体内，TREM1 激活会加剧小鼠的结肠炎，而肠道共生细菌粪布劳特菌 (Blautia faecis) 可能会导致 IBD 中的人类 TREM1 激活。在 IBD 患者的活检样本中，TREM1 通路特征升高与溃疡性结肠炎的发炎组织和治疗抵抗相关。因此，我们的研究结果强调 TREM1 是粘膜炎症的调节因子，也是 IBD 的潜在治疗靶点。

title: A metabolite-bridged complex between SerRS and SIRT2 couples NAD⁺ metabolism to translation control
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cellular homeostasis requires tight coordination between metabolic and translational networks. Here we identify a direct molecular link between these processes through a cryo-EM structure of human cytosolic seryl-tRNA synthetase (SerRS) in complex with the NAD⁺-dependent deacetylase SIRT2. This interaction is promoted by the NAD⁺ metabolite ADP-ribose (ADPR), which acts as a molecular bridge between the two enzymes. Within the SIRT2 active site, ADPR engages SerRS residue K414 located in a flexible catalytic-domain loop. Acetylation of K414 is dispensable for binding. Functionally, complex formation inhibits SIRT2 deacetylase activity by blocking substrate access, while SIRT2 association suppresses SerRS aminoacylation activity by preventing tRNA binding. Thus, SerRS and SIRT2 mutually regulate each other, with ADPR enhancing while tRNA attenuating their interaction. Oxidative stress promotes this interaction via a PARP1-dependent pathway, revealing an ADPR-responsive regulatory module that couples metabolic state to translational output. This regulatory module is likely conserved across vertebrates.
title_zh: SerRS 和 SIRT2 之间的代谢桥复合物将 NAD⁺ 代谢与翻译控制结合起来
abstract_zh: 细胞稳态需要代谢网络和翻译网络之间的紧密协调。在这里，我们通过人胞质丝氨酰-tRNA合成酶（SerRS）与NAD⁺依赖性脱乙酰酶SIRT2复合物的冷冻电镜结构确定了这些过程之间的直接分子联系。这种相互作用是由 NAD⁺ 代谢物 ADP-核糖 (ADPR) 促进的，它充当两种酶之间的分子桥梁。在 SIRT2 活性位点内，ADPR 与位于灵活催化结构域环中的 SerRS 残基 K414 结合。 K414 的乙酰化对于结合来说是可有可无的。从功能上讲，复合物的形成通过阻断底物进入来抑制 SIRT2 脱乙酰酶活性，而 SIRT2 结合通过阻止 tRNA 结合来抑制 SerRS 氨酰化活性。因此，SerRS 和 SIRT2 相互调节，ADPR 增强，而 tRNA 减弱它们的相互作用。氧化应激通过 PARP1 依赖性途径促进这种相互作用，揭示了将代谢状态与翻译输出耦合的 ADPR 响应调节模块。这种调节模块可能在脊椎动物中是保守的。

title: Cellular heterogeneity of hepatic granuloma formation and evolution in murine schistosomiasis japonica
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Schistosomiasis morbidity and mortality are primarily driven by egg-triggered granulomas with subsequent fibrosis. However, the dynamics of cellular composition within these granulomas, particularly the identity and function of key immune cells that orchestrate their formation and evolution, remain poorly understood. Here, we combine single-cell RNA sequencing with multiplex immunofluorescence to characterize the hepatic immune landscape in Schistosoma japonicum-infected mice and further validate the functional roles of two neutrophil subsets. We find that eggs alter hepatic immune cell composition, which is characterized by extensive neutrophil recruitment and differentiation. Neutrophil recruitment correlates with CXCL2 derived from both an autocrine loop and paracrine signaling from monocytes. Cellular localization analysis reveals that granulomas progress through three distinct developmental stages: early Ly6GhiF4/80loDesminlo, developing Ly6GmidF4/80hiDesminmid, and advanced Ly6GloF4/80midDesminhi. Neutrophil subsets display a zonal distribution within granulomas, with CD177+ neutrophils surrounding the eggs and Ltf+ neutrophils localizing to the mid-outer layer. Cd177 knockdown reduces granuloma size and fibrosis, whereas Ltf suppression increases these pathological features, indicating that CD177 and LTF exert opposite effects on granuloma formation. Our findings provide new insights into the cellular complexity of S. japonicum egg-induced granulomas and may help guide the development of novel therapies for liver fibrosis.
title_zh: 小鼠日本血吸虫病肝肉芽肿形成和进化的细胞异质性
abstract_zh: 血吸虫病的发病率和死亡率主要是由虫卵引发的肉芽肿及其随后的纤维化引起的。然而，这些肉芽肿内细胞组成的动态，特别是协调其形成和进化的关键免疫细胞的身份和功能，仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们将单细胞 RNA 测序与多重免疫荧光相结合，来表征日本血吸虫感染小鼠的肝脏免疫景观，并进一步验证两个中性粒细胞亚群的功能作用。我们发现鸡蛋改变了肝脏免疫细胞的组成，其特点是广泛的中性粒细胞募集和分化。中性粒细胞募集与源自单核细胞自分泌环和旁分泌信号的 CXCL2 相关。细胞定位分析表明，肉芽肿经历三个不同的发育阶段：早期 Ly6GhiF4/80loDesminlo、发育中的 Ly6GmidF4/80hiDesminmid 和晚期 Ly6GloF4/80midDesminhi。中性粒细胞亚群在肉芽肿内呈带状分布，CD177+中性粒细胞围绕卵，Ltf+中性粒细胞定位于中外层。 Cd177 敲低可减少肉芽肿大小和纤维化，而 Ltf 抑制则可增加这些病理特征，表明 CD177 和 LTF 对肉芽肿形成具有相反的作用。我们的研究结果为日本血吸虫卵诱导的肉芽肿的细胞复杂性提供了新的见解，并可能有助于指导肝纤维化新疗法的开发。

title: Aging-Tolerant Precursor Solution for Perovskite Solar Cells Enabled by Phosphite-Assisted Chemical Protection
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Despite rapid advances in the power conversion efficiency of perovskite solar cells, stability issues arising from the degradation of both the perovskite precursor solution and film remain a significant challenge for commercialization. Here, we demonstrate full lifecycle management of perovskite solar cells by introducing triphenyl phosphite as a beneficial additive into the perovskite precursor solution. Triphenyl phosphite not only stabilizes the precursor solution by preventing iodide oxidation and deprotonation of organic cations but also enables the formation of perovskite films with enhanced crystallinity, reduced defect density, and enhanced long-term stability under aging conditions. The optimized n-i-p perovskite solar cells deliver a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.6%. The target device retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 600 h of continuous illumination under maximum power point tracking. Notably, even after aging for 21 days in ambient air, the triphenyl phosphite-containing precursor solution can still yield perovskite solar cells with efficiencies comparable to those fabricated from fresh precursor solutions. These results provide a practical strategy and guiding framework for improving the stability of both perovskite precursor solutions and perovskite films.
title_zh: 通过亚磷酸盐辅助化学保护实现钙钛矿太阳能电池的耐老化前驱体解决方案
abstract_zh: 尽管钙钛矿太阳能电池的功率转换效率快速进步，但钙钛矿前驱体溶液和薄膜降解引起的稳定性问题仍然是商业化的重大挑战。在这里，我们通过将亚磷酸三苯酯作为有益的添加剂引入钙钛矿前体溶液中，展示了钙钛矿太阳能电池的完整生命周期管理。亚磷酸三苯酯不仅通过防止碘化物氧化和有机阳离子去质子化来稳定前体溶液，而且能够形成结晶度增强、缺陷密度降低、老化条件下长期稳定性增强的钙钛矿薄膜。经过优化的 n-i-p 钙钛矿太阳能电池经认证的功率转换效率为 26.6%。在最大功率点跟踪下连续照明 600 小时后，目标器件仍保持其初始效率的 90%。值得注意的是，即使在环境空气中老化 21 天后，含亚磷酸三苯酯的前体溶液仍然可以产生钙钛矿太阳能电池，其效率与用新鲜前体溶液制造的电池相当。这些结果为提高钙钛矿前驱体溶液和钙钛矿薄膜的稳定性提供了实用的策略和指导框架。

title: Orbital coupling in bridge-mediated FeCu dual-atom catalysts for water decontamination
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Dual-atom catalysts (DACs) hold significant promise for advanced oxidation processes. However, their practical applications are often limited by sluggish electron transfer and low atomic utilization efficiency. Herein, we report that P-bridged Fe-Cu dual-atom catalysts (FeCu-NP-C) are precisely modulated by first-shell N and P ligands, forming a unique N3Fe-P1-CuN3 structure. The Fe-P-Cu bridging bond induces d-p-d gradient orbital coupling to establish a directional electron-transfer channel from the Cu site (electron donor) to the Fe site (electron acceptor) for enabling ultrafast pollutant degradation and bacterial inactivation. The FeCu-NP-C catalyst enables peroxymonosulfate activation to selectively generate high-valent iron-oxo species with a steady-state concentration of 5.80 × 10−5 mM, which is 100 times higher than that of Fe-NP-C. The FeCu-NP-C membrane reactor achieves a treatment capacity of 500 L of wastewater per gram of catalyst over 100 h, at an operational cost of USD 0.16 per tonne. This work provides deep insights into the bridge-mediated orbital interactions of DACs for water decontamination.
title_zh: 用于水净化的桥介导 FeCu 双原子催化剂的轨道耦合
abstract_zh: 双原子催化剂 (DAC) 对高级氧化过程具有重大前景。然而，它们的实际应用往往受到电子转移缓慢和原子利用效率低的限制。在此，我们报道了P桥联的Fe-Cu双原子催化剂（FeCu-NP-C）由第一层N和P配体精确调控，形成独特的N3Fe-P1-CuN3结构。 Fe-P-Cu桥键诱导d-p-d梯度轨道耦合，建立从Cu位点（电子供体）到Fe位点（电子受体）的定向电子转移通道，从而实现污染物超快降解和细菌灭活。 FeCu-NP-C催化剂能够过一硫酸盐活化，选择性地生成稳态浓度为5.80×10−5 mM的高价铁氧物种，比Fe-NP-C高100倍。 FeCu-NP-C膜反应器在100小时内可实现每克催化剂处理500升废水的能力，每吨运行成本为0.16美元。这项工作为水净化中 DAC 的桥介导轨道相互作用提供了深入的见解。

title: Spatial transcriptomic profiling of ovarian clear cell carcinoma reveals heterogeneity in OXPHOS and EMT gradients
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Intratumoral heterogeneity is intrinsically comprised of molecular alterations of tumor cells and extrinsically from interconnections with microenvironments. This study explores the spatial heterogeneity of ovarian clear cell carcinoma (OCCC), a rare cancer with significance to East Asian women. We profile 21 primary-metastatic tumor pairs in a discovery cohort and 16 tumors in two validation cohorts using spatial transcriptomic (ST) platforms. Our integrative analysis revealed an inverse relationship between OXPHOS and inflammation along the EMT gradient. OCCC cells undergoing partial EMT have metabolic shifts and lose LCN2 expression, possibly via concomitant down-regulation of SOX9. Conversely, LCN2 expression correlated with OXPHOS-enriched tumor signature, low EMT, and better outcomes in OCCC. Single-cell ST profiling using CosMx further identifies nine spatially distinct cancer cell populations including the LCN2-high cancer subclone with a high epithelial score. SOX9 induction could partially restore epithelial-ness in LCN2-low cells suggesting that plasticity in OCCC is achieved via transcriptional reprogramming. Our findings provide further insights into epithelial-mesenchymal plasticity and the adaptive interactions between cancer cells and their microenvironments in OCCC.
title_zh: 卵巢透明细胞癌的空间转录组分析揭示了 OXPHOS 和 EMT 梯度的异质性
abstract_zh: 肿瘤内异质性本质上由肿瘤细胞的分子改变组成，外在则由与微环境的互连组成。本研究探讨了卵巢透明细胞癌（OCCC）的空间异质性，这是一种对东亚女性具有重要意义的罕见癌症。我们使用空间转录组 (ST) 平台对发现队列中的 21 个原发性转移肿瘤对和两个验证队列中的 16 个肿瘤进行了分析。我们的综合分析揭示了 OXPHOS 和炎症之间沿 EMT 梯度呈负相关。经历部分 EMT 的 OCCC 细胞发生代谢变化并失去 LCN2 表达，可能是通过 SOX9 的伴随下调而实现的。相反，LCN2 表达与 OCCC 中富含 OXPHOS 的肿瘤特征、低 EMT 和更好的结果相关。使用 CosMx 进行的单细胞 ST 分析进一步鉴定了九个空间上不同的癌细胞群，包括具有高上皮评分的 LCN2 高癌症亚克隆。 SOX9 诱导可以部分恢复 LCN2-low 细胞的上皮性，表明 OCCC 的可塑性是通过转录重编程实现的。我们的研究结果为 OCCC 中上皮间质可塑性以及癌细胞与其微环境之间的适应性相互作用提供了进一步的见解。

title: A portable Cas6f-based system for multiplex translational repression in bacteria
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Engineered small RNAs (sRNAs) enable programmable gene knockdowns and support metabolic engineering and multiplex regulation in model bacteria. Still, precise, tunable, and multiplex gene repression remains a challenge in synthetic biology. Common tools can impose genetic burden, depend on host RNA factors, or do not transfer well across species. Here we present MORTISE (Multiplex, ORthogonal Translation Interference SystEm), a compact Cas6f-based platform for programmable translational repression in Gram-negative bacteria. The system functions without host Hfq or RNases and operates robustly in Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas putida. We demonstrate repression in both species using chromosomal reporter assays, with performance improving when guide and target transcription are matched and when the translation initiation region is targeted. Single-promoter multiplexing enables simultaneous knockdowns and a cloning toolbox facilitates assembly of up to nine guides in a single step. Finally, MORTISE is leveraged to boost malonyl-coenzyme A–dependent production in P. putida, supporting pathway balancing.
title_zh: 一种基于 Cas6f 的便携式细菌多重翻译抑制系统
abstract_zh: 工程化小 RNA (sRNA) 可实现可编程基因敲除，并支持模型细菌中的代谢工程和多重调控。尽管如此，精确、可调节和多重基因抑制仍然是合成生物学中的一个挑战。常见的工具可能会造成遗传负担，取决于宿主 RNA 因素，或者不能很好地跨物种转移。在这里，我们推出 MORTISE（多重正交翻译干扰系统），这是一种基于 Cas6f 的紧凑平台，用于革兰氏阴性细菌的可编程翻译抑制。该系统无需宿主 Hfq 或 RNase，即可在大肠杆菌和恶臭假单胞菌中稳定运行。我们使用染色体报告基因检测证明了这两个物种的抑制，当引导转录和目标转录匹配以及翻译起始区域被靶向时，性能得到改善。单启动子多重化可实现同时击倒，克隆工具箱可促进一步组装多达 9 个导向器。最后，MORTISE 被用来促进恶臭假单胞菌中依赖丙二酰辅酶 A 的生产，支持途径平衡。

title: Elimination of myotonia improves myopathy in a muscleblind-like knockout model of myotonic dystrophy
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: A cardinal sign of myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) is myotonia, slow muscle relaxation after voluntary contraction. Myotonia results from mis-regulated splicing of chloride channel 1 (ClC-1), leading to loss of channel function and runs of involuntary action potentials in muscle fibers. Preceding the onset of weakness, myotonia is often the first symptom of DM1, and thus this raises the possibility that muscle hyperexcitability contributes to the subsequent weakness and myopathy. Here, we show that genomic deletion of ClC-1 exon 7a (E7a), a cryptic exon abnormally regulated in DM1, completely rescues of ClC-1 function and yields permanent elimination of myotonia in the muscleblind-like 1 (Mbnl1) knockout mouse model of DM1. The restoration of normal excitability results in normalization of muscle force generation, correction of fiber-type distribution, and improvement of muscle histology. E7a deletion also partially corrects the muscle transcriptome, including changes of differential gene expression and alternative splicing. These results indicate that E7a inclusion is a lynchpin splice event that contributes to myotonic myopathy, and support myotonia reduction as a therapeutic objective in DM1.
title_zh: 消除肌强直可改善强直性肌营养不良的肌盲样基因敲除模型中的肌病
abstract_zh: 1 型强直性肌营养不良 (DM1) 的主要症状是肌强​​直，即随意收缩后肌肉松弛缓慢。肌强直是由氯通道 1 (ClC-1) 剪接错误调节引起的，导致通道功能丧失和肌纤维中不自主动作电位的运行。在无力发作之前，肌强直通常是 DM1 的首发症状，因此这增加了肌肉过度兴奋导致随后的无力和肌病的可能性。在这里，我们发现，ClC-1 外显子 7a (E7a)（DM1 中异常调节的神秘外显子）的基因组缺失可以完全挽救 ClC-1 功能，并在 DM1 肌盲样 1 (Mbnl1) 敲除小鼠模型中永久消除肌强直。正常兴奋性的恢复导致肌肉力量产生的正常化、纤维类型分布的纠正以及肌肉组织学的改善。 E7a 缺失还部分纠正了肌肉转录组，包括差异基因表达和选择性剪接的变化。这些结果表明，E7a 包含是导致强直性肌病的关键剪接事件，并支持将减少肌强直作为 DM1 的治疗目标。

title: Dynamic immune profiling predicts response to radiation plus anti-PD-1 therapy in oligometastatic renal cell carcinoma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Biomarkers that predict response to combined radiation and anti-PD-1 therapy in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) are poorly defined. RAPPORT trial (NCT02855203) is a prospective phase I/II study of stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy (SABR) and pembrolizumab in 30 patients with oligometastatic ccRCC. The primary endpoint was safety; secondary endpoints included overall survival, time to local progression, distant progression-free survival, objective and disease control rates, duration of response and patient-reported pain. Here, we report the pre-specified exploratory translational analyses. In pre-treatment tumours, responders had greater intra-tumoural cytotoxic T cell infiltration in close proximity to tumour cells, whereas non-responders showed enrichment of immunosuppressive, TGF-β and angiogenic signatures. In peripheral blood post-treatment, responders developed a proliferative burst of activated CD8+ T cells and sustained sharing of pre-existing tumour-enriched TCR clones. These findings identify trafficking and maintenance of pre-existing tumour-enriched T cell clones as determinants of response to SABR plus anti-PD-1 in ccRCC.
title_zh: 动态免疫分析预测寡转移性肾细胞癌对放射加抗 PD-1 治疗的反应
abstract_zh: 预测透明细胞肾细胞癌 (ccRCC) 联合放疗和抗 PD-1 治疗反应的生物标志物尚不明确。 RAPPORT 试验 (NCT02855203) 是一项前瞻性 I/II 期研究，对 30 名寡转移性 ccRCC 患者进行立体定向消融性放射治疗 (SABR) 和派姆单抗 (pembrolizumab)。主要终点是安全性；次要终点包括总生存期、局部进展时间、远处无进展生存期、客观控制率和疾病控制率、缓解持续时间和患者报告的疼痛。在这里，我们报告预先指定的探索性转化分析。在治疗前的肿瘤中，有反应者在肿瘤细胞附近有更多的肿瘤内细胞毒性 T 细胞浸润，而无反应者则表现出免疫抑制、TGF-β 和血管生成特征的富集。在治疗后的外周血中，反应者出现了活化的 CD8+ T 细胞的增殖爆发，并持续共享预先存在的富含肿瘤的 TCR 克隆。这些发现确定了预先存在的富含肿瘤的 T 细胞克隆的运输和维持是 ccRCC 中对 SABR 加抗 PD-1 反应的决定因素。

title: Hierarchical optimization predicts plasticity in the macaque inferior temporal cortex following object training
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: How does the primate brain coordinate plasticity when learning to discriminate new objects? We measured consequences of object learning on inferior temporal (IT) cortex, a key waypoint supporting object recognition in the ventral visual stream, in male macaques. Neural activity in task-trained monkeys’ IT showed increased object selectivity, enhanced linear separability across objects, and more object-invariant representations compared to task-naïve monkeys. To model these differences, we developed a computational framework using anatomically-mapped artificial neural network (ANN) models of the ventral stream with various learning algorithms. Simulations revealed that gradient-based, performance-optimizing updates of ANN internal representations accurately approximated observed IT cortex changes. These models predict novel training-induced phenomena in the IT cortex, including changes independent of object identity and IT’s alignment with behavior. This convergence between empirical measurements and model predictions suggests ventral stream plasticity follows task optimization principles well-approximated by gradient descent, enabling accurate predictions about visual plasticity and generalization to test images.
title_zh: 分层优化预测对象训练后猕猴下颞叶皮层的可塑性
abstract_zh: 当灵长类动物学习辨别新物体时，大脑如何协调可塑性？我们测量了对象学习对雄性猕猴下颞叶皮层（IT）的影响，下颞叶皮层是支持腹侧视觉流中对象识别的关键路径点。与未经任务训练的猴子相比，经过任务训练的猴子 IT 的神经活动表现出更高的对象选择性、增强的对象之间的线性可分离性以及更多的对象不变表示。为了模拟这些差异，我们使用腹侧流的解剖映射人工神经网络（ANN）模型和各种学习算法开发了一个计算框架。模拟显示，基于梯度、性能优化的 ANN 内部表示更新准确地近似了观察到的 IT 皮层变化。这些模型预测 IT 皮层中由训练引起的新现象，包括独立于物体身份的变化以及 IT 与行为的一致性。经验测量和模型预测之间的这种收敛表明腹侧流可塑性遵循通过梯度下降很好地近似的任务优化原则，从而能够准确预测视觉可塑性和泛化到测试图像。

title: Electron tomography reveals mitochondrial network and cristae remodelling during cell differentiation in the human placenta
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Mitochondria adapt their structure through fusion and fission, yet how their morphology and cristae architecture change as cells differentiate remains unclear. The human placenta is a valuable model for studying mitochondrial diversity within a single tissue. As epithelial trophoblast cells of the placenta differentiate, their accompanying mitochondria morphologically and functionally transform. We use array tomography to characterise mitochondrial volume and network complexity. Cryo-electron tomography reveals two distinct subpopulations of mitochondria within preparations enriched for progenitor cytotrophoblasts, and a singular, homogeneous population in the differentiated syncytiotrophoblast. We showcase the 3D topology of individual cristae through a standardised metric of “curvedness”. Proteomic analysis of isolated mitochondria identifies reduced levels of proteins involved in mitochondrial dynamics and cristae organisation complexes in the syncytiotrophoblast, accompanied by variations in electron transport chain subunits, ATP synthase, and supercomplex components. This study highlights the advantages of combining multimodal imaging with proteomic analyses, to elucidate the process of mitochondrial morphology and cristae architecture remodelling as cells differentiate.
title_zh: 电子断层扫描揭示人胎盘细胞分化过程中的线粒体网络和嵴重塑
abstract_zh: 线粒体通过融合和裂变调整其结构，但其形态和嵴结构如何随着细胞分化而变化仍不清楚。人类胎盘是研究单个组织内线粒体多样性的有价值的模型。随着胎盘上皮滋养层细胞的分化，其伴随的线粒体在形态和功能上发生转变。我们使用阵列断层扫描来表征线粒体体积和网络复杂性。冷冻电子断层扫描揭示了富含祖细胞滋养层的制剂中两个不同的线粒体亚群，以及分化的合体滋养层中的单一均匀群体。我们通过标准化的“弯曲度”度量来展示单个嵴的 3D 拓扑。对分离线粒体的蛋白质组学分析发现，合体滋养层中参与线粒体动力学和嵴组织复合体的蛋白质水平降低，并伴有电子传递链亚基、ATP 合酶和超复合体成分的变化。这项研究强调了将多模态成像与蛋白质组学分析相结合的优势，以阐明细胞分化时线粒体形态和嵴结构重塑的过程。

title: Systems-level analysis predicts no autotrophy-linked protein-RNA interactions in Clostridium autoethanogenum
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Burning fossil fuels drives climate change with detrimental consequences on humankind while waste accumulation from increasing consumption threatens biosustainability globally. Gas fermentation enables to recycle carbon oxides (CO and CO2) from industrial waste gases and gasified waste into value-added products using gas-fermenting microbes, namely acetogens. However, our limited understanding of gene function and metabolic regulation is hindering rational engineering of acetogen cell factories. In this work, we aimed to identify genome-wide protein-RNA interactions contributing to autotrophy in the model-acetogen Clostridium autoethanogenum by combining steady-state chemostat cultivation, functional genomics, and computational methods. We first detected limited and uncoupled transcriptional and translational regulation between autotrophy and heterotrophy. Rigorous mapping of genome-wide transcriptional architecture revealed both differential usage and signal strength of transcriptional start and termination sites between genes and growth substrates. We then used computational tools to reconstruct protein-RNA interactions for differentially regulated genes, predicting 14 trans-acting regulatory RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) involved in post-transcriptional regulation but not linked to genes key for autotrophy. Most RBPs, one of which is translationally regulated, perform RNA modifications and regulate mRNA stability while others target translation-related genes. Our work provides valuable knowledge for metabolic engineering of acetogens and potentially contributes towards understanding primordial life on Earth.
title_zh: 系统级分析预测 Clostridium autoethanogenum 中不存在自养相关蛋白-RNA 相互作用
abstract_zh: 燃烧化石燃料会导致气候变化，对人类造成不利影响，而消费增加造成的废物积累威胁着全球的生物可持续性。气体发酵能够利用气体发酵微生物（即产乙酸菌）将工业废气和气化废物中的碳氧化物（CO 和 CO2）回收成增值产品。然而，我们对基因功能和代谢调控的有限了解阻碍了产乙酸细胞工厂的合理工程。在这项工作中，我们的目的是通过结合稳态恒化器培养、功能基因组学和计算方法，识别有助于模型产乙酸梭菌自养的全基因组蛋白质-RNA 相互作用。我们首先检测到自养和异养之间有限且不偶联的转录和翻译调节。对全基因组转录结构的严格作图揭示了基因和生长底物之间转录起始和终止位点的差异使用和信号强度。然后，我们使用计算工具重建差异调节基因的蛋白质-RNA 相互作用，预测 14 个参与转录后调节但与自养关键基因无关的反式作用调节 RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP)。大多数 RBP（其中一种受翻译调节）执行 RNA 修饰并调节 mRNA 稳定性，而其他 RBP 则针对翻译相关基因。我们的工作为产乙酸菌的代谢工程提供了宝贵的知识，并可能有助于开发

title: Spliceosomal proteins direct RNA methylation to modulate gene expression and silence retrotransposons
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: RNA modifications are fundamental to gene regulation and RNA processing, yet their diversity and transcript specificity remain incompletely defined. Here, using a genetic screen in S. pombe, we identify the RNA methyltransferase Tgs1 and Coilin-related proteins as regulators of transcripts harboring inefficiently spliced cryptic introns. These factors associate to form a protein assembly, termed TEaM, which is recruited to cryptic-intron-containing RNAs, including retrotransposon-derived transcripts, by spliceosomal components, and to gametogenic gene transcripts by a YTH-family RNA-binding protein. Upon recruitment, Tgs1 catalyzes trimethylguanosine (TMG) capping, facilitating engagement of the conserved factor Pir2/ARS2, which cooperates with the DROSHA homolog Pac1 and other factors to promote RNA processing and RNAi-mediated silencing. This pathway also targets centromeric repeat RNAs containing cryptic introns, enabling de novo production of siRNAs that specify heterochromatin nucleation. Together, these findings delineate a mechanism in which Tgs1-directed TMG capping, coupled with Pir2/ARS2, specifies RNAi substrates to broadly regulate gene expression and silence retrotransposons.
title_zh: 剪接体蛋白指导 RNA 甲基化来调节基因表达并沉默逆转录转座子
abstract_zh: RNA 修饰是基因调控和 RNA 加工的基础，但其多样性和转录特异性仍未完全确定。在这里，通过对粟酒裂殖酵母进行遗传筛选，我们鉴定出 RNA 甲基转移酶 Tgs1 和 Coilin 相关蛋白是含有低效剪接的隐秘内含子的转录本的调节因子。这些因子结合形成称为 TEaM 的蛋白质组装体，它通过剪接体成分被募集到含隐含内含子的 RNA（包括逆转录转座子衍生的转录本），并通过 YTH 家族 RNA 结合蛋白募集到配子基因转录本。招募后，Tgs1 催化三甲基鸟苷 (TMG) 加帽，促进保守因子 Pir2/ARS2 的参与，该因子与 DROSHA 同源物 Pac1 和其他因子配合，促进 RNA 加工和 RNAi 介导的沉默。该途径还靶向含有隐性内含子的着丝粒重复RNA，从而能够从头产生指定异染色质成核的siRNA。总之，这些发现描绘了一种机制，其中 Tgs1 引导的 TMG 加帽与 Pir2/ARS2 结合，指定 RNAi 底物来广泛调节基因表达并沉默逆转录转座子。

title: Loss of the USP22 deubiquitylase confers resistance to chemotherapy in small cell lung cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) responds exceptionally well to cytotoxic chemotherapy. However, relapse with the emergence of chemoresistant disease is rapid and accompanied by poor treatment outcomes. To understand the genetic basis of chemoresistance in SCLC, we apply in vivo CRISPR deletion screening to patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models. Top screen hits include genes encoding components of the transcriptional co-activator SAGA (Spt-Ada-Gcn5 acetyltransferase) complex. We demonstrate that deletion of the SAGA deubiquitylase USP22 confers cisplatin-etoposide resistance in two chemosensitive PDX models, and that restoring expression in a PDX model harboring homozygous truncating mutation of USP22 re-sensitizes tumors to chemotherapy. USP22 loss increases gene body histone H2AK119 monoubiquitylation at key regulators of neuronal differentiation and suppresses neural and neuroendocrine gene expression including targets of ASCL1. Chemoresistance following USP22 loss reflects attenuated DNA damage-driven phosphorylation events and apoptosis, in conjunction with increased expression of glycolysis and hypoxia-related genes. Glycolysis program upregulation may reflect a targetable vulnerability, as inhibition of GLUT1 re-sensitizes USP22-null tumors to chemotherapy.
title_zh: USP22 去泛素化酶的缺失导致小细胞肺癌对化疗产生耐药性
abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）对细胞毒性化疗的反应非常好。然而，随着耐药性疾病的出现，复发速度很快，并且治疗效果不佳。为了了解 SCLC 化疗耐药的遗传基础，我们将体内 CRISPR 缺失筛选应用于患者来源的异种移植 (PDX) 模型。热门屏幕点击包括编码转录共激活因子 SAGA（Spt-Ada-Gcn5 乙酰转移酶）复合物成分的基因。我们证明，SAGA 去泛素化酶 USP22 的缺失会在两种化疗敏感的 PDX 模型中赋予顺铂依托泊苷耐药性，并且在含有 USP22 纯合截短突变的 PDX 模型中恢复表达使肿瘤对化疗重新敏感。 USP22 缺失会增加神经元分化关键调节因子处的基因体组蛋白 H2AK119 单泛素化，并抑制神经和神经内分泌基因表达，包括 ASCL1 的靶标。 USP22 缺失后的化学耐药性反映了 DNA 损伤驱动的磷酸化事件和细胞凋亡的减弱，以及糖酵解和缺氧相关基因表达的增加。糖酵解程序的上调可能反映了一种可靶向的脆弱性，因为抑制 GLUT1 会使 USP22 无效的肿瘤对化疗重新敏感。

title: Regime transitions in Arctic surface momentum balance reveal persistent and predictable dynamical states
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Arctic sea-ice decline is fundamentally altering the momentum transfer between the atmosphere and ocean, with important implications for the climate system. However, capturing the complexity of air–ice–ocean interactions across varying timescales remains a challenge for climate models. Here, we show that Arctic Ekman pumping is organized into seven distinct physical regimes identified using a probabilistic clustering framework applied to a 26-year state estimate. These regimes reflect different combinations of wind, ice, and geostrophic forcing, alongside a residual component that becomes more prominent during seasonal sea-ice transitions. Spatially, the Beaufort Sea is characterized by frequent transitions and persistent ice–geostrophic coupled regimes, whereas the Nordic and Eurasian marginal seas exhibit greater variability in regime stability over time. This regime framework provides a physically grounded link between atmospheric forcing and surface momentum balance, offering a process-based perspective on how changing ice cover may influence Arctic upper-ocean dynamics.
title_zh: 北极表面动量平衡的制度转变揭示了持久且可预测的动态状态
abstract_zh: 北极海冰的减少从根本上改变了大气和海洋之间的动量传递，对气候系统产生了重要影响。然而，捕捉不同时间尺度的空气-冰-海洋相互作用的复杂性仍然是气候模型的一个挑战。在这里，我们展示了北极埃克曼抽水被组织成七个不同的物理状态，这些物理状态是使用应用于 26 年状态估计的概率聚类框架确定的。这些状况反映了风、冰和地转强迫的不同组合，以及在季节性海冰转变期间变得更加突出的残余成分。在空间上，波弗特海的特点是频繁的转变和持续的冰-地转耦合状态，而北欧和欧亚边缘海随着时间的推移表现出更大的状态稳定性变化。该体系框架提供了大气强迫和表面动量平衡之间的物理基础联系，为冰盖变化如何影响北极上层海洋动力学提供了基于过程的视角。

title: Urbanization processes widen global divergence in extreme temperature variability
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Extreme temperature variability (ETV) is a key dimension of climate risk for billions of residents. However, how urbanization shapes global ETV divergence remains unclear. Here, we assemble a 1950–2020 panel of 10,522 cities and demonstrate that ETV trajectories diverge by development status as measured by the human development index (HDI). ETV intensifies in high-development cities, whereas it slowly weakens in low-development cities, resulting in a current gap of roughly 1.66 °C. Decomposing ETV into event frequency and intensity reveals that cumulative ETV is driven mainly by intensity. Using an interpretable machine-learning framework, we find that aerosols are the urban factor most strongly associated with ETV after controlling for climate and geography. Blue-green space is consistently associated with lower ETV, whereas urban morphology has a smaller and context-dependent effect. These findings link global ETV inequality to urban governance and support targeted management that focusses on limiting volatility under climate risk.
title_zh: 城市化进程扩大了极端温度变化的全球差异
abstract_zh: 极端温度变化（ETV）是数十亿居民面临气候风险的一个关键维度。然而，城市化如何影响全球 ETV 差异仍不清楚。在这里，我们汇集了 1950-2020 年 10,522 个城市的面板，并证明 ETV 轨迹因人类发展指数 (HDI) 衡量的发展状况而有所不同。 ETV 在高发展城市中增强，而在低发展城市中缓慢减弱，导致目前差距约为 1.66 °C。将 ETV 分解为事件频率和强度表明累积 ETV 主要由强度驱动。使用可解释的机器学习框架，我们发现在控制气候和地理之后，气溶胶是与 ETV 相关性最强的城市因素。蓝绿色空间始终与较低的 ETV 相关，而城市形态的影响较小且取决于环境。这些发现将全球 ETV 不平等与城市治理联系起来，并支持专注于限制气候风险下波动的有针对性的管理。

title: Particle-associated diazotrophs drive nitrogen fixation in Arctic subsurface waters of the Barents Sea
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Biological dinitrogen (N2) fixation sustains productivity in oligotrophic oceans and is now also thought to contribute substantially to the nitrogen supply in the warming Arctic. Here we demonstrate significant N2 fixation by particle-associated diazotrophs in subsurface waters of the Barents Sea. Comparing our findings with subtropical studies reveals particle-associated non-cyanobacterial diazotrophs as the primary N2 fixers in subsurface Arctic waters of the Barents Sea, contrasting with diverse communities in warmer regions. As the Arctic shifts towards oligotrophication, understanding the magnitude and controls of particle-associated N2 fixation will provide critical insights into future nitrogen supply required to sustain productivity in the rapidly changing Arctic Ocean. However, particle-associated N2 fixation may be a distinctive feature of the Barents Sea, where in contrast to other Arctic shelves the seasonal and long-term trends in nitrogen dynamics are heterogeneously determined by changes in the external Atlantic Water supply, sea-ice extent, and terrestrial inputs. In this context, the role of particle-associated N2 fixation across the wider Arctic Ocean will require further investigation.
title_zh: 颗粒相关的固氮菌驱动巴伦支海北极地下水的固氮
abstract_zh: 生物二氮（N2）固定维持了贫营养海洋的生产力，现在也被认为对变暖的北极的氮供应做出了重大贡献。在这里，我们证明了巴伦支海地下水中与颗粒相关的固氮生物对 N2 的显着固定。将我们的研究结果与亚热带研究进行比较，发现与颗粒相关的非蓝藻固氮菌是巴伦支海北极次表层水域中主要的氮固定剂，与温暖地区的不同群落形成鲜明对比。随着北极向贫营养化转变，了解与颗粒相关的氮固定的程度和控制将为维持快速变化的北冰洋生产力所需的未来氮供应提供重要见解。然而，与颗粒相关的氮固定可能是巴伦支海的一个显着特征，与其他北极陆架相比，氮动态的季节性和长期趋势是由外部大西洋供水、海冰范围和陆地输入的变化异质性决定的。在这种情况下，整个北冰洋与颗粒相关的氮气固定的作用将需要进一步研究。

title: Elevated CO2 and warming intensify plant reliance on soil nitrogen reserves despite intensive fertilization
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how ecosystems sustain plant nitrogen (N) supply under climate change is critical, yet whether increasing plant N demand is met by external inputs or mobilization of soil N reserves remains unresolved. Here we show that climate change increases plant reliance on soil N reserves despite intensive fertilization. Using a two-year 15N-tracing experiment combining elevated CO2, warming, and drought in a montane grassland, we found that plants obtained 82–88% of their N from soil and acquired 4.6–7.3 times more N from soil than from fertilizer despite high N inputs. Elevated CO2 and warming increased plant uptake of soil-derived N but not fertilizer N. Consequently, plant N export exceeded fertilizer inputs, causing ecosystem N deficits and depletion of soil N stocks, with the strongest soil N mining under combined elevated CO2 and warming. Our findings reveal that climate change accelerates biological mining of soil N reserves, potentially constraining the long-term sustainability of intensively managed agroecosystems.
title_zh: 尽管大量施肥，但二氧化碳浓度升高和变暖加剧了植物对土壤氮储备的依赖
abstract_zh: 了解生态系统如何在气候变化下维持植物氮（N）供应至关重要，但是否通过外部投入或动员土壤氮储备来满足植物氮需求的增加仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们表明，尽管密集施肥，气候变化仍增加了植物对土壤氮储备的依赖。通过在山地草原上结合二氧化碳升高、变暖和干旱进行的为期两年的 15N 追踪实验，我们发现植物从土壤中获取了 82-88% 的氮，并且尽管氮输入量较高，但从土壤中获取的氮是从肥料中获取的氮的 4.6-7.3 倍。二氧化碳浓度升高和气候变暖增加了植物对土壤源氮的吸收，但不增加肥料氮的吸收。因此，植物氮输出超过化肥输入，导致生态系统氮赤字和土壤氮储量枯竭，在二氧化碳浓度升高和变暖的共同作用下，土壤氮开采最为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，气候变化加速了土壤氮储量的生物开采，可能限制集约化管理的农业生态系统的长期可持续性。

title: Neuronal dynamics, timing, and flow of sensory and choice-related information in auditory-prefrontal circuitry
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Auditory decision-making requires transforming sensory inputs into meaningful choices by integrating external stimuli with internal cognitive processes. Classical hierarchical models propose sequential processing, where primary sensory areas relay sensory information to higher-order regions that compute decision-related processes. However, whether this sequential hierarchy fully captures cortical dynamics remains unclear. Here, we analyzed simultaneous neuronal recordings from primary auditory cortex (A1) and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (PFC) in two male macaque monkeys performing a spatial auditory decision-making task. Our analyses revealed a clear temporal hierarchy: sensory information was unidirectionally transferred from A1 to PFC, while decision-related information exhibited a bidirectional transfer, first from PFC to A1, and crucially back from A1 to PFC. These findings extend classical hierarchical assumptions, demonstrating a recurrent loop between A1 and PFC during decision-making, and offer a dynamic perspective on the integration of sensory and cognitive processes in the cerebral cortex.
title_zh: 听觉前额叶回路中感觉和选择相关信息的神经元动力学、时序和流动
abstract_zh: 听觉决策需要通过将外部刺激与内部认知过程相结合，将感官输入转化为有意义的选择。经典的分层模型提出了顺序处理，其中主要感觉区域将感觉信息传递到计算决策相关过程的高阶区域。然而，这种顺序层次结构是否完全捕捉皮质动态仍不清楚。在这里，我们分析了两只执行空间听觉决策任务的雄性猕猴的初级听觉皮层（A1）和背外侧前额叶皮层（PFC）的同步神经元记录。我们的分析揭示了一个清晰的时间层次结构：感觉信息从 A1 单向传输到 PFC，而决策相关信息则呈现双向传输，首先从 PFC 到 A1，最重要的是从 A1 返回到 PFC。这些发现扩展了经典的层次假设，证明了决策过程中 A1 和 PFC 之间的循环循环，并为大脑皮层中感觉和认知过程的整合提供了动态视角。

title: Immune protection and persistence in Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections by pyruvate cross-feeding
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Chronic infections by Pseudomonas aeruginosa in people with cystic fibrosis are characterized by persistent inflammation and oxidative stress, yet the mechanisms enabling bacterial persistence are not fully understood. Here, we identify a persistence mechanism mediated by pyruvate secretion resulting from mutations in the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex in clinical isolates of P. aeruginosa, with putative analogous mutations also identified in Staphylococcus aureus, Haemophilus influenzae and Stenotrophomonas maltophilia. These mutations lead to elevated extracellular pyruvate, which dampens host inflammatory responses and favors bacterial persistence. Pyruvate exerts multiple roles: scavenges reactive oxygen species such as H2O2, suppresses host immune activation both in airway epithelial cells and macrophages, and increases bacterial survival during phagocytosis. This metabolic crosstalk promotes bacterial persistence while reducing epithelial and macrophage inflammatory responses. Our findings reveal pyruvate as a bacterial immunometabolite that mimics host antioxidant defenses, reshaping the infection niche to favor long-term colonization. This work highlights the broader role of secreted metabolites in host-pathogen interactions and suggests new strategies targeting metabolic pathways to manage chronic infections.
title_zh: 丙酮酸交叉喂养对铜绿假单胞菌感染的免疫保护和持久性
abstract_zh: 囊性纤维化患者的铜绿假单胞菌慢性感染的特点是持续炎症和氧化应激，但细菌持续存在的机制尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定了铜绿假单胞菌临床分离株中丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物突变导致的丙酮酸分泌介导的持久机制，在金黄色葡萄球菌、流感嗜血杆菌和嗜麦芽寡养单胞菌中也发现了推定的类似突变。这些突变导致细胞外丙酮酸升高，从而抑制宿主炎症反应并有利于细菌的持久存在。丙酮酸发挥多种作用：清除 H2O2 等活性氧，抑制气道上皮细胞和巨噬细胞中的宿主免疫激活，并增加吞噬过程中细菌的存活率。这种代谢串扰促进细菌的持久存在，同时减少上皮细胞和巨噬细胞的炎症反应。我们的研究结果表明，丙酮酸是一种细菌免疫代谢物，可以模仿宿主的抗氧化防御，重塑感染生态位以有利于长期定植。这项工作强调了分泌代谢物在宿主-病原体相互作用中的更广泛作用，并提出了针对代谢途径来管理慢性感染的新策略。

title: SBRT embedded in low-dose RT plus αPD-1 (immuno-EclipseRT, iERT) elicits CD8+ T cell immunity against bulky tumors via an IFN-I/NK/DC axis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Bulky tumors remain challenging to treat, and immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), alone or combined with conventional radiotherapy (RT), yield limited efficacy. We present EclipseRT (ERT), an RT technique that delivers low-dose RT (LDRT) to the gross tumor volume (GTV) and stereotactic body RT (SBRT) to selected subvolume(s) within the GTV. Combined with ICIs (iERT), this approach achieves marked control of bulky tumors through the coordinated activity of NK and CD8⁺ T cells. Single-cell RNA sequencing and validation experiments show that the SBRT component robustly induces type I interferon (IFN-I), which activates NK cells to secrete XCL1, thereby recruiting cross-presenting XCR1⁺ dendritic cells (DCs). SBRT also promotes the release of extracellular vesicles carrying neoantigens, enhancing DC cross-presentation and CD8⁺ T-cell responses. The LDRT component further promotes NK and CD8⁺ T-cell recruitment. iERT also induces precursor exhausted CD8⁺ T cells in tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes. Collectively, iERT activates the IFN-I/NK/DC/CD8⁺ T-cell axis, driving potent antitumor immunity against bulky tumors.
title_zh: 嵌入低剂量 RT 加 αPD-1（immuno-EclipseRT、iERT）中的 SBRT 通过 IFN-I/NK/DC 轴引发针对大型肿瘤的 CD8+ T 细胞免疫
abstract_zh: 大块肿瘤的治疗仍然具有挑战性，单独使用免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）或与传统放疗（RT）联合使用的疗效有限。我们提出了 EclipseRT (ERT)，这是一种 RT 技术，可将低剂量 RT (LDRT) 递送至大体肿瘤体积 (GTV)，并将立体定向体 RT (SBRT) 递送至 GTV 内的选定子体积。与 ICI (iERT) 相结合，该方法通过 NK 和 CD8⁺ T 细胞的协调活性实现对大体积肿瘤的显着控制。单细胞 RNA 测序和验证实验表明，SBRT 成分可强力诱导 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I)，从而激活 NK 细胞分泌 XCL1，从而招募交叉呈递的 XCR1⁺ 树突状细胞 (DC)。 SBRT 还促进携带新抗原的细胞外囊泡的释放，增强 DC 交叉呈递和 CD8⁺ T 细胞反应。 LDRT 成分进一步促进 NK 和 CD8⁺ T 细胞招募。 iERT 还在肿瘤和肿瘤引流淋巴结中诱导前体耗尽的 CD8⁺ T 细胞。总的来说，iERT 激活 IFN-I/NK/DC/CD8⁺ T 细胞轴，驱动针对大体积肿瘤的有效抗肿瘤免疫。

title: System-level assessment of dynamic reconfiguration for lifetime and cost outcomes in electric vehicle battery packs
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The electrification of transport relies heavily on lithium-ion batteries, yet conventional fixed-configuration battery packs suffer from structural inefficiencies such as cell-to-cell variability and premature failure. Dynamic battery reconfiguration, enabled by intelligent control of switching hardware around individual cells, provides an alternative pack architecture. Here we present a systematic, battery technology-agnostic evaluation of the lifetime and economic benefits of reconfigurable battery packs using a statistically grounded framework based on detailed cell modelling across diverse design and usage conditions. We show that reconfigurable battery packs can extend battery lifetime by over 20%, particularly in high-voltage applications such as electric trucks and long-range passenger vehicles. Despite higher upfront costs, reconfigurable packs can reduce lifetime cost by deferring replacements and retaining greater residual value. A sensitivity analysis identifies robust thresholds for economic viability: battery capacities above approximately 50 kWh, annual driving distances below 12,150 km, and additional upfront costs under 7.16%. These findings position dynamic reconfiguration as a scalable, cost-optimised architecture for next-generation battery platforms, and provide a quantitative foundation for future hardware design, management software, and life-cycle sustainability assessments.
title_zh: 电动汽车电池组寿命和成本结果动态重新配置的系统级评估
abstract_zh: 交通运输的电气化在很大程度上依赖于锂离子电池，但传统的固定配置电池组存在结构效率低下的问题，例如电池之间的可变性和过早失效。通过对各个电池周围的开关硬件进行智能控制来实现动态电池重新配置，提供了另一种电池组架构。在这里，我们使用基于统计的框架，基于跨不同设计和使用条件的详细电池建模，对可重构电池组的寿命和经济效益进行了系统的、与电池技术无关的评估。我们证明，可重构电池组可以将电池寿命延长 20% 以上，特别是在电动卡车和远程乘用车等高压应用中。尽管前期成本较高，但可重新配置的电池组可以通过推迟更换并保留更大的剩余价值来降低生命周期成本。敏感性分析确定了经济可行性的稳健阈值：电池容量高于约 50 kWh，年行驶距离低于 12,150 公里，额外前期成本低于 7.16%。这些发现将动态重新配置定位为下一代电池平台的可扩展、成本优化的架构，并为未来的硬件设计、管理软件和生命周期可持续性评估提供了定量基础。

title: Translation initiation by the Kozak mRNA sequence is based on a conformational readout on the ribosome
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The recognition mechanism of Kozak mRNA, typically comprising purines in the −3 and +4 positions flanking the AUG start codon, has remained enigmatic for decades. To address this fundamental function in eukaryotes during translation initiation, we analysed several cryo-EM structures of human 48S preinitiation complexes with mRNA sequences differing in Kozak activity revealing distinct modes of recognition. The pre-codon triplet forms a fan-like intercalation into the 18S ribosomal RNA (rRNA), while a −3 pyrimidine destabilizes ternary complex positioning. Specificity towards the +4 purine is achieved beyond a single residue recognition by mutual conformational adaptations of eIF1A, mRNA and rRNA that involve the insertion of a reading head in which decoding residue A1825 (rRNA) stacks with the A-site codon to stabilize the fully accommodated state. Hence, instead of relying on base pairing as in bacteria, the specific recognition of the Kozak sequence on eukaryotic ribosomes is based on an induced-fit mechanism that triggers a conformational readout of the mRNA.
title_zh: Kozak mRNA 序列的翻译起始基于核糖体上的构象读数
abstract_zh: Kozak mRNA（通常在 AUG 起始密码子两侧的 -3 和 +4 位点包含嘌呤）的识别机制几十年来一直是个谜。为了解决真核生物在翻译起始过程中的这一基本功能，我们分析了人类 48S 起始复合物的几种冷冻电镜结构，其中 mRNA 序列的 Kozak 活性不同，揭示了不同的识别模式。前密码子三联体在 18S 核糖体 RNA (rRNA) 中形成扇形嵌入，而 -3 嘧啶使三元复合物定位不稳定。对 +4 嘌呤的特异性是通过 eIF1A、mRNA 和 rRNA 的相互构象适应实现的，超出了单个残基识别的范围，其中涉及插入读取头，其中解码残基 A1825 (rRNA) 与 A 位密码子堆叠以稳定完全适应状态。因此，真核核糖体上 Kozak 序列的特异性识别不是像细菌那样依赖碱基配对，而是基于诱导拟合机制，该机制触发 mRNA 的构象读出。

title: Intergenerational mobility fosters innovation in Europe
source: Nature
abstract: The circumstances into which individuals are born can place fundamental constraints on their future economic opportunities1,2,3,4,5, leading to a mismatch between talent, education and occupation. One major determinant of this inequality of opportunity is the absence of intergenerational educational mobility2. Here we extend existing knowledge on intergenerational mobility by presenting The European Atlas of Spatially Disaggregated Intergenerational Mobility (EUROPE-IGM-ATLAS), a panel database comprising indicators of intergenerational mobility for European subnational regions. In doing so, we make two contributions. First, we extend existing knowledge on the development of intergenerational mobility in European regions. The EUROPE-IGM-ATLAS reveals several spatiotemporal trends that characterize the changing geography of opportunity in Europe. For example, we show that observed increases in intergenerational mobility primarily stem from improvements in educational achievements among individuals from families at the lower end of the educational distribution, with fewer changes in rank across the educational spectrum. However, these increases are not uniformly distributed. Regions with a high degree of educational inequality also exhibit lower levels of intergenerational mobility, implying the co-existence of inequality both within and between generations. Second, we use this database to provide evidence on the relationship between intergenerational mobility and innovation. We provide large-scale time-series evidence that European regions with higher intergenerational mobility achieve higher innovation outcomes, one important driver of economic growth. Subsets of results further indicate that this relationship is nonlinear and that distinct mechanisms operate in major innovation hubs.

title: Understanding and engineering electrocatalyst durability
source: Nature Reviews Materials
abstract: Electrochemical devices such as fuel cells and electrolysers are pivotal to a sustainable energy future, but their commercial viability depends on electrocatalyst stability — a challenge as critical as achieving high catalytic activity. Materials scientists, chemists and engineers need strategies to design catalysts that maintain high performance under demanding real-world conditions. This Review addresses that need by bridging the latest fundamental understanding of nanostructured catalysts with practical application guidelines, offering timely insights into the chemical and structural principles governing catalyst stability — factors that ultimately dictate reliability, longevity and cost effectiveness. We begin by examining how chemical potential drives stability, exploring intrinsic engineering tactics — spanning composition, crystallinity and morphology — as well as extrinsic strategies such as encapsulation, adhesion and microenvironment optimization that protect electrocatalysts under harsh operating conditions. Building on this foundation, we highlight the need for advanced in situ or operando tools that can capture electrocatalyst behaviour in action, thereby enabling further understanding and guiding the engineering of catalyst stability. We conclude with a forward-looking perspective on emerging directions, from stability descriptors to machine learning, that promise to elevate electrocatalyst activity and stability even further. By placing stability at the forefront, this Review hopes to provide a comprehensive perspective for academia and industry, accelerating the development and deployment of robust, economically viable electrocatalysts to facilitate broader adoption of clean energy.
title_zh: 了解和设计电催化剂的耐久性
abstract_zh: 燃料电池和电解槽等电化学装置对于可持续能源的未来至关重要，但它们的商业可行性取决于电催化剂的稳定性——这是一个与实现高催化活性同样重要的挑战。材料科学家、化学家和工程师需要策略来设计在苛刻的现实条件下保持高性能的催化剂。本综述通过将对纳米结构催化剂的最新基本理解与实际应用指南联系起来，及时洞察控制催化剂稳定性的化学和结构原理（最终决定可靠性、寿命和成本效益的因素）来满足这一需求。我们首先研究化学势如何驱动稳定性，探索内在的工程策略（涵盖组成、结晶度和形态）以及外在策略，例如在恶劣操作条件下保护电催化剂的封装、粘附和微环境优化。在此基础上，我们强调需要先进的原位或操作工具来捕获电催化剂的行为行为，从而能够进一步理解和指导催化剂稳定性的工程。最后，我们对从稳定性描述符到机器学习的新兴方向提出了前瞻性的观点，这些方向有望进一步提高电催化剂的活性和稳定性。通过将稳定放在首位，本次审查希望为学术界和工业界提供全面的视角，加速

title: Linoleic acid accelerates osteoarthritis progression in male rats by targeting iron-sulfur clusters to drive ferroptosis in chondrocytes
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The development of osteoarthritis (OA) is accompanied by various metabolic disorders, highlighting the need for further investigation into metabolism-related pathogenesis and targeted therapeutic strategies. Herein, we found that linoleic acid (LA), the most abundant essential fatty acid in the diet, accumulates in the blood, synovial fluid, and cartilage tissue of elderly and OA individuals. Notably, LA not only induces ferroptosis in chondrocytes, but it also serves as a risk metabolite, driving OA onset and accelerating the progression of traumatic OA in male rat models. Mechanistically, LA can directly bind to iron-sulfur cluster assembly enzyme (ISCU) to induce its autophagic degradation and inhibit iron-sulfur cluster synthesis, which subsequently activates IRP1-mediated translational regulation to drive the ferroptosis process. Furthermore, upregulating or supplementing ISCU in cartilage tissue contributes to mitigating LA accumulation and trauma-induced OA progression, and this strategy can further enhance the therapeutic efficacy of moderate exercise in OA treatment by effectively inhibiting ferroptosis. Taken together, our findings identify LA as a key metabolite involved in the onset and progression of OA by driving ferroptosis and propose a targeted therapeutic strategy based on ISCU supplementation.
title_zh: 亚油酸通过靶向铁硫簇驱动软骨细胞铁死亡加速雄性大鼠骨关节炎的进展
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）的发展伴随着各种代谢紊乱，突出需要进一步研究代谢相关的发病机制和针对性的治疗策略。在此，我们发现亚油酸（LA）是饮食中最丰富的必需脂肪酸，在老年人和骨关节炎个体的血液、滑液和软骨组织中积累。值得注意的是，LA 不仅诱导软骨细胞铁死亡，而且还作为一种风险代谢物，在雄性大鼠模型中驱动 OA 发病并加速创伤性 OA 的进展。从机制上讲，LA可以直接与铁硫簇组装酶（ISCU）结合，诱导其自噬降解并抑制铁硫簇合成，随后激活IRP1介导的翻译调节以驱动铁死亡过程。此外，上调或补充软骨组织中的 ISCU 有助于减轻 LA 积累和创伤诱导的 OA 进展，该策略可以通过有效抑制铁死亡来进一步增强适度运动在 OA 治疗中的治疗效果。总而言之，我们的研究结果确定 LA 是通过驱动铁死亡而参与 OA 发生和进展的关键代谢物，并提出了基于 ISCU 补充剂的靶向治疗策略。

title: Genetically targeted photocatalytic organic dyes for spatiotemporally controlled organic synthesis in specific living cells
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract: The catalytic synthesis of many abiotic organic compounds is beyond the native capabilities of mammalian cells. Broadening the range of physiologically compatible, bond-forming catalytic reactions could enable the in situ synthesis of diverse molecules within living systems. By controlling these reactions in both specific cells and in physical space, this approach could offer transformative ways to modulate cellular behaviour and treat cells as distinct reaction vessels within organisms. Here we use genetic targeting to incorporate organic photocatalytic dyes onto and within cells to enable cell-type-specific and spatially defined catalysis. Photocatalysis can be restricted to individual cells using mild, green-to-red visible stimulation. The dyes catalyse cross-dehydrogenative C–H functionalization for the light- and cell-specific construction of C–C bonds in situ. Nuclear-localized assembly directs protein translocation with reversed transport directionality, illustrating the utility of this approach to both generate and enhance the function of chemical biology tools. We anticipate that the integration of synthetic catalysts with cell-specific targeting may lay an important foundation for future precision-directed abiotic chemical synthesis in living organisms.
title_zh: 基因靶向光催化有机染料用于特定活细胞中时空控制的有机合成
abstract_zh: 许多非生物有机化合物的催化合成超出了哺乳动物细胞的天然能力。扩大生理相容性成键催化反应的范围可以使生命系统内不同分子的原位合成成为可能。通过控制特定细胞和物理空间中的这些反应，这种方法可以提供调节细胞行为的变革性方法，并将细胞视为生物体内不同的反应容器。在这里，我们使用基因靶向将有机光催化染料掺入细胞上和细胞内，以实现细胞类型特异性和空间限定的催化。使用温和的、从绿色到红色的可见光刺激，可以将光催化作用限制在单个细胞上。该染料催化交叉脱氢 C-H 官能化，以实现光和细胞特异性的 C-C 键原位构建。核定位组装以反向运输方向指导蛋白质易位，说明了这种方法在生成和增强化学生物学工具功能方面的实用性。我们预计，合成催化剂与细胞特异性靶向的整合可能为未来生物体中精确定向的非生物化学合成奠定重要基础。

title: Palladium-Catalyzed Enantioselective C–H Activation Reaction of Undirected Arenes with Cyclopentenes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Although directed C-H activation has revolutionized organic synthesis, the asymmetric functionalization of arenes in the absence of directing groups remains a formidable challenge. Here we show that a palladium-catalyzed C-H activation reaction enables the enantioselective coupling of undirected arenes and heteroarenes with cyclopentene derivatives. Facilitated by a class of readily accessible chiral pyridone-oxazoline ligands, this protocol promotes efficient C(sp2)-H activation to generate the products featuring two stereocenters with excellent stereocontrol (up to 96% ee and 40:1 dr).
title_zh: 钯催化无向芳烃与环戊烯的对映选择性 C-H 活化反应
abstract_zh: 尽管定向 C-H 活化已经彻底改变了有机合成，但在没有定向基团的情况下芳烃的不对称官能化仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们表明，钯催化的 C-H 活化反应能够实现无向芳烃和杂芳烃与环戊烯衍生物的对映选择性偶联。在一类易于获得的手性吡啶酮-恶唑啉配体的促进下，该方案可促进有效的 C(sp2)-H 活化，生成具有两个立体中心且具有出色立体控制的产品（高达 96% ee 和 40:1 dr）。

title: Biomimetic Redox-Mediated Proton Relay in Nanoreactors for Photocatalysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Mimicking the hierarchical compartmentalization and proton pump machinery of living cells in synthetic nanomaterials offers a promising route for sustainable photocatalysis. Here, we report a hollow CdS@polydopamine nanoreactor that integrates two biomimetic features: (i) A dynamic catechol/o-benzoquinone redox pair in the polydopamine shell that functions as a proton relay (rather than an active pump), accelerating proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) by reversibly donating and accepting protons, and (ii) compartmentalized nanoreactor architecture comprising a porous shell-defined nanoscale cavity that creates confined microenvironments for mass diffusion, reactant enrichment, and photon trapping. This synergistic integration concurrently promotes both oxygen reduction and water oxidation half-reactions, achieving a record H2O2 photosynthesis rate (3.24 mmol gcat.-1 h-1) in aqueous solution under visible-light illumination, with a solar-to-chemical conversion efficiency of 1.2%. The combination of in situ spectroscopy, photochemical analysis, finite element simulations, and theoretical calculations visualizes the biomimetic machinery and elucidates the photocatalytic mechanism. Furthermore, encapsulation within an environmentally benign sodium alginate hydrogel matrix yields monolithic and recyclable photocatalysts capable of stable H2O2 synthesis under natural sunlight. This work will inspire a new generation of biomimetic nanomaterials that increasingly replicate the sophistication of living cells, opening frontiers in photosynthesis, energy catalysis, and synthetic chemistry.
title_zh: 光催化纳米反应器中仿生氧化还原介导的质子中继
abstract_zh: 在合成纳米材料中模仿活细胞的分层分区和质子泵机制为可持续光催化提供了一条有前途的途径。在这里，我们报告了一种中空的CdS@聚多巴胺纳米反应器，它集成了两个仿生特征：（i）聚多巴胺壳中的动态儿茶酚/邻苯醌氧化还原对充当质子继电器（而不是主动泵），通过可逆地给予和接受质子来加速质子耦合电子转移（PCET），以及（ii）划分的纳米反应器结构，包括多孔壳定义的纳米级空腔，可产生有限的空间用于质量扩散、反应物富集和光子捕获的微环境。这种协同整合同时促进了氧还原和水氧化半反应，在可见光照射下在水溶液中实现了创纪录的H2O2光合作用速率（3.24 mmol gcat.-1 h-1），太阳能到化学的转化效率为1.2%。原位光谱、光化学分析、有限元模拟和理论计算相结合，使仿生机械可视化并阐明光催化机制。此外，封装在环境友好的海藻酸钠水凝胶基质中可产生整体式且可回收的光催化剂，能够在自然阳光下稳定合成 H2O2。这项工作将激发新一代仿生纳米材料的开发，这种材料将越来越多地复制活细胞的复杂性，开辟光合作用、能量催化和合成化学领域的前沿。

title: The forest of knowledge under global change
source: Nature
abstract: Amazonia harbours more than 10% of the terrestrial biodiversity of the Earth1 and more than 400 Indigenous groups2. So far, however, no study has assessed how climate change and the loss of Indigenous languages may simultaneously impact its biological and cultural heritage. Here, to bridge this gap, we first assembled a database of 90,536 reports from 700 references to understand the societal benefits that native plants provide across all countries of the Amazon basin. We found that humans utilize 5,796 native plant species, which amounts to one-third of the known Amazon vascular seed plant flora. Next, analysing 8,429 species distribution models across three future climate scenarios (SSP1–2.6, SSP3–7.0 and SSP5–8.5), we show that climate change will produce a greater reduction in the ranges of utilized than of non-utilized species by 2060–2080. Locally, Indigenous cultures may lose an average of 28–34% of their utilized plant species and 18–23% of their associated services from climate change. Regionally, the loss of threatened Indigenous languages may result in a 26% reduction in the Amazonian knowledge pool. Overall, our results point to the strong climate and language vulnerability of Amazonian biocultural heritage. At the same time, these results—together with our publicly available dataset—may serve to guide biocultural restoration and reverse the growing global change effects on ecosystems and cultural traditions.
title_zh: 全球变化下的知识森林
abstract_zh: 亚马逊流域拥有地球 10% 以上的陆地生物多样性1和 400 多个土著群体2。然而，到目前为止，还没有研究评估气候变化和土著语言的丧失如何同时影响其生物和文化遗产。为了弥补这一差距，我们首先收集了来自 700 份参考资料的 90,536 份报告的数据库，以了解本土植物为亚马逊流域所有国家提供的社会效益。我们发现人类利用了 5,796 种本土植物，占已知的亚马逊维管种子植物区系的三分之一。接下来，通过分析三种未来气候情景（SSP1-2.6、SSP3-7.0 和 SSP5-8.5）的 8,429 个物种分布模型，我们发现，到 2060 年至 2080 年，气候变化将导致利用物种范围比未利用物种范围出现更大的减少。在当地，由于气候变化，原住民文化可能会平均损失 28-34% 的利用植物物种和 18-23% 的相关服务。从区域来看，受威胁的土著语言的消失可能会导致亚马逊知识库减少 26%。总体而言，我们的结果表明亚马逊生物文化遗产在气候和语言方面存在严重脆弱性。与此同时，这些结果与我们公开的数据集可能有助于指导生物文化恢复并扭转全球变化对生态系统和文化传统日益严重的影响。

title: Plant-soil feedbacks benefit plant invaders under multiple global change factors
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Plant-soil feedbacks (PSFs) are an important mechanism determining plant community dynamics and invasion by non-native species. While the individual responses of plants and soil microbes to multiple concurrent global change factors (GCFs) have been documented, it remains poorly understood how multiple GCFs affect PSFs and, particularly, whether this effect depends on plant origin. We conducted a PSF experiment with five pairs of native and alien species and nine GCFs applied in concurrent combinations of 0, 1, 3 and 6 GCFs. As GCF-number increased, PSFs shifted from negative to neutral or positive in native species, but were consistently positive and became stronger in alien species. The positive response of PSFs to multiple GCFs was due to specific interactions between co-acting GCFs in native species, but not in alien species, and was related to changes in soil mutualists. Our study highlights that PSFs could promote the spread of alien species under multiple concurrent GCFs.
title_zh: 在多种全球变化因素下，植物-土壤反馈有利于植物入侵者
abstract_zh: 植物-土壤反馈（PSF）是决定植物群落动态和非本地物种入侵的重要机制。虽然植物和土壤微生物对多个同时发生的全球变化因素 (GCF) 的个体反应已被记录，但人们仍然对多个 GCF 如何影响 PSF 知之甚少，特别是这种影响是否取决于植物起源。我们对五对本地和外来物种以及 9 个 GCF 进行了 PSF 实验，并同时组合了 0、1、3 和 6 个 GCF。随着 GCF 数量的增加，本地物种中的 PSF 从负值转变为中性或正值，但外来物种中的 PSF 始终为正值并且变得更强。 PSF 对多个 GCF 的积极反应是由于本地物种中共同作用的 GCF 之间的特定相互作用，而不是外来物种中的相互作用，并且与土壤互利共生体的变化有关。我们的研究强调，PSF 可以在多个并发的 GCF 下促进外来物种的传播。
