title: Self-single-atomization of active sites in electrochemical ammonia synthesis unveiled by machine learning potential
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Electrochemical NO reduction reaction (eNORR) has emerged as a promising route for the synthesis of green ammonia. Fe was observed experimentally with great activity and selectivity for eNORR to ammonia. However, we found the electrochemical performance over iron is not due to its intrinsic activity, but from an adaptive capability of self-single-atomization in operando condition. We first performed Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations driven by a machine learning potential (MLP), where we explored ∼2.5 million possible active structures and their evolution with increased electrode potential. Microkinetic modelling indicates that Fe surface will be predominantly covered by adsorbed N* species in reaction, resulting in the formation of FeNx motifs by self-single-atomizing. Statistical results indicate that the top sites of isolated FeNx motifs contribute higher activity of ammonia synthesis than bridge and hollow sites. Furthermore, based on the self-single-atomized active sites, we reproduced and rationalized the variation trends of experimental Faradaic efficiency of different products with electrode potential, verifying the reliability of proposed active site herein. Hence, we propose to make use of the self-single-atomization capability of catalysts in working conditions to construct active sites beyond ammonia synthesis.
title_zh: 机器学习潜力揭示电化学氨合成中活性位点的自单原子化
abstract_zh: 电化学NO还原反应（eNORR）已成为合成绿色氨的一种有前景的途径。实验观察到 Fe 对 eNORR 对氨具有很高的活性和选择性。然而，我们发现铁的电化学性能并不是由于其固有活性，而是源于操作条件下自单原子化的自适应能力。我们首先进行了由机器学习势 (MLP) 驱动的大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC) 模拟，其中我们探索了约 250 万种可能的活性结构及其随电极势增加而演化的情况。微动力学模型表明，Fe 表面将主要被反应中吸附的 N* 物质覆盖，从而通过自单原子化形成 FeNx 基序。统计结果表明，孤立的 FeNx 基序的顶部位点比桥位和空心位点贡献更高的氨合成活性。此外，基于自单原子化活性位点，我们再现并合理化了不同产品的实验法拉第效率随电极电位的变化趋势，验证了本文提出的活性位点的可靠性。因此，我们建议利用催化剂在工作条件下的自单原子化能力来构建氨合成以外的活性位点。

title: A ferroelectric-induced few-nm-thick graphene membrane enables molecular sliding for ultra-fast separation
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Graphene’s atomically smooth surface offers a promising platform for achieving superlubricity, not only in solid-state contacts but also in mass transport. While its ability to minimize interfacial friction has been extensively explored in microelectromechanical systems, engines, and biomedical implants, harnessing this property for near-frictionless molecular flow to enable ultra-fast permeation remains a fundamental challenge. The principal limitation lies in the fabrication of defect-free graphene membranes with an exposed surface for probing intrinsic molecular friction and the associated transport phenomena. Here, we demonstrate a ferroelectric-polarization-assisted strategy for fabricating a 3.5 nm-thick graphene skin membrane for ultra-fast and selective separation. This is achieved by electrospinning a graphene oxide (GO)-poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) mixture, followed by thermal reduction. The crucial step involves the electric-field-induced transition of PVDF from the paraelectric (α) to the ferroelectric (β) phase, which promotes ordered chain packing and reduces the polymer’s affinity for GO, thereby driving the spontaneous segregation of GO to the PVDF nanofiber surface. The resulting graphene surface minimizes interfacial interactions with permeating molecules, reducing the molecular flow friction coefficient by 2–3 orders of magnitude. Acting either a selective layer or a support, the membrane exhibits ultra-fast permeation of water and organic solvents, surpassing current state-of-the-art membranes for water and solvent purification. For instance, water flux up to 105.1 L m-2 h-1, salt rejection of > 99.99% and long-term stability of 1000 h are achieved for desalination of hypersaline with salt concentration >150 g L-1. This work establishes a new paradigm for realizing ultra-fast molecular transport and provides a versatile platform for investigating nanoscale fluidics at material interfaces.
title_zh: 铁电诱导的几纳米厚的石墨烯膜能够实现分子滑动以实现超快速分离

title: Threonine Phosphorylation Is a Bioreversible Surrogate of Proline Hydroxylation in a Collagen Triple Helix
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Collagen, the most abundant protein in the human body and structural foundation of connective tissue, derives its remarkable stability from repeating (Xaa-Yaa-Gly)n sequences rich in (2S)-proline (Pro) and (2S,4R)-4-hydroxyproline (Hyp), the product of a post-translational modification. Here, we demonstrate that another such modification, phosphorylation, yields a bioreversible mimic of Hyp. Using synthetic collagen-mimetic peptides, we substituted the Xaa or Yaa position of a central Pro-Hyp-Gly triplet with (2S)-serine (Ser), (2S,3R)-threonine (Thr), or their O-phosphorylated derivatives, pSer or pThr. All substitutions were destabilizing─except pThr in the Yaa position, which preserved the triple-helical stability conferred by Hyp. Moreover, pThr within a collagen triple helix is a substrate for a mammalian secretory phosphatase. Notably, Thr is enriched at the Yaa position in mammalian fibrillar collagens, consistent with pThr being a linchpin of collagen remodeling in the extracellular matrix. Thus, the phosphorylation of threonine (which is bioreversible) mimics the hydroxylation of proline (which is not), enabling dynamic modulation of collagen architecture in development and disease.
title_zh: 苏氨酸磷酸化是胶原三螺旋中脯氨酸羟基化的生物可逆替代物
abstract_zh: 胶原蛋白是人体内最丰富的蛋白质，也是结缔组织的结构基础，其卓越的稳定性源自富含 (2S)-脯氨酸 (Pro) 和 (2S,4R)-4-羟脯氨酸 (Hyp)（翻译后修饰产物）的重复 (Xaa-Yaa-Gly)n 序列。在这里，我们证明了另一种这样的修饰，磷酸化，产生了 Hyp 的生物可逆模拟物。使用合成的胶原模拟肽，我们用 (2S)-丝氨酸 (Ser)、(2S,3R)-苏氨酸 (Thr) 或其 O-磷酸化衍生物 pSer 或 pThr 取代中心 Pro-Hyp-Gly 三联体的 Xaa 或 Yaa 位置。所有取代都不稳定——除了Yaa位置的pThr，它保留了Hyp赋予的三螺旋稳定性。此外，胶原蛋白三螺旋内的 pThr 是哺乳动物分泌性磷酸酶的底物。值得注意的是，Thr 在哺乳动物纤维状胶原蛋白的 Yaa 位置富集，这与 pThr 作为细胞外基质中胶原蛋白重塑的关键相一致。因此，苏氨酸的磷酸化（生物可逆）模仿脯氨酸的羟基化（生物可逆），从而能够在发育和疾病中动态调节胶原蛋白结构。

title: Fluorescent Detection of Aqueous N -Nitrosodimethylamine via Photochemical Transformation and Affinity Capture
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: N-Nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA) is a water-soluble carcinogen typically quantified using mass spectrometry coupled with chromatographic separation, which requires extensive sample preparation and sophisticated instrumentation. Here, we report a fluorescence-based detection strategy for NDMA in aqueous media that replaces column-based separation with affinity capture. Photochemical transformation of NDMA, followed by reaction with a biotinylated polymeric reagent, generates a biotin-labeled fluorescent product that can be selectively enriched through streptavidin-biotin interaction, enabling effective separation of the analytical signal from background. The assay is performed entirely in water without sample pretreatment, preconcentration, or solvent exchange. Under optimized conditions, quantitative detection is achieved in a plate-based format using only 100 μL samples, affording a limit of detection of 235 ppb. The chemical transformation is completed within 22 min, followed by rapid affinity capture via streptavidin-coated agarose beads or plates. The method is rigorously validated through spectroscopic characterization, selective capture experiments, and quantitative analysis, and demonstrates consistent performance in spiked commercial water samples. These results establish a chemically defined platform for chromatography-independent optical NDMA detection and provide a basis for further development toward scalable sensing formats built on streptavidin-functionalized solid phases.
title_zh: 通过光化学转化和亲和捕获对水性 N-亚硝基二甲胺进行荧光检测
abstract_zh: N-亚硝基二甲胺 (NDMA) 是一种水溶性致癌物，通常使用质谱法结合色谱分离进行定量，这需要大量的样品制备和复杂的仪器。在这里，我们报告了一种基于荧光的水介质中 NDMA 检测策略，该策略用亲和捕获取代了基于柱的分离。 NDMA 进行光化学转化，然后与生物素化聚合物试剂反应，生成生物素标记的荧光产物，该产物可以通过链霉亲和素-生物素相互作用选择性富集，从而能够有效地将分析信号与背景分离。该测定完全在水中进行，无需样品预处理、预浓缩或溶剂交换。在优化条件下，仅使用 100 μL 样品以基于板的形式实现定量检测，检测限为 235 ppb。化学转化在 22 分钟内完成，然后通过链霉亲和素包被的琼脂糖珠或板进行快速亲和捕获。该方法经过光谱表征、选择性捕获实验和定量分析的严格验证，并在加标的商业水样中表现出一致的性能。这些结果建立了一个化学定义的平台，用于独立于色谱的光学 NDMA 检测，并为进一步开发基于链霉亲和素功能化固相的可扩展传感格式奠定了基础。

title: Geopolymer-based electrolytes derived from industrial solid waste for structural energy storage
source: Joule
abstract: Turning waste into useful infrastructure is central to low-carbon energy storage. This study converts fly ash and slag into a strong, ion-conducting geopolymer electrolyte for zinc-ion brick batteries. By engineering connected pores that guide ions efficiently, the material combines mechanical durability with long-term electrochemical performance, pointing toward building components that can both bear loads and store energy.
title_zh: 来自工业固体废物的地质聚合物电解质用于结构储能
abstract_zh: 将废物转化为有用的基础设施是低碳能源存储的核心。这项研究将飞灰和矿渣转化为用于锌离子砖电池的强离子导电地质聚合物电解质。通过设计有效引导离子的连通孔，该材料将机械耐久性与长期电化学性能结合起来，指向构建既能承受负载又能储存能量的组件。

title: Modular macromolecular design unlocks high-performance silica scale inhibitors
source: Nature Chemical Engineering
abstract: Silica scaling presents a longstanding challenge in industrial water systems, including heat exchangers, pipelines and membrane separation, where uncontrolled polymerization of silicic acid causes irreversible fouling and operational decline. Polymeric antiscalants offer promising mitigation; however, their design remains limited by incomplete molecular-level understanding. Here we introduce a modular synthetic platform that integrates controlled radical polymerization with post-polymerization modification to generate polymeric silica inhibitors with independently tunable chain length, functionality and conformation. Combining computation with experiment, we establish key structure–property relationships governing inhibition performance. We further identify a critical limitation of conventional designs: polymers displaying high inhibition efficiency sometimes aggregate and self-precipitate, compromising stability and long-term efficacy. Guided by these mechanistic insights, we develop inhibitors that sustain above 75% inhibition efficiency without precipitation. In a cooling-tower simulator, these polymers maintained effective silica control and preserved high thermal-transfer efficiency over extended operation. This work provides a molecular design framework for next-generation polymeric antiscalants, advancing scalable strategies for silica mitigation in sustainable water treatment and industrial infrastructure.
title_zh: 模块化大分子设计解锁高性能二氧化硅阻垢剂
abstract_zh: 二氧化硅结垢对工业水系统（包括热交换器、管道和膜分离）提出了长期的挑战，在这些系统中，不受控制的硅酸聚合会导致不可逆的污垢和运行下降。聚合物阻垢剂具有良好的缓解效果；然而，它们的设计仍然受到不完整的分子水平理解的限制。在这里，我们介绍了一个模块化合成平台，该平台将受控自由基聚合与聚合后改性相结合，生成具有独立可调链长、功能和构象的聚合二氧化硅抑制剂。将计算与实验相结合，我们建立了控制抑制性能的关键结构-性质关系。我们进一步确定了传统设计的一个关键限制：表现出高抑制效率的聚合物有时会聚集和自沉淀，从而损害稳定性和长期功效。在这些机制见解的指导下，我们开发了能够维持 75% 以上抑制效率且不产生沉淀的抑制剂。在冷却塔模拟器中，这些聚合物在长时间运行中保持了有效的二氧化硅控制并保持了高传热效率。这项工作为下一代聚合物阻垢剂提供了分子设计框架，推进了可持续水处理和工业基础设施中二氧化硅减排的可扩展策略。

title: Weak Bond, Strong Response: Complete Activation and Efficient Cargo Release with a Furan/Acrylamide Mechanophore
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Mechanophores are force-sensitive molecules that can be activated upon elongation with the help of actuating polymers. Mechanophores have been designed for various applications including force-sensing, catalysis, and the controlled release of functional molecules. However, most of these mechanophores are activated at relatively high forces, sometimes close to the rupture force of the actuating polymers, which limits their applicability in applications requiring a high efficiency and selectivity of activation, such as controlled release. Here, we present a furan/acrylamide mechanophore that can be activated at low force (FCOGEF = 3.0 nN), leading to its complete and selective activation in solution. Complete activation is achieved in a standard sonication bath, eliminating the need for specialized, high-intensity ultrasonic probes. The weakness and versatility of this mechanophore were demonstrated through the controlled release of active molecules in solution with a quantitative efficiency.
title_zh: 弱键，强响应：呋喃/丙烯酰胺机械载体的完全激活和有效的货物释放
abstract_zh: 机械载体是力敏感分子，可以在驱动聚合物的帮助下在伸长时被激活。机械载体被设计用于各种应用，包括力传感、催化和功能分子的受控释放。然而，大多数这些机械载体在相对较高的力下被激活，有时接近致动聚合物的断裂力，这限制了它们在需要高效率和选择性激活的应用中的适用性，例如控制释放。在这里，我们提出了一种可以在低力（FCOGEF = 3.0 nN）下激活的呋喃/丙烯酰胺机械载体，从而使其在溶液中完全且选择性地激活。在标准超声波浴中实现完全激活，无需专门的高强度超声波探头。通过以定量效率控制溶液中活性分子的释放，证明了这种机械载体的弱点和多功能性。

title: SnSe Alloying Enables High Thermoelectric Efficiency in Out-of-Plane PbSnS 2 Crystals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Layered thermoelectrics inherently possess low thermal conductivity along the out-of-plane direction. However, the sluggish interlayer electron transport arising from the distorted rock-salt structure and Pb/Sn cation disorder severely restricts the further enhancement of overall thermoelectric performance in PbSnS2. Herein, this study proposes an effective strategy to synergistically optimize the out-of-plane performance of n-type PbSnS2 via SnSe alloying. The incorporation of SnSe elevates carrier concentration and markedly boosts out-of-plane charge mobility, which can be primarily attributed to the improved lattice symmetry and optimized electronic bands. Additionally, alloying-induced point defects intensify phonon scattering, enabling effective decoupling of electron and phonon transports in n-type PbSnS2 crystals. Experimental results reveal that the optimized n-type (PbSnS2)0.7(SnSe)0.3 achieves a maximum out-of-plane ZT of ∼1.9 at 750 K. Subjected to a temperature gradient of 529 K, the assembled single-leg device exhibits a power generation efficiency of ∼7.9%. Both material and device-level performance stand at the forefront among all reported n-type PbSnS2-based thermoelectrics. This work elucidates a novel pathway for optimizing interlayer charge transport through structural manipulation and underscores the promising prospect of earth-abundant PbSnS2 for medium-temperature power generation.
title_zh: SnSe 合金化使面外 PbSnS 2 晶体具有高热电效率
abstract_zh: 层状热电材料本质上沿面外方向具有低导热率。然而，扭曲的岩盐结构和Pb/Sn阳离子无序引起的层间电子传输缓慢严重限制了PbSnS2整体热电性能的进一步提高。在此，本研究提出了一种通过 SnSe 合金化协同优化 n 型 PbSnS2 面外性能的有效策略。 SnSe 的加入提高了载流子浓度并显着提高了面外电荷迁移率，这主要归因于晶格对称性的改善和电子带的优化。此外，合金化引起的点缺陷会加剧声子散射，从而实现 n 型 PbSnS2 晶体中电子和声子传输的有效解耦。实验结果表明，优化后的n型(PbSnS2)0.7(SnSe)0.3在750 K时实现了最大面外ZT~1.9。在529 K的温度梯度下，组装的单腿装置表现出~7.9%的发电效率。材料和器件级性能在所有已报道的 n 型 PbSnS2 基热电材料中均处于领先地位。这项工作阐明了一种通过结构操纵优化层间电荷传输的新途径，并强调了地球上储量丰富的 PbSnS2 用于中温发电的广阔前景。

title: Residue-Driven Degradation and Its Stabilization in NaCl-Assisted WS 2 with 3R Stacking Enrichment
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Salt-assisted chemical vapor deposition (CVD) enables large-grain synthesis of 2D transition-metal dichalcogenides, yet residual salts at the growth interface remain a critical bottleneck for ambient stability. Here, we investigate NaCl-assisted metal-organic CVD growth of WS2 and reveal a coupled physical-chemical degradation mechanism driven by Na- and W-containing amorphous residues. Upon air exposure, these residues crystallize and mechanically disrupt the WS2 layer while fostering a hygroscopic, Na-rich environment that drives oxidative breakdown of W-S bonds. Kinetic analysis establishes a thermally activated degradation process with an apparent activation energy of ∼0.22 eV, consistent with moisture-driven residue crystallization. We demonstrate that post-growth annealing (PGA) eliminates these residues and preserves the morphological integrity and optical emission characteristics over month-scale ambient storage. Beyond residue elimination, PGA also drives a pronounced 3R stacking enrichment in multilayer overgrowth regions. First-principles calculations reveal that interlayer Na+ thermodynamically favors the 3R registry, so that 3R is selected during the early, Na-rich stage of annealing and kinetically locked once Na+ is removed. These results establish residue management as a central design principle in salt-assisted 2D material synthesis.
title_zh: 3R 堆积富集 NaCl 辅助 WS 2 中残留驱动的降解及其稳定性
abstract_zh: 盐辅助化学气相沉积（CVD）能够实现二维过渡金属二硫属化物的大晶粒合成，但生长界面处的残留盐仍然是环境稳定性的关键瓶颈。在这里，我们研究了 WS2 的 NaCl 辅助金属有机 CVD 生长，并揭示了由含 Na 和 W 的非晶态残留物驱动的耦合物理化学降解机制。暴露在空气中后，这些残留物会结晶并机械破坏 WS2 层，同时形成吸湿且富含钠的环境，从而驱动 W-S 键的氧化分解。动力学分析建立了热激活降解过程，表观激活能为~0.22 eV，与水分驱动的残留物结晶一致。我们证明，生长后退火（PGA）可以消除这些残留物，并在一个月规模的环境储存中保持形态完整性和光学发射特性。除了消除残留物之外，PGA 还可以促进多层过度生长区域中显着的 3R 堆积富集。第一性原理计算表明，层间 Na+ 在热力学上有利于 3R 注册，因此在退火的早期富 Na 阶段会选择 3R，并在 Na+ 被去除后进行动力学锁定。这些结果将残留物管理确立为盐辅助二维材料合成的中心设计原则。

title: Strength of Interlayer Metal–Metal Coupling as Key Active Site Configuration and Atomic Descriptor for Single-Atom Catalysts
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Single-atom catalysts (SACs) are widely considered for large-scale applications due to their exceptional activity, selectivity, and near-unity atom economy, where active-site configuration is critical. Yet how the active site regulates catalytic performance remains incompletely understood. A long-standing example is layered Fe-N-C, which shows a large discrepancy between theoretical predictions and experimental oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) activity, limiting rational design and predictability. Here, guided by X-ray absorption fine structure (XAFS) observations and supported by simulations and machine learning, we identify a stacked bilayer metal-metal coupling (MMC) configuration as an important active-site motif in these catalysts. Without invoking constant-potential treatments or surface hydroxyl coverage, our model, constructed within the standard computational hydrogen electrode (CHE) framework, reproduces the experimental activity and reconciles theory with experiment, supporting MMC as a plausible and important mechanistic contributor to ORR. By constructing and comparing 15 single-layer (SL) and MMC configurations, we quantify how metal-metal coupling strength governs activity and establish a criterion for selecting appropriate modeling strategies based on coupling intensity. Using machine learning and data mining, we further identify local electronic-structure descriptors that enable quantitative structure-activity relationships to guide catalyst design. Finally, we synthesize a series of molecular catalysts featuring bilayer MMC motifs or isolated single-metal sites, thereby experimentally validating the proposed structural motif and its role in ORR characteristics. This discovery provides guidance for the rational design of SACs and highlights that physically faithful active-site modeling is a prerequisite for predictive theory, with transferable implications for electrocatalytic systems beyond ORR.
title_zh: 层间金属-金属耦合作为单原子催化剂关键活性位点构型和原子描述符的强度
abstract_zh: 单原子催化剂（SAC）因其卓越的活性、选择性和近乎统一的原子经济性而被广泛考虑用于大规模应用，其中活性位点的配置至关重要。然而，活性位点如何调节催化性能仍不完全清楚。一个长期存在的例子是层状 Fe-N-C，它显示理论预测与实验氧还原反应 (ORR) 活性之间存在巨大差异，限制了合理设计和可预测性。在这里，在 X 射线吸收精细结构 (XAFS) 观察的指导下，并在模拟和机器学习的支持下，我们确定了堆叠双层金属-金属耦合 (MMC) 构型作为这些催化剂中重要的活性位点基序。在不调用恒电位处理或表面羟基覆盖的情况下，我们的模型在标准计算氢电极 (CHE) 框架内构建，重现了实验活动并使理论与实验相一致，支持 MMC 作为 ORR 的合理且重要的机制贡献者。通过构建和比较 15 种单层 (SL) 和 MMC 配置，我们量化了金属-金属耦合强度如何控制活性，并建立了基于耦合强度选择适当建模策略的标准。利用机器学习和数据挖掘，我们进一步确定了局部电子结构描述符，使定量的结构-活性关系能够指导催化剂设计。最后，我们合成了一系列具有双层MMC​​图案或孤立的单金属结构的分子催化剂

title: Neural mechanisms of time-forward predictions for naturalistic auditory tone sequences
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Prediction of future events is essential for guiding effective actions in dynamic environments. Studies on the neural mechanisms for time-forward predictions have typically used stimuli with relatively simple statistical regularities. Here, we investigated time-forward predictions using stimuli containing statistical regularities similar to those found in natural auditory stimuli. Using intracranial EEG recordings in neurosurgical patients, we found that prediction signals were primarily carried by low-frequency activity across widespread cortical regions, including sensory, parietal, and frontal areas. Prediction-error (PE) signals were found in both low- and high-frequency activity, with high-frequency components localized mainly to sensory areas. Contrary to previous hypotheses, prediction and PE signals did not show a clear spatial or spectral segregation. Directed connectivity between brain regions decreased over the course of the stimulus sequence as predictability increased, except for pathways originating from the parietal cortex. These results reveal integrative and distributed predictive processing and highlight the dorsal auditory pathway in time-forward prediction.
title_zh: 自然听觉音调序列的时间前向预测的神经机制
abstract_zh: 对未来事件的预测对于指导动态环境中的有效行动至关重要。对时间向前预测的神经机制的研究通常使用具有相对简单的统计规律的刺激。在这里，我们使用包含类似于自然听觉刺激中发现的统计规律的刺激来研究时间向前预测。使用神经外科患者的颅内脑电图记录，我们发现预测信号主要由广泛皮质区域的低频活动携带，包括感觉、顶叶和额叶区域。在低频和高频活动中都发现了预测误差（PE）信号，其中高频成分主要集中在感觉区域。与之前的假设相反，预测和 PE 信号没有显示出明显的空间或光谱分离。随着可预测性的增加，大脑区域之间的定向连接随着刺激序列的过程而减少，除了源自顶叶皮层的通路之外。这些结果揭示了综合和分布式预测处理，并强调了时间向前预测中的背侧听觉通路。

title: Unravelling the key factors governing O2 evolution upon charging a reversible LiOH-based nonaqueous Li | |O2 battery
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Achieving a reversible four-electron-per-oxygen-molecule oxygen evolution reaction is an essential yet highly challenging task for nonaqueous lithium hydroxide-based Li | |O2 batteries, as the kinetically sluggish oxygen evolution reaction tends to entangle with competing parasitic reactions, whose origins and mitigating strategies remain largely elusive. Here we construct a highly reversible lithium hydroxide-based Li | |O2 battery using iron–cobalt–nickel layered double hydroxide catalysts and tetramethylene sulfone-based electrolytes. Lithium hydroxide decomposition toward oxygen evolution involves key reactive oxygen species of surface-bound hydroxyl and hydroxyl radicals, but no singlet oxygen. These hydroxyl species corrode the electrolyte and carbon support, predominantly accounting for charging irreversibility. While oxidation-resistant solvents and electrical conductors are necessary to reduce hydroxyl-induced side reactions, the synergistic interplay of interfacial water solvation and catalytic surface structures hold the key to steering hydroxyl activity toward the desirable oxygen evolution reaction or by-product formation. This work offers insights into achieving long-life lithium hydroxide-based Li | |O2 batteries.

title: Direct correspondence between liquid and glass polymorphism in densely packed metallic alloys
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Liquid and glass are two closely related disordered states of matter. Whether each can exhibit two or more structurally distinct yet chemically identical forms have been debated for decades and the relationship between polymorphism in equilibrium liquids and that in non-equilibrium glasses remains elusive. Here, we address these long-standing issues in two prototype glass-forming metallic alloys using in situ high-pressure high-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction in diamond anvil cells. We identify distinct liquids above their melting temperatures and corresponding glasses formed upon melt quenching at different pressures, as evidenced by reproducible discontinuous changes in multiple diffraction-derived structural descriptors. Comprehensive structural and compositional characterizations consistently demonstrate that the recovered samples are fully amorphous and chemically homogeneous glasses. By continuously monitoring the formation and transformation pathways with in situ structural probes, our study provides compelling experimental evidence for the more general existence of liquid and glass polymorphism in densely packed metallic alloy systems.
title_zh: 致密金属合金中液体和玻璃多晶型之间的直接对应关系
abstract_zh: 液体和玻璃是两种密切相关的无序物质状态。每种物质是否可以表现出两种或多种结构上不同但化学上相同的形式已经争论了几十年，平衡液体中的多晶型与非平衡玻璃中的多晶型之间的关系仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们利用金刚石砧池中的原位高压高温同步加速器 X 射线衍射技术解决了两种原型玻璃形成金属合金中长期存在的问题。我们识别出高于其熔化温度的不同液体以及在不同压力下熔融淬火时形成的相应玻璃，如多个衍射衍生的结构描述符中可再现的不连续变化所证明的那样。全面的结构和成分表征一致表明，回收的样品是完全无定形且化学均匀的玻璃。通过使用原位结构探针持续监测形成和转变途径，我们的研究为密集金属合金系统中更普遍存在液体和玻璃多晶型现象提供了令人信服的实验证据。

title: Unveiling surface and subsurface atomic vacancies in MoS2 with lateral force microscopy
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Atomic-scale defects govern materials properties, with their influence amplified in low-dimensional systems. Understanding and controlling such defects is therefore essential for both fundamental science and technological applications. However, precise defect identification and localization remain major challenges. Lateral force microscopy (LFM), an atomic force microscopy mode that measures friction forces through the lateral torsion of the cantilever, is an appealing technique for probing surface properties. Nevertheless, it has conventionally been regarded as insensitive to structural features beneath the topmost atomic layer. In this study, we overturn this paradigm by demonstrating that LFM can not only detect but also classify atomic vacancies in MoS2 according to their depth. By combining experiments with molecular dynamics and Prandtl-Tomlinson (PT) modeling, we identify unique frictional fingerprints associated with each defect type: surface vacancies produce a characteristic ’drop-and-rise’ signature, whereas subsurface vacancies generate a pronounced exit barrier without an entry drop. While molecular dynamics validates these specific MoS2 signatures, the PT model reveals a generic, geometric lattice-disruption mechanism, extending the validity of our findings beyond MoS2. Furthermore, we apply these findings to compare the defect density and defect types in MoS2 flakes obtained via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and mechanical exfoliation.
title_zh: 用横向力显微镜揭示 MoS2 中的表面和次表面原子空位
abstract_zh: 原子尺度的缺陷控制着材料的特性，其影响在低维系统中被放大。因此，了解和控制这些缺陷对于基础科学和技术应用都至关重要。然而，精确的缺陷识别和定位仍然是主要挑战。横向力显微镜 (LFM) 是一种通过悬臂横向扭转测量摩擦力的原子力显微镜模式，是探测表面特性的一种颇具吸引力的技术。然而，传统上它被认为对最顶层原子层下方的结构特征不敏感。在本研究中，我们通过证明 LFM 不仅可以检测而且可以根据深度对 MoS2 中的原子空位进行分类，从而推翻了这一范式。通过将实验与分子动力学和 Prandtl-Tomlinson (PT) 模型相结合，我们确定了与每种缺陷类型相关的独特摩擦指纹：表面空位产生特征性的“下降和上升”特征，而地下空位则产生明显的出口势垒，而没有入口下降。虽然分子动力学验证了这些特定的 MoS2 特征，但 PT 模型揭示了一种通用的几何晶格破坏机制，将我们研究结果的有效性扩展到 MoS2 之外。此外，我们应用这些发现来比较通过化学气相沉积 (CVD) 和机械剥离获得的 MoS2 薄片中的缺陷密度和缺陷类型。

title: Rapid quasi-periodic reconfiguration of the accretion column in pulsar 1A 0535+262
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Accretion onto strongly magnetised neutron stars is commonly interpreted using quasi-steady models, in which the accretion-column structure adjusts smoothly to the mass inflow rate. The cyclotron line in the X-ray spectrum, whose centroid energy traces the magnetic field strength and thus the height of the line-forming region, provides a key diagnostic of this structure. Whether this simple quasi-steady description remains valid on short dynamical timescales has remained uncertain. Here we show that, during a giant outburst of the X-ray pulsar 1A 0535+262, quasi-periodic hard X-ray flux variations are accompanied by synchronised oscillations of the cyclotron line energy, with amplitudes exceeding those expected from simple accretion-rate fluctuations. The anti-correlation between cyclotron energy and apparent flux provides direct spectral-timing evidence for rapid changes in the line-forming region, which we interpret as geometric reconfiguration of the accretion column. The variability emerges in the luminosity regime where radiation pressure becomes dynamically important. These results reveal limitations of a simple quasi-steady interpretation for this source and suggest that radiation-supported columns can enter intrinsically dynamical states in high-luminosity accreting pulsars.
title_zh: 脉冲星 1A 0535+262 中吸积柱的快速准周期重构
abstract_zh: 强磁化中子星上的吸积通常使用准稳态模型来解释，其中吸积柱结构平滑地调整到质量流入速率。 X射线光谱中的回旋加速器线，其质心能量追踪磁场强度，从而追踪线形成区域的高度，提供了对该结构的关键诊断。这种简单的准稳态描述在短动态时间尺度上是否仍然有效仍然不确定。在这里，我们表明，在 X 射线脉冲星 1A 0535+262 的巨大爆发期间，准周期硬 X 射线通量变化伴随着回旋加速器线能量的同步振荡，其幅度超出了简单吸积率波动所预期的幅度。回旋加速器能量和表观通量之间的反相关性为线形成区域的快速变化提供了直接的光谱定时证据，我们将其解释为吸积柱的几何重新配置​​。变化性出现在光度范围内，其中辐射压变得动态重要。这些结果揭示了对该源的简单准稳态解释的局限性，并表明辐射支持的柱可以在高光度吸积脉冲星中进入本质动态状态。

title: Propagation effects in high harmonic generation media driven by bright squeezed vacuum light
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Recent developments in quantum light engineering have enabled the use of infrared bright squeezed vacuum (BSV) femtosecond pulses in nonlinear optics, including strong-field physics and high-harmonic generation. However, theory has focused on single-atom interactions, neglecting the crucial macroscopic aspect of light propagation through media. This raises a key question: How does BSV propagate in nonlinear media, and how this affects the nonlinear signals and the radiation’s quantumness? We address this with a fully quantized framework for propagation in gas media undergoing high-harmonic generation. We find that ionization and the associated photon losses cause decoherence, which limits the propagation length, degrades radiation’s quantumness, and reduces the emitted harmonics. However, these effects are not detrimental. We identify conditions that minimize propagation-induced decoherence while preserving detectable harmonics with super-Poissonian photon statistics. Our results establish fully quantized basis for exploring BSV in nonlinear optics, strong-field-quantum optics, and ultrafast science in all states of matter.
title_zh: 明亮压缩真空光驱动的高次谐波产生介质中的传播效应
abstract_zh: 量子光工程的最新发展使得红外亮压缩真空（BSV）飞秒脉冲能够在非线性光学中使用，包括强场物理和高次谐波产生。然而，理论集中于单原子相互作用，忽略了光通过介质传播的关键宏观方面。这就提出了一个关键问题：BSV 如何在非线性介质中传播，以及这如何影响非线性信号和辐射的量子性？我们通过一个完全量化的框架来解决这个问题，该框架用于在发生高次谐波产生的气体介质中传播。我们发现电离和相关的光子损失会导致退相干，从而限制传播长度，降低辐射的量子性，并减少发射的谐波。然而，这些影响并不是有害的。我们确定了最小化传播引起的退相干的条件，同时通过超泊松光子统计保留可检测的谐波。我们的结果为在所有物质状态下探索非线性光学、强场量子光学和超快科学中的 BSV 奠定了完全量化的基础。

title: Author Correction: Photothermal effects control ultrafast charge transport in titanium carbide MXenes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
title_zh: 作者更正：光热效应控制碳化钛 MXene 中的超快电荷传输

title: Reversibly Stacked Monolithic 3D Integrated Circuits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Monolithic three-dimensional integration enables dense vertical stacking of devices with fine-pitch interconnects, offering a promising route toward high-density, energy-efficient logic and memory systems. However, its implementation is constrained by the thermal budget of back-end-of-line processes, which must remain below 400 °C to avoid degrading underlying circuitry. While various low-temperature semiconductors have been explored, current demonstrations remain confined to fixed stacking sequences due to high-temperature growth or transfer requirements. Here, we demonstrate a M3D complementary field-effect transistor architecture using low-temperature-deposited n-type In2O3 and p-type Te semiconductors. This platform resolves existing thermal constraints, demonstrating the design freedom to reverse n- and p-type sequences. This capability enables the integration of CMOS inverters, multilayer logic stacks, and a fully functional 3D SRAM storage cell, all fabricated below 300 °C. This scalable platform provides a practical pathway for constructing vertically integrated complementary logic with intrinsic interconnects, paving the way for next-generation 3D system-on-chip technologies.
title_zh: 可逆堆叠单片 3D 集成电路
abstract_zh: 单片三维集成可实现具有细间距互连的器件的密集垂直堆叠，为实现高密度、节能逻辑和存储系统提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，其实施受到后端工艺热预算的限制，后端工艺必须保持在 400°C 以下，以避免降低底层电路的性能。尽管已经探索了各种低温半导体，但由于高温生长或转移要求，当前的演示仍然局限于固定的堆叠顺序。在这里，我们展示了使用低温沉积的 n 型 In2O3 和 p 型 Te 半导体的 M3D 互补场效应晶体管架构。该平台解决了现有的热限制，展示了反转 n 型和 p 型序列的设计自由度。此功能可实现 CMOS 反相器、多层逻辑堆栈和功能齐全的 3D SRAM 存储单元的集成，所有这些均在 300 °C 以下制造。该可扩展平台为构建具有内在互连的垂直集成互补逻辑提供了实用途径，为下一代 3D 片上系统技术铺平了道路。

title: Bound states in doped charge transfer insulators
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding the physics of doped charge transfer insulators is the most important problem in high-temperature superconductivity. In this work, we show that an in-gap bound state emerges from the localized hole of the doped charge transfer insulator. We propose an approximate ground state wavefunction based on one localized Zhang-Rice singlet and the Néel state. By calculating the excitation states with one hole added and removed from this ground state, we successfully identify the existence of bound states inside the charge transfer gap. This feature is further confirmed by a Lanczos calculation based on matrix product states (MPS) for a system of 4 × 4 CuO2 unit cells. How these bound states evolve into metallic states is further discussed. Our findings identify the key component of recent STM results on lightly doped Ca2CuO2Cl2 and provide a new understanding of hole-doped charge transfer insulators.
title_zh: 掺杂电荷转移绝缘体中的束缚态
abstract_zh: 了解掺杂电荷转移绝缘体的物理原理是高温超导中最重要的问题。在这项工作中，我们证明了带隙内束缚态从掺杂电荷转移绝缘体的局域空穴中出现。我们提出了一种基于局部张赖斯单线态和尼尔态的近似基态波函数。通过计算在基态上添加和去除一个空穴的激发态，我们成功地识别了电荷转移间隙内束缚态的存在。基于 4 × 4 CuO2 晶胞系统的矩阵积态 (MPS) 的 Lanczos 计算进一步证实了这一特性。进一步讨论了这些束缚态如何演化成金属态。我们的研究结果确定了轻掺杂 Ca2CuO2Cl2 近期 STM 结果的关键组成部分，并提供了对空穴掺杂电荷转移绝缘体的新认识。

title: Fractal hierarchy enables exponential scaling of topological boundary states
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Exponential growth describes an extremely rapid process ubiquitous in mathematics and across diverse physical, biological, and technological systems. Here, we introduce a class of fractal-inspired lattices that combine long-range periodic order with self-similar hierarchy, establishing a structural motif that enables exponential scaling of topological boundary states. We demonstrate this phenomenon in (i) a quasi-one-dimensional lattice chain constructed from Koch-curve unit cells and (ii) a two-dimensional periodic tiling lattice composed of Sierpiński-gasket unit cells. We show that, for suitable coupling parameters, both the number of topological boundary states Nℓ" role="presentation">Nℓ{N}_{{\ell}} and the number of topological minigaps Mℓ" role="presentation">Mℓ{M}_{{\ell}} grow exponentially with the fractal generation index ℓ" role="presentation">ℓ{\ell}. We find that Nℓ" role="presentation">Nℓ{N}_{{\ell}} is an integer multiple of Mℓ" role="presentation">Mℓ{M}_{{\ell}}, with the integer determined by the underlying symmetry. This hierarchical scaling law is captured by the multi-topological-phase theory and confirmed experimentally in laser-written photonic lattices. Our results identify fractal hierarchy as a design principle for controlling boundary-state multiplicity, revealing a fundamental interplay between topology, self-similar geometry, and periodic order. More broadly, this work suggests a route toward synthetic materials and integrated photonic platforms in which large numbers of robust boundary modes can be engineered within hierarchically structured architectures.
title_zh: 分形层次结构可以实现拓扑边界状态的指数缩放
abstract_zh: 指数增长描述了数学中以及不同的物理、生物和技术系统中普遍存在的极其快速的过程。在这里，我们引入了一类受分形启发的晶格，它将长程周期顺序与自相似层次结构相结合，建立了一个能够实现拓扑边界状态指数缩放的结构基序。我们在（i）由科赫曲线晶胞构成的准一维晶格链和（ii）由谢尔宾斯基垫片晶胞构成的二维周期性平铺晶格中证明了这种现象。我们发现，对于合适的耦合参数，拓扑边界态的数量 Nℓ" role="presentation">Nℓ{N}_{{\ell}} 和拓扑小间隙的数量 Mℓ" role="presentation">Mℓ{M}_{{\ell}} 随着分形生成指数 ℓ" role="presentation">ℓ{\ell} 呈指数增长。我们发现 Nℓ" role="presentation">Nℓ{N}_{{\ell}} 是 Mℓ" role="presentation">Mℓ{M}_{{\ell}} 的整数倍，其整数由基础对称性决定。这种分层缩放定律由多拓扑相理论捕获，并在激光写入光子晶格中得到实验证实。我们的结果将分形层次确定为控制边界态多重性的设计原理，揭示了拓扑之间的基本相互作用，更广泛地说，这项工作提出了一条通往合成材料和集成光子平台的途径，在该平台中可以设计大量鲁棒的边界模式。

title: Realization of the Bienenstock-Cooper-Munro rule in a single memristor
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neuromorphic computing aims to build electronic systems that mimic the brain’s remarkable efficiency and adaptability. A key feature of brain is homeostatic plasticity, which stabilizes neural activity; the Bienenstock–Cooper–Munro (BCM) rule accurately describes this by adjusting a neuron’s sensitivity threshold based on past activity. However, implementing the homeostatic rule in synaptic device remains challenging. Here we show that a CuInP₂S₆ memristor naturally realizes the complete BCM rule. We reveal that the device’s intrinsic junction capacitance generates reverse spikes that cause spike-rate-dependent conductance depression, combining with second-order ionic dynamics to replicate key BCM features. Through simulations, we demonstrate that adding a similar capacitance can universally enable this behavior in conventional memristors. Finally, we build a physical reservoir computing system based on this strategy that exhibits robust, noise-tolerant spatiotemporal processing. This work provides a viable path for deploying adaptive homeostatic plasticity in hardware, enhancing the reliability of neuromorphic systems.
title_zh: 在单个忆阻器中实现 Bienenstock-Cooper-Munro 规则
abstract_zh: 神经形态计算旨在构建模仿大脑卓越效率和适应性的电子系统。大脑的一个关键特征是稳态可塑性，它可以稳定神经活动。 Bienenstock-Cooper-Munro (BCM) 规则通过根据过去的活动调整神经元的敏感度阈值准确地描述了这一点。然而，在突触装置中实施稳态规则仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了 CuInP2S₆ 忆阻器自然地实现了完整的 BCM 规则。我们发现，该器件的固有结电容会产生反向尖峰，从而导致尖峰速率相关的电导下降，并与二阶离子动力学相结合来复制关键的 BCM 特征。通过模拟，我们证明添加类似的电容可以在传统忆阻器中普遍实现这种行为。最后，我们基于该策略构建了一个物理油藏计算系统，该系统具有鲁棒、耐噪声的时空处理能力。这项工作为在硬件中部署自适应稳态可塑性提供了一条可行的途径，从而增强了神经形态系统的可靠性。

title: Deep Learning Predicts Dissimilar DNA-DNA Binding and Engineers Hyperconnected Networks
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Common frameworks in molecular bioengineering and synthetic biology focus on orthogonality, viewing weak or non-specific interactions as problems to avoid. This constrains the usable sequence space, limits scalability, and neglects scenarios where synthetic systems must operate within natural backgrounds of high sequence diversity. Harnessing the full space is difficult because models are lacking that can accurately and quickly predict non-orthogonal interactions and be validated against ground truth data. Here we develop BINND — Binding and Interaction Neural Network for DNA — using DNA-DNA interactions as a testbed. BINND combines an ultra-high throughput platform measuring millions of interactions with a deep learning model attaining accuracies above 80%, generalizing across diverse sequences and running 50 times faster than current models. We demonstrate its value with a searchable DNA network of fictitious storybook characters. BINND enables accurate prediction for diagnostics, bioengineering, and DNA origami, supporting a shift toward exploiting the full sequence space.
title_zh: 深度学习预测不同的 DNA-DNA 结合并设计超连接网络
abstract_zh: 分子生物工程和合成生物学的通用框架侧重于正交性，将弱或非特异性相互作用视为需要避免的问题。这限制了可用的序列空间，限制了可扩展性，并忽略了合成系统必须在高序列多样性的自然背景下运行的场景。利用整个空间很困难，因为缺乏能够准确、快速预测非正交相互作用并根据地面实况数据进行验证的模型。在这里，我们使用 DNA-DNA 相互作用作为测试平台开发 BINND（DNA 结合和相互作用神经网络）。 BINND 将测量数百万次交互的超高吞吐量平台与深度学习模型相结合，准确率达到 80% 以上，可泛化不同的序列，运行速度比当前模型快 50 倍。我们通过虚构故事书中人物的可搜索 DNA 网络展示了它的价值。 BINND 能够准确预测诊断、生物工程和 DNA 折纸，支持向利用完整序列空间的转变。

title: Force-based reading and writing of individual single-atom magnets
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The integration of single-atom bits enables the realization of the highest data-density memory. Reading and writing information to these bits through mechanical interactions opens the possibility of operating the magnetic devices with low heat generation and high density recording. To achieve this visionary goal, we demonstrate the use of magnetic exchange force microscopy to read and write the spin orientation of individual holmium adatoms on MgO thin films. The spin orientation of the holmium adatom is stabilized by the strong uniaxial anisotropy of the adsorption site and can be read out by measuring the exchange forces between the magnetic tip and the atom. The spin orientation can be written by approaching the tip closer to the holmium adatom. We explain this writing mechanism by the symmetry reduction of the adsorption site of the Ho adatom. These findings demonstrate the potential for information storage with minimal energy loss and pave the way for a new field of atomic-scale mechano-spintronics.
title_zh: 基于力的单个单原子磁体的读写
abstract_zh: 单原子位的集成可以实现最高数据密度的存储器。通过机械相互作用向这些位读取和写入信息开启了以低热量产生和高密度记录操作磁性设备的可能性。为了实现这一愿景，我们演示了使用磁交换力显微镜来读取和写入 MgO 薄膜上单个钬吸附原子的自旋方向。钬吸附原子的自旋方向通过吸附位点的强单轴各向异性来稳定，并且可以通过测量磁性尖端和原子之间的交换力来读出。自旋方向可以通过使尖端更靠近钬吸附原子来写入。我们通过Ho吸附原子吸附位点的对称性还原来解释这种写入机制。这些发现证明了以最小能量损失存储信息的潜力，并为原子级机械自旋电子学的新领域铺平了道路。

title: Eight-qubit operation of a 300 mm SiMOS foundry-fabricated device
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform for quantum computing due to their high coherence, controllability, and CMOS manufacturability, yet scalable implementations have so far been limited to a few qubits. Here, to take a step towards larger qubit systems, we tune and coherently control an eight-dot linear array of silicon spin qubits fabricated in a 300 mm CMOS-compatible foundry process, establishing operational scalability beyond the two-qubit regime. All eight qubits are successfully tuned and characterized as four double-dot pairs, exhibiting Ramsey dephasing times T2∗" role="presentation">T2∗{T}_{2}^{*} up to 41(2) μs and Hahn-echo coherence times T2Hahn" role="presentation">T2Hahn{T}_{2}^{{{{\rm{Hahn}}}}} up to 1.31(4) ms. Readout of the central four qubits is achieved via a cascaded charge-sensing protocol, enabling high-fidelity measurements of the entire multi-qubit array in a two step process. Additionally, we demonstrate a two-qubit gate operation between adjacent qubits with low phase noise. We show that silicon spin qubit arrays can be scaled to medium-sized arrays of 8 qubits while maintaining system coherence.
title_zh: 300 mm SiMOS 代工制造器件的八量子位运行
abstract_zh: 硅自旋量子位因其高相干性、可控性和 CMOS 可制造性而成为量子计算的一个有前途的平台，但迄今为止可扩展的实现仅限于几个量子位。在这里，为了向更大的量子位系统迈出一步，我们调整并连贯地控制在 300 mm CMOS 兼容铸造工艺中制造的硅自旋量子位的八点线性阵列，建立超越两个量子位体系的操作可扩展性。所有八个量子位都成功调谐并表征为四个双点对，拉姆齐相干时间 T2*" role="presentation">T2*{T}_{2}^{*} 高达 41(2) μs，哈恩回波相干时间 T2Hahn" role="presentation">T2Hahn{T}_{2}^{{{{\rm{Hahn}}}}} 高达 1.31(4)女士。中央四个量子位的读出是通过级联电荷传感协议实现的，从而能够在两步过程中对整个多量子位阵列进行高保真测量。此外，我们还演示了具有低相位噪声的相邻量子位之间的双量子位门操作。我们证明，硅自旋量子位阵列可以扩展到 8 个量子位的中型阵列，同时保持系统的一致性。

title: Pathways to cost competitive and viable lithium production from Salton Sea geothermal brines
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Lithium supply chains remain heavily concentrated in hard rock and brine resources, creating significant supply risks. Geothermal brines represent an underutilized alternative, yet commercial progress is hindered by the absence of facility-scale cost assessments. Here, we present a techno-economic analysis of large-scale lithium extraction from Salton Sea geothermal brines, drawing on primary company disclosures, process patents, and brine resource modeling. Caused by varying lithium and impurity concentrations, brine dilution over time, and process configurations (e.g., production via carbonation and conversion vs. electrolysis), we find that large-scale production costs may reach ~10,000 United States dollars per ton, but increase up to 22,000 United States dollars per ton with higher certainty of brine modeling, raising concerns about economic competitiveness to conventional low-cost sources. Finally, a project feasibility-focused scenario analyses shows that leveraging brine pre-treatment by-product sales could lower long-term lithium break-even prices by ~5,000 United States dollars per ton, whereas capital cost optimization of 20% could further reduce lithium break-even prices by 10%.
title_zh: 从索尔顿海地热盐水中生产具有成本竞争力且可行的锂的途径
abstract_zh: 锂供应链仍然严重集中在硬岩和盐水资源中，造成了巨大的供应风险。地热盐水是一种未得到充分利用的替代方案，但由于缺乏设施规模的成本评估，商业进展受到阻碍。在这里，我们利用公司的主要披露信息、工艺专利和卤水资源模型，对从索尔顿海地热盐水中大规模提取锂进行了技术经济分析。由于锂和杂质浓度的变化、盐水随时间的稀释以及工艺配置（例如，通过碳酸化和转化与电解进行生产），我们发现大规模生产成本可能达到每吨约 10,000 美元，但随着盐水建模的确定性更高，每吨成本将增加至 22,000 美元，这引发了人们对传统低成本来源的经济竞争力的担忧。最后，以项目可行性为重点的情景分析表明，利用盐水预处理副产品销售可以将长期锂盈亏平衡价格降低约5,000美元/吨，而资本成本优化20%可以进一步将锂盈亏平衡价格降低10%。

title: Continuous electricity from charged total dissolved solids in wastewater using a wood-based ion-selective power generator
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Exploring the potential for secondary utilization of wastewater is a prudent strategy to achieve “take-make-use-reuse” circular economy. Taking advantages of wood’s hierarchical structure and large surface area, in this project, we fabricate surface-encapsulated anion-selective and cation-selective wood membranes (comprising up to 98% eco-friendly materials) through a two-step process: dip-coating with either positively charged 2(dimethylamino)ethyl methacrylate or negatively charged acrylic acid, followed by energy-efficient sunlight-induced polymerization. The output voltage and current of a single modified wood cell (20 × 20 × 3 mm3) in modulated wastewater from flue gas desulfurization are 55 mV and 0.6 µA, respectively, tenfold higher than that of untreated wood cells. When five cells are connected in series, the output voltage reaches 0.27 V, sufficient to power simple electronic devices. This underscores its potential for scaling up and its viability for future applications in industrial power plants.
title_zh: 使用木质离子选择性发电机从废水中带电的总溶解固体中连续发电
abstract_zh: 探索废水二次利用潜力是实现“取用-再利用-再利用”循环经济的审慎策略。利用木材的分层结构和大表面积的优势，在该项目中，我们通过两步工艺制造了表面封装的阴离子选择性和阳离子选择性木质膜（包含高达98％的环保材料）：用带正电的甲基丙烯酸2（二甲氨基）乙酯或带负电的丙烯酸浸涂，然后进行节能的阳光诱导聚合。烟气脱硫调制废水中单个改性木细胞​​（20×20×3 mm3）的输出电压和电流分别为 55 mV 和 0.6 µA，比未经处理的木细胞高十倍。当五个电池串联时，输出电压达到 0.27 V，足以为简单的电子设备供电。这强调了其扩大规模的潜力及其未来在工业发电厂应用的可行性。

title: Self-reconfiguring modular robotic boats
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Self-reconfiguring aquatic robots offer promise for a wide range of marine applications, including building temporary infrastructure, remote maintenance and search-and-rescue operations, environmental monitoring, and on-demand transportation. However, achieving autonomous water-based self-reconfiguration, even in two dimensions on the water surface, remains challenging, due to complex nonlinear hydrodynamics, disturbances from self-motion and neighboring robots, as well as external environmental factors. Here, we present the FloatForm platform, a group of miniature modular robotic boats capable of self-assembling into physically connected structures, self-reconfiguring, and collectively traveling as larger assemblies via a hybrid coordination framework. Each robot unit is equipped with onboard sensing, motion control, and the ability to coordinate and physically connect with its neighbors. We demonstrate the feasibility of aquatic self-reconfiguration via hybrid coordination, where distributed controllers on each robot handle coordination tasks such as aggregating into desired shapes and avoiding collisions, while a minimalist central planner oversees the overall success of each task and fixes final imperfections. This work advances the design, control, and coordination of modular robotic systems in aquatic environments, enabling flexible, robust, and scalable applications on the water.
title_zh: 自重构模块化机器人船
abstract_zh: 自重构水生机器人为广泛的海洋应用提供了前景，包括建造临时基础设施、远程维护和搜救行动、环境监测和按需运输。然而，由于复杂的非线性流体动力学、自运动和邻近机器人的干扰以及外部环境因素，即使在水面的二维空间中实现自主的水基自重构仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了 FloatForm 平台，这是一组微型模块化机器人船，能够自组装成物理连接的结构、自重新配置，并通过混合协调框架作为更大的组件集体行驶。每个机器人单元都配备了机载传感、运动控制以及与其邻居协调和物理连接的能力。我们证明了通过混合协调进行水生自我重构的可行性，其中每个机器人上的分布式控制器处理协调任务，例如聚合成所需的形状和避免碰撞，而极简中央规划器则监督每个任务的整体成功并修复最终的缺陷。这项工作推进了水生环境中模块化机器人系统的设计、控制和协调，实现了灵活、稳健和可扩展的水上应用。

title: Resolving human α versus β cell fate allocation for the generation of stem cell-derived islets
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stem cell-derived glucagon-(α) and insulin-producing (β) cells allow to engineer in vitro biomimetics of islet of Langerhans, the micro-organ controlling glycemia; however, a knowledge gap in the mechanism by which human stem cell-derived α and β cells are specified persists. Mouse studies postulated that Aristaless Related homeobox (Arx) and Paired box 4 (Pax4) transcription factors cross-inhibit each other in endocrine progenitors to promote α/β fate allocation, respectively. To test this model in human, we combine lineage labelling with single-cell multiomic analysis in our newly generated ARXCFP/CFP; PAX4mCherry/mCherry knock-in induced pluripotent stem cell reporter line. Lineage tracing, proteomic and gene regulatory network analysis and potency assays reveal a human specific regulation of α/β cell fate allocation. Pharmacological perturbations previously proposed to trigger α-to-β transdifferentiation or identified by our gene regulatory network lead to enhanced endocrine induction and directed α/β cell fate. Studying mechanisms of endocrinogenesis and fate segregation enables the engineering of islets in vitro, and has broader implications for cell-replacement therapy, disease modelling and drug screening.
title_zh: 解决人类 α 与 β 细胞命运分配以产生干细胞衍生的胰岛
abstract_zh: 干细胞衍生的胰高血糖素（α）和胰岛素生成（β）细胞可以在体外设计朗格汉斯岛（控制血糖的微器官）的仿生体；然而，对于人类干细胞衍生的α和β细胞的特定机制仍然存在知识空白。小鼠研究假设 Aristaless 相关同源盒 (Arx) 和配对盒 4 (Pax4) 转录因子在内分泌祖细胞中相互交叉抑制，分别促进 α/β 命运分配。为了在人体中测试这个模型，我们在新生成的 ARXCFP/CFP 中将谱系标记与单细胞多组学分析相结合； PAX4mCherry/mCherry 敲入诱导多能干细胞报告系。谱系追踪、蛋白质组学和基因调控网络分析以及效力测定揭示了人类对 α/β 细胞命运分配的特异性调控。先前提出的药理学扰动会触发α到β的转分化，或由我们的基因调控网络识别出，会导致内分泌诱导增强并定向α/β细胞命运。研究内分泌发生和命运分离的机制可以实现体外胰岛工程，并对细胞替代疗法、疾病建模和药物筛选具有更广泛的影响。

title: Selective Molecular Ion-Gating at Electrochemical Interfaces for Accelerated Lithium Extraction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: The selective recovery of lithium from complex brines in battery deionization (BDI) systems is constrained by the competitive adsorption and intercalation of chemically similar alkali ions at the solid-liquid interface. Although Faradaic lithium insertion materials exhibit high theoretical capacities, they often fail to provide the necessary selectivity to suppress the substantial competitive flux of coexisting sodium ions. Here, we report a molecular ion-gating strategy that decouples selectivity from capacity via interfacial engineering. By encapsulating the LiMn2O4 (LMO) core within an Aza-15-Crown-5 (A15C5)-functionalized graphene oxide (CGO) shell, we construct a core-shell LMO@CGO architecture that exhibits highly selective Li+ transport. Experimental results and kinetic modeling support that the [C10O5] macrocyclic rings function as selective ion gates, preferentially enriching Li+ at the interfacial region through coordination. This interfacial enrichment accelerates Li+ intercalation into the LMO lattice while suppressing competing cation transfer. When integrated into a BDI system, the LMO@CGO architecture achieves a highly competitive Li+/Na+ separation factor of 302.23 and a capacity of 19.8 mg·g-1 in raw Lagoco salt lake brine. Our findings demonstrate that bridging molecular-level gating with electrochemical Faradaic processes provides a promising interfacial design strategy for selective electrochemical lithium recovery from complex aqueous conditions.
title_zh: 电化学界面上的选择性分子离子门控加速锂提取
abstract_zh: 在电池去离子（BDI）系统中从复杂盐水中选择性回收锂受到固液界面化学相似碱离子的竞争吸附和嵌入的限制。尽管法拉第锂插入材料表现出较高的理论容量，但它们通常无法提供必要的选择性来抑制共存钠离子的大量竞争通量。在这里，我们报告了一种分子离子门控策略，该策略通过界面工程将选择性与容量分离。通过将 LiMn2O4 (LMO) 核封装在 Aza-15-Crown-5 (A15C5) 功能化氧化石墨烯 (CGO) 壳内，我们构建了具有高选择性 Li+ 传输的核壳 LMO@CGO 结构。实验结果和动力学模型支持[C10O5]大环作为选择性离子门，通过配位优先富集界面区域的Li+。这种界面富集加速了 Li+ 嵌入 LMO 晶格中，同时抑制竞争性阳离子转移。当集成到BDI系统中时，LMO@CGO架构在Lagoco盐湖原盐水中实现了极具竞争力的Li+/Na+分离因子302.23和19.8 mg·g-1的容量。我们的研究结果表明，桥接分子级门控与电化学法拉第过程为从复杂的水相条件中选择性电化学锂回收提供了一种有前途的界面设计策略。

title: A unified vision-language model for precision oncology and biomarker prediction in neuroblastoma
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Neuroblastoma is a leading cause of childhood cancer mortality, presenting persistent management challenges due to its biological heterogeneity and the limited accessibility of molecular profiling in routine practice. Here we present NEVA (NEuroblastoma Vision–language AI), a multimodal foundation model designed to address these barriers. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on frozen encoders and multiple instance learning, NEVA implements a pathologist-inspired hierarchical workflow with end-to-end optimization. Developed and evaluated in a large multi-institutional cohort of 1,238 patients across multiple centers, NEVA outperforms ten representative foundation models, including TITAN, UNI, and Virchow, across the majority of the 11 clinical tasks evaluated. The model demonstrates diagnostic capability, achieving Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curves of 0.916 for subtype classification, 0.823 for Shimada classification, and 0.806 for risk group stratification. Furthermore, NEVA predicts key molecular alterations from routinely available pathology data, reaching an AUROC of 0.924 for NMYC amplification and 0.830 for 1p36 deletion, while enabling prognostic stratification for progression-free and overall survival across multiple test cohorts. By integrating interpretable attention maps that localize histologically relevant regions, NEVA establishes a scalable framework for neuroblastoma risk stratification and clinical decision support.
title_zh: 用于神经母细胞瘤精准肿瘤学和生物标志物预测的统一视觉语言模型
abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤是儿童癌症死亡的主要原因，由于其生物异质性和常规实践中分子分析的可及性有限，带来了持续的管理挑战。在这里，我们介绍 NEVA（神经母细胞瘤视觉 - 语言人工智能），这是一种旨在解决这些障碍的多模式基础模型。与依赖冻结编码器和多实例学习的传统方法不同，NEVA 通过端到端优化实现了受病理学家启发的分层工作流程。 NEVA 在多个中心、由 1,238 名患者组成的大型多机构队列中进行开发和评估，在评估的 11 项临床任务的大部分中，其表现优于十种代表性基础模型，包括 TITAN、UNI 和 Virchow。该模型展示了诊断能力，亚型分类的接受者操作特征曲线下面积为 0.916，Shimada 分类为 0.823，风险组分层为 0.806。此外，NEVA 根据常规病理学数据预测关键分子改变，NMYC 扩增的 AUROC 为 0.924，1p36 缺失的 AUROC 为 0.830，同时能够对多个测试队列的无进展生存率和总生存率进行预后分层。通过整合定位组织学相关区域的可解释注意力图，NEVA 为神经母细胞瘤风险分层和临床决策支持建立了可扩展的框架。

title: BAM-BepA complexes in outer membrane protein quality control
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Correct folding of outer membrane proteins (OMPs) by the β-barrel assembly machinery (BAM) is essential for maintaining the outer membrane (OM) barrier function of diderm bacteria. When OMP biogenesis is perturbed, the β-barrel assembly enhancing protease A (BepA) binds to BAM to mediate quality control, but how BepA interacts with BAM and degrades substrate OMPs remains unclear. Here, cryoEM structures of BAM-bound BepA reveals that BepA induces large conformational changes in the BAM complex enabling the enzyme to poise its active site within the periplasmic ring of BAM, beneath the BamA barrel. The lid of BepA is dynamic, embedding two of its water-soluble helices deep into the membrane bilayer when BAM-bound, which readies BepA for proteolysis of misfolding OMPs. Movement of BepA’s plug is triggered by OMP binding rather than interaction with BAM, activating the enzyme for cleavage. We reveal BepA preferentially recognises Aromatic-X-Aromatic (Ar-X-Ar) motifs which are enriched in OMP sequences. The results reveal a mechanism for proteolytic degradation by BepA in OMP quality control which requires interaction with BAM, the membrane, and its OMP substrates.
title_zh: BAM-BepA 复合物在外膜蛋白质量控制中的应用
abstract_zh: β-桶组装机器 (BAM) 正确折叠外膜蛋白 (OMP) 对于维持二皮细菌的外膜 (OM) 屏障功能至关重要。当 OMP 生物发生受到干扰时，β-桶组装增强蛋白酶 A (BepA) 会与 BAM 结合以介导质量控制，但 BepA 如何与 BAM 相互作用并降解底物 OMP 仍不清楚。在这里，BAM 结合的 BepA 的冷冻电镜结构表明，BepA 会诱导 BAM 复合物发生较大的构象变化，使酶能够在 BamA 桶下方的 BAM 周质环内保持其活性位点。 BepA 的盖子是动态的，当 BAM 结合时，它的两个水溶性螺旋会深入嵌入膜双层中，从而为 BepA 准备好对错误折叠的 OMP 进行蛋白水解。 BepA 插头的运动是由 OMP 结合触发的，而不是与 BAM 相互作用，从而激活酶进行裂解。我们发现 BepA 优先识别富含 OMP 序列的 Aromatic-X-Aromatic (Ar-X-Ar) 基序。结果揭示了 OMP 质量控制中 BepA 蛋白水解降解的机制，需要与 BAM、膜及其 OMP 底物相互作用。

title: Phylo-Plex: a phylogenetically informed, low-cost amplicon sequencing platform for deployable high-resolution genomic epidemiology
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Genomic pathogen surveillance is a powerful tool for public health and research, but is costly and unachievable in low-resource settings. Most sub-genomic typing methods sacrifice resolution whilst remaining costly. We developed “Phylo-Plex”, a novel approach that identifies information-rich genomic regions to maximise phylogenetic information whilst minimising the number of regions. Applied to Treponema pallidum and Neisseria gonorrhoeae, we designed a high-resolution multiplex PCR sequencing scheme for lineage tracking pathogens with different extremes of genome variation. title: Kekulé superconductivity in twisted magic angle bilayer graphene
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: While it has been one of the most important new physics discoveries in the last decade, the nature of superconductivity in the twisted graphene family remains an unsolved problem. Motivated by recent scanning tunneling experiments that report Kekulé ordering in moiré graphene superconductors, we develop a microscopic theory of this superconductivity for the twisted bilayer system. The pairing we find is an intra-valley, finite-momentum pair-density wave (PDW) that intrinsically carries a Kekulé modulation. This state exhibits four salient features: (i) spontaneous breaking of C3 rotation symmetry, producing nematic order; (ii) triplet pairing; and (iii) a quasiparticle density of states that evolves from a V-shaped profile to a fully gapped, U-shaped spectrum as the attraction increases, which is accompanied by (iv) systematic behavior of the temperature dependent zero bias conductance. These features align with key experimental signatures. We find, as well, that with only modest interaction strengths, the state is near to a BEC-like phase, consistent with the observed extremely short coherence lengths. Taken together, these results identify a microscopic intra-valley Kekulé PDW as a compelling candidate for unconventional superconductivity in the twisted graphene family.
title_zh: 扭曲魔角双层石墨烯中的凯库勒超导
abstract_zh: 虽然它是过去十年中最重要的新物理发现之一，但扭曲石墨烯家族的超导性质仍然是一个未解决的问题。受最近报告莫尔石墨烯超导体凯库勒有序的扫描隧道实验的启发，我们开发了扭曲双层系统超导性的微观理论。我们发现的配对是谷内有限动量配对密度波（PDW），本质上带有凯库勒调制。这种状态表现出四个显着特征：（i）C3旋转对称性自发破缺，产生向列有序； (ii) 三联体配对； (iii) 随着吸引力的增加，准粒子态密度从 V 形轮廓演变为完全带隙的 U 形谱，同时伴随着 (iv) 温度相关的零偏置电导的系统行为。这些功能与关键的实验特征相一致。我们还发现，只要有适度的相互作用强度，该状态就接近类似 BEC 的相位，这与观察到的极短相干长度一致。综上所述，这些结果表明微观谷内 Kekulé PDW 是扭曲石墨烯家族中非常规超导性的有力候选者。

title: The distribution of Earth’s wind-blown sand dunes
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Sand dunes develop when there is a source of sediment and adequate wind. Dune morphology and occurrence can then be used to infer sediment source distribution and formative climate conditions. This is useful where direct climate observation is challenging on Earth, other planets, and the past. However, there has been no complete and accurate digital map of the occurrence of Earth’s sand dunes with distinguishable morphologies. Here we present that map and demonstrate that in arid environments dune presence is mostly explained by convergent transport and source proximity, whereas in wetter climates wind strength is an additional constraint. By limiting analysis to dunes identified from globally available imagery and topographic data, we produce a consistent dataset useful for inferring myriad aspects of geology and climate, and improving understanding of aeolian landscapes. We provide an example, using barchan dune orientations, to demonstrate a trade-off between inference of sediment and wind characteristics.
title_zh: 地球风沙丘的分布
abstract_zh: 当有沉积物来源和足够的风时，沙丘就会形成。沙丘形态和发生情况可用于推断沉积物来源分布和形成气候条件。当地球、其他行星和过去的直接气候观测具有挑战性时，这非常有用。然而，目前还没有完整、准确的、具有可区分形态的地球沙丘出现的数字地图。在这里，我们展示了该地图并证明，在干旱环境中，沙丘的存在主要是通过汇聚运输和来源接近来解释的，而在潮湿的气候中，风力强度是一个额外的限制。通过限制对从全球可用图像和地形数据中识别的沙丘进行分析，我们生成了一致的数据集，可用于推断地质和气候的各个方面，并提高对风沙景观的理解。我们提供了一个示例，使用新月形沙丘方向来演示沉积物推断和风特征之间的权衡。

title: Preferential nitrogen retention characterizes current eutrophication in United States lakes
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The relative retention of nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) in lakes and their roles in nutrient cycling remain debated. Although the United States has implemented long-term P control measures in lakes, inexplicable eutrophication exacerbation still reoccurred over the past two decades. Here we geographically track and analyze the nutrient retention changes of 121 lakes in the USA during 2012-2022 using a combination of machine learning and Bayesian hierarchical methods. We find that the preferential retention of P in 70.3% lakes in 2012 shifted to that of N in 85.1% lakes in 2017, and 92.6% lakes in 2022. Four key lake indicators exhibit flickering-like dynamics, which may help identify the nutrient metabolic disorder-like state in the aquatic ecosystem. Overall, our results show that eutrophication in U.S. lakes during 2012-2022 is advancing on the basis of preferential and net nutrient retention shift from P to N, flickering-like dynamics, and associated occurrence of the nutrient metabolic disorder-like state that are all predominantly driven by internal cycling instead of external loading. These patterns are consistent with the possibility of a regime shift rather than simple eutrophication recurrence, and provide insights relevant to lake management and water quality improvement strategies.
title_zh: 优先氮滞留是美国湖泊当前富营养化的特征
abstract_zh: 湖泊中氮（N）和磷（P）的相对保留及其在养分循环中的作用仍然存在争议。尽管美国对湖泊实施了长期的控磷措施，但近二十年来，莫名其妙的富营养化加剧现象仍然反复出现。在这里，我们结合机器学习和贝叶斯分层方法，对美国 121 个湖泊在 2012 年至 2022 年期间的养分保留变化进行地理跟踪和分析。我们发现，2012年70.3%的湖泊对磷的优先保留转移到2017年85.1%的湖泊和2022年92.6%的湖泊对氮的优先保留。四个关键湖泊指标表现出闪烁的动态，这可能有助于识别水生生态系统中的营养代谢紊乱状态。总体而言，我们的结果表明，2012-2022 年美国湖泊的富营养化正在以优先和净养分保留从 P 到 N 的转变、闪烁状动态以及相关的营养物代谢紊乱状态的发生为基础，这些都主要由内部循环而不是外部负荷驱动。这些模式与状态转变的可能性一致，而不是简单的富营养化复发，并提供了与湖泊管理和水质改善策略相关的见解。

title: Aligning climate and air quality goals demands early VOC control for China’s ozone pollution
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Global surface ozone (O3), intensified by climate change, poses increasing health and ecosystem threats. Despite stringent air policies, China’s persistent O3 pollution exemplifies a global challenge intertwined with climate actions reshaping emission pathways. Optimal mitigation remains contentious, primarily due to inconsistent conclusions regarding the sensitivity of summer regional O3 formation. Here we show the path dependency in O3 mitigation strategies for synergistic clean air and climate action goal achievement over multidecade scales. This path dependence is validated by observed concurrent plateaus (2020-2023) in deweathered O3 concentrations and sensitivity trends across Chinese megacity clusters. Leveraging this understanding of path dependency, we quantitatively reveal that the optimal future strategy involves prioritizing early volatile organic compound reductions, as their high effectiveness for regional O3 mitigation gradually diminishes towards 2050. This challenges prevailing nitrogen oxides priority paradigms. Our work reframes O3 control, providing a paradigm for resilient air quality-climate governance.
title_zh: 协调气候和空气质量目标需要尽早控制中国的臭氧污染
abstract_zh: 全球表面臭氧 (O3) 因气候变化而加剧，对健康和生态系统构成越来越大的威胁。尽管有严格的空气政策，中国持续存在的臭氧污染体现了与重塑排放途径的气候行动交织在一起的全球挑战。最佳缓解仍然存在争议，主要是由于关于夏季区域 O3 形成的敏感性的结论不一致。在这里，我们展示了数十年尺度上协同清洁空气和气候行动目标实现的 O3 减排策略的路径依赖。这种路径依赖性通过观察到的中国特大城市群除风化 O3 浓度和敏感性趋势的同时稳定期（2020-2023 年）得到了验证。利用对路径依赖的这种理解，我们定量地揭示了最佳的未来策略包括优先考虑早期挥发性有机化合物的减排，因为它们对区域 O3 减排的高效性在 2050 年之前逐渐减弱。这对现行的氮氧化物优先范式提出了挑战。我们的工作重新构建了 O3 控制，为弹性空气质量气候治理提供了范例。

title: Caloric restriction improves glycemic control via the adiponectin–ceramide axis in non-obese men and women: the CALERIE™ 2 randomized controlled trial
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Caloric restriction (CR) improves metabolic health across species, but the molecular mediators of its effects in humans remain incompletely defined. In a 24-month non-blinded randomized controlled trial (Clinicaltrial.gov: NCT00427193) of non-obese (BMI 22-27.9 kg/m2) men and premenopausal women aged 21 to 50 years, we assessed prespecified outcomes. Participants were randomized to an ad libitum or CR diet. We found that CR was associated with increased high-molecular-weight (HMW) adiponectin and reduced circulating ceramide species implicated in insulin resistance, including C16:0, C18:0, and C24:0. Mediation analysis indicated that reductions in ceramides were statistically compatible with partial mediation of the CR-associated improvements in insulin secretion, insulin sensitivity, and IGF-1 signaling markers. These effects were most pronounced at 12 months and attenuated by 24 months, suggesting partial metabolic adaptation over time. Overall, our findings are consistent with a model in which CR remodels bioactive lipid profiles and may enhance glucose metabolism in part through an adiponectin-ceramide-linked mechanism, highlighting a potential therapeutic axis for enhancing metabolic health.
title_zh: 热量限制通过脂联素-神经酰胺轴改善非肥胖男性和女性的血糖控制：CALERIE™ 2 随机对照试验
abstract_zh: 热量限制（CR）可以改善物种间的代谢健康，但其对人类影响的分子介导因素仍未完全确定。在一项针对 21 至 50 岁非肥胖（BMI 22-27.9 kg/m2）男性和绝经前女性的为期 24 个月的非盲随机对照试验（Clinicaltrial.gov：NCT00427193）中，我们评估了预先设定的结果。参与者被随机分为随意饮食或 CR 饮食。我们发现 CR 与高分子量 (HMW) 脂联素增加和与胰岛素抵抗有关的循环神经酰胺种类减少有关，包括 C16:0、C18:0 和 C24:0。中介分析表明，神经酰胺的减少与 CR 相关的胰岛素分泌、胰岛素敏感性和 IGF-1 信号标记物改善的部分中介作用在统计学上是一致的。这些影响在 12 个月时最为明显，并在 24 个月时减弱，表明随着时间的推移会出现部分代谢适应。总体而言，我们的研究结果与 CR 重塑生物活性脂质谱并可能部分通过脂联素-神经酰胺相关机制增强葡萄糖代谢的模型一致，突出了增强代谢健康的潜在治疗轴。

title: Climatic reach of small-scale turbulence in the ocean interior
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Small-scale turbulent mixing in the ocean interior is vital in governing ocean circulation and tracer distributions, and hence global climate. However, the planetary extent of this role and its dependence on the microphysics of mixing remain inadequately understood. Here, we emphasize the variety of spatio-temporal scales on which such interior turbulent mixing can shape the climate system. In addition to its well-established role in facilitating the equilibration of deep branches of ocean circulation on centennial-to-millennial timescales, interior turbulent mixing is a leading determinant of oceanic tracer budgets on timescales as short as sub-annual. We highlight the importance of the co-dependence of vertical (diapycnal) mixing and lateral (isopycnal) stirring in establishing the large-scale impacts of oceanic turbulence. We conclude with a summary of theoretical, observational and computational bottlenecks in the way of a sufficiently accurate representation of mixing in Earth System Models, and discuss emerging opportunities for making progress in these areas.
title_zh: 海洋内部小规模湍流的气候范围
abstract_zh: 海洋内部的小规模湍流混合对于控制海洋环流和示踪剂分布乃至全球气候至关重要。然而，这种作用的全球范围及其对混合微观物理的依赖性仍然没有得到充分的了解。在这里，我们强调这种内部湍流混合可以塑造气候系统的时空尺度的多样性。除了在百年到千年的时间尺度上促进海洋环流深层分支平衡方面的既定作用外，内部湍流混合还是短至亚年时间尺度上的海洋示踪剂预算的主要决定因素。我们强调了垂直（双重）混合和横向（等重）搅拌的相互依赖性在确定海洋湍流的大规模影响方面的重要性。最后，我们总结了在地球系统模型中充分准确地表示混合的理论、观测和计算瓶颈，并讨论了在这些领域取得进展的新机会。

title: Proteome-scale quantification of the interactions driving condensate formation of intrinsically disordered proteins
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cellular organization in the form of biomolecular condensates is a fundamental regulatory mechanism across all forms of life. Formation of condensates relies on multivalent interactions that are often weak and transient, making them challenging to study experimentally. We have developed Condensate Partitioning by mRNA-Display (CPmD) to measure these interactions from the partition free energies of peptides and nucleic acids into reconstituted condensates. CPmD increases experimental throughput by several orders of magnitude, and we apply it to reveal the interactions driving condensate formation of intrinsically disordered proteins. We show that the partition free energies of about one hundred thousand peptides derived from the disordered proteome into a model condensate directly reflect their intrinsic propensity to form condensates. We reveal that amino acid content, linked to hydrophobicity, is the primary determinant of phase behavior. Additionally, CPmD uniquely resolves subtle sequence-dependent contributions that can encode specificity. CPmD thus provides a powerful tool to decipher how weak interactions between protein and RNA regulate biological function through condensate formation.
title_zh: 驱动本质无序蛋白质凝结物形成的相互作用的蛋白质组规模量化
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体形式的细胞组织是所有生命形式的基本调节机制。冷凝物的形成依赖于多价相互作用，这些相互作用通常很弱且短暂，这使得它们难以进行实验研究。我们开发了 mRNA-Display 冷凝分配 (CPmD)，用于测量肽和核酸分配自由能到重构冷凝中的相互作用。 CPmD 将实验通量提高了几个数量级，我们应用它来揭示驱动本质无序蛋白质的凝聚物形成的相互作用。我们表明，来自无序蛋白质组的约十万个肽进入模型凝聚物的分配自由能直接反映了它们形成凝聚物的内在倾向。我们发现，与疏水性相关的氨基酸含量是相行为的主要决定因素。此外，CPmD 独特地解决了可以编码特异性的微妙序列依赖性贡献。因此，CPmD 提供了一个强大的工具来破译蛋白质和 RNA 之间的弱相互作用如何通过冷凝物形成来调节生物功能。

title: An integrated, scaled approach to resolve TSC2 variants of uncertain significance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Obtaining a precise genetic tuberous sclerosis complex diagnosis is a challenge as many missense TSC2 variants are variants of uncertain significance. Variants of uncertain significance in TSC2 have been resolved by one-at-a-time functional assays, but these assays cannot scale to the 3634 TSC2 missense variants of uncertain significance observed so far. To address this challenge, we use massively parallel sequencing to measure the steady-state abundance of almost 9000 TSC2 missense variants and develop an mTOR pathway activity assay using genome editing and cell sorting to generate activity scores for 391 missense variants. We observe that 1256 of 8864 (14.17%) missense variants assayed have altered TSC2 abundance, and 69 of 391 (17.65%) missense variants assayed have altered mTOR pathway activity. Calibration and integration of these data into classification of variants identified in a clinical cohort putatively reclassifies 212 of 276 (76.8%) TSC2 missense variants of uncertain significance. These datasets will lead to improved genetic diagnosis of tuberous sclerosis complex with potential positive impacts on the clinical management of patients and their families.
title_zh: 解决意义不确定的 TSC2 变体的集成、规模化方法
abstract_zh: 获得精确的遗传性结节性硬化症诊断是一项挑战，因为许多错义 TSC2 变异是意义不确定的变异。 TSC2 中意义不确定的变体已通过一次性功能测定解决，但这些测定无法扩展到迄今为止观察到的 3634 个意义不确定的 TSC2 错义变体。为了应对这一挑战，我们使用大规模并行测序来测量近 9000 个 TSC2 错义变体的稳态丰度，并使用基因组编辑和细胞分选开发 mTOR 通路活性测定，以生成 391 个错义变体的活性评分。我们观察到，检测的 8864 个错义变体中有 1256 个（14.17%）改变了 TSC2 丰度，检测的 391 个错义变体中有 69 个（17.65%）改变了 mTOR 通路活性。将这些数据校准并整合到临床队列中识别的变异分类中，推测重新分类了 276 个 (76.8%) TSC2 意义不确定的 TSC2 错义变异中的 212 个。这些数据集将改进结节性硬化症的基因诊断，对患者及其家人的临床管理产生潜在的积极影响。

title: Asymmetric temperature responses to soil moisture drought legacies under anthropogenic forcing
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: As anthropogenic forcing intensifies, soil moisture droughts have become prevalent across many regions. Soil moisture anomalies can influence near-surface air temperature by modulating both energy and carbon fluxes. However, the annual temperature response to soil moisture anomalies in the year following a soil moisture drought remains unclear. Here, we show that annual soil water loss in the year after soil moisture droughts induces a larger annual warming effect than the annual cooling from an equivalent water gain. This asymmetric response arises only when the effects of anthropogenic greenhouse gas forcing are included, where vegetation is more strongly suppressed after soil moisture drought than enhanced after soil moisture gaining, contributing to reduced transpiration and carbon uptake that collectively amplify warming. More than 60% of global land areas exhibit the asymmetry. Our findings suggest that past climate extremes may accelerate future warming by impairing vegetation’s capacity to regulate biophysical and biogeochemical processes.
title_zh: 人为强迫下土壤水分干旱遗产的不对称温度响应
abstract_zh: 随着人为强迫的加剧，许多地区土壤水分干旱已变得普遍。土壤湿度异常可以通过调节能量和碳通量来影响近地表空气温度。然而，土壤水分干旱后一年的温度对土壤水分异常的响应仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，土壤水分干旱后一年的年度土壤水流失比等量增水带来的年度降温产生更大的年度变暖效应。这种不对称反应只有在考虑了人为温室气体强迫的影响时才会出现，即土壤水分干旱后植被受到的抑制比土壤水分增加后植被的增强更强，从而导致蒸腾和碳吸收减少，从而共同加剧变暖。全球超过 60% 的陆地面积表现出不对称性。我们的研究结果表明，过去的极端气候可能会损害植被调节生物物理和生物地球化学过程的能力，从而加速未来的变暖。
